## Referência: references/squad/archive/orphan-sops/SOP-SLIDES-003.yaml

```yaml
# ============================================================
# SOP-SLIDES-003: Slide Deck Creation — Brand-Agnostic LLM Reference
# Stack: React + TypeScript + Framer Motion + Tailwind
# All brand values use {{handlebars}} — resolve before use
# ============================================================

sop:
  id: "SOP-SLIDES-003"
  version: "1.1.0"
  title: "Slide Deck Creation — Brand-Agnostic LLM Reference"
  purpose: "Enable LLM agents to generate slide decks for ANY brand using React/TSX/Framer Motion"
  consumer: "llm_agent"
  stack: "React + TypeScript + Framer Motion + Tailwind CSS"

  classification:
    domain: "design-system"
    category: "slide-creation-agnostic"
    risk_level: "medium"
    compliance_tags: ["WCAG-2.2-AA"]
  status: "DRAFT"
  effective_date: "2026-03-16"

  # --- Brand Configuration Schema ------------------------------------------
  # EVERY {{placeholder}} must be resolved before generating code.
  brand_config:
    identity:
      name: "{{brand.name}}"
      prefix: "{{brand.prefix}}"
      url: "{{brand.url}}"
      tagline: "{{brand.tagline}}"

    colors:
      bg_primary:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.bg_primary}}"
        description: "Dark background (80% of slides)"
        example: "#050505"
      bg_accent:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.bg_accent}}"
        description: "Accent/highlight background for section breaks, emphasis"
        example: "#D1FF00"
      surface:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.surface}}"
        description: "Cards, panels, internal containers"
        example: "#111111"
      text_primary:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.text_primary}}"
        description: "Primary text on dark background"
        example: "#FFFDD0"
      text_secondary:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.text_secondary}}"
        description: "Secondary/dim text. MUST be >= #777777 for WCAG AA"
        example: "#999999"
        constraint: "hex value must yield >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio on bg_primary"
      accent:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.accent}}"
        description: "Inline highlights, emphasis, chart primary color"
        example: "#D1FF00"
      border:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.border}}"
        description: "Borders, dividers, separators"
        example: "#222222"
      warning:
        placeholder: "{{brand.color.warning}}"
        description: "Warning/negative accent (used in COMPARISON 'before' side)"
        example: "#FF4444"

    fonts:
      sans:
        placeholder: "{{brand.font.sans}}"
        description: "Primary sans-serif font family"
        example: "Geist"
      sans_fallback:
        placeholder: "{{brand.font.sans_fb}}"
        description: "Fallback for sans"
        example: "system-ui, sans-serif"
      mono:
        placeholder: "{{brand.font.mono}}"
        description: "Monospace font for labels, data, code"
        example: "Geist Mono"
      mono_fallback:
        placeholder: "{{brand.font.mono_fb}}"
        description: "Fallback for mono"
        example: "monospace"

    contrast_requirements:
      - combo: "text_primary on bg_primary"
        minimum: 4.5
        grade: "AA"
        preferred: 7.0
      - combo: "accent on bg_primary"
        minimum: 4.5
        grade: "AA"
      - combo: "text_secondary on bg_primary"
        minimum: 4.5
        grade: "AA"
        hard_rule: "text_secondary hex must be >= #777777"
      - combo: "bg_primary on bg_accent"
        minimum: 4.5
        grade: "AA"
    validation: "IF any contrast fails → DO NOT PROCEED. Adjust brand colors."

  # --- CSS Variables to Generate -------------------------------------------
  css_variables:
    colors:
      "--slide-bg": "{{brand.color.bg_primary}}"
      "--slide-accent": "{{brand.color.bg_accent}}"
      "--slide-surface": "{{brand.color.surface}}"
      "--slide-text": "{{brand.color.text_primary}}"
      "--slide-text-dim": "{{brand.color.text_secondary}}"
      "--slide-border": "{{brand.color.border}}"
      "--slide-warning": "{{brand.color.warning}}"
    fonts:
      "--font-slide-sans": '"{{brand.font.sans}}", {{brand.font.sans_fb}}'
      "--font-slide-mono": '"{{brand.font.mono}}", {{brand.font.mono_fb}}'
    typography_scale:
      "--slide-title-xl": "clamp(48px, 6.8vw, 130px)"
      "--slide-title-lg": "clamp(40px, 3.3vw, 64px)"
      "--slide-title-md": "clamp(32px, 2.5vw, 48px)"
      "--slide-body": "clamp(24px, 1.9vw, 36px)"
      "--slide-caption": "clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 28px)"
      "--slide-label": "clamp(13px, 0.7vw, 14px)"
    spacing:
      "--slide-space-xs": "clamp(4px, 0.4vw, 8px)"
      "--slide-space-sm": "clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 16px)"
      "--slide-space-md": "clamp(16px, 1.7vw, 32px)"
      "--slide-space-lg": "clamp(32px, 3.3vw, 64px)"
      "--slide-space-xl": "clamp(64px, 5vw, 96px)"
    margins:
      "--slide-margin-x": "clamp(48px, 7.3vw, 200px)"
      "--slide-margin-top": "clamp(40px, 5vw, 136px)"
      "--slide-margin-bottom": "clamp(24px, 2.1vw, 40px)"
    floor: "13px — no text below this in any viewport"
    palco_label_min: "16px effective"

  # --- Shared Module API ---------------------------------------------------
  api:
    font_constants:
      FONT_SANS: '{ fontFamily: "var(--font-slide-sans)" }'
      FONT_MONO: '{ fontFamily: "var(--font-slide-mono)" }'
      rule: "EVERY text element MUST have style={FONT_SANS} or style={FONT_MONO} inline"

    animations:
      fadeUp: { y: 20, duration: 0.5, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "titles, text" }
      fadeIn: { duration: 0.4, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "backgrounds" }
      slideRight: { x: -40, duration: 0.6, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "from left" }
      slideLeft: { x: 40, duration: 0.6, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "from right" }
      scaleIn: { scale: 0.88, duration: 0.45, ease: "SPRING", use: "cards, metrics" }
      growWidth: { scaleX: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "horiz lines" }
      growHeight: { scaleY: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "SMOOTH", use: "vert lines, bars" }
      stagger: { formula: "base + i * 0.08", default_base: 0.1 }
    easing:
      EASE_SMOOTH: [0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1]
      EASE_SPRING: [0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1]

    components:
      SlideLayout: { renders: "1920x1080 motion.div", bg: "var(--slide-bg)", text: "var(--slide-text)", font: "FONT_SANS" }
      SectionTag: { props: "label, delay?", style: "mono, uppercase, tracking, text-dim" }
      CornerMarks: { props: "color?, opacity?", default: "var(--slide-accent) 0.3", constraint: "max 2 per section" }
      WatermarkNumber: { props: "n, className?", renders: "16rem, accent color, 4% opacity" }
      MetaBar: { props: "left, center?, right", renders: "56px bar, border-bottom" }
      TechFrame: { props: "children, className?", renders: "12px corner clips", constraint: "max 2 per slide" }

    patterns:
      inline_highlight: 'style={{ background: "var(--slide-accent)", color: "var(--slide-bg)", padding: "0.05em 0.2em" }}'
      max_highlights_per_slide: 2
      page_footer: "Inline div, absolute bottom, 3-part: section — number — brand.name"

  # --- Format Guide ---------------------------------------------------------
  format_guide:
    ted_keynote: { mode: "palco", slides: "40-90", bullets: "NEVER", text: "minimal", dominant: ["STATEMENT", "IMAGE", "METRIC"], rule: "slide supports narrator" }
    pitch_deck: { mode: "palco+async", slides: "10-15", data: "essential", font_min: "30pt", versions: 2, fatal: "We have no competition" }
    sales_deck: { mode: "palco+async", slides: "8-25", framework: "SCR", leave_behind: "autonomous seller" }
    technical: { mode: "palco", code: "legitimate", code_font: "20pt", backup: "5-10 slides", test: "step back 2m" }
    zoom_virtual: { mode: "live", movements_per_min: 2, interaction_every: "3-5 min", slide_is_focus: true }
    carousel_stories: { mode: "async", ratio: "9:16 or 1:1", slides: "5-10", bullets: "NEVER", first: "hook", last: "CTA" }

  # --- Decision Trees -------------------------------------------------------
  decisions:
    format:
      - { condition: "TED, keynote, inspirational", result: "ted_keynote" }
      - { condition: "VC, investor, fundraising", result: "pitch_deck" }
      - { condition: "sales call, B2B, demo", result: "sales_deck" }
      - { condition: "conference, engineering, technical", result: "technical" }
      - { condition: "Zoom, Teams, virtual call", result: "zoom_virtual" }
      - { condition: "Instagram, LinkedIn, Stories", result: "carousel_stories" }
      - { condition: "default", result: "determine mode directly" }

    mode:
      - condition: "context in [conference, keynote, workshop]"
        result: { mode: "palco", max_words: 15, min_font: "2.2vw", whitespace: 50, animations: true, notes: true }
      - condition: "context in [youtube, twitch, screenshare]"
        result: { mode: "live", max_words: 15, min_font: "2.2vw", whitespace: 45, animations: true, delay_reduction: 0.3, safe_right: "20%", safe_bottom: "15%", notes: true }
      - condition: "context in [post_event, course, pdf]"
        result: { mode: "async", max_words: 30, min_font: "1.6vw", whitespace: 40, animations: false, notes: false }

    aspect_ratio:
      - { condition: "projector/monitor/stream", result: "16:9 1920x1080" }
      - { condition: "macbook", result: "16:10 1920x1200" }
      - { condition: "stories/reels", result: "9:16 1080x1920" }
      - { condition: "instagram/carousel", result: "1:1 1080x1080" }
      - { condition: "default", result: "16:9 1920x1080" }

    slide_type:
      - { content: "opening/title/speaker", type: "TITLE" }
      - { content: "section transition", type: "SECTION_BREAK" }
      - { content: "impact phrase", type: "STATEMENT" }
      - { content: "third-party quote", type: "QUOTE" }
      - { content: "bullets/keywords", type: "CONTENT" }
      - { content: "before/after, A vs B", type: "COMPARISON" }
      - { content: "1-3 big numbers", type: "METRIC" }
      - { content: "chart/graph/table", type: "DATA_VIZ" }
      - { content: "photo/screenshot", type: "IMAGE" }
      - { content: "step-by-step/timeline", type: "BUILD" }
      - { content: "code snippet", type: "CODE" }
      - { content: "CTA/thank you", type: "CLOSING" }

  # --- Slide Types (compact rules) -----------------------------------------
  slide_types:
    TITLE:
      position: "first"
      title: { token: "title_xl", weight: 900, max_words: 5 }
      decoratives: ["CornerMarks", "MetaBar"]
      layout: ["full_center", "left_with_visual"]
      screen_time_s: [10, 15]

    SECTION_BREAK:
      title: { token: "title_lg", weight: 900, max_words: 3 }
      layout: "full_center"
      footer: false
      backgrounds: ["bg_primary", "bg_accent"]
      screen_time_s: [3, 5]

    STATEMENT:
      text: { token: ["title_xl", "title_lg"], weight: 900 }
      max_words: 10
      max_highlights: 2
      background: "bg_primary only"
      min_whitespace: 60
      screen_time_s: [5, 10]

    QUOTE:
      extends: "STATEMENT"
      has_attribution: true
      visual_quotes: true
      quote_font: "mono"

    CONTENT:
      section_tag: true
      title: { token: "title_lg", weight: 900 }
      items: { token: "body", count: [3, 4], format: "keywords not sentences" }
      footer: "PageFooter"
      layout: "left_aligned"
      min_whitespace: 50
      screen_time_s: [20, 40]

    COMPARISON:
      sides: 2
      items_per_side: [2, 3]
      split: ["50_50", "60_40"]
      differentiation: "color + form, NEVER color alone"
      screen_time_s: [20, 40]

    METRIC:
      count: [1, 3]
      value: { token: "title_xl", weight: 900, font: "mono" }
      label: { token: "caption", weight: 500 }
      animation: "scaleIn stagger 0.15"
      screen_time_s: [10, 20]

    DATA_VIZ:
      title_rule: "conclusion not description"
      chart_min_area: "60%"
      max_series: 3
      colors: { primary: "accent", secondary: "text@60%", tertiary: "text_dim" }
      differentiation: "color + pattern"
      allowed: { bar_v: 6, bar_h: 8, line: "12pts/2lines", donut: 4, table: "4x5" }
      prohibited: ["scatter", "heatmap", "treemap", "sankey"]
      screen_time_s: [30, 60]

    IMAGE:
      min_area: "60%"
      caption_max_words: 8
      overlay: "bg_primary gradient 60-80%"
      min_resolution: "1920px"
      max_size: "500KB webp"
      anti_patterns: ["stock", "no_context", "pixelated", "watermark", "unrelated"]
      screen_time_s: [5, 15]

    BUILD:
      steps: [2, 5]
      active_opacity: 1.0
      future_opacity: 0.15
      async_mode: "all visible"
      screen_time_s_per_step: [15, 30]

    CODE:
      font: "mono"
      min_size: "body"
      max_lines: 12
      overflow: "split into 2 slides"
      rule: "NEVER screenshot code"
      screen_time_s: [30, 60]

    CLOSING:
      position: "last"
      message: { token: "title_lg", weight: 900, max_words: 5 }
      rule: "text CTA only, no clickable buttons"
      screen_time_s: [10, 20]

  # --- Sequence -------------------------------------------------------------
  sequence:
    first: "TITLE"
    last: "CLOSING"
    section_breaks: "between thematic blocks"
    max_consecutive_same_type: 3
    max_slide_duration_s: 120
    rhythm_patterns:
      - { seq: ["STATEMENT", "CONTENT", "CONTENT"], effect: "impact-detail-detail" }
      - { seq: ["METRIC", "DATA_VIZ", "CONTENT"], effect: "number-context-explain" }
      - { seq: ["IMAGE", "STATEMENT"], effect: "visual-emotional" }
      - { seq: ["COMPARISON", "STATEMENT"], effect: "contrast-conclusion" }

  # --- Animation Rules ------------------------------------------------------
  animation_rules:
    async: "skip all"
    live: "reduce delays 30%"
    palco: "normal"
    max_types_per_slide: 3
    max_total_delay_s: 1.5
    max_flash_per_second: 3
    animate: ["sequential_steps", "impact_reveal", "build", "comparative_charts"]
    skip: ["decorative_bg", "slide_title", "content_all_at_once"]

  # --- Validation -----------------------------------------------------------
  validation:
    per_slide:
      - "single idea"
      - "3-second comprehension"
      - "font inline style on every text"
      - "all colors via var(--slide-*) — zero hardcoded hex"
      - "whitespace >= mode min"
      - "zero paragraphs (async: max 1)"
      - "zero buttons"
      - "alt text on images"
      - "unique accessible title"
    killer_items:
      - "contrast < WCAG AA"
      - "missing font inline style"
      - "> 15 words palco/live"
      - "paragraph palco/live"
      - "code screenshot"
      - "text_secondary < #777777"
      - "hardcoded brand color hex"
    per_sequence:
      - "first=TITLE, last=CLOSING"
      - "section breaks between blocks"
      - "no slide > 2min"
      - "max 3 consecutive same type"

  # --- Anti-Patterns --------------------------------------------------------
  anti_patterns:
    - "text paragraphs"
    - "font < body in palco"
    - "> 4 bullets palco/live"
    - "clickable buttons"
    - "hover effects"
    - "fill all space"
    - "> 3 colors per slide"
    - "animations > 1.5s"
    - "hardcoded px sizing"
    - "code screenshots"
    - "stock photos"
    - "> 1 chart per slide"
    - "color-only differentiation"
    - "no accessible title"
    - "hardcoded hex colors (breaks portability)"

  # --- Metadata -------------------------------------------------------------
  metadata:
    created_by: "Gerber (SOP Creator Agent)"
    created_at: "2026-03-16T00:00:00Z"
    tags: ["slides", "llm", "brand-agnostic", "react", "framer-motion"]
    review_cycle: "P180D"
    change_log:
      - version: "1.1.0"
        date: "2026-03-16"
        author: "Gerber (SOP Creator Agent)"
        summary: "svh (not dvh), Format Guide (TED/Pitch/Sales/Technical/Zoom/Carousel), format decision tree, PEAT 2017 note."
      - version: "1.0.0"
        date: "2026-03-16"
        author: "Gerber (SOP Creator Agent)"
        summary: "Initial version. Brand-agnostic adaptation of SOP-SLIDES-002. All AIOX tokens replaced with {{brand.*}} handlebars. Code examples use CSS vars. Brand config schema with contrast validation gate."
```


## Referência: references/squad/archive/orphan-tests/e2e-visual-andragogic.yaml

```yaml
# =============================================================================
# E2E Test Specification: Visual + Andragogic Integration
# Story 5.1 — EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 5
#
# PURPOSE: Defines WHAT to verify when running the full slides-creator v2
# pipeline with ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=true and education_mode=true.
# This is a TEST SPECIFICATION, not runtime code.
#
# DEPENDENCIES:
#   - andragogic-rules.yaml (9 rules in education mode)
#   - visual-engines.yaml (6 engines, routing table, budget caps)
#   - cost-tracking.yaml (budget guardrails, cost log)
#   - semantic-classification.yaml (12 content types, engine auto-selection)
#   - generate-presentation.yaml (7-phase pipeline workflow)
# =============================================================================

e2e_test:
  id: e2e-visual-andragogic-001
  name: "E2E Integration Test — Visual + Andragogic"
  story: "5.1"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  sprint: 5
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TEST SCENARIO
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  scenario:
    description: >
      Gerar um deck educacional de 20 slides sobre "Arquitetura de
      Microsservicos" com todas as feature flags v2 ativas. O deck deve
      exercitar o pipeline completo: briefing -> content -> visual strategy ->
      template binding -> asset resolution -> render -> QA gate -> release.
      Deve ativar tanto o motor visual (diagramas + AI images) quanto o
      motor andragogico (Kolb + DPC + Mayer + Scaffolding).
    slide_count: 20
    feature_flags:
      ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION: true
      ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION: true
    pipeline_entry: "*create-presentation"
    pipeline_workflow: "generate-presentation.yaml"
    expected_phases:
      - youtube_ingest (bypassed — input_type != youtube_url)
      - briefing_contract
      - reference_intake
      - grounded_content
      - visual_strategy
      - template_binding
      - asset_resolution
      - render_to_site_aiox
      - qa_gate
      - release_gate

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAMPLE BRIEFING
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  sample_briefing:
    description: >
      Briefing de entrada para o teste. Simula um pedido real de deck
      educacional sobre arquitetura de microsservicos para equipe de
      desenvolvedores intermediarios.

    briefing:
      title: "Arquitetura de Microsservicos: Do Monolito ao Cloud-Native"
      objective: >
        Capacitar desenvolvedores a entender quando e como decompor
        aplicacoes monoliticas em microsservicos, incluindo trade-offs,
        padroes de comunicacao, e estrategias de deploy.
      audience:
        role: "Desenvolvedores Backend"
        company_size: "50-200 funcionarios"
        dreyfus_level: "advanced_beginner"
        prior_knowledge: >
          Familiaridade com REST APIs, Docker basico, e pelo menos
          uma linguagem de programacao server-side.
      education_mode: true
      delivery_mode: "async"
      aspect_ratio: "16:9"
      slide_count: 20
      language: "pt-BR"
      brand:
        name: "TechEdu Academy"
        palette: ["#2563EB", "#1E40AF", "#DBEAFE", "#1F2937", "#F9FAFB"]
        typography:
          heading_font: "Inter"
          body_font: "Inter"
        style_preference: "flat"
        background: "white"
      modules:
        - name: "Fundamentos"
          description: "O que sao microsservicos, contexto historico, monolito vs microsservicos"
          estimated_slides: 5
        - name: "Padroes de Comunicacao"
          description: "REST, gRPC, mensageria assincrona, event-driven"
          estimated_slides: 5
        - name: "Estrategias de Decomposicao"
          description: "Domain-driven design, strangler fig, bounded contexts"
          estimated_slides: 5
        - name: "Deploy e Observabilidade"
          description: "Containers, orquestracao, CI/CD, logging, tracing"
          estimated_slides: 5
      reference_assets: []
      source_materials: []

    expected_content_types_distribution:
      process: 3-5
      hierarchy: 1-2
      comparison: 2-3
      system: 2-3
      concept: 2-3
      data: 1-2
      cycle: 1-2
      definition: 1-2
      timeline: 0-1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VALIDATION CHECKLIST
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  validation_checklist:

    # --- AC1: Deck educacional de 20 slides gerado --------------------------
    - id: VC-01
      acceptance_criteria: "AC1"
      name: "Deck Generation Completeness"
      description: >
        Deck educacional de 20 slides gerado com education_mode=true e
        ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=true. Pipeline completa sem erros.
      validation_type: structural
      check:
        - "deck-manifest.json exists and is valid JSON"
        - "deck-manifest.json.slides.length == 20"
        - "deck-manifest.json.briefing.education_mode == true"
        - "ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION was true during pipeline execution"
        - "Pipeline completed all 7 phases without BLOCK errors"
        - "release-summary.md exists"
      pass_criteria:
        slides_count: 20
        education_mode: true
        visual_generation: true
        pipeline_complete: true
      fail_if:
        - "slides.length != 20"
        - "pipeline halted at any phase with unresolved BLOCK"
        - "education_mode is false or absent in manifest"

    # --- AC2: >= 60% visual coverage -----------------------------------------
    - id: VC-02
      acceptance_criteria: "AC2"
      name: "Visual Coverage"
      description: >
        Pelo menos 60% dos slides de conteudo (excluindo TITLE e CLOSING)
        devem ter um visual gerado — diagrama (d2/mermaid) ou imagem AI
        (gpt_image/ideogram/recraft) ou data viz (plotly).
      validation_type: quantitative
      check:
        - "Count slides where slide_type == 'CONTENT'"
        - "Count CONTENT slides where visual_strategy.engine != 'none' AND visual_output exists"
        - "Calculate: (visual_slides / content_slides) * 100"
      pass_criteria:
        metric: visual_coverage_pct
        threshold: ">= 60%"
        formula: "(content_slides_with_visual / total_content_slides) * 100"
      expected_outcome: >
        Com 20 slides (estimando ~2 TITLE + 1 CLOSING = 17 CONTENT slides),
        pelo menos 11 slides devem ter visual gerado. Esperado: 12-14 visuais
        (3-4 concept sem visual: definition, quote, statement).
      fail_if:
        - "visual_coverage_pct < 60%"

    # --- AC3: Brand compliance >= 95% ----------------------------------------
    - id: VC-03
      acceptance_criteria: "AC3"
      name: "Brand Compliance"
      description: >
        >= 95% dos visuais gerados devem passar validateBrandCompliance.
        Cores usadas devem estar dentro da palette do briefing. Nenhum visual
        com forbidden_colors.
      validation_type: quantitative
      check:
        - "For each VisualOutput: check metadata.brand_compliance.compliant"
        - "Count compliant visuals vs total visuals"
        - "Calculate: (compliant / total) * 100"
      pass_criteria:
        metric: brand_compliance_pct
        threshold: ">= 95%"
        formula: "(compliant_visuals / total_visuals) * 100"
      expected_outcome: >
        Com palette ["#2563EB", "#1E40AF", "#DBEAFE", "#1F2937", "#F9FAFB"],
        diagramas D2/Mermaid devem usar theme injection para cores da marca.
        AI images devem receber brand injection via prompt suffix.
        Esperado: 100% compliance em diagramas, >= 90% em AI images.
      fail_if:
        - "brand_compliance_pct < 95%"
        - "any visual uses forbidden_colors"

    # --- AC4: Mayer compliance >= 8/12 principios ----------------------------
    - id: VC-04
      acceptance_criteria: "AC4"
      name: "Mayer CTML Compliance"
      description: >
        Pelo menos 8 dos 12 principios de Mayer devem estar satisfeitos
        no deck. Os 3 always-on (MAYER-01, MAYER-06, K9) sao obrigatorios.
        MAYER-05 (contiguidade espacial) e verificado em education mode.
      validation_type: quantitative
      check:
        - "Run andragogic validation engine against deck-manifest.json"
        - "Count Mayer principles satisfied (no violations per principle)"
        - "MAYER-01 (multimedia): zero violations"
        - "MAYER-06 (segmentation): zero HIGH violations"
        - "MAYER-05 (spatial contiguity): zero MEDIUM violations"
        - "K9 (killer — overload): zero CRITICAL violations"
      pass_criteria:
        metric: mayer_principles_satisfied
        threshold: ">= 8/12"
        mandatory_principles: ["MAYER-01", "MAYER-06", "K9"]
      mayer_principles_checklist:
        - id: "MAYER-01"
          name: "Multimedia"
          validation: "andragogic_rules.always_on_rules[MAYER-01]"
          mandatory: true
        - id: "MAYER-02"
          name: "Spatial Contiguity (basic)"
          validation: "visual + text on same slide"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-03"
          name: "Temporal Contiguity"
          validation: "animation/build order respects narrative"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-04"
          name: "Coherence"
          validation: "no extraneous content per slide"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-05"
          name: "Spatial Contiguity (strict)"
          validation: "andragogic_rules.education_mode_only_rules[MAYER-05]"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-06"
          name: "Segmentation"
          validation: "andragogic_rules.always_on_rules[MAYER-06]"
          mandatory: true
        - id: "MAYER-07"
          name: "Pre-training"
          validation: "K8 — jargon pre-trained before use"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-08"
          name: "Modality"
          validation: "audio narration (async mode — speaker notes exist)"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-09"
          name: "Redundancy"
          validation: "no redundant on-screen text for narrated content"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-10"
          name: "Signaling"
          validation: "visual cues highlight key points"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-11"
          name: "Voice"
          validation: "conversational tone in speaker notes"
          mandatory: false
        - id: "MAYER-12"
          name: "Image"
          validation: "consistent visual style across deck"
          mandatory: false
      expected_outcome: >
        Mandatory principles (MAYER-01, MAYER-06, K9) devem ter zero violacoes.
        Com education_mode, MAYER-05 e MAYER-07 (via K8) tambem sao validados.
        Esperado: 8-10/12 principios satisfeitos.
      fail_if:
        - "mayer_principles_satisfied < 8"
        - "any mandatory principle has violations"

    # --- AC5: Kolb cycle completo --------------------------------------------
    - id: VC-05
      acceptance_criteria: "AC5"
      name: "Kolb Experiential Cycle Completeness"
      description: >
        Cada modulo do deck deve conter as 4 fases do ciclo Kolb:
        EC (Experiencia Concreta), OR (Observacao Reflexiva),
        CA (Conceitualizacao Abstrata), EA (Experimentacao Ativa).
      validation_type: structural
      check:
        - "Run KOLB-01 validation per module"
        - "For each module: verify EC, OR, CA, EA all present"
        - "Verify no module starts with CA (must start with EC)"
        - "Verify proportion: EC 15-20%, OR 15-20%, CA 30-40%, EA 20-30%"
      pass_criteria:
        all_phases_present: true
        phases_required: ["EC", "OR", "CA", "EA"]
        per_module: true
        first_phase_must_be: "EC"
        first_phase_must_not_be: "CA"
      expected_outcome: >
        Com 4 modulos de ~5 slides cada:
        - Modulo 1 (Fundamentos): EC(cenario real) -> OR(reflexao) -> CA(teoria) -> EA(exercicio)
        - Modulo 2 (Comunicacao): EC(problema) -> OR(analise) -> CA(padroes) -> EA(design)
        - Modulo 3 (Decomposicao): EC(case study) -> OR(discussao) -> CA(DDD) -> EA(pratica)
        - Modulo 4 (Deploy): EC(incidente) -> OR(post-mortem) -> CA(estrategias) -> EA(hands-on)
      fail_if:
        - "any module missing EC, OR, CA, or EA phase"
        - "any module starts with CA"

    # --- AC6: DPC order correto -----------------------------------------------
    - id: VC-06
      acceptance_criteria: "AC6"
      name: "DPC Ordering Compliance"
      description: >
        Dentro de cada conceito ensinado, a sequencia deve seguir:
        D (Declarativo — "o que e") antes de P (Procedural — "como fazer")
        antes de C (Condicional — "quando/por que usar").
      validation_type: structural
      check:
        - "Run DPC-01 validation per module per concept"
        - "For each concept: verify first D index < first P index < first C index"
      pass_criteria:
        ordering: "D before P before C"
        scope: "per concept within each module"
        zero_violations: true
      expected_outcome: >
        Cada conceito segue D->P->C:
        - "Microsservicos": D(definicao) -> P(como decompor) -> C(quando usar vs monolito)
        - "gRPC": D(o que e) -> P(como implementar) -> C(quando preferir sobre REST)
        - "DDD": D(bounded context) -> P(como mapear) -> C(quando aplicar)
      fail_if:
        - "any concept has P before D"
        - "any concept has C before P"

    # --- AC7: Custo total < $2.00 --------------------------------------------
    - id: VC-07
      acceptance_criteria: "AC7"
      name: "Budget Compliance"
      description: >
        Custo total de geracao visual do deck deve ser menor que $2.00 USD.
        Conforme budget_caps.per_deck em cost-tracking.yaml.
      validation_type: quantitative
      check:
        - "Read cost-log.json entries for this deck_id"
        - "SUM(cost_usd) WHERE deck_id = test_deck_id"
        - "Verify total < 2.00"
      pass_criteria:
        metric: total_cost_usd
        threshold: "< 2.00"
        source: "cost-log.json aggregation per deck"
      cost_estimation:
        description: >
          Estimativa de custo para 20 slides com mix tipico de engines.
        breakdown:
          diagram_engines: "~8 slides x d2/mermaid x $0.00 = $0.00"
          plotly_charts: "~2 slides x plotly x $0.00 = $0.00"
          ai_images: "~4 slides x gpt_image x $0.04 = $0.16"
          ai_images_fallback: "~1 slide x ideogram x $0.04 = $0.04 (if gpt_image fails)"
          total_estimated: "$0.16 - $0.60"
          headroom: "Amplo — $1.40+ de headroom no budget"
      expected_outcome: >
        Custo total entre $0.16 e $0.60. Muito abaixo do cap de $2.00.
        Apenas slides de content_type=concept usam engines pagas.
        Diagramas e data viz sao free (d2, mermaid, plotly).
      fail_if:
        - "total_cost_usd >= 2.00"
        - "any single engine call cost > $0.08 (max known: recraft)"

    # --- AC8: Tempo total < 5 minutos ----------------------------------------
    - id: VC-08
      acceptance_criteria: "AC8"
      name: "Pipeline Execution Time"
      description: >
        Tempo total de execucao do pipeline (briefing ate release gate)
        deve ser menor que 5 minutos (300.000 ms).
      validation_type: quantitative
      check:
        - "Record pipeline_start_time at briefing_contract"
        - "Record pipeline_end_time at release_gate"
        - "Calculate: pipeline_end_time - pipeline_start_time"
      pass_criteria:
        metric: total_execution_time_ms
        threshold: "< 300000"
        unit: "milliseconds"
      time_budget:
        briefing_contract: "~5s"
        reference_intake: "~3s"
        grounded_content: "~30s (LLM call for content generation)"
        visual_strategy: "~10s (LLM call for batch classification)"
        template_binding: "~5s"
        asset_resolution: "~60-120s (diagram rendering + AI image generation)"
        render_to_site_aiox: "~15s"
        qa_gate: "~10s (andragogic validation + QA scoring)"
        release_gate: "~2s"
        total_estimated: "~140-200s"
        headroom: "100-160s de headroom"
      expected_outcome: >
        Pipeline completa em 2-3.5 minutos. Gargalo principal:
        asset_resolution (AI image API calls). Mitigado por:
        concurrency_limit=3, diagram engines < 1s cada.
      fail_if:
        - "total_execution_time_ms >= 300000"

    # --- AC9: Deck renderiza no ds presenter ---------------------------
    - id: VC-09
      acceptance_criteria: "AC9"
      name: "Site-AIOX Presenter Rendering"
      description: >
        Deck renderizado deve abrir e funcionar corretamente no ds
        presenter. Slides navegaveis, visuais exibidos, thumbnails presentes.
      validation_type: functional
      check:
        - "slides/*.tsx files exist for all 20 slides"
        - "thumbnails/*.png files exist for all 20 slides"
        - "render-summary.md exists"
        - "ds-integration-plan.md exists"
        - "No broken image references in TSX files"
        - "No TypeScript compilation errors in slides/*.tsx"
        - "Presenter opens deck without runtime errors"
      pass_criteria:
        tsx_files_count: 20
        thumbnails_count: 20
        render_summary_exists: true
        integration_plan_exists: true
        zero_broken_references: true
        zero_ts_errors: true
      expected_outcome: >
        Todos os 20 slides renderizam como componentes TSX validos.
        Thumbnails PNG gerados para cada slide. Visuais (SVG/PNG)
        corretamente referenciados nos componentes.
      fail_if:
        - "any slide missing TSX file"
        - "any slide missing thumbnail"
        - "TypeScript compilation errors in slides/"
        - "broken image/visual references"

    # --- AC10: Zero killer items no QA report ---------------------------------
    - id: VC-10
      acceptance_criteria: "AC10"
      name: "Zero Killer Items"
      description: >
        QA report (qa/report.json) nao deve conter nenhum killer item.
        Killer items sao violacoes CRITICAL que bloqueiam a emissao do deck:
        K8 (jargao sem pre-treino) e K9 (sobrecarga textual absoluta).
      validation_type: structural
      check:
        - "Read qa/report.json"
        - "Check andragogic_validation.summary.killer_items_triggered == []"
        - "Check andragogic_validation.blocked == false"
        - "Check andragogic_validation.summary.critical_count == 0"
        - "Verify K8 not triggered: no undefined technical terms"
        - "Verify K9 not triggered: no slide exceeds absolute word limit"
      pass_criteria:
        killer_items_count: 0
        blocked: false
        critical_violations: 0
        killer_item_ids_must_be_absent: ["K8", "K9"]
      expected_outcome: >
        Zero killer items. K8 evitado porque content-architect define
        termos tecnicos antes de usa-los (pre-training). K9 evitado
        porque MAYER-06 segmentation ja limita palavras por slide.
      fail_if:
        - "killer_items_triggered is not empty"
        - "blocked == true"
        - "critical_count > 0"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PASS/FAIL CRITERIA (SUMMARY)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  pass_fail_summary:
    description: >
      O teste E2E passa SOMENTE se TODOS os 10 validation checks passarem.
      Qualquer falha individual falha o teste inteiro.
    overall_pass: "ALL 10 validation checks pass"
    overall_fail: "ANY validation check fails"
    blocking_checks:
      description: "Checks que, se falharem, impedem qualquer analise adicional."
      checks: ["VC-01", "VC-10"]
      rationale: >
        VC-01 (deck gerado) e pre-requisito para todos os outros checks.
        VC-10 (zero killer items) e um gate bloqueante por definicao
        (killer items impedem emissao do deck).
    quantitative_checks:
      description: "Checks com thresholds numericos."
      checks:
        - { id: "VC-02", metric: "visual_coverage_pct", threshold: ">= 60%" }
        - { id: "VC-03", metric: "brand_compliance_pct", threshold: ">= 95%" }
        - { id: "VC-04", metric: "mayer_principles_satisfied", threshold: ">= 8/12" }
        - { id: "VC-07", metric: "total_cost_usd", threshold: "< $2.00" }
        - { id: "VC-08", metric: "total_execution_time_ms", threshold: "< 300000" }
    structural_checks:
      description: "Checks boolean/estruturais."
      checks:
        - { id: "VC-05", check: "Kolb cycle complete per module" }
        - { id: "VC-06", check: "DPC ordering correct per concept" }
        - { id: "VC-09", check: "Site-AIOX presenter renders correctly" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXECUTION INSTRUCTIONS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  execution:
    description: >
      Instrucoes para executar este teste E2E quando a pipeline v2
      estiver implementada (pos Sprints 1-4).
    prerequisites:
      - "Sprints 1-4 completos e merged"
      - "Feature flags ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION e ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION disponiveis"
      - "Kroki self-hosted rodando em localhost:8000 (D2 + Mermaid)"
      - "API keys configuradas: OPENAI_API_KEY (gpt_image)"
      - "Plotly + Kaleido instalados (Python)"
      - "ds presenter funcional"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        action: "Configurar environment"
        commands:
          - "export ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=true"
          - "export ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION=true"
          - "Verificar Kroki: curl http://localhost:8000/health"
      - step: 2
        action: "Executar pipeline com sample briefing"
        command: "*create-presentation"
        input: "sample_briefing deste arquivo"
        expected_duration: "2-4 minutos"
      - step: 3
        action: "Coletar resultados"
        artifacts:
          - "deck-manifest.json"
          - "qa/report.json"
          - "cost-log.json (filtrado por deck_id)"
          - "slides/*.tsx"
          - "thumbnails/*.png"
          - "render-summary.md"
          - "release-summary.md"
      - step: 4
        action: "Executar validation checklist"
        checks: "VC-01 a VC-10 em ordem"
        tool: "Manual review ou script de validacao automatizado"
      - step: 5
        action: "Gerar test report"
        output: "e2e-test-report.json"
        format:
          test_id: "e2e-visual-andragogic-001"
          executed_at: "ISO 8601 timestamp"
          duration_ms: "pipeline execution time"
          results: "array of VC-XX results with pass/fail + details"
          overall_verdict: "PASS | FAIL"
          notes: "free text observations"
```


## Referência: references/squad/archive/orphan-tests/e2e-youtube-pipeline.yaml

```yaml
# E2E Integration Test: YouTube Pipeline
# Story 5.2 — EPIC-SC-V2-001
# Validates the complete YouTube-to-Deck pipeline end-to-end
#
# Orchestration: slide-chief agent via *create-from-youtube command
# Contract validation: ./squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh --ci

test_name: "E2E YouTube Pipeline — 30min Video to Deck"
version: "1.0.0"
story_id: "5.2"
epic_id: "EPIC-SC-V2-001"
feature_flag: "ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test Scenario
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

scenario:
  description: >
    Convert a 30-minute YouTube video (with available subtitles) into a
    presentation deck of 15-25 slides. Validates every stage of the YouTube
    pipeline: ingestao, transcricao, extracao visual, analise multimodal,
    Q&A de adaptacao, briefing generation, and deck rendering.

  # Sample video: Google I/O 2024 keynote segment (~30 min, English, subtitles available)
  # This video has: diagrams, code snippets, text slides, and speaker moments
  # making it ideal for visual moment classification testing.
  #
  # PLACEHOLDER: Replace with a stable, publicly available ~30min video URL
  # that has subtitles and visual diversity (diagrams, code, slides).
  # Requirements for the sample video:
  #   - Duration: 25-35 minutes
  #   - Subtitles: available in English or Portuguese
  #   - Visual content: mix of diagrams, code, text slides, speaker
  #   - Publicly accessible (no age restriction, no region lock)
  sample_video:
    url: "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vMDJHyrBbiU"
    description: "Google Cloud Next '24 — Developer Keynote (~30 min, EN subtitles)"
    expected_duration_range: [1500, 2100]  # 25-35 minutes in seconds
    expected_language: "en"
    has_subtitles: true

  # Test-default answers for the Q&A stage (Stage 5)
  # These simulate a user who keeps the original content structure
  qa_defaults:
    target_product: "keep_original"
    target_audience: "software developers and tech leads"
    tone: "tecnico"
    structure_decision: "keep_all"
    visual_selections: "all"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pipeline Stages — Validation Checkpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

stages:

  # ---- Stage 1: Ingestao ----
  stage_1_ingestao:
    description: "yt-dlp metadata extraction and availability check"
    timeout_seconds: 30
    cost_expected_usd: 0.00

    validations:
      - id: "S1.1"
        check: "video_metadata object is populated"
        field: "video_metadata"
        condition: "all required fields present (title, video_id, duration_seconds, channel, url)"
        pass_criteria: "video_metadata is not null and contains all 5 required fields"

      - id: "S1.2"
        check: "duration within expected range"
        field: "video_metadata.duration_seconds"
        condition: "value >= 1500 AND value <= 2100"
        pass_criteria: "Video is between 25 and 35 minutes"

      - id: "S1.3"
        check: "video is not a live stream"
        field: "video_metadata.is_live"
        condition: "value != true"
        pass_criteria: "Video is a recorded video, not a live stream"

      - id: "S1.4"
        check: "video_id is 11 characters"
        field: "video_metadata.video_id"
        condition: "length == 11"
        pass_criteria: "Standard YouTube video ID format"

  # ---- Stage 2: Transcricao ----
  stage_2_transcricao:
    description: "Transcript extraction via youtube-transcript-api (fast path)"
    timeout_seconds: 90
    cost_expected_usd: 0.00
    expected_source: "youtube_captions"

    validations:
      - id: "S2.1"
        check: "transcript extracted via fast path"
        field: "extraction_status.transcript_source"
        condition: "value == 'youtube_captions'"
        pass_criteria: "Free caption extraction succeeded (no paid API needed)"

      - id: "S2.2"
        check: "transcript segments populated"
        field: "transcript_segments"
        condition: "array length > 100"
        pass_criteria: "30-min video should have 100+ transcript segments"

      - id: "S2.3"
        check: "timestamps are float seconds"
        field: "transcript_segments[*].start"
        condition: "type == number AND value >= 0"
        pass_criteria: "All start timestamps are non-negative floats, NOT MM:SS strings"

      - id: "S2.4"
        check: "end timestamps are after start"
        field: "transcript_segments[*]"
        condition: "end > start for every segment"
        pass_criteria: "Every segment has end > start"

      - id: "S2.5"
        check: "text is non-empty"
        field: "transcript_segments[*].text"
        condition: "each text is a non-empty string"
        pass_criteria: "No empty transcript segments"

  # ---- Stage 3: Extracao Visual ----
  stage_3_extracao_visual:
    description: "PySceneDetect + ffmpeg keyframe extraction"
    timeout_seconds: 60
    cost_expected_usd: 0.00

    validations:
      - id: "S3.1"
        check: "keyframes extracted"
        field: "keyframes_manifest"
        condition: "array length >= 20 AND array length <= 80"
        pass_criteria: "PySceneDetect produces 20-80 keyframes for a 30-min video"

      - id: "S3.2"
        check: "keyframes saved to correct path"
        field: "keyframes_manifest[*].path"
        condition: "each path starts with 'cache/slides-v2/videos/'"
        pass_criteria: "Frames stored in expected cache directory"

      - id: "S3.3"
        check: "keyframes have timestamps"
        field: "keyframes_manifest[*].timestamp_seconds"
        condition: "type == number AND value >= 0"
        pass_criteria: "Each keyframe has a valid float timestamp"

      - id: "S3.4"
        check: "keyframes are chronologically ordered"
        field: "keyframes_manifest"
        condition: "timestamps are monotonically increasing"
        pass_criteria: "Frames are in chronological order"

  # ---- Stage 4: Analise Multimodal ----
  stage_4_analise_multimodal:
    description: "Gemini Flash visual analysis and classification"
    timeout_seconds: 120
    cost_expected_usd_range: [0.30, 1.50]

    validations:
      - id: "S4.1"
        check: "visual moments detected"
        field: "visual_moments"
        condition: "array length >= 3"
        pass_criteria: "At least 3 visual moments detected in a 30-min tech talk"

      - id: "S4.2"
        check: "visual moments have valid types"
        field: "visual_moments[*].type"
        condition: "value in ['diagram', 'code', 'text_slide', 'whiteboard', 'screen_demo', 'infographic', 'other']"
        pass_criteria: "All types are from the allowed enum (speaker_only filtered out)"

      - id: "S4.3"
        check: "confidence threshold met"
        field: "visual_moments[*].confidence"
        condition: "value >= 0.7"
        pass_criteria: "All retained visual moments have confidence >= 0.7 (epic AC requirement)"
        note: "Moments with confidence < 0.7 should be filtered during analysis"

      - id: "S4.4"
        check: "visual analysis source recorded"
        field: "extraction_status.visual_analysis_source"
        condition: "value == 'gemini_flash'"
        pass_criteria: "Gemini Flash was used for visual analysis"

      - id: "S4.5"
        check: "chapters detected"
        field: "chapters"
        condition: "array length >= 2"
        pass_criteria: "At least 2 chapters detected in a 30-min video"

      - id: "S4.6"
        check: "chapter timestamps are float seconds"
        field: "chapters[*].timestamp_seconds"
        condition: "type == number AND value >= 0"
        pass_criteria: "Chapter timestamps are non-negative floats"

  # ---- Stage 5: Adaptacao Q&A ----
  stage_5_adaptacao_qa:
    description: "User interaction: 3-5 adaptation questions"
    timeout_seconds: null  # User-interactive, no timeout
    cost_expected_usd: 0.00
    elicit: true

    validations:
      - id: "S5.1"
        check: "3-5 questions presented"
        field: "qa_questions_count"
        condition: "value >= 3 AND value <= 5"
        pass_criteria: "Between 3 and 5 adaptation questions were asked"

      - id: "S5.2"
        check: "adaptation preferences recorded"
        field: "adaptation"
        condition: "object is not null and contains target_product, target_audience, tone"
        pass_criteria: "Core adaptation fields are populated"

      - id: "S5.3"
        check: "structure decisions captured"
        field: "adaptation.structure_decisions"
        condition: "object or array is present"
        pass_criteria: "User's keep/adapt/remove decisions for chapters are recorded"

    test_inputs:
      note: "Use qa_defaults from scenario section for automated test execution"
      target_product: "keep_original"
      target_audience: "software developers and tech leads"
      tone: "tecnico"
      structure_decision: "keep_all"

  # ---- Stage 6: Briefing Generation ----
  stage_6_briefing_generation:
    description: "youtube-extraction.json to briefing.normalized.json conversion"
    timeout_seconds: 10
    cost_expected_usd: 0.00

    validations:
      - id: "S6.1"
        check: "youtube-extraction.json validates against schema"
        field: "youtube_extraction"
        condition: "validates against schemas/contracts/youtube-extraction.schema.json"
        pass_criteria: "Producer-side schema validation passes"

      - id: "S6.2"
        check: "briefing.normalized.json has source_type=youtube"
        field: "briefing_normalized.source_type"
        condition: "value == 'youtube'"
        pass_criteria: "Source type correctly set to 'youtube'"

      - id: "S6.3"
        check: "briefing has no blockers"
        field: "briefing_normalized.blockers"
        condition: "array length == 0"
        pass_criteria: "No blocking issues in the normalized briefing"

      - id: "S6.4"
        check: "briefing validates against normalized schema"
        field: "briefing_normalized"
        condition: "validates against squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        pass_criteria: "Consumer-side schema validation passes (dual validation)"

      - id: "S6.5"
        check: "youtube_source metadata present"
        field: "briefing_normalized.youtube_source"
        condition: "object contains url, video_id, extraction_profile, chapters, visual_moments"
        pass_criteria: "YouTube-specific metadata carried through to briefing"

      - id: "S6.6"
        check: "max_slides in expected range"
        field: "briefing_normalized.max_slides"
        condition: "value >= 15 AND value <= 25"
        pass_criteria: "Slide count derived from chapters (clamped 15-25 for this test)"

      - id: "S6.7"
        check: "output targets include ds"
        field: "briefing_normalized.output_targets"
        condition: "array contains 'ds'"
        pass_criteria: "Deck will render for ds"

  # ---- Deck Generation (post-briefing) ----
  deck_generation:
    description: "generate-presentation.yaml pipeline produces final deck"
    timeout_seconds: 120
    cost_expected_usd_range: [0.50, 1.50]

    validations:
      - id: "D1"
        check: "deck-manifest.json generated"
        field: "deck_manifest"
        condition: "file exists and is valid JSON"
        pass_criteria: "Deck manifest was produced by the pipeline"

      - id: "D2"
        check: "slide count in range"
        field: "deck_manifest.slides"
        condition: "array length >= 15 AND array length <= 25"
        pass_criteria: "Deck has 15-25 slides (epic AC)"

      - id: "D3"
        check: "deck renders in ds format"
        field: "deck_manifest.output_target"
        condition: "value == 'ds' OR output_targets contains 'ds'"
        pass_criteria: "Deck is compatible with ds renderer"

      - id: "D4"
        check: "each slide has required fields"
        field: "deck_manifest.slides[*]"
        condition: "each slide has: type, content (title or body), layout"
        pass_criteria: "No empty or malformed slides in the deck"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global Constraints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

global_constraints:

  budget:
    max_total_usd: 2.50
    breakdown_estimate:
      ingestao: 0.00
      transcricao_fast_path: 0.00
      extracao_visual: 0.00
      analise_multimodal: 0.50  # to 1.50
      qa: 0.00
      briefing_generation: 0.00
      deck_generation: 0.50  # to 1.50 (content-architect + visual-scout LLM calls)
    validation:
      - id: "B1"
        check: "total cost under budget"
        field: "extraction_status.cost_usd + deck_generation_cost"
        condition: "value < 2.50"
        pass_criteria: "Total pipeline cost stays under $2.50"

  timing:
    max_total_seconds: 300
    per_stage_budgets:
      stage_1: 30
      stage_2: 90
      stage_3: 60
      stage_4: 120
      stage_5: null  # user-interactive
      stage_6: 10
      deck_generation: 120
    validation:
      - id: "T1"
        check: "total time under 5 minutes"
        field: "total_processing_time_seconds"
        condition: "value < 300"
        note: "Excludes Stage 5 (user-interactive Q&A wait time)"
        pass_criteria: "Pipeline completes within 5 minutes (excluding user interaction)"

  schema_compliance:
    validations:
      - id: "SC1"
        check: "youtube-extraction.json conforms to contract"
        schema: "schemas/contracts/youtube-extraction.schema.json"
        pass_criteria: "Output matches cross-squad contract"

      - id: "SC2"
        check: "briefing.normalized.json conforms to contract"
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        pass_criteria: "Briefing matches consumer contract"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Expected Outcomes & Pass/Fail Criteria
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_outcomes:
  youtube_extraction:
    video_metadata:
      video_id: "11-character string"
      duration_seconds: "1500-2100 range"
      channel: "non-empty string"
    transcript_segments: ">= 100 segments with float timestamps"
    visual_moments: ">= 3 moments with confidence >= 0.7"
    chapters: ">= 2 chapters with float timestamps"
    extraction_status:
      transcript_source: "youtube_captions"
      visual_analysis_source: "gemini_flash"
      cost_usd: "< 1.50"
      processing_time_seconds: "< 180"

  briefing_normalized:
    source_type: "youtube"
    youtube_source: "present with url, video_id, chapters, visual_moments, adaptation"
    max_slides: "15-25"
    blockers: "empty array"
    output_targets: "includes 'ds'"

  deck_manifest:
    slides: "15-25 slides"
    render_target: "ds"
    all_slides_valid: "each has type, content, layout"

pass_fail_criteria:
  pass:
    description: "All validations pass"
    conditions:
      - "All S1.x, S2.x, S3.x, S4.x, S5.x, S6.x, D1-D4 validations PASS"
      - "B1 (budget < $2.50) PASS"
      - "T1 (time < 5 min) PASS"
      - "SC1, SC2 (schema compliance) PASS"

  fail:
    description: "Any critical validation fails"
    critical_failures:
      - "Transcript extraction fails entirely (no segments)"
      - "No visual moments with confidence >= 0.7"
      - "Briefing has blockers (blockers array non-empty)"
      - "Deck has fewer than 15 or more than 25 slides"
      - "Total cost exceeds $2.50"
      - "Total time exceeds 5 minutes (excluding Q&A)"
      - "Schema validation fails for youtube-extraction or briefing"

    acceptable_degradation:
      - "Fewer than 20 keyframes extracted (min 5 acceptable with warning)"
      - "Visual analysis falls back to 'none' (budget or API issue) — test WARNS but does not FAIL"
      - "Q&A has fewer than 5 questions (minimum 3 required)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Execution Instructions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

execution:
  method: "agent-orchestrated"
  agent: "slide-chief"
  command: "*create-from-youtube"
  steps:
    - step: 1
      action: "Activate slide-chief agent"
      instruction: "Ensure ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT feature flag is enabled"

    - step: 2
      action: "Run *create-from-youtube with sample video URL"
      instruction: "Execute: *create-from-youtube {sample_video.url}"

    - step: 3
      action: "Answer Q&A with test defaults"
      instruction: >
        When prompted with adaptation questions, use the qa_defaults from the
        scenario section. For structure: keep all chapters. For tone: tecnico.

    - step: 4
      action: "Validate youtube-extraction.json"
      instruction: >
        After Stage 6 completes, validate the youtube-extraction.json output
        against all S1-S6 validations in this file.

    - step: 5
      action: "Validate deck output"
      instruction: >
        After deck generation completes, validate the deck-manifest.json
        against D1-D4 validations.

    - step: 6
      action: "Validate global constraints"
      instruction: >
        Check B1 (budget), T1 (timing), SC1, SC2 (schema compliance).

    - step: 7
      action: "Record results"
      instruction: >
        Document PASS/FAIL per validation ID. If any critical failure occurs,
        document the failure details and root cause.

  contract_validation:
    pre_test: "./squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh --ci"
    post_test: "./squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh --ci"
    note: "Run contract validation before AND after the E2E test to detect any schema drift caused by the pipeline"
```
