## Referência: references/squad/archive/orphan-tests/performance-benchmarks.yaml

```yaml
# Performance Benchmarks for slides-creator v2
# SSOT for performance targets, measurement methodology, and pass/fail criteria.
# Created by: Story 5.4 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 5)
# Dependencies:
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml (Story 1.6 -- cache levels, key computation, stats)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml (Story 1.1/2.2 -- concurrency, timeouts, routing)
# Consumed by: qa-inspector (performance gate), devops (performance_review)

performance_benchmarks:
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  story: "5.4"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GLOBAL TEST CONDITIONS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  global:
    test_environment:
      platform: "Apple Silicon (M-series)"
      min_ram_gb: 16
      services_required:
        - "Kroki (D2 + Mermaid sidecar) on port 8000"
        - "Python 3.11+ with plotly + kaleido"
      feature_flags:
        ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION: true
        ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC: true
        ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT: false  # not required for perf benchmarks
    baseline:
      pipeline_v1_total_seconds: 100
      max_acceptable_delta_pct: 120  # pipeline v2 may be at most +120% of v1
      max_pipeline_v2_total_seconds: 220  # 100 * (1 + 1.20) = 220
    repetitions: 3  # run each benchmark N times, report median
    warm_up_runs: 1  # discard first run (cold JIT, DNS, container startup)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # BENCHMARK 1: BM-CACHE-HIT
  # Cache hit rate over 10 decks
  # AC: meta >= 10% primeiro uso, >= 30% mesmo tema
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  benchmarks:

    - id: BM-CACHE-HIT
      name: "Cache Hit Rate"
      description: >
        Measures cache effectiveness across two scenarios: (a) 10 unique-topic
        decks where minimal cache reuse is expected, and (b) 10 decks on the
        same topic where diagram/image reuse should be significant.
      acceptance_criteria:
        - "Cache hit rate >= 10% for first-use (unique topic) decks"
        - "Cache hit rate >= 30% for same-topic decks"
      dependencies:
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml"
          sections: ["levels", "lookup", "statistics"]

      scenarios:

        - id: CACHE-UNIQUE
          name: "First Use -- Unique Topics"
          description: >
            Generate 10 decks with distinct topics (e.g., "Machine Learning",
            "Roman History", "Nutrition", ...). Each topic is unique so L2 (AI
            image) cache hits are unlikely. However, L1 (diagram) cache hits
            are possible if diagram types repeat (e.g., two flowcharts with
            identical Mermaid syntax for common patterns).
          setup:
            - "Clear cache directory: rm -rf ${SLIDES_CACHE_DIR:-cache/slides-v2}/*"
            - "Reset cache-stats.json to initial_state (all zeros)"
            - "Prepare 10 briefings with distinct topics, 15-20 slides each"
          execution:
            - "Run pipeline for each briefing sequentially"
            - "After each deck: read cache-stats.json, record hits/misses"
            - "After all 10: compute aggregate hit_rate_pct"
          measurement:
            metric: hit_rate_pct
            source: "cache-stats.json -> hit_rate_pct"
            formula: "(total_hits / (total_hits + total_misses)) * 100"
            unit: "%"
          target:
            operator: ">="
            value: 10
            rationale: >
              Even across unique topics, common diagram patterns (generic
              flowcharts, org charts) and reused Plotly chart types produce
              L1 cache hits. 10% is the conservative floor.
          pass_condition: "hit_rate_pct >= 10"
          fail_action: >
            Investigate cache key computation. Common cause: design_tokens_hash
            changing between runs (ensure consistent tokens across test decks).

        - id: CACHE-SAME-TOPIC
          name: "Same Topic Reuse"
          description: >
            Generate 10 decks on the SAME topic (e.g., "Introduction to Python")
            with slight variations (different audience levels, different slide
            counts). Cache L1 hits expected for identical diagram code. Cache L2
            hits expected when prompt + engine + style_constraints match exactly.
          setup:
            - "Clear cache directory: rm -rf ${SLIDES_CACHE_DIR:-cache/slides-v2}/*"
            - "Reset cache-stats.json to initial_state"
            - "Prepare 10 briefings: same topic, vary audience_level and slide_count"
          execution:
            - "Run pipeline for each briefing sequentially"
            - "After each deck: record cumulative hit_rate_pct"
            - "Track per-level hits: L1 (diagrams) vs L2 (images)"
          measurement:
            metric: hit_rate_pct
            source: "cache-stats.json -> hit_rate_pct"
            formula: "(total_hits / (total_hits + total_misses)) * 100"
            unit: "%"
            supplementary:
              - "L1 hit rate: hits.diagrams / (hits.diagrams + misses.diagrams)"
              - "L2 hit rate: hits.images / (hits.images + misses.images)"
              - "cost_avoided_usd from cache-stats.json"
          target:
            operator: ">="
            value: 30
            rationale: >
              Same topic produces identical diagram code for structural concepts
              (L1 = ~80% hit rate) and similar prompts for conceptual illustrations
              (L2 = ~20% hit rate). Blended target: >= 30%.
          pass_condition: "hit_rate_pct >= 30"
          fail_action: >
            Check if prompt variation between audience levels produces different
            cache keys. If L1 hits are low, verify diagram_code normalization.
            If L2 hits are low, verify prompt + style_constraints stability.

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BENCHMARK 2: BM-BATCH-PARALLEL
    # Batch processing 12 visuals parallel with concurrency=3
    # AC: 12 visuais em paralelo com concurrency limit = 3
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - id: BM-BATCH-PARALLEL
      name: "Batch Processing -- Parallel Execution"
      description: >
        Validates that the visual generation orchestrator correctly processes
        12 visual specs concurrently with a concurrency limit of 3, meaning
        at most 3 engine.render() calls are in-flight simultaneously.
      acceptance_criteria:
        - "12 visuals processed in parallel batches"
        - "Max 3 concurrent render() calls at any point"
        - "All 12 visuals successfully generated"
        - "Recraft engine limited to 2 concurrent (override)"
      dependencies:
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
          sections: ["orchestration.concurrency_limit", "orchestration.concurrency_overrides"]

      scenarios:

        - id: BATCH-12-CONC-3
          name: "12 Visuals, Concurrency 3"
          description: >
            Create a deck with 12 slides requiring visual generation. Mix of
            engine types: 4 D2 diagrams, 3 Mermaid diagrams, 2 Plotly charts,
            2 GPT Image illustrations, 1 Recraft icon.
          setup:
            - "Prepare deck-manifest with 12 slides, each with visual_strategy"
            - "Engine distribution: 4x d2, 3x mermaid, 2x plotly, 2x gpt_image, 1x recraft"
            - "Ensure all API keys configured (OPENAI_API_KEY, RECRAFT_API_KEY)"
            - "Enable concurrency logging in visual-scout"
          execution:
            - "Invoke visual-scout.generateAll(manifest.slides) with concurrency=3"
            - "Log timestamps: [start, end] for each render() call"
            - "Log concurrent count at each start/end event"
          measurement:
            metrics:
              - name: max_concurrent
                description: "Maximum number of simultaneous render() calls observed"
                source: "Concurrency log: max(concurrent_count at any timestamp)"
                unit: "count"
              - name: total_generated
                description: "Number of visuals successfully generated"
                source: "Count of VisualOutput results (non-error)"
                unit: "count"
              - name: total_wall_time_ms
                description: "Wall-clock time from first render start to last render end"
                source: "max(end_timestamps) - min(start_timestamps)"
                unit: "ms"
              - name: recraft_max_concurrent
                description: "Maximum concurrent Recraft calls observed"
                source: "Concurrency log filtered by engine_id=recraft"
                unit: "count"
          targets:
            max_concurrent:
              operator: "<="
              value: 3
              rationale: "orchestration.concurrency_limit = 3"
            total_generated:
              operator: "=="
              value: 12
              rationale: "All 12 visuals must complete (success or fallback)"
            recraft_max_concurrent:
              operator: "<="
              value: 2
              rationale: "orchestration.concurrency_overrides.recraft = 2"
            total_wall_time_ms:
              operator: "<"
              value: 150000  # 150s -- 4 batches of 3, worst case 30s each + overhead
              rationale: >
                With concurrency=3, 12 visuals execute in ceil(12/3) = 4 batches.
                Worst-case engine timeout is 30s (GPT Image). 4 * 30s = 120s + 30s overhead.
          pass_condition: "max_concurrent <= 3 AND total_generated == 12 AND recraft_max_concurrent <= 2"
          fail_action: >
            If max_concurrent > 3: concurrency semaphore is leaking. Check
            Promise.allSettled pool implementation. If total_generated < 12:
            check fallback chain exhaustion. If recraft_max_concurrent > 2:
            check concurrency_overrides enforcement.

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BENCHMARK 3: BM-PHASE4-LATENCY
    # Phase 4 latency with parallelization < 50s for 20-slide deck
    # AC: Phase 4 (Asset Resolution) latencia com paralelizacao < 50s
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - id: BM-PHASE4-LATENCY
      name: "Phase 4 (Asset Resolution) Latency"
      description: >
        Measures wall-clock time for Phase 4 (Asset Resolution) when processing
        a 20-slide deck with visual generation enabled. Phase 4 includes:
        cache lookup, engine selection, render (parallel), cache write, and
        asset embedding. Parallelization must keep total under 50 seconds.
      acceptance_criteria:
        - "Phase 4 total latency < 50 seconds for 20-slide deck"
      dependencies:
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml"
          sections: ["lookup"]
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
          sections: ["orchestration", "engines_registry"]

      scenarios:

        - id: PHASE4-20-SLIDES-COLD
          name: "20 Slides, Cold Cache"
          description: >
            Process a 20-slide deck with empty cache (worst case). All visuals
            must be generated from scratch. Parallelization (concurrency=3) is
            the primary mitigation for latency.
          setup:
            - "Clear cache directory completely"
            - "Prepare 20-slide deck-manifest with visual_strategy per slide"
            - "Engine distribution: 8x d2, 5x mermaid, 3x plotly, 3x gpt_image, 1x ideogram"
            - "OSS-heavy distribution to minimize paid API latency"
          execution:
            - "Record Phase 4 start timestamp"
            - "Execute visual-scout.generateAll(manifest.slides)"
            - "Record Phase 4 end timestamp"
            - "Calculate wall-clock delta"
          measurement:
            metric: phase4_wall_time_seconds
            source: "phase4_end - phase4_start"
            formula: "(end_timestamp - start_timestamp) / 1000"
            unit: "seconds"
            supplementary:
              - "Per-engine breakdown: avg, p50, p95, max latency"
              - "Cache miss rate (expected: 100% on cold cache)"
              - "Effective parallelism: total_engine_time / wall_time"
          target:
            operator: "<"
            value: 50
            rationale: >
              With concurrency=3 and 20 visuals: ceil(20/3) = 7 batches.
              OSS engines (d2, mermaid, plotly): ~1-5s each.
              AI engines (gpt_image, ideogram): ~10-25s each.
              Expected: batches 1-5 (OSS-heavy) ~5s each = 25s.
              Batches 6-7 (AI-heavy) ~25s each = 25s (overlap with OSS).
              But OSS engines are prioritized first (BM-OSS-PRIORITY),
              so AI engines run in later batches. Total ~40-48s.
          pass_condition: "phase4_wall_time_seconds < 50"
          fail_action: >
            Profile per-engine latency. If OSS engines > 5s: check Kroki
            container health. If AI engines > 30s: verify timeout_ms config.
            If effective_parallelism < 2.0: concurrency pool is underutilized.

        - id: PHASE4-20-SLIDES-WARM
          name: "20 Slides, Warm Cache (Same Topic Re-run)"
          description: >
            Re-run the same 20-slide deck after PHASE4-20-SLIDES-COLD.
            L1 cache hits expected for all diagram engines. Some L2 hits
            expected for AI image engines. Phase 4 should be significantly
            faster due to cache hits.
          setup:
            - "Do NOT clear cache (use state from COLD run)"
            - "Use identical deck-manifest from COLD scenario"
          execution:
            - "Record Phase 4 start/end timestamps"
            - "Record cache hit/miss counts"
          measurement:
            metric: phase4_wall_time_seconds
            source: "phase4_end - phase4_start"
            unit: "seconds"
            supplementary:
              - "Cache hit rate (expected: >= 70% for identical re-run)"
              - "Cost avoided vs cold run"
          target:
            operator: "<"
            value: 15  # cache hits should make this very fast
            rationale: >
              With >= 70% cache hits, only 6 visuals need actual rendering.
              ceil(6/3) = 2 batches. OSS engine hits return < 10ms (filesystem).
              Remaining renders: ~15s. Total: ~10-15s.
          pass_condition: "phase4_wall_time_seconds < 15"
          fail_action: >
            If cache hits < 50%: verify cache key stability. design_tokens_hash
            must be identical between runs (same tokens file).

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BENCHMARK 4: BM-PIPELINE-TOTAL
    # Pipeline total < 220s (vs 100s baseline v1, delta < +120%)
    # AC: Pipeline total < 220s
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - id: BM-PIPELINE-TOTAL
      name: "Pipeline Total Latency"
      description: >
        End-to-end pipeline latency for a complete v2 deck generation, compared
        against the v1 baseline of 100 seconds. The delta must not exceed +120%,
        meaning total time must be under 220 seconds.
      acceptance_criteria:
        - "Pipeline total < 220 seconds for standard 20-slide deck"
        - "Delta vs v1 baseline (100s) < +120%"
      dependencies:
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
          sections: ["orchestration"]
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml"
          sections: ["lookup", "statistics"]

      scenarios:

        - id: PIPELINE-V2-STANDARD
          name: "Standard 20-Slide Deck, All Features"
          description: >
            Generate a 20-slide educational deck with all v2 features enabled:
            visual generation, andragogic validation, brand compliance.
            Measures total wall-clock time from briefing input to PPTX output.
          setup:
            - "Clear cache for clean measurement"
            - "Enable all feature flags: ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION, ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC"
            - "Prepare standard briefing: 20 slides, educational topic, brand tokens"
          execution:
            - "Record pipeline start (briefing received)"
            - "Execute all 7 phases: normalize -> outline -> content -> asset_resolution -> design_render -> qa_inspect -> export"
            - "Record pipeline end (PPTX written)"
            - "Log per-phase timing breakdown"
          measurement:
            metric: pipeline_total_seconds
            source: "pipeline_end - pipeline_start"
            formula: "(end_timestamp - start_timestamp) / 1000"
            unit: "seconds"
            supplementary:
              - name: per_phase_breakdown
                description: "Timing for each of the 7 pipeline phases"
                phases:
                  - "Phase 1 (Normalize): expected ~2-5s"
                  - "Phase 2 (Outline): expected ~5-15s (LLM call)"
                  - "Phase 3 (Content): expected ~15-30s (LLM calls per slide)"
                  - "Phase 4 (Asset Resolution): expected ~30-50s (visual gen, parallelized)"
                  - "Phase 5 (Design Render): expected ~10-20s (PPTX composition)"
                  - "Phase 6 (QA Inspect): expected ~5-10s (validation passes)"
                  - "Phase 7 (Export): expected ~2-5s (file write)"
              - name: delta_vs_v1
                description: "((pipeline_v2 - 100) / 100) * 100"
                unit: "%"
              - name: cost_total_usd
                description: "Total cost of visual generation for the deck"
                unit: "USD"
          targets:
            pipeline_total_seconds:
              operator: "<"
              value: 220
              rationale: "100s baseline * (1 + 1.20) = 220s max"
            delta_vs_v1_pct:
              operator: "<"
              value: 120
              rationale: "Epic constraint: delta < +120%"
            cost_total_usd:
              operator: "<="
              value: 2.00
              rationale: "Budget cap: $2.00/deck (architectural decision #10)"
          pass_condition: "pipeline_total_seconds < 220 AND delta_vs_v1_pct < 120 AND cost_total_usd <= 2.00"
          fail_action: >
            Identify slowest phase via per_phase_breakdown. If Phase 4 > 50s:
            see BM-PHASE4-LATENCY. If Phase 3 > 40s: optimize LLM batching
            for content generation. If Phase 5 > 25s: profile PPTX library
            performance (python-pptx or pptxgenjs).

        - id: PIPELINE-V1-REGRESSION
          name: "V1 Baseline Regression (Flags Off)"
          description: >
            Run the pipeline with ALL v2 feature flags disabled. Must complete
            in approximately the v1 baseline time (100s +/- 15%), proving that
            v2 code paths do not degrade v1 performance.
          setup:
            - "Disable all feature flags: ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=false, ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC=false"
            - "Use v1-compatible briefing (no visual_strategy, no education_mode)"
          execution:
            - "Run full pipeline with standard v1 briefing"
            - "Record total time"
          measurement:
            metric: pipeline_total_seconds
            source: "pipeline_end - pipeline_start"
            unit: "seconds"
          target:
            operator: "<="
            value: 115  # v1 baseline 100s + 15% tolerance
            rationale: >
              V2 code with flags off should have negligible overhead.
              15% tolerance accounts for flag-checking conditionals and
              minor code path differences.
          pass_condition: "pipeline_total_seconds <= 115"
          fail_action: >
            V2 code is adding overhead even with flags off. Profile to find
            which v2 module is executing when it should be skipped. Check
            feature flag gate placement -- it should be at phase entry, not
            inside hot loops.

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BENCHMARK 5: BM-OSS-PRIORITY
    # OSS diagrams (D2/Mermaid) generated before AI images
    # AC: Diagramas OSS gerados antes de imagens AI
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - id: BM-OSS-PRIORITY
      name: "OSS Engine Priority Ordering"
      description: >
        Validates that the visual generation orchestrator schedules OSS
        engines (D2, Mermaid, Plotly -- free, fast, deterministic) before
        AI image engines (GPT Image, Recraft, Ideogram -- paid, slow,
        non-deterministic). This enables partial render: slides with
        completed OSS visuals can begin PPTX composition while AI images
        are still generating.
      acceptance_criteria:
        - "All OSS engine renders start before any AI engine render"
        - "OSS visuals available for partial render before AI visuals complete"
      dependencies:
        - file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
          sections: ["routing_table", "orchestration.engine_selection_algorithm"]

      scenarios:

        - id: OSS-BEFORE-AI
          name: "OSS Engines Scheduled First"
          description: >
            Given a mixed deck with both OSS and AI visual specs, verify
            that all OSS specs are enqueued in the concurrency pool before
            any AI specs. This is a scheduling order test, not a timing test.
          setup:
            - "Prepare 12-slide deck: 6x OSS (3 d2, 2 mermaid, 1 plotly) + 6x AI (3 gpt_image, 2 ideogram, 1 recraft)"
            - "Enable scheduling order logging in visual-scout"
          execution:
            - "Invoke visual-scout.generateAll(manifest.slides)"
            - "Capture scheduling log: ordered list of [engine_id, enqueue_timestamp]"
            - "Verify all OSS engine entries appear before all AI engine entries"
          measurement:
            metrics:
              - name: scheduling_order_correct
                description: "Boolean: all OSS specs enqueued before all AI specs"
                source: "scheduling log analysis"
                unit: "boolean"
              - name: last_oss_enqueue_ts
                description: "Timestamp of last OSS spec enqueued"
                source: "max(enqueue_timestamp) where engine_id in [d2, mermaid, plotly]"
                unit: "ms"
              - name: first_ai_enqueue_ts
                description: "Timestamp of first AI spec enqueued"
                source: "min(enqueue_timestamp) where engine_id in [gpt_image, recraft, ideogram]"
                unit: "ms"
              - name: oss_completion_before_ai
                description: "Boolean: all OSS renders complete before all AI renders complete"
                source: "max(oss_end_timestamps) < max(ai_end_timestamps)"
                unit: "boolean"
          targets:
            scheduling_order_correct:
              operator: "=="
              value: true
              rationale: >
                OSS-first scheduling enables partial render and reduces
                perceived latency. Deterministic engines finish fast (~1-5s),
                so PPTX composition can start while AI engines are still
                processing (~10-30s).
            oss_completion_before_ai:
              operator: "=="
              value: true
              rationale: >
                OSS engines are ~5-10x faster than AI engines. With OSS
                scheduled first, they should complete well before AI engines.
          pass_condition: "scheduling_order_correct == true"
          fail_action: >
            Check visual-scout's spec sorting logic. Specs should be sorted
            by engine category (diagram > data_viz > ai_vector > ai_image)
            before being fed to the concurrency pool. If sorting is correct
            but scheduling is wrong, check if the pool implementation
            preserves insertion order.

        - id: OSS-PARTIAL-RENDER
          name: "Partial Render Unblocking"
          description: >
            Verify that slides with completed OSS visuals can be passed to
            Phase 5 (Design Render) while AI visuals are still generating.
            This is the "partial render" optimization that reduces
            end-to-end latency.
          setup:
            - "Prepare 12-slide deck with mixed OSS/AI visuals"
            - "Enable phase overlap logging"
          execution:
            - "Start Phase 4 (Asset Resolution)"
            - "When first batch of OSS visuals complete: check if Phase 5 can begin for those slides"
            - "Record: phase5_first_slide_start vs phase4_last_ai_complete"
          measurement:
            metrics:
              - name: partial_render_enabled
                description: "Boolean: Phase 5 starts for OSS slides before Phase 4 completes for AI slides"
                source: "phase5_first_slide_start < phase4_last_ai_complete"
                unit: "boolean"
              - name: overlap_time_seconds
                description: "Time saved by overlapping Phase 4 (AI) with Phase 5 (OSS slides)"
                source: "phase4_last_ai_complete - phase5_first_slide_start"
                unit: "seconds"
          targets:
            partial_render_enabled:
              operator: "=="
              value: true
              rationale: >
                Partial render is the key latency optimization. Without it,
                Phase 5 waits for ALL visuals (including slow AI engines).
                With it, OSS-only slides can be composed immediately.
            overlap_time_seconds:
              operator: ">="
              value: 5  # at least 5 seconds of overlap savings
              rationale: >
                AI engines take 10-30s. OSS engines take 1-5s. The overlap
                window should be at least 5-25 seconds.
          pass_condition: "partial_render_enabled == true AND overlap_time_seconds >= 5"
          fail_action: >
            If partial_render_enabled == false: Phase 5 is waiting for all
            Phase 4 results (batch mode, not streaming). Refactor to use
            event-driven or streaming architecture: visual-scout emits
            completed visuals as they finish, design-renderer consumes them.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SUMMARY: PASS/FAIL MATRIX
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  summary:
    description: >
      All 5 benchmarks must PASS for Story 5.4 to be considered complete.
      Any FAIL requires investigation and remediation before QA gate.
    pass_criteria:
      - benchmark: BM-CACHE-HIT
        condition: "CACHE-UNIQUE >= 10% AND CACHE-SAME-TOPIC >= 30%"
        priority: HIGH
      - benchmark: BM-BATCH-PARALLEL
        condition: "max_concurrent <= 3 AND total_generated == 12 AND recraft_concurrent <= 2"
        priority: HIGH
      - benchmark: BM-PHASE4-LATENCY
        condition: "cold < 50s AND warm < 15s"
        priority: CRITICAL
      - benchmark: BM-PIPELINE-TOTAL
        condition: "v2_total < 220s AND v1_regression <= 115s AND cost <= $2.00"
        priority: CRITICAL
      - benchmark: BM-OSS-PRIORITY
        condition: "scheduling_order_correct == true AND partial_render_enabled == true"
        priority: HIGH
    overall_pass: "ALL 5 benchmarks PASS"
    overall_fail: "ANY benchmark FAIL -> investigate, fix, re-run"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXECUTION INSTRUCTIONS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  execution:
    runner: "Manual or automated via test harness"
    recommended_order:
      - BM-OSS-PRIORITY    # scheduling validation (no perf dependency)
      - BM-BATCH-PARALLEL   # concurrency validation
      - BM-CACHE-HIT        # cache effectiveness
      - BM-PHASE4-LATENCY   # phase-level timing
      - BM-PIPELINE-TOTAL   # end-to-end (depends on all above)
    output_format: "JSON report with per-benchmark results, saved to outputs/qa/performance-report.json"
    report_sections:
      - "Benchmark ID + Name"
      - "Pass/Fail verdict"
      - "Measured values vs targets"
      - "Per-scenario details"
      - "Failure analysis (if any)"
      - "Environment metadata (platform, RAM, services, feature flags)"
```


## Referência: references/squad/archive/orphan-tests/regression-v1-compat.yaml

```yaml
# =============================================================================
# regression-v1-compat.yaml
# Backward Compatibility Regression Suite — Story 5.3 (EPIC-SC-V2-001)
#
# Defines 6 regression tests proving v1 decks, QA reports, schemas, templates,
# and pipeline steps continue to work identically after v2 upgrades.
#
# Cross-references: validate-contracts.sh (Story 4.4)
# =============================================================================

suite:
  name: "Backward Compatibility Regression Suite"
  id: "regression-v1-compat"
  version: "1.0.0"
  story: "5.3"
  epic: "EPIC-SC-V2-001"
  description: >-
    Proves that all v1 functionality remains intact after the v2 upgrade.
    Every test must PASS before any v2 feature is merged to main.
  contract_validator: "squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature Flags — must be OFF for v1 regression baseline
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
feature_flags_v1_baseline:
  ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION: false
  ENABLE_ANDRAGOGY: false
  ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 1: v1 Deck — All Feature Flags OFF
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tests:
  - id: T1
    name: "v1 deck generates identically with all feature flags OFF"
    acceptance_criteria: "Deck v1 (sem nenhum campo novo) gera identicamente com todas as feature flags desativadas"
    category: backward_compat
    priority: critical
    feature_flags:
      ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION: false
      ENABLE_ANDRAGOGY: false
      ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT: false
    input:
      briefing_fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/briefing-v1-no-education.json"
      description: >-
        Standard v1 briefing: no education_mode, no youtube_source, no audience_profile.
        Contains only required fields from briefing.normalized.json schema.
    assertions:
      - id: T1-A1
        description: "Briefing validates against briefing.normalized.json schema"
        method: schema_validation
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/briefing-v1-no-education.json"
        verify_with: "validate-contracts.sh --ci"
      - id: T1-A2
        description: "Pipeline skips youtube_ingest step (ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT=false)"
        method: workflow_trace
        workflow: "squads/slides-creator/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml"
        expected_skip: ["youtube_ingest"]
        expected_execute: ["briefing_contract", "reference_intake", "content", "template", "assets", "render", "qa", "release"]
      - id: T1-A3
        description: "Pipeline skips visual_strategy step (ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=false)"
        method: workflow_trace
        expected_skip: ["visual_strategy"]
        note: "Content step emits deck-manifest.json without visual_strategy fields — identical to v1"
      - id: T1-A4
        description: "No v2 optional fields appear in pipeline output"
        method: output_inspection
        absent_fields:
          - "visual_strategy"
          - "education_mode"
          - "audience_profile"
          - "youtube_source"
          - "andragogy"
    pass_criteria: "All 4 assertions pass"
    fail_action: "HALT — v1 backward compatibility broken"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test 2: v1 Deck — Feature Flags ON (optional fields ignored)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - id: T2
    name: "v1 deck generates correctly with feature flags ON"
    acceptance_criteria: "Deck v1 gera corretamente com feature flags ativadas (novos campos opcionais ignorados)"
    category: backward_compat
    priority: critical
    feature_flags:
      ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION: true
      ENABLE_ANDRAGOGY: true
      ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT: true
    input:
      briefing_fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/briefing-v1-no-education.json"
      description: >-
        Same v1 briefing as T1, but with all v2 feature flags enabled.
        Pipeline must gracefully handle absence of optional v2 fields.
    assertions:
      - id: T2-A1
        description: "Briefing still validates against schema (v2 fields are optional)"
        method: schema_validation
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/briefing-v1-no-education.json"
      - id: T2-A2
        description: "youtube_ingest skipped because input_type != 'youtube_url' (even with flag ON)"
        method: workflow_trace
        expected_skip: ["youtube_ingest"]
        note: "Flag alone is not sufficient — input_type must also be youtube_url"
      - id: T2-A3
        description: "visual_strategy step runs but produces no-op (no visual content types to classify)"
        method: workflow_trace
        expected_behavior: "Step executes, detects no education_mode or visual cues, emits deck-manifest.json unchanged"
      - id: T2-A4
        description: "education_mode defaults to false when absent"
        method: field_default_check
        field: "education_mode"
        expected_default: false
        schema_source: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
      - id: T2-A5
        description: "Deck output is functionally equivalent to T1 (flags-OFF)"
        method: output_comparison
        compare_against: "T1"
        tolerance: "byte-identical for manifest content fields"
    pass_criteria: "All 5 assertions pass"
    fail_action: "HALT — v2 flags break v1 payloads"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test 3: QA Report v1 — No Andragogy Dimension
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - id: T3
    name: "QA report v1 (no andragogy) has identical scores"
    acceptance_criteria: "QA report v1 (sem andragogy dimension) tem scores identicos"
    category: backward_compat
    priority: critical
    input:
      qa_report_fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/qa-report-v1.json"
      qa_report_v2_fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/qa-report-v2-education.json"
      description: >-
        v1 QA report with 4 dimensions (content, design, coherence, gad).
        No andragogy dimension present.
    assertions:
      - id: T3-A1
        description: "v1 QA report validates against qa-report.json schema v1.1.0"
        method: schema_validation
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/qa-report.json"
        fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/qa-report-v1.json"
      - id: T3-A2
        description: "v1 weights sum to 1.00 (content=0.30 + design=0.30 + coherence=0.20 + gad=0.20)"
        method: weight_validation
        expected_weights:
          content: 0.30
          design: 0.30
          coherence: 0.20
          gad: 0.20
        expected_sum: 1.00
      - id: T3-A3
        description: "composite_score calculated with v1 formula matches fixture value"
        method: score_calculation
        formula: "(content.score * 0.30) + (design.score * 0.30) + (coherence.score * 0.20) + (gad.score * 0.20)"
        fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/qa-report-v1.json"
        expected_composite: 7.93
        tolerance: 0.01
      - id: T3-A4
        description: "andragogy dimension absent or inactive in v1 report"
        method: field_absence_check
        field: "dimensions.andragogy"
        accepted_states:
          - absent
          - "active: false"
      - id: T3-A5
        description: "v2 QA report (with andragogy) also validates — schema supports both"
        method: schema_validation
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/qa-report.json"
        fixture: "schemas/contracts/fixtures/qa-report-v2-education.json"
    pass_criteria: "All 5 assertions pass"
    fail_action: "HALT — QA scoring regression"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test 4: Schema Field Integrity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - id: T4
    name: "No existing field removed or renamed in any schema"
    acceptance_criteria: "Nenhum campo existente removido ou renomeado em qualquer schema"
    category: schema_integrity
    priority: critical
    schemas_under_test:
      - path: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        version: "1.2.0"
        v1_required_fields:
          - topic
          - objective
          - audience
          - context
          - duration_minutes
          - format
          - mode
          - aspect_ratio
          - induction_mode
          - max_slides
          - brand_config_resolved
          - source_materials_count
          - reference_assets_count
          - output_targets
          - warnings
          - blockers
      - path: "squads/slides-creator/templates/qa-report.json"
        version: "1.1.0"
        v1_required_fields:
          - deck_id
          - evaluated_at
          - inputs
          - dimensions
          - composite_score
          - thresholds
          - verdict
          - next_target
          - killer_items
      - path: "schemas/contracts/youtube-extraction.schema.json"
        version: "1.0.0"
        note: "New in v2 — no v1 baseline to regress against"
      - path: "schemas/contracts/visual-generation-request.schema.json"
        version: "1.0.0"
        note: "New in v2 — no v1 baseline to regress against"
      - path: "schemas/contracts/visual-generation-response.schema.json"
        version: "1.0.0"
        note: "New in v2 — no v1 baseline to regress against"
      - path: "schemas/contracts/diagram-generation-request.schema.json"
        version: "1.0.0"
        note: "New in v2 — no v1 baseline to regress against"
    assertions:
      - id: T4-A1
        description: "briefing.normalized.json still has all 16 v1 required fields"
        method: required_field_check
        schema: "squads/slides-creator/templates/briefing.normalized.json"
        expected_required:
          - topic
          - objective
          - audience
          - context
          - duration_minutes
          - format
          - mode
          - aspect_ratio
          - induction_mode
          - max_slides
          - brand_config_resolved
          - source_materials_count
          - reference_assets_count
          - output_targets
          - warnings

      - id: T4-A2
        description: "qa-report.json still has all 9 v1 required fields"
        method: required_field_check

        expected_required:

      - id: T4-A4

      - id: T4-A5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test 5: Template Registry v1 Templates
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - id: T5
    name: "Template registry v1 templates work unchanged"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  - id: T6
    name: "Pipeline YAML v1 steps execute unchanged"

    category: backward_compat
    priority: critical
    input:
      workflow: "squads/slides-creator/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml"

            phase: 2

        description: "visual_strategy has bypass condition that skips when flag is OFF"

      - id: T6-A4
        description: "Checkpoint policy unchanged (always_active, fail_fast=true)"

          checkpoint_policy: always_active
          fail_fast: true
          max_refinement_loops: 2
      - id: T6-A5
        description: "v1 handoff prompts preserved (no renamed or removed prompts)"
        method: handoff_check
        workflow: "squads/slides-creator/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml"
        v1_handoff_keys:
          - slide-chief_to_template-curator
          - slide-chief_to_content-architect
          - template-curator_to_content-architect
          - content-architect_to_template-curator
          - template-curator_to_visual-scout
          - visual-scout_to_design-renderer
          - design-renderer_to_qa-inspector
          - qa-inspector_to_content-architect
          - qa-inspector_to_design-renderer
          - qa-inspector_to_slide-chief
      - id: T6-A6
        description: "v1 transitions preserved (briefing->reference_intake->content->template->...)"
        method: transition_check
        workflow: "squads/slides-creator/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml"
        v1_transitions:
          - from: briefing
            to: reference_intake
          - from: reference_intake
            to: content
          - from: content
            to: template
          - from: template
            to: assets
          - from: assets
            to: render
          - from: render
            to: qa
          - from: qa
            to: release
    pass_criteria: "All 6 assertions pass"
    fail_action: "HALT — pipeline regression"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Regression Checklist (consolidated execution guide)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
regression_checklist:
  description: >-
    Consolidated checklist for manual or CI execution. All items must pass
    before any v2 merge to main.
  pre_conditions:
    - "All feature flags set to OFF for baseline tests (T1, T6)"
    - "squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh is executable"
    - "All fixture files exist in schemas/contracts/fixtures/"
    - "ajv-cli available (global or npx)"
  items:
    - id: RC-1
      test_ref: T1
      description: "v1 briefing + flags OFF = identical v1 output"
      verification: "Run pipeline with v1 fixture, verify no v2 fields in output"
    - id: RC-2
      test_ref: T2
      description: "v1 briefing + flags ON = optional fields gracefully ignored"
      verification: "Run pipeline with v1 fixture + flags ON, verify no errors"
    - id: RC-3
      test_ref: T3
      description: "QA report v1 scores unchanged (4 dimensions, v1 weights)"
      verification: "Validate qa-report-v1.json against schema, verify composite = 7.93"
    - id: RC-4
      test_ref: T4
      description: "Schema field integrity (no removals, no renames, v2 fields optional)"
      verification: "Run validate-contracts.sh --ci (exit 0)"
    - id: RC-5
      test_ref: T5
      description: "Template registry (11 types, 61+ templates, 5 categories, aliases)"
      verification: "Parse template-registry.yaml, verify counts and mappings"
    - id: RC-6
      test_ref: T6
      description: "Pipeline v1 steps preserved (8-step sequence, bypasses, checkpoints)"
      verification: "Parse generate-presentation.yaml, verify v1 step IDs and transitions"
  pass_verdict: "All 6 items PASS"
  fail_action: "BLOCK merge. Fix regression before proceeding."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CI Integration Notes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ci_integration:
  description: >-
    For CI pipeline integration, the regression checklist can be automated by:
    1. Schema validation: already covered by validate-contracts.sh --ci
    2. Registry/workflow checks: parse YAML and verify fields programmatically
    3. Score calculations: parse JSON fixtures and verify arithmetic
  recommended_runner: "Node.js script or shell script wrapping ajv-cli + yq"
  validate_contracts_command: "./squads/slides-creator/scripts/validate-contracts.sh --ci"
  exit_code_on_failure: 1
```


## Referência: references/squad/archive/v2-prototypes/environment-setup-v2.md

# Environment Setup -- slides-creator v2

Guia completo para configurar o ambiente de desenvolvimento do slides-creator v2, incluindo os 4 upgrades: Auto Illustration Pipeline, Visual Rendering Tools, Andragogic Slide Design System e YouTube to Presentation Pipeline.

---

## Pre-requisitos

### Sistema Operacional

| Requisito | Versao Minima | Verificacao |
|-----------|---------------|-------------|
| macOS / Linux | macOS 13+ ou Ubuntu 22.04+ | `uname -a` |
| Node.js | >= 18.0.0 | `node --version` |
| npm | >= 9.0.0 | `npm --version` |
| Python | >= 3.10 | `python3 --version` |
| Docker | >= 24.0 | `docker --version` |
| Docker Compose | >= 2.20 | `docker compose version` |
| Git | >= 2.40 | `git --version` |

### CLI Tools

| Ferramenta | Instalacao | Verificacao | Usado por |
|------------|------------|-------------|-----------|
| D2 | `brew install d2` | `d2 --version` (>= 0.6) | Upgrade 1, 2 -- geracao de diagramas |
| Cairo (nativo) | `brew install cairo pango gdk-pixbuf libffi` | `python3 -c "import cairosvg"` | Upgrade 2 -- conversao SVG -> PNG |
| FFmpeg | `brew install ffmpeg` | `ffmpeg -version` | Upgrade 4 -- processamento de video |

---

## Instalacao

### 1. Dependencias Node.js

```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Dependencias Python

```bash
pip install python-pptx cairosvg PySceneDetect[opencv] plotly kaleido EasyPPTX
```

### 3. Cairo e bibliotecas nativas (macOS)

```bash
brew install cairo pango gdk-pixbuf libffi
```

Verificar instalacao:

```bash
python3 -c "import cairosvg; print('cairosvg OK')"
```

### 4. D2 CLI

```bash
brew install d2
d2 --version  # deve retornar >= 0.6
```

Teste rapido:

```bash
echo 'x -> y -> z' | d2 - test-output.svg
```

---

## Kroki Docker Setup

Kroki e o servidor de rendering de diagramas (Mermaid, D2 via API, PlantUML, etc.).

### docker-compose.slides-v2.yml

```yaml
services:
  kroki:
    image: yuzutech/kroki
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - KROKI_MERMAID_HOST=mermaid
    mem_limit: 512m
    depends_on:
      - mermaid

  mermaid:
    image: yuzutech/kroki-mermaid
    mem_limit: 256m
    expose:
      - "8002"
```

### Iniciar Kroki

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml up -d
```

### Verificar Health

```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/health
# Deve retornar: 200 OK
```

### Parar Kroki (quando nao estiver em uso)

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml down
```

**Nota:** Kroki e on-demand. Iniciar apenas quando for gerar diagramas via API. D2 CLI local e preferido para renders simples.

---

## Variaveis de Ambiente

8 novas variaveis adicionadas ao `.env.example` para v2:

| Variavel | Descricao | Valor Default | Upgrade |
|----------|-----------|---------------|---------|
| `RECRAFT_API_KEY` | API key para Recraft (geracao de imagens) | (obrigatorio se visual gen ativo) | 1, 2 |
| `KROKI_URL` | URL do servidor Kroki | `http://localhost:8000` | 2 |
| `SLIDES_COST_CAP` | Custo maximo por deck em USD | `2.00` | 1, 2 |
| `SLIDES_VIDEO_COST_CAP` | Custo maximo por video->deck em USD | `5.00` | 4 |
| `SLIDES_CACHE_DIR` | Diretorio base para cache v2 | `cache/slides-v2` | 1, 2, 4 |
| `ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION` | Feature flag: Auto Illustration Pipeline | `false` | 1, 2 |
| `ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION` | Feature flag: Andragogic Design System | `false` | 3 |
| `ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT` | Feature flag: YouTube to Presentation | `false` | 4 |

### Configurar

Copiar as variaveis para o `.env`:

```bash
# slides-creator v2
RECRAFT_API_KEY=your_key_here
KROKI_URL=http://localhost:8000
SLIDES_COST_CAP=2.00
SLIDES_VIDEO_COST_CAP=5.00
SLIDES_CACHE_DIR=cache/slides-v2
ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION=false
ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION=false
ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT=false
```

### Feature Flags

Cada upgrade pode ser ativado/desativado independentemente:

| Flag | Upgrade | Efeito quando `false` |
|------|---------|-----------------------|
| `ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION` | 1 + 2 (Auto Illustration + Visual Rendering) | Pipeline v1 intacta, sem geracao de visuais |
| `ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION` | 3 (Andragogic Design System) | QA scoring usa pesos v1, sem dimensao andragogy |
| `ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT` | 4 (YouTube Pipeline) | Input type youtube_url nao disponivel |

---

## Diretorios de Cache

Criar os diretorios de cache antes da primeira execucao:

```bash
mkdir -p cache/slides-v2/{diagrams,images,videos}
```

| Diretorio | Conteudo | TTL |
|-----------|----------|-----|
| `cache/slides-v2/diagrams` | SVG/PNG de diagramas D2/Mermaid | Indefinido (key = SHA-256 do codigo + theme) |
| `cache/slides-v2/images` | Imagens geradas por AI (GPT Image, Recraft) | 30 dias |
| `cache/slides-v2/videos` | Transcricoes e keyframes de video | 7 dias |

---

## Verificacao

### health-check-v2.sh

Script de verificacao completa do ambiente:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== slides-creator v2 Health Check ==="

# D2
echo -n "D2 CLI: "
d2 --version 2>/dev/null && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL -- brew install d2"

# Kroki
echo -n "Kroki: "
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8000/health | grep -q 200 && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL -- docker compose up"

# cairosvg
echo -n "cairosvg: "
python3 -c "import cairosvg; print('OK')" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL -- pip install cairosvg + brew install cairo"

# Python deps
echo -n "Python deps: "
python3 -c "import pptx, cairosvg, plotly; print('OK')" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL -- pip install python-pptx cairosvg plotly kaleido"

# Cache dirs
echo -n "Cache dirs: "
[ -d "cache/slides-v2/diagrams" ] && [ -d "cache/slides-v2/images" ] && [ -d "cache/slides-v2/videos" ] && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL -- mkdir -p cache/slides-v2/{diagrams,images,videos}"

# Env vars
echo -n "Env vars: "
if [ -f .env ]; then
  MISSING=""
  for var in RECRAFT_API_KEY KROKI_URL SLIDES_COST_CAP SLIDES_VIDEO_COST_CAP SLIDES_CACHE_DIR ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION ENABLE_YOUTUBE_ENTRYPOINT; do
    grep -q "^${var}=" .env || MISSING="${MISSING} ${var}"
  done
  [ -z "$MISSING" ] && echo "OK" || echo "MISSING:${MISSING}"
else
  echo "FAIL -- .env not found"
fi

echo "=== Done ==="
```

### test-renders-v2.sh

Script de teste de rendering:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "=== slides-creator v2 Render Tests ==="

TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)

# Test 1: D2 -> SVG
echo -n "D2 -> SVG: "
echo 'a -> b -> c' | d2 - "${TMPDIR}/test-d2.svg" 2>/dev/null && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL"

# Test 2: D2 -> SVG with theme overrides
echo -n "D2 themed: "
echo 'x -> y' | d2 --theme-overrides='N1:#FF6B6B,B1:#4ECDC4' - "${TMPDIR}/test-d2-themed.svg" 2>/dev/null && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL"

# Test 3: SVG -> PNG via cairosvg
echo -n "SVG -> PNG: "
if [ -f "${TMPDIR}/test-d2.svg" ]; then
  python3 -c "
import cairosvg
cairosvg.svg2png(url='${TMPDIR}/test-d2.svg', write_to='${TMPDIR}/test-d2.png', dpi=300)
print('OK')
" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL"
else
  echo "SKIP (no SVG from test 1)"
fi

# Test 4: Mermaid via Kroki
echo -n "Mermaid via Kroki: "
curl -s -o "${TMPDIR}/test-mermaid.svg" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain" \
  -d 'graph LR; A-->B; B-->C;' \
  "http://localhost:8000/mermaid/svg" 2>/dev/null && \
  [ -s "${TMPDIR}/test-mermaid.svg" ] && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL (Kroki running?)"

# Test 5: Plotly static
echo -n "Plotly static: "
python3 -c "
import plotly.graph_objects as go
fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Bar(x=['A','B','C'], y=[1,2,3])])
fig.write_image('${TMPDIR}/test-plotly.png')
print('OK')
" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL"

# Cleanup
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"

echo "=== Done ==="
```

## Troubleshooting

### D2 nao encontrado

```
d2: command not found
```

**Solucao:** `brew install d2` e reiniciar o terminal.

### cairosvg falha ao importar

```
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cairosvg'
```

**Solucao:**

1. Instalar bibliotecas nativas: `brew install cairo pango gdk-pixbuf libffi`
2. Instalar pacote Python: `pip install cairosvg`
3. Se ainda falhar, verificar que o Python esta usando o brew-installed cairo: `pkg-config --libs cairo`

### Kroki retorna connection refused

```
curl: (7) Failed to connect to localhost port 8000
```

**Solucao:** Iniciar os containers:

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml up -d
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml logs kroki  # verificar logs
```

### Kroki retorna 503 para Mermaid

```
503 Service Unavailable
```

**Solucao:** O container `mermaid` pode nao ter inicializado ainda. Aguardar 10-15 segundos apos `docker compose up` e tentar novamente. Se persistir:

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml restart mermaid
```

### Plotly/Kaleido falha ao exportar imagem

```
ValueError: Image export requires the kaleido package
```

**Solucao:** `pip install kaleido`

### FFmpeg nao encontrado (YouTube Pipeline)

```
ffmpeg: command not found
```

**Solucao:** `brew install ffmpeg`

### Memoria insuficiente com Kroki + processamento de video

**Sintoma:** Containers reiniciando, processamento lento.

**Solucao:** Nao rodar Kroki e video processing simultaneamente. O `mem_limit` dos containers esta configurado para 512m (Kroki) + 256m (Mermaid). Se necessario, parar Kroki durante processamento de video:

```bash
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml down
# processar video
docker compose -f docker-compose.slides-v2.yml up -d
# gerar diagramas
```

### Cache corrompido

**Sintoma:** Renders desatualizados ou quebrados.

**Solucao:** Limpar o cache afetado:

```bash
rm -rf cache/slides-v2/diagrams/*  # diagramas
rm -rf cache/slides-v2/images/*    # imagens AI
rm -rf cache/slides-v2/videos/*    # transcricoes/keyframes
```

## Referência: references/squad/checklists/presentation-readiness-checklist.md

# Presentation Readiness Checklist

## Contract

- [ ] `briefing.normalized.json` exists
- [ ] `reference-induction-notes.md` exists when `reference_assets` trigger `reference_first`
- [ ] `source-bundle.json` exists
- [ ] `deck-manifest.json` exists
- [ ] `template-selection-summary.md` exists once template binding runs
- [ ] `asset-resolution.json` exists when slides request visuals
- [ ] manifest remains the source of truth after template, asset, and render decisions
- [ ] `qa/report.json` exists once QA runs
- [ ] `release-summary.md` exists once the release gate runs
- [ ] non-trivial claims in the manifest point to source-bundle evidence or explicit assumptions
- [ ] template provenance is explicit
- [ ] degraded asset decisions are explicit
- [ ] workflow input path works with and without `reference_assets`
- [ ] selected mode is explicit and respected end-to-end (`palco`, `live`, or `async`)

## ds Parity

- [ ] deck can be mounted in the `ds` slide surface
- [ ] preview cards are available for all slides
- [ ] render output uses the canonical 1920x1080 surface scaled by preview/fullscreen runtime
- [ ] shared slide primitives or CSS variables drive brand styling
- [ ] fullscreen presenter opens from a slide preview
- [ ] keyboard controls work: `Escape`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Space`
- [ ] slide counter is visible
- [ ] progress bar is visible
- [ ] body scroll locks during presenter mode

## Visual QA

- [ ] multi-ratio adaptation notes exist for `16:9`, `9:16`, and `1:1` when layouts are risky
- [ ] every slide has a thumbnail
- [ ] every slide has a unique accessible title
- [ ] every image has alt text
- [ ] reduced-motion handling exists when animation is present
- [ ] no killer items remain (K1-K7 + K8 when education_mode + K9 always-on)
- [ ] K8: no jargon without pre-training in education_mode decks
- [ ] K9: no slide exceeds 60 words (exceptions: data_table 80, comparison_matrix 60, quote 60)
- [ ] no hardcoded `px` values remain in slide output
- [ ] no hardcoded brand hex values remain in slide output
- [ ] consumer dim-text token (`var(--{prefix}-dim)`) stays at or above `#777777` contrast minimum
- [ ] Palco/Live slides stay at or below 15 words
- [ ] Palco/Live slides contain zero paragraphs
- [ ] code appears as rendered text, not screenshots
- [ ] degraded assets are explicit
- [ ] degraded hero/opening/closing visuals set `human_checkpoint_required=true`
- [ ] degraded hero/opening/closing visuals set `human_checkpoint_recorded=true`
- [ ] degraded hero/opening/closing visuals have a human checkpoint note
- [ ] no blocked visual anti-pattern is approved for render
- [ ] composite score is at least `7.5`
- [ ] design/content/coherence/GAD score meets threshold
- [ ] andragogy score meets threshold when education_mode=true (weight 0.15)

## Release

- [ ] final surface target conforms to a render_target declared in `config.yaml#render_targets`
- [ ] refinement target is explicit when QA fails
- [ ] workflow re-entry point is explicit when QA fails
- [ ] refinement loop stops after two iterations and escalates instead of cycling indefinitely
- [ ] human approval recorded when required

```yaml
pack:
  name: slides-creator
  version: "9.1.0"

    Squad de agents especializados que automatizam o ciclo completo de geracao

    por design -- gera slides para qualquer marca via {{handlebars}} e CSS variables.
    Baseado em SOP-SLIDES-003 (brand-agnostic), PPTEval (Design, Content, Coherence, GAD)
    e absorção v9 da disciplina narrativa McKinsey (Pyramid + SCQA + Action Titles + APA).

absorption_source: outputs/sinkra-squad/criacao-slides-ia/

squad:
  name: slides-creator
  version: 9.1.0
  short-title: Slides Creator Squad
  description: >-
    Squad de agents especializados que automatizam o ciclo completo de geracao
    de slide decks profissionais: do briefing a entrega validada. Brand-agnostic
    por design -- gera slides para qualquer marca via {{handlebars}} e CSS variables.

  author: AIOX Community
  icon: "SC"

metadata:
  # Canonical single-block metadata (MIGRATION-SCHEMA-001 legacy comment removed; collapsed duplicates)
  name: slides-creator
  status: active
  domain: slides-creator
  quality_score:
    value: 8.9
    scale: 0-10
    rubric: "internal AIOX assessment pre-upgrade"
    scored_at: "2026-04-18"
  # absorption_source removed (duplicate — canonical declaration at top-level line 11)

workspace_integration:
  level: controlled_runtime_consumer
  rationale: >-
    Slides Creator consumes brand context from the workspace and targets a consumer
    TSX application (resolved per deployment via config.yaml#render_targets). The squad
    does not own any specific app; readiness + handoff are gated by the operator.
    Designed portable — may ship into any repo without hard refs.
  read_paths:
    - workspace/_system/config.yaml
    - workspace/businesses/

  template_namespace: slides
  owner: "operator"
  execution_mode: "contract_based"   # consumer apps implement the contract; squad emits spec
  readiness_owner: "operator"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INVARIANTS (P1-P7) — absorbed from /sinkra-map-process criacao-slides-ia
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Canonical summary: data/principios-invioláveis.md
# Canonical source:  outputs/sinkra-squad/criacao-slides-ia/architecture.yaml#invariants
invariants:
  reference: data/principios-invioláveis.md
  items:
    - id: P1
      name: Fidelidade aos dados
      enforcement_level: code
      failure_mode: "Qualquer número/citação não rastreável à fonte = QA FAIL"
    - id: P2
      name: Especificação obsessiva
      enforcement_level: schema
      failure_mode: "SlideSpec sem hex/grid_coord/pt_size = schema validation FAIL"
    - id: P3
      name: Pyramid Principle + MECE
      enforcement_level: validator
      failure_mode: "Vertical test falha OU MECE violado = QA FAIL"
    - id: P4
      name: Action titles obrigatórios
      enforcement_level: validator
      failure_mode: "Título descritivo (ex: 'Análise de market share') = QA FAIL"
    - id: P5
      name: Enumeração universal
      enforcement_level: validator
      failure_mode: "Qualquer visual sem ID (Gráfico N, Tabela N.M) = QA FAIL"
    - id: P6
      name: Citação completa APA
      enforcement_level: schema
      failure_mode: "Citação sem {org, title, date, url, access_date} = schema FAIL"
    - id: P7
      name: Prompts de IA completos (10 componentes)
      enforcement_level: schema
      failure_mode: "Prompt IA com <10 componentes = schema FAIL"

# Pattern Library (SC-xxx)
pattern_library:
  prefix: SC
  naming_convention:
    format: "{PREFIX}-{CATEGORY}-{NUMBER}"
    example: "SC-TP-001"
  categories:
    - id: TP
      name: "Task Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for slide generation task structure"
    - id: EP
      name: "Executor Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for executor types and selection"
    - id: PP
      name: "Process Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for presentation workflow processes"
    - id: IP
      name: "Integration Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for brand config and template integration"
    - id: AP
      name: "Automation Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for automated slide generation"
    - id: DP
      name: "Documentation Patterns"
      description: "Patterns for slide documentation and SOPs"
  patterns: []

# Task Standards (SC-TP-001)
task_standards:
  enforce_anatomy: true
  validator: "SC-TP-001"
  required_fields:
    - task_name
    - status
    - responsible_executor
    - execution_type
    - input
    - output
    - action_items
    - acceptance_criteria
  optional_fields:
    - estimated_time
    - dependencies
    - templates
    - quality_gate
    - handoff

# Executor Types
executor_types:
  human:
    id: "SC-EP-001"
    name: "Human Executor"
    characteristics:
      - judgment
      - creativity
      - brand_alignment
    cost: "$$$"
    speed: slow
    use_for:
      - "Brand config definition"
      - "Briefing creation"
      - "Final visual approval"
  agent:
    id: "SC-EP-002"
    name: "Agent Executor (AI)"
    characteristics:
      - analysis
      - generation
      - pattern_recognition
    cost: "$$$$"
    speed: fast
    use_for:
      - "Outline generation"
      - "TSX component generation"
      - "Quality evaluation"
      - "Template matching"
  hybrid:
    id: "SC-EP-003"
    name: "Hybrid Executor"
    characteristics:
      - ai_assisted
      - human_validated
    cost: "$$"
    speed: moderate
    use_for:
      - "Content review"
      - "Visual QA"
      - "Brand compliance check"
  worker:
    id: "SC-EP-004"
    name: "Worker Executor"
    characteristics:
      - deterministic
      - api_integration
      - file_operations
    cost: "$"
    speed: very_fast
    use_for:
      - "Image search and validation"
      - "WCAG contrast calculation"
      - "Lint and typecheck execution"

executor_selection:
  requires_creativity: human
  requires_judgment: [human, hybrid]
  requires_speed: [agent, worker]
  requires_consistency: worker
  requires_validation: hybrid
  requires_learning: agent

# Workflow Configuration
workflow_config:
  checkpoint_policy: always_active
  checkpoint_modes:
    always_active: "Every checkpoint MUST pass"
    skip_on_override: "Can skip with manual approval"
    advisory: "Only alerts, doesn't block"
  fail_fast: true
  allow_manual_override: false

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUALITY GATES (Numeric Thresholds)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
quality_gates:
  - name: brand-token-compliance
    executor: Worker
    threshold: "token_usage >= 95% AND 0 custom violations"
    description: "Validates design token usage against brand config"
  - name: visual-regression
    executor: Worker
    threshold: "< 2% pixel diff from reference"
    description: "Pixel-level comparison with reference renders"
  - name: accessibility
    executor: Worker
    threshold: "0 WCAG AA violations"
    description: "Automated WCAG AA compliance scan"
  - name: ppteval-composite
    executor: Agent
    threshold: "Design >= 7, Content >= 7, Coherence >= 7, GAD >= 7"
    description: "PPTEval 4-dimension quality gate (existing slides-creator standard)"
  - name: human-visual-approval
    executor: Human
    threshold: "Explicit approval"
    required_for: "external-facing artifacts only"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HANDOFF CONTRACT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
handoff_contract:
  imports:
    - source: "workspace/businesses/{slug}/L2-tactical/brand/"
      provides: "Brand config (colors, fonts, spacing, logo)"
    - source: "data/template-registry.yaml"
      provides: "56 canonical slide templates with provenance"
    - source: "data/SOP-SLIDES-003.md"
      provides: "Brand-agnostic generation rules"
  exports:
    - "Rendered slide deck (TSX/HTML)"
    - "QA report (PPTEval scores)"
    - "Normalized briefing (JSON)"

settings:

    creative_tasks: opus

# SINKRA v3.2 — Artifact Contracts (Wave 3 — expanded for 16 workflow outputs)
# Each contract: producer/consumer/lifecycle + transition rules
artifact_contracts:
  # === Canonical existing contracts ===
  - artifact_id: normalized-briefing
    template_path: templates/briefing.normalized.json
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: normalize-briefing
    consumer: [catalog-sources-apa, distill-governing-thought, build-pyramid]
    transition_rules:
      draft_to_validated: "schema valid + all required fields present"
      validated_to_approved: "P00 gate implicit (no rework)"

  - artifact_id: deck-manifest
    template_path: templates/deck-manifest.json
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: create-presentation
    consumer: [Human reviewer]
    transition_rules:
      draft_to_validated: "qa_verdict == PASS"
      validated_to_approved: "Human review verdict == APPROVED"

  - artifact_id: qa-report
    template_path: templates/qa-report.json
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: qa-inspector
    consumer: [qa_verdict gate, dimension_router, Human reviewer]
    transition_rules:
      draft_to_validated: "all 6 validators emitted"
      validated_to_approved: "qa_verdict gate PASS"

  # === Narrative outputs (P01-P02) ===
  - artifact_id: sources-apa
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: catalog-sources-apa
    consumer: [validate-fontes-apa, p1-fidelity-sampling]
    schema_ref: "APA schema: {org, title, date, url, access_date}"

  - artifact_id: governing-thought
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated]
    producer: distill-governing-thought
    consumer: [build-pyramid]

  - artifact_id: pyramid-tree
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: build-pyramid
    consumer: [write-action-titles, classify-slide-type, validate-pyramid, emit-deck-spec]
    schema_ref: data/checkpoint-schema.yaml
    invariant_enforced: [P3]

  - artifact_id: scqa-map
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: apply-scqa
    consumer: [write-action-titles, validate-vertical-flow]

  - artifact_id: vertical-test-result
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated]
    producer: run-vertical-test
    consumer: [D02_gate]
    cross_session: true

  # === Spec outputs (P03-P04) ===
  - artifact_id: grid-layouts
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated]
    producer: compose-grid-layout
    consumer: [emit-deck-spec]

  - artifact_id: active-palette
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, approved]
    producer: resolve-active-palette
    consumer: [compose-grid-layout, emit-deck-spec, handoff-render-request]
    co_sign_on_override: STK-10

  - artifact_id: deck-spec
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: emit-deck-spec
    consumer: [P05 validators, handoff-render-request, create-presentation]
    invariant_enforced: [P2, P5]
    schema_ref: "hex/grid_coord/pt_size required per slide"

  # === Release outputs (P06) ===
  - artifact_id: render-request
    template_path: inline
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: handoff-render-request
    consumer: ["consumer_tsx_app (resolved per render_targets); LLM-direct fallback"]
    handoff_token: BC-08_RENDER_REQUEST

  - artifact_id: slide-specifications
    template_path: "deliverables/Slide_Specifications.md"
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: create-presentation
    consumer: [Human reviewer, audience]

  - artifact_id: design-system-doc
    template_path: "deliverables/Design_System.md"
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: create-presentation
    consumer: [Human reviewer]

  - artifact_id: references-bibliography
    template_path: "deliverables/References_Bibliography.md"
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: catalog-sources-apa + create-presentation
    consumer: [Human reviewer, audience]
    invariant_enforced: [P6]

  - artifact_id: ai-image-prompts
    template_path: "deliverables/AI_Image_Prompts.md"
    lifecycle_states: [draft, validated, approved]
    producer: create-presentation
    consumer: [visual-scout, Human reviewer]
    invariant_enforced: [P7]

  - artifact_id: version-history
    template_path: "deliverables/Version_History.md"
    lifecycle_states: [draft, approved]
    producer: create-presentation
    consumer: [Human reviewer]

# RENDER TARGETS (brand-agnostic — consumer app contract, not specific paths)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
render_targets:
  - id: consumer_tsx_app
    status: ACTIVE
    contract: "Consumer React/Next.js app conforming to tech_discipline in slide-component-vocabulary.yaml"
    output_pattern: "{consumer_root}/{consumer_slides_dir}/{slide-id}.tsx"
    stack_required: "React 18+ / Tailwind v4 / shadcn/ui new-york baseline / cssVariables: true"
    canvas: "1920×1080 via consumer-implemented SlideFrame equivalent"
    chrome: "consumer-implemented chrome_atom per chrome_atom_contract"
    skeleton: templates/slide-component.tsx.hbs
    brand_resolution: "via CSS var prefix declared in consumer globals.css + resolve-active-palette.yaml mapping"
    consumer_inputs_required:
      - "chrome_atom implementation path"
      - "motion library import path (Framer Motion OR equivalent with useReducedMotion)"
      - "class-merge utility path (cn() equivalent)"
      - "motion presets module path"
      - "brand.css_var_prefix (eg: 'bb', 'rp', 'acme')"
      - "brand token mappings (background, fg, accent, dim, display_font)"

  - id: llm_direct
    status: FALLBACK
    output: "markdown + deck-spec.yaml (no TSX emission)"
    contract: "Used when no consumer TSX app is wired; produces human-readable deliverables only"

  - id: native_pptx
    status: ACTIVE
    contract: "Native editable .pptx via @sinkra/slides-renderer consuming Native Slide IR"
    output_pattern: "outputs/slides-creator/{run_id}/exports/{run_id}.pptx"
    schema_ref: "packages/@sinkra/slides-renderer/src/ir/native-slide-ir.schema.json"
    consumer_packages:
      - "@sinkra/slides-renderer"
      - "@sinkra/slides-core"
      - "@sinkra/slides-mcp"
    surfaces:
      - cli: "scripts/sinkra/slides-cli.mjs"
      - api: "apps/squad-engine /api/v1/slides/*"
      - mcp: "@sinkra/slides-mcp"
    quality_gates:
      - "editability-report.json verdict == PASS"
      - "design-mastery-report.yaml verdict == DESIGN_100 when premium required"
      - "validate_runtime_parity.py verdict == PASS in CI"
    absorption_provenance:
      patterns_from: ["../bench/ppt-master", "../bench/powerpoint-skill"]
      runtime_from: ["../bench/Presenton (Apache-2.0) — API/MCP scaffold"]
      forbidden: ["../bench/banana-slides (AGPL-3.0)"]

sinkra_native: true

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FEATURE FLAGS (Wave C — standalone render + motion + direction advisor)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# All default false for backward-compat. Setting true activates new render modes
# and commands. Existing TSX+ds flow remains untouched when all flags are false.
feature_flags:
  ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER:
    default: false
    description: >-
      Unlock standalone HTML render modes (multi-file composer OR single-file
      web-component deck). When true, design-renderer reads data/render-modes.yaml
      and chooses mode via selection_rules. Enables PDF/PPTX/MP4 exports without
      dependency on apps/ds runtime.
    consumers:
      - agents/design-renderer.md (*render-standalone command)
      - data/render-modes.yaml (mode selection)
      - tasks/render-html-standalone.md (when implemented)
    unblocks:
      - tasks/export-editable-pptx.md
      - tasks/decide-slide-architecture.md
      - data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md

  ENABLE_MOTION_NARRATIVE:
    default: false
    description: >-
      Activate Slow-Fast-Boom-Stop narrative pacing for animated slides,
      motion graphics, and MP4 export. When delivery_format.primary == "D"
      (MP4/GIF), design-renderer applies structure from data/narrative-pacing.md.
    consumers:
      - agents/design-renderer.md (when delivery is motion-bound)
      - data/narrative-pacing.md
      - scripts/render-video.mjs (when implemented)

  ENABLE_DESIGN_DIRECTION_ADVISOR:
    default: false
    description: >-
      Route briefs with vague visual requirement through a 3-philosophy advisor
      using data/design-philosophies.md (5 schools × 4 philosophies). Triggered
      when briefing.design_context.status == "absent" AND no reference material
      was provided.
    consumers:
      - agents/slide-chief.md (routing when brief is vague)
      - tasks/advise-design-direction.md (when implemented)
      - data/design-philosophies.md
```
