## Referência: references/squad/data/andragogic-rules.yaml

```yaml
# ============================================================
# Andragogic Rules — slides-creator Squad
# Defines always-on and education-mode-only pedagogical rules
# for automated slide generation quality gates.
#
# Story 0.2: Rules defined (scope, categories, pseudocode)
# Story 3.1: Validation Engine operationalized (deterministic,
#            execution flow, scoring, severity actions)
# ============================================================

andragogic_rules:
  # --- Metadata -----------------------------------------------------------
  id: slides-creator-andragogic-rules
  version: 2.0.0
  created: 2026-03-19
  updated: 2026-03-20
  description: >-
    Regras andragogicas para validacao de slides. Divididas em always_on
    (aplicadas a TODO deck, incluindo corporativo) e education_mode_only
    (aplicadas SOMENTE quando briefing.education_mode == true).
    Baseadas em Mayer CTML, Kolb, DPC, Dreyfus e Scaffolding (Vygotsky/ZPD).
    Inclui validation_engine deterministico (sem LLM) — YAML in, boolean checks out.
  activation_contract:
    always_on: "Aplicado incondicionalmente a todo deck gerado."
    education_mode_only: "Aplicado SOMENTE quando briefing.education_mode == true."
  references:
    - docs/research/2026-03-19-slide-creator-v2-upgrade/03-andragogic-slide-design-system.md
    - outputs/enhance/slides-creator-v2-upgrade/03-roundtable.md

  # --- Word Limit Exceptions ----------------------------------------------
  word_limit_exceptions:
    description: >-
      Limites de palavras por slide_type que sobrescrevem o limite-base de 40
      palavras. Aplicaveis tanto em always_on quanto em education_mode_only.
    base_limit: 40
    exceptions:
      - slide_type: data_table
        limit: 80
        rationale: "Tabelas de dados requerem legendas, headers e notas de rodape que excedem 40 palavras sem violar carga cognitiva (informacao estruturada, nao prosa)."
      - slide_type: comparison_matrix
        limit: 60
        rationale: "Matrizes comparativas precisam de labels descritivos em ambos os eixos."
      - slide_type: quote
        limit: 60
        rationale: "Citacoes diretas nao podem ser truncadas sem perder fidelidade ao autor original."
      - slide_type: executive_summary
        limit: 80
        rationale: "Slides de resumo executivo corporativo consolidam multiplos pontos-chave. Risco K9 mitigado pelo tipo."

  # --- Always-On Rules (3) ------------------------------------------------
  # Subset conservador de Mayer aplicado a TODOS os decks.
  # Regras: MAYER-01, MAYER-06, K9 (alias LOAD-01)
  always_on_rules:
    description: >-
      3 regras aplicadas a TODOS os decks, independente de education_mode.
      Subset conservador de Mayer que melhora qualquer apresentacao sem
      restringir decks corporativos.
    count: 3
    rules:
    - id: MAYER-01
      principle: "Mayer — Principio Multimidia"
      scope: always_on
      rule: >-
        Todo slide DEVE conter pelo menos um elemento visual (diagrama, icone,
        ilustracao, grafico, foto ou imagem). Slides text-only sao proibidos
        exceto para content_variant=quote com max 15 palavras ou slide_type
        STATEMENT.
      severity: HIGH
      check: |
        IF slide.visual_elements_count == 0
           AND slide.content_variant != "quote"
           AND slide.slide_type != "STATEMENT"
        THEN FAIL("MAYER-01: slide sem elemento visual")

    - id: MAYER-06
      principle: "Mayer — Principio da Segmentacao (Cognitive Load)"
      scope: always_on
      rule: >-
        Cada slide DEVE respeitar o limite de palavras para seu tipo.
        Limite-base: 40 palavras. Excecoes por slide_type conforme
        word_limit_exceptions. Slides que excedem o limite do tipo DEVEM
        ser divididos.
      severity: HIGH
      word_limit_base: 40
      word_limit_override_source: word_limit_exceptions
      check: |
        SET limit = word_limit_exceptions[slide.slide_type] OR 40
        IF slide.word_count > limit
        THEN FAIL("MAYER-06: slide com {slide.word_count} palavras, limite para {slide.slide_type} e {limit}")

    - id: K9
      alias: LOAD-01
      principle: "Killer Item — Sobrecarga Textual Absoluta"
      scope: always_on
      rule: >-
        Nenhum slide pode ter mais de 60 palavras para tipos sem excecao.
        Tipos listados em word_limit_exceptions usam o limite do tipo
        quando este e maior que 60. K9 e a barreira final absoluta:
        bloqueia a 60 para slides normais, a 80 para data_table e
        executive_summary, a 60 para comparison_matrix e quote.
      severity: CRITICAL
      killer: true
      base_absolute_max: 60
      override_source: word_limit_exceptions
      check: |
        SET type_limit = word_limit_exceptions[slide.slide_type] OR 60
        SET k9_limit = MAX(type_limit, 60)
        IF slide.word_count > k9_limit
        THEN BLOCK("K9: slide com {slide.word_count} palavras excede limite absoluto de {k9_limit} para {slide.slide_type}")
      notes: >-
        K9 e BLOQUEANTE (severity CRITICAL). Diferente de MAYER-06 (severity HIGH)
        que usa limites por tipo com base 40. K9 e a barreira final que usa
        word_limit_exceptions como fonte unica de verdade para limites por tipo,
        com fallback de 60 palavras para tipos sem excecao definida.

  # --- Education Mode Only Rules (6) --------------------------------------
  # Regras: KOLB-01, DPC-01, PRETRAIN-01 (K8), SCAFFOLD-01, INTERACT-01, MAYER-05
  education_mode_only_rules:
    description: >-
      6 regras aplicadas SOMENTE quando briefing.education_mode == true.
      Baseadas em Kolb, DPC, Dreyfus, Scaffolding e Mayer (contiguidade).
      Projetadas para decks educacionais/treinamento. NAO aplicar a decks
      corporativos, comerciais ou institucionais.
    activation_check: "briefing.education_mode == true"
    count: 6
    rules:
    - id: KOLB-01
      principle: "Kolb — Completude do Ciclo Experiencial"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        Cada modulo do deck DEVE conter as 4 fases do ciclo Kolb:
        EC (Experiencia Concreta), OR (Observacao Reflexiva),
        CA (Conceitualizacao Abstrata), EA (Experimentacao Ativa).
        Proporcao recomendada: EC 15-20%, OR 15-20%, CA 30-40%, EA 20-30%.
        NUNCA comecar por CA (teoria). SEMPRE comecar por EC (problema/cenario).
        SEMPRE terminar por EA (aplicacao).
      severity: HIGH
      check: |
        SET phases = COLLECT(slide.kolb_phase FOR slide IN module.slides)
        IF "EC" NOT IN phases THEN FAIL("KOLB-01: fase EC ausente no modulo")
        IF "OR" NOT IN phases THEN FAIL("KOLB-01: fase OR ausente no modulo")
        IF "CA" NOT IN phases THEN FAIL("KOLB-01: fase CA ausente no modulo")
        IF "EA" NOT IN phases THEN FAIL("KOLB-01: fase EA ausente no modulo")
        IF module.slides[0].kolb_phase == "CA"
        THEN FAIL("KOLB-01: modulo comeca com teoria (CA) em vez de experiencia (EC)")

    - id: DPC-01
      principle: "DPC — Ordenamento Declarativo-Procedural-Condicional"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        Dentro de cada conceito ensinado, a sequencia DEVE seguir:
        D (Declarativo — "o que e") antes de P (Procedural — "como fazer")
        antes de C (Condicional — "quando/por que usar").
        Primeira ocorrencia de D deve preceder primeira de P, que deve
        preceder primeira de C.
      severity: HIGH
      check: |
        SET d_first = FIRST_INDEX(slide.dpc_type == "D" FOR slide IN concept.slides)
        SET p_first = FIRST_INDEX(slide.dpc_type == "P" FOR slide IN concept.slides)
        SET c_first = FIRST_INDEX(slide.dpc_type == "C" FOR slide IN concept.slides)
        IF d_first > p_first THEN FAIL("DPC-01: Procedural aparece antes de Declarativo")
        IF p_first > c_first THEN FAIL("DPC-01: Condicional aparece antes de Procedural")

    - id: K8
      alias: PRETRAIN-01
      principle: "Killer Item — Jargao sem Pre-treino"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        Nenhum slide pode usar termo tecnico ou jargao que nao tenha sido
        definido em um slide anterior do mesmo deck. Viola o Principio do
        Pre-treino de Mayer e cria barreira cognitiva artificial.
        Aplicavel SOMENTE em education_mode porque decks corporativos
        assumem audiencia com dominio do vocabulario do setor.
      severity: CRITICAL
      killer: true
      check: |
        SET defined_terms = COLLECT(slide.introduces_terms FOR slide IN deck.slides WHERE slide.position < current.position)
        FOR term IN current.technical_terms:
          IF term NOT IN defined_terms
          THEN BLOCK("K8: termo '{term}' usado no slide {current.position} sem definicao previa")

    - id: SCAFFOLD-01
      principle: "Scaffolding — Fade de Suporte Progressivo"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        O nivel de suporte ao aprendiz DEVE diminuir progressivamente ao
        longo do modulo, seguindo o padrao:
        full (exemplo completo + explicacao detalhada) ->
        partial (exemplo completo + explicacao resumida) ->
        hints (exemplo parcial + dicas) ->
        minimal (prompt de problema + suporte minimo).
        O suporte NUNCA deve aumentar dentro do mesmo modulo (exceto em
        retomadas explicitas de conceito).
      severity: LOW
      support_levels_ordered:
        - full
        - partial
        - hints
        - minimal
      check: |
        FOR i IN 1..LENGTH(module.slides)-1:
          SET prev = module.slides[i-1].support_level
          SET curr = module.slides[i].support_level
          IF INDEX(curr) < INDEX(prev)
             AND module.slides[i].is_concept_retake != true
          THEN WARN("SCAFFOLD-01: suporte aumentou de {prev} para {curr} no slide {i}")

    - id: INTERACT-01
      principle: "Interacao — Frequencia Minima de Engajamento"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        Maximo de 5 slides consecutivos sem interacao (slide de tipo OR
        ou EA no ciclo Kolb, ou slide com interaction_type definido).
        Adultos sao auto-dirigidos; passividade prolongada causa
        desengajamento.
      severity: MEDIUM
      max_consecutive_passive: 5
      check: |
        SET counter = 0
        FOR slide IN module.slides:
          IF slide.kolb_phase IN ["OR", "EA"]
             OR slide.interaction_type IS NOT NULL
          THEN SET counter = 0
          ELSE SET counter = counter + 1
          IF counter > 5
          THEN FAIL("INTERACT-01: {counter} slides consecutivos sem interacao")

    - id: MAYER-05
      principle: "Mayer — Principio da Contiguidade Espacial"
      scope: education_mode_only
      rule: >-
        Texto explicativo e o elemento visual que ele descreve DEVEM estar
        adjacentes no mesmo slide. Labels devem estar proximos ao elemento
        visual (nao em legenda separada). Nunca colocar grafico em um slide
        e sua explicacao no slide seguinte.
      severity: MEDIUM
      check: |
        IF slide.has_visual == true
           AND slide.has_text == true
           AND slide.text_visual_proximity != "adjacent"
        THEN FAIL("MAYER-05: texto e visual nao estao adjacentes")

  # --- Validation Engine --------------------------------------------------
  # Story 3.1: Motor de validacao DETERMINISTICO.
  # YAML in, boolean checks out. Zero LLM involvement.
  validation_engine:
    description: >-
      Motor de validacao deterministico para regras andragogicas.
      Recebe deck-manifest.json como input, executa checks por slide,
      agrega score e retorna resultado estruturado. Sem LLM — apenas
      logica condicional sobre campos do manifest.
    version: 1.0.0
    deterministic: true
    llm_required: false

    # --- Input Contract ---------------------------------------------------
    input:
      type: "deck-manifest.json"
      required_fields:
        - "slides[].word_count"
        - "slides[].slide_type"
        - "slides[].visual_elements_count"
      optional_fields:
        - "briefing.education_mode"
        - "briefing.audience_profile.dreyfus_level"
        - "slides[].content_variant"
        - "slides[].kolb_phase"
        - "slides[].dpc_type"
        - "slides[].support_level"
        - "slides[].interaction_type"
        - "slides[].has_visual"
        - "slides[].has_text"
        - "slides[].text_visual_proximity"
        - "slides[].variables_count"
        - "slides[].uses_undefined_term"
        - "slides[].introduces_terms"
        - "slides[].technical_terms"
        - "slides[].is_concept_retake"
        - "modules[].slides"

    # --- Output Contract --------------------------------------------------
    output:
      type: "andragogic-validation-result"
      schema:
        passed: "boolean — true se zero BLOCK e zero FAIL com severity CRITICAL"
        score: "float 0.0-1.0 — percentual de checks que passaram"
        total_checks: "int — quantidade total de checks executados"
        passed_checks: "int — quantidade de checks que passaram"
        failed_checks: "int — quantidade de checks que falharam"
        blocked: "boolean — true se qualquer killer item (K8/K9) disparou BLOCK"
        mode: "string — 'standard' ou 'education'"
        rules_applied: "string[] — lista de rule IDs aplicados nesta execucao"
        violations:
          type: "array"
          item_schema:
            rule_id: "string — ID da regra violada (e.g., MAYER-01, K9)"
            severity: "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW"
            action: "BLOCK|FAIL|WARN"
            message: "string — mensagem descritiva da violacao"
            slide_index: "int — indice do slide que violou (0-based)"
            slide_type: "string — tipo do slide"
            details: "object — dados adicionais especificos da regra"
        summary:
          critical_count: "int"
          high_count: "int"
          medium_count: "int"
          low_count: "int"
          killer_items_triggered: "string[] — IDs dos killer items que dispararam"

    # --- Execution Flow ---------------------------------------------------
    execution_flow:
      description: >-
        Fluxo sequencial e deterministico. Cada etapa depende da anterior.
        Nenhuma etapa envolve chamada a LLM.
      steps:
        - step: 1
          name: "load_rules"
          description: >-
            Carregar andragogic-rules.yaml e parsear todas as regras
            (always_on_rules + education_mode_only_rules) e word_limit_exceptions.
          input: "andragogic-rules.yaml"
          output: "parsed_rules{always_on[], education_mode_only[], word_limit_exceptions{}}"
          pseudocode: |
            rules = YAML.parse("andragogic-rules.yaml")
            always_on = rules.always_on_rules
            education_only = rules.education_mode_only_rules
            exceptions = rules.word_limit_exceptions
            RETURN { always_on, education_only, exceptions }

        - step: 2
          name: "detect_mode"
          description: >-
            Determinar o modo de validacao com base no briefing.
            Se briefing.education_mode == true, ativar regras education_mode_only
            ALEM das always_on. Caso contrario, apenas always_on.
          input: "deck-manifest.json → briefing.education_mode"
          output: "mode: 'standard' | 'education'"
          pseudocode: |
            IF manifest.briefing.education_mode == true
            THEN mode = "education"
            ELSE mode = "standard"
            RETURN mode

        - step: 3
          name: "filter_rules"
          description: >-
            Montar a lista de regras aplicaveis com base no modo detectado.
            Standard: apenas always_on (3 regras).
            Education: always_on + education_mode_only (9 regras).
          input: "parsed_rules, mode"
          output: "active_rules[]"
          pseudocode: |
            active_rules = always_on_rules
            IF mode == "education"
            THEN active_rules = active_rules + education_mode_only_rules
            RETURN active_rules

        - step: 4
          name: "build_exception_map"
          description: >-
            Construir lookup map de word_limit_exceptions indexado por slide_type
            para consulta O(1) durante validacao.
          input: "word_limit_exceptions"
          output: "exception_map{slide_type -> limit}"
          pseudocode: |
            exception_map = {}
            FOR exc IN word_limit_exceptions.exceptions:
              exception_map[exc.slide_type] = exc.limit
            RETURN exception_map

        - step: 5
          name: "validate_per_slide"
          description: >-
            Iterar por cada slide do manifest e executar todas as regras
            ativas que operam no nivel de slide (MAYER-01, MAYER-06, K9,
            MAYER-05, K8, DREYFUS-01). Coletar violacoes.
          input: "manifest.slides[], active_rules[], exception_map"
          output: "slide_violations[]"
          pseudocode: |
            violations = []
            defined_terms = []

            FOR i, slide IN ENUMERATE(manifest.slides):
              # --- Always-on per-slide rules ---
              # MAYER-01: Multimedia check
              IF "MAYER-01" IN active_rules:
                IF slide.visual_elements_count == 0
                   AND slide.content_variant != "quote"
                   AND slide.slide_type != "STATEMENT"
                THEN violations.APPEND({
                  rule_id: "MAYER-01", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                  message: "slide sem elemento visual",
                  slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type
                })

              # MAYER-06: Segmentation check
              IF "MAYER-06" IN active_rules:
                SET limit = exception_map[slide.slide_type] OR 40
                IF slide.word_count > limit
                THEN violations.APPEND({
                  rule_id: "MAYER-06", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                  message: "slide com {slide.word_count} palavras, limite {limit}",
                  slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type,
                  details: { word_count: slide.word_count, limit: limit }
                })

              # K9 (LOAD-01): Hard word limit check
              IF "K9" IN active_rules:
                SET type_limit = exception_map[slide.slide_type] OR 60
                SET k9_limit = MAX(type_limit, 60)
                IF slide.word_count > k9_limit
                THEN violations.APPEND({
                  rule_id: "K9", severity: "CRITICAL", action: "BLOCK",
                  message: "slide com {slide.word_count} palavras excede limite absoluto {k9_limit}",
                  slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type,
                  details: { word_count: slide.word_count, k9_limit: k9_limit }
                })

              # --- Education-mode per-slide rules ---
              # MAYER-05: Spatial contiguity check
              IF "MAYER-05" IN active_rules:
                IF slide.has_visual == true
                   AND slide.has_text == true
                   AND slide.text_visual_proximity != "adjacent"
                THEN violations.APPEND({
                  rule_id: "MAYER-05", severity: "MEDIUM", action: "FAIL",
                  message: "texto e visual nao estao adjacentes",
                  slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type
                })

              # K8 (PRETRAIN-01): Jargon without pre-training
              IF "K8" IN active_rules:
                FOR term IN slide.technical_terms:
                  IF term NOT IN defined_terms
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "K8", severity: "CRITICAL", action: "BLOCK",
                    message: "termo '{term}' usado sem definicao previa",
                    slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type,
                    details: { undefined_term: term, defined_terms: defined_terms }
                  })
                # Track terms introduced by this slide
                defined_terms = defined_terms + (slide.introduces_terms OR [])

              # DREYFUS-01: Learner level calibration
              IF "DREYFUS-01" IN active_rules:
                SET level = manifest.briefing.audience_profile.dreyfus_level
                SET params = dreyfus_parameters[level]
                IF params IS NOT NULL:
                  IF slide.variables_count > params.max_variables_per_slide
                     AND params.max_variables_per_slide != "unlimited"
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "DREYFUS-01", severity: "MEDIUM", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "slide com {slide.variables_count} variaveis excede {params.max_variables_per_slide} para nivel {level}",
                    slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type,
                    details: { variables: slide.variables_count, max: params.max_variables_per_slide, level: level }
                  })
                  IF params.vocabulary_pretraining == "mandatory"
                     AND slide.uses_undefined_term == true
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "DREYFUS-01", severity: "MEDIUM", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "termo tecnico sem pre-treino (obrigatorio para {level})",
                    slide_index: i, slide_type: slide.slide_type,
                    details: { level: level, pretraining_required: true }
                  })

            RETURN violations

        - step: 6
          name: "validate_per_module"
          description: >-
            Iterar por cada modulo do manifest e executar regras que operam
            no nivel de modulo (KOLB-01, DPC-01, SCAFFOLD-01, INTERACT-01).
            Somente executado em education mode.
          input: "manifest.modules[], active_rules[]"
          output: "module_violations[]"
          condition: "mode == 'education'"
          pseudocode: |
            violations = []
            IF mode != "education" THEN RETURN violations

            FOR m, module IN ENUMERATE(manifest.modules):
              # KOLB-01: Experiential cycle completeness
              IF "KOLB-01" IN active_rules:
                SET phases = COLLECT(slide.kolb_phase FOR slide IN module.slides)
                FOR required_phase IN ["EC", "OR", "CA", "EA"]:
                  IF required_phase NOT IN phases
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "KOLB-01", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "fase {required_phase} ausente no modulo {m}",
                    slide_index: module.slides[0].position,
                    details: { module_index: m, missing_phase: required_phase, phases_found: phases }
                  })
                IF LENGTH(module.slides) > 0 AND module.slides[0].kolb_phase == "CA"
                THEN violations.APPEND({
                  rule_id: "KOLB-01", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                  message: "modulo {m} comeca com teoria (CA) em vez de experiencia (EC)",
                  slide_index: module.slides[0].position,
                  details: { module_index: m, first_phase: "CA" }
                })

              # DPC-01: Declarative-Procedural-Conditional ordering
              IF "DPC-01" IN active_rules:
                FOR concept IN module.concepts:
                  SET d_first = FIRST_INDEX(s.dpc_type == "D" FOR s IN concept.slides)
                  SET p_first = FIRST_INDEX(s.dpc_type == "P" FOR s IN concept.slides)
                  SET c_first = FIRST_INDEX(s.dpc_type == "C" FOR s IN concept.slides)
                  IF d_first IS NOT NULL AND p_first IS NOT NULL AND d_first > p_first
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "DPC-01", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "Procedural antes de Declarativo no modulo {m}",
                    slide_index: concept.slides[p_first].position,
                    details: { module_index: m, d_index: d_first, p_index: p_first }
                  })
                  IF p_first IS NOT NULL AND c_first IS NOT NULL AND p_first > c_first
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "DPC-01", severity: "HIGH", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "Condicional antes de Procedural no modulo {m}",
                    slide_index: concept.slides[c_first].position,
                    details: { module_index: m, p_index: p_first, c_index: c_first }
                  })

              # SCAFFOLD-01: Support fade
              IF "SCAFFOLD-01" IN active_rules:
                SET levels_order = ["full", "partial", "hints", "minimal"]
                FOR i IN 1..LENGTH(module.slides)-1:
                  SET prev_level = module.slides[i-1].support_level
                  SET curr_level = module.slides[i].support_level
                  IF prev_level IS NOT NULL AND curr_level IS NOT NULL:
                    SET prev_idx = INDEX_OF(prev_level IN levels_order)
                    SET curr_idx = INDEX_OF(curr_level IN levels_order)
                    IF curr_idx < prev_idx
                       AND module.slides[i].is_concept_retake != true
                    THEN violations.APPEND({
                      rule_id: "SCAFFOLD-01", severity: "LOW", action: "WARN",
                      message: "suporte aumentou de {prev_level} para {curr_level}",
                      slide_index: module.slides[i].position,
                      details: { module_index: m, from: prev_level, to: curr_level }
                    })

              # INTERACT-01: Engagement frequency
              IF "INTERACT-01" IN active_rules:
                SET counter = 0
                FOR slide IN module.slides:
                  IF slide.kolb_phase IN ["OR", "EA"]
                     OR slide.interaction_type IS NOT NULL
                  THEN SET counter = 0
                  ELSE SET counter = counter + 1
                  IF counter > 5
                  THEN violations.APPEND({
                    rule_id: "INTERACT-01", severity: "MEDIUM", action: "FAIL",
                    message: "{counter} slides consecutivos sem interacao no modulo {m}",
                    slide_index: slide.position,
                    details: { module_index: m, consecutive_passive: counter }
                  })

            RETURN violations

        - step: 7
          name: "aggregate_results"
          description: >-
            Combinar violacoes de slide-level e module-level.
            Calcular score, contar por severity, determinar se deck
            passou ou foi bloqueado.
          input: "slide_violations[], module_violations[], active_rules[]"
          output: "andragogic-validation-result"
          pseudocode: |
            all_violations = slide_violations + module_violations

            # Count by severity
            critical = COUNT(v FOR v IN all_violations WHERE v.severity == "CRITICAL")
            high = COUNT(v FOR v IN all_violations WHERE v.severity == "HIGH")
            medium = COUNT(v FOR v IN all_violations WHERE v.severity == "MEDIUM")
            low = COUNT(v FOR v IN all_violations WHERE v.severity == "LOW")

            # Identify killer items
            killers = UNIQUE(v.rule_id FOR v IN all_violations WHERE v.action == "BLOCK")

            # Calculate score
            # Total possible checks = (slides * per_slide_rules) + (modules * per_module_rules)
            total_checks = COUNT(all checks executed)
            passed_checks = total_checks - LENGTH(all_violations)
            score = passed_checks / total_checks IF total_checks > 0 ELSE 1.0

            # Determine pass/fail
            blocked = LENGTH(killers) > 0
            passed = critical == 0 AND NOT blocked

            RETURN {
              passed: passed,
              score: ROUND(score, 3),
              total_checks: total_checks,
              passed_checks: passed_checks,
              failed_checks: LENGTH(all_violations),
              blocked: blocked,
              mode: mode,
              rules_applied: [r.id FOR r IN active_rules],
              violations: all_violations,
              summary: {
                critical_count: critical,
                high_count: high,
                medium_count: medium,
                low_count: low,
                killer_items_triggered: killers
              }
            }

    # --- Severity Actions -------------------------------------------------
    severity_actions:
      description: >-
        Mapeamento de severity para acao do engine. Define o que acontece
        quando cada nivel de severidade e violado.
      mapping:
        CRITICAL:
          action: BLOCK
          description: "Deck NAO pode ser emitido. Violacao deve ser corrigida."
          blocks_output: true
          routing: "content-architect para reescrita"
        HIGH:
          action: FAIL
          description: "Deck emitido com WARNING prominente. Score penalizado fortemente."
          blocks_output: false
          routing: "content-architect (sequencia) ou design-renderer (layout)"
        MEDIUM:
          action: FAIL
          description: "Deck emitido com nota no QA report. Score penalizado moderadamente."
          blocks_output: false
          routing: "agente apropriado conforme tipo de violacao"
        LOW:
          action: WARN
          description: "Apenas registrado no QA report. Score penalizado minimamente."
          blocks_output: false
          routing: "nenhum — informativo apenas"

    # --- Integration Points -----------------------------------------------
    integration:
      qa_inspector:
        dimension: "andragogy"
        weight_education_mode: 0.15
        weight_standard_mode: 0.0
        score_field: "andragogic_validation.score"
      refinement_routing:
        sequence_violations: ["KOLB-01", "DPC-01", "SCAFFOLD-01"]
        content_violations: ["K8", "K9", "MAYER-06", "INTERACT-01"]
        layout_violations: ["MAYER-01", "MAYER-05"]
        calibration_violations: ["DREYFUS-01"]
      feature_flag: "ENABLE_ANDRAGOGIC_VALIDATION"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/asset-resolution.yaml

```yaml
asset_resolution:
  id: slides-creator-asset-resolution
  version: 1.3.0
  updated_at: 2026-03-20
  updated_by: "Story 1.3 (EPIC-SC-V2-001)"
  source_of_truth:
    canonical_sources:
      - path: docs/projects/slides-creator-prd.md
        status: implemented
      - path: docs/projects/slides-creator-prd.md
        status: partial
      - path: squads/slides-creator/data/SOP-SLIDES-001.md
        status: implemented
      - path: squads/slides-creator/data/SOP-SLIDES-003.md
        status: implemented
      - path: squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml
        status: implemented
        added_by: "Story 1.1"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FALLBACK CHAIN (v2 — with "generate" branch)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Story 1.1 adds the ai_generation step with full routing to VisualEngine
  # strategy pattern. When visual_strategy.engine != "none", the flow can
  # skip steps 1-3 and go directly to ai_generation.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fallback_chain:
    - id: briefing_assets
      order: 1
      description: Assets explicit in the briefing, brand package, or source bundle
      success_status: resolved

    - id: reference_extraction
      order: 2
      description: Assets extracted from PPTX, screenshots, or reference decks
      success_status: resolved

    - id: contextual_search
      order: 3
      description: Web/provider search using narrative keywords plus brand context
      success_status: resolved
      failure_status: blocked

    - id: ai_generation
      order: 4
      description: >
        AI-generated visual via VisualEngine strategy pattern. Routes to the
        appropriate engine (D2, Mermaid, GPT Image, Recraft, Plotly, Ideogram)
        based on visual_strategy.engine from deck-manifest. Falls through the
        engine's fallback_chain on failure before reaching degraded_placeholder.
      success_status: generated
      failure_status: blocked
      feature_flag: ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION
      # --- Story 1.1: Generate branch operational config ---
      generate_config:
        routing_source: "visual-engines.yaml -> routing_table"
        engine_selection: "routing_table[visual_strategy.content_type].primary_engine"
        skip_search_when: "visual_strategy.engine != 'none'"
        skip_search_description: >
          When the content-architect has assigned a visual_strategy with a
          specific engine, skip briefing_assets, reference_extraction, and
          contextual_search -- go directly to ai_generation. This avoids
          wasting time searching for images when we know we want a diagram.
        budget_check: "estimateCost(spec) <= remaining_deck_budget"
        fallback_within_generate:
          description: >
            Within ai_generation, each engine has its own fallback_engines list.
            visual-scout tries the primary engine, then iterates fallback_engines.
            Only after ALL engine fallbacks are exhausted does the chain fall
            through to degraded_placeholder.
          max_engine_attempts: 3
          example: "d2 fails -> mermaid fallback -> if mermaid fails -> contextual_search -> degraded_placeholder"

    - id: degraded_placeholder
      order: 5
      description: Explicit placeholder when no valid candidate survives the gate
      success_status: degraded

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # STATUS MODEL (v2 — adds "generated")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  status_model:
    resolved:
      meaning: Final candidate from search or briefing approved for render
    generated:
      meaning: Visual created by VisualEngine via ai_generation step
      added_by: "Story 1.1"
      provenance_detail_values:
        - d2_kroki
        - d2_cli
        - mermaid_kroki
        - gpt_image_1_5
        - recraft_v4
        - plotly_local
        - ideogram_v3
    degraded:
      meaning: Placeholder or lower-tier fallback accepted temporarily with explicit visibility
    blocked:
      meaning: Candidate rejected and not eligible for final asset_ref output

  final_output_policy:
    allowed_final_statuses:
      - resolved
      - generated
      - degraded
    blocked_candidates_must_stay_in: rejected_candidates
    blocked_final_asset_ref_forbidden: true

  validation_rules:
    min_width_px: 1920
    preferred_format: webp
    max_file_size_kb: 500
    screenshot_requires_frame: true
    light_background_requires_border: true
    dark_background_can_full_bleed: true
    # --- Story 1.1: additional validation for generated assets ---
    generated_asset_rules:
      svg_must_be_valid: true
      png_min_dpi: 300
      brand_compliance_required: true
      max_generation_time_ms: 30000

  blocked_patterns:
    - generic_stock_photo
    - visible_watermark
    - pixelated_or_stretched
    - screenshot_without_context
    - argument_mismatch

  decision_table:
    - when: explicit briefing asset exists and passes validation
      then: use briefing_assets
    - when: reference deck contains a reusable screenshot or visual
      then: use reference_extraction
    - when: visual_strategy.engine != "none" and ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION is true
      then: skip to ai_generation (bypass contextual_search)
      added_by: "Story 1.1"
    - when: no local/reference asset fits but contextual search returns a valid candidate
      then: use contextual_search
    - when: search returns only invalid or irrelevant candidates and generation is allowed
      then: try ai_generation
    - when: no candidate survives validation
      then: emit degraded_placeholder and require checkpoint for hero/opening/closing visuals

  degraded_policy:
    explicit_required: true
    human_checkpoint_required_for:
      - hero_image
      - opening_slide_visual
      - closing_slide_visual

  asset_ref_schema:
    required_fields:
      - slide_id
      - requested_role
      - keywords
      - selected_source
      - asset_ref
      - rejected_candidates
    asset_ref_fields:
      - uri
      - provenance
      - provenance_detail    # Story 1.1: "d2_kroki", "mermaid_kroki", "gpt_image_1_5", etc.
      - fallback_status
      - generation_cost_usd  # Story 1.1: cost tracking per asset
      - cache_key            # Story 1.1: SHA-256 reference to cache entry
      - notes
      - human_checkpoint_required
      - human_checkpoint_recorded
      - human_checkpoint_note
    contract_rules:
      - "asset_ref.fallback_status must be resolved, generated, or degraded in final output"
      - "Blocked candidates stay only in rejected_candidates with an explicit reason"
      - "Degraded hero/opening/closing visuals require human_checkpoint_required=true"
      - "Degraded hero/opening/closing visuals require human_checkpoint_recorded=true before render"
      - "Generated assets MUST have provenance_detail set to engine identifier"
      - "Generated assets MUST have generation_cost_usd populated (0.0000 for free engines)"
      - "Generated assets MUST have cache_key populated (SHA-256 of engine_id + content + tokens_hash)"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CONCURRENCY CONFIG (Story 1.3 — operational limits for generate branch)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  concurrency_config:
    source: "visual-engines.yaml -> orchestration"
    global_limit: 3
    description: >
      Maximum number of simultaneous API calls during asset resolution.
      visual-scout uses Promise.allSettled to batch up to 3 concurrent
      render() calls. Recraft is further limited to 2 concurrent.
    engine_overrides:
      recraft: 2
    implementation_notes: >
      When resolving assets for a deck with N slides, visual-scout groups
      slides into batches of concurrency_limit size. Each batch resolves
      in parallel (Promise.allSettled). Recraft calls within a batch are
      further throttled to concurrency_overrides.recraft.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GENERATE OPERATIONAL FLOW (Story 1.3 — step-by-step generate branch)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  generate_operational_flow:
    description: >
      Detailed operational flow for the ai_generation step in the fallback
      chain. This is the step-by-step procedure visual-scout follows when
      executing the generate branch.
    trigger: "visual_strategy.engine != 'none' AND ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION == true"
    steps:
      - step: 1
        name: budget_pre_check
        description: >
          Call estimateCost(spec) on the target engine. Compare against
          remaining deck budget (from cost-tracking.yaml pre_call_check).
          If estimate > remaining: skip paid engine, try free fallback.
        reference: "cost-tracking.yaml -> pre_call_check.algorithm"
        on_budget_exceeded: "skip to next engine in fallback chain (free engines only)"

      - step: 2
        name: cache_lookup
        description: >
          Compute cache_key = SHA256(engine_id + diagram_code|prompt + design_tokens_hash).
          Check cache directory for existing entry. If hit: return cached
          VisualOutput with cache_hit=true, cost_usd=0, skip steps 3-7.
        reference: "visual-engines.yaml -> orchestration.cache_integration"
        on_cache_hit: "return cached output, set generation_cost_usd=0.0000"

      - step: 3
        name: engine_selection
        description: >
          Lookup routing_table by spec.content_type. Get primary_engine.
          Verify: supports() returns true, API key present in env.
          If primary fails pre-checks: iterate fallback_chain.
        reference: "visual-engines.yaml -> routing_table + engine_selection_algorithm"

      - step: 4
        name: token_transform
        description: >
          Load design tokens for the brand via Token Transformer.
          Convert to engine-specific format (CLI flag, init directive, prompt suffix).
          Inject into VisualSpec before render().
        reference: "token-transformer.yaml -> transform_pipeline"

      - step: 5
        name: render
        description: >
          Call engine.render(spec). Await response within engine timeout.
          On success: receive VisualOutput with metadata.
          On failure: receive VisualError with fallback_suggestion.
        timeout: "engine-specific (5s-30s, see visual-engines.yaml)"
        on_success: "proceed to step 6"
        on_failure: "try fallback_suggestion engine (max 2 fallbacks)"

      - step: 6
        name: brand_validation
        description: >
          Call engine.validateBrandCompliance(output, tokens).
          For diagram engines: apply color substitution if needed.
          For AI image engines: log violation, suggest re-generation.
        reference: "token-transformer.yaml -> brand_validator"
        on_violation_diagram: "substitute colors, re-render"
        on_violation_ai: "log warning, accept if delta-E < 10"

      - step: 7
        name: cost_logging
        description: >
          Record actual cost in cost-log.json. Update deck accumulated cost.
          Update monthly accumulated cost. Set generation_cost_usd in asset_ref.
        reference: "cost-tracking.yaml -> cost_log"

      - step: 8
        name: emit_asset_ref
        description: >
          Compose final asset_ref with all required fields:
          uri, provenance, provenance_detail (engine identifier),
          fallback_status=generated, generation_cost_usd, cache_key, notes.
        output_status: "generated"

    fallback_exhaustion:
      description: >
        When all engine fallbacks within ai_generation are exhausted
        (primary + max 2 fallbacks), the flow falls through to the next
        step in the asset-resolution fallback chain:
        1. If contextual_search has not been tried: try contextual_search
        2. If contextual_search also fails: emit degraded_placeholder
      max_engine_attempts: 3
      after_exhaustion: "fall_through_to_next_chain_step"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CROSS REFERENCES (Story 1.3 — how Stories 1.1-1.4 connect)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_references:
    visual_engines:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
      provides:
        - "engines_registry (6 engines with render_config)"
        - "routing_table (content_type -> engine mapping)"
        - "orchestration (concurrency, budget caps, cache, fallback strategy)"
      consumed_by: "generate_operational_flow steps 1-5"

    token_transformer:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/token-transformer.yaml"
      provides:
        - "converters (D2, Mermaid, AI Image, Plotly)"
        - "brand_validator (SVG hex, PNG delta-E, WCAG contrast)"
        - "transform_pipeline (load -> normalize -> convert -> inject -> validate)"
      consumed_by: "generate_operational_flow steps 4, 6"

    cost_tracking:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cost-tracking.yaml"
      provides:
        - "budget_caps (per_deck, per_video, monthly)"
        - "pre_call_check (estimateCost guard)"
        - "cost_log schema (append-only JSON log)"
        - "circuit_breaker (max 3 retries per call)"
      consumed_by: "generate_operational_flow steps 1, 7"
```

```yaml
# Cache Configuration for slides-creator v2 Visual Assets
# SSOT for caching strategy, key computation, TTL policy, and invalidation rules.
# Consumed by: visual-scout (cache lookup/write), qa-inspector (cache stats validation),
#               slide-chief (cache hit reporting).
# Created by: Story 1.6 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 1)
# Dependencies:
#   - schemas/contracts/asset-cache-entry.schema.json (Story 1.5 -- entry schema)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml (Story 1.1 -- engine configs)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/asset-resolution.yaml (Story 1.3 -- cache_key in asset_ref)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/cost-tracking.yaml (Story 1.4 -- cost avoidance)

cache_config:
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  story: "1.6"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GLOBAL SETTINGS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  global:
    base_directory:
      env_var: SLIDES_CACHE_DIR
      default: "cache/slides-v2"
      description: >
        Root directory for all cached visual assets. Relative to project root.
        Matches orchestration.cache_integration.cache_directory in visual-engines.yaml.
    entry_schema: "schemas/contracts/asset-cache-entry.schema.json"
    stats_file: "cache-stats.json"
    stats_file_description: >
      Hit/miss counter file. Located at ${base_directory}/cache-stats.json.
      Updated atomically on every cache lookup (hit or miss).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CACHE LEVELS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AC: Cache L1 (diagramas) -- key = SHA-256 do codigo D2/Mermaid + theme_overrides. TTL indefinido.
  # AC: Cache L2 (imagens AI) -- key = SHA-256 do prompt + engine + style_constraints. TTL 30 dias.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  levels:

    L1:
      id: diagrams
      description: >
        Deterministic diagram cache. Stores SVG output from D2, Mermaid, and
        Plotly engines. These engines are deterministic -- same input always
        produces same output -- so TTL is indefinite (immutable cache).
      directory: "diagrams"
      full_path: "${base_directory}/diagrams/{cache_key}.svg"
      ttl_hours: 0
      ttl_description: "Indefinite. Deterministic engines produce identical output for identical input."
      engines:
        - d2
        - mermaid
        - plotly
      output_format: svg
      key_computation:
        algorithm: SHA-256
        inputs:
          - field: engine_id
            description: "Engine identifier (d2, mermaid, plotly)"
          - field: diagram_code
            description: "Source code (D2 syntax, Mermaid syntax, or Plotly JSON)"
          - field: theme_overrides
            description: >
              Serialized theme/style overrides applied to the diagram.
              For D2: CLI --theme-overrides string.
              For Mermaid: %%{init}%% directive values.
              For Plotly: layout.colorway + font config.
          - field: design_tokens_hash
            description: >
              SHA-256 hash of the design tokens file used at generation time.
              Ensures cache miss when brand tokens change.
        formula: "SHA256(engine_id + '|' + diagram_code + '|' + theme_overrides + '|' + design_tokens_hash)"
        # AC: Cache e brand-scoped -- mesmo diagrama com paleta diferente = cache miss
        brand_scoping: >
          theme_overrides encodes the brand palette. Different brands produce
          different theme_overrides, resulting in different cache keys.
          Same diagram code with different palette = cache MISS. This is by design.

    L2:
      id: images
      description: >
        AI-generated image cache. Stores PNG output from GPT Image, Recraft,
        and Ideogram engines. These engines are non-deterministic but prompt +
        engine + constraints produce visually acceptable reuse. TTL 30 days
        to allow periodic refresh for style evolution.
      directory: "images"
      full_path: "${base_directory}/images/{cache_key}.png"
      ttl_hours: 720
      ttl_description: "30 days (720 hours). AI images may benefit from regeneration as models improve."
      engines:
        - gpt_image
        - recraft
        - ideogram
      output_format: png
      key_computation:
        algorithm: SHA-256
        inputs:
          - field: engine_id
            description: "Engine identifier (gpt_image, recraft, ideogram)"
          - field: prompt
            description: "Full prompt string including brand injection suffix"
          - field: style_constraints
            description: >
              Serialized style constraints: style_preference + background +
              aspect_ratio + forbidden_colors. Captures brand-specific visual rules.
          - field: design_tokens_hash
            description: >
              SHA-256 hash of the design tokens file. Ensures cache miss when
              brand visual identity changes.
        formula: "SHA256(engine_id + '|' + prompt + '|' + style_constraints + '|' + design_tokens_hash)"
        # AC: Cache e brand-scoped -- different style_constraints per brand
        brand_scoping: >
          style_constraints includes palette-derived values. Different brands
          produce different style_constraints, resulting in different cache keys.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CACHE LOOKUP (BEFORE API call -- cost avoidance)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AC: Cache lookup acontece ANTES de chamar API (evita custo desnecessario)
  # Reference: asset-resolution.yaml -> generate_operational_flow.steps[2] (cache_lookup)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lookup:
    description: >
      Cache lookup is step 2 in the generate_operational_flow, executed BEFORE
      engine.render(). On cache hit, the entire render pipeline is bypassed:
      no API call, no cost, no latency beyond filesystem read.
    trigger: "Before every engine.render(spec) call"
    algorithm:
      steps:
        - step: 1
          name: determine_cache_level
          description: >
            Map engine_id to cache level. Diagram engines (d2, mermaid, plotly)
            use L1. AI image engines (gpt_image, recraft, ideogram) use L2.
          logic: |
            if engine_id in ['d2', 'mermaid', 'plotly']:
              level = L1
            else:
              level = L2

        - step: 2
          name: compute_cache_key
          description: >
            Compute SHA-256 hash using the level's key_computation formula.
            All inputs must be normalized (trimmed, sorted for objects) before hashing.
          logic: |
            if level == L1:
              raw = engine_id + '|' + diagram_code + '|' + theme_overrides + '|' + design_tokens_hash
            else:
              raw = engine_id + '|' + prompt + '|' + style_constraints + '|' + design_tokens_hash
            cache_key = SHA256(raw)

        - step: 3
          name: check_filesystem
          description: >
            Check if file exists at level.full_path with the computed cache_key.
            For L2: also verify TTL has not expired (created_at + ttl_hours > now).
          logic: |
            file_path = level.full_path.replace('{cache_key}', cache_key)
            if file_exists(file_path):
              if level == L1:
                return CACHE_HIT  # L1 is immutable, no TTL check
              else:
                entry = read_cache_entry_metadata(cache_key)
                if entry.created_at + entry.ttl_hours > now:
                  return CACHE_HIT
                else:
                  delete_expired_entry(file_path)
                  return CACHE_MISS  # expired

        - step: 4
          name: update_stats
          description: >
            Update cache-stats.json with hit or miss counter.
            Atomic update: read -> increment -> write.
          logic: |
            stats = read_stats_file()
            if result == CACHE_HIT:
              stats.hits[level.id] += 1
              stats.total_hits += 1
            else:
              stats.misses[level.id] += 1
              stats.total_misses += 1
            write_stats_file(stats)

    on_cache_hit:
      description: >
        When cache hit: return cached VisualOutput with cache_hit=true and
        generation_cost_usd=0.0000. Skip steps 3-7 of generate_operational_flow.
      actions:
        - "Set VisualOutput.metadata.cache_hit = true"
        - "Set VisualOutput.metadata.cost_usd = 0.0000"
        - "Log to cost-log.json with cache_hit=true, cost_usd=0.0000"
        - "Skip engine.render() -- no API call"
      reference: "asset-resolution.yaml -> generate_operational_flow.steps[2].on_cache_hit"

    on_cache_miss:
      description: >
        When cache miss: proceed with normal render pipeline (steps 3-7).
        After successful render, write result to cache (see cache_write section).
      actions:
        - "Proceed to step 3 (engine_selection)"
        - "After successful render: write to cache"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CACHE WRITE (after successful render)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  write:
    description: >
      After a successful engine.render() call, write the output to cache.
      Create cache entry metadata file alongside the asset file.
    trigger: "After successful engine.render(spec) that was not a cache hit"
    algorithm:
      steps:
        - step: 1
          name: determine_paths
          description: "Compute file path based on cache level and key."
          logic: |
            asset_path = level.full_path.replace('{cache_key}', cache_key)
            metadata_path = asset_path + '.meta.json'

        - step: 2
          name: write_asset
          description: "Write the rendered asset (SVG or PNG) to the cache directory."
          logic: |
            ensure_directory_exists(dirname(asset_path))
            write_file(asset_path, output.data)

        - step: 3
          name: write_metadata
          description: >
            Write cache entry metadata conforming to asset-cache-entry.schema.json.
            Includes source_hash_inputs for debugging and invalidation.
          logic: |
            entry = {
              cache_key: cache_key,
              asset_path: asset_path,
              ttl_hours: level.ttl_hours,
              brand_id: spec.brand_id,
              engine: spec.engine,
              format: level.output_format,
              created_at: now_iso8601(),
              cost_usd: output.metadata.cost_usd,
              source_hash_inputs: {
                code_or_prompt: spec.diagram_code || spec.prompt,
                theme_overrides: spec.theme_overrides || spec.style_constraints,
                design_tokens_hash: spec.design_tokens_hash
              }
            }
            write_json(metadata_path, entry)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # INVALIDATION
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AC: Cache invalidado quando design tokens mudam (detectado via hash do arquivo de tokens)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  invalidation:
    description: >
      Cache entries are invalidated when the design tokens file changes.
      The design_tokens_hash is part of the cache key computation, so a change
      in tokens automatically produces different cache keys (natural invalidation).
      Additionally, explicit invalidation can purge stale entries.

    design_tokens_change:
      detection_method: hash_comparison
      description: >
        Before cache lookup, visual-scout computes SHA-256 of the current
        design tokens file. This hash is used as part of the cache key.
        When tokens change, the hash changes, producing different cache keys.
        Old entries with the previous tokens hash become unreachable (orphaned).
      algorithm: |
        current_tokens_hash = SHA256(read_file(design_tokens_path))
        # This hash is used in key_computation.inputs.design_tokens_hash
        # Changed tokens -> changed hash -> different cache key -> cache MISS
      orphan_cleanup:
        description: >
          Orphaned entries (unreachable due to changed tokens) are cleaned up
          by the periodic cleanup job. They are identified by comparing
          source_hash_inputs.design_tokens_hash against the current tokens hash.
        schedule: "On pipeline startup or explicit *cache-cleanup command"

    explicit_invalidation:
      description: >
        Manual invalidation via CLI command or API call. Purges entries
        matching specific criteria (brand_id, engine, date range).
      commands:
        purge_brand: "Delete all entries where brand_id = X"
        purge_engine: "Delete all entries where engine = X"
        purge_expired: "Delete all L2 entries where created_at + ttl_hours < now"
        purge_all: "Delete all cache entries (full reset)"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CACHE STATISTICS (cache-stats.json)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AC: Hit/miss counter em cache-stats.json
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  statistics:
    file: "${base_directory}/cache-stats.json"
    description: >
      Persistent hit/miss counters for cache performance monitoring.
      Updated atomically on every cache lookup. Read by slide-chief for
      reporting and by qa-inspector for performance validation.
    schema:
      total_hits:
        type: number
        description: "Total cache hits across all levels."
      total_misses:
        type: number
        description: "Total cache misses across all levels."
      hits:
        type: object
        description: "Per-level hit counts."
        properties:
          diagrams:
            type: number
            description: "L1 diagram cache hits."
          images:
            type: number
            description: "L2 AI image cache hits."
      misses:
        type: object
        description: "Per-level miss counts."
        properties:
          diagrams:
            type: number
            description: "L1 diagram cache misses."
          images:
            type: number
            description: "L2 AI image cache misses."
      hit_rate_pct:
        type: number
        description: "Computed: (total_hits / (total_hits + total_misses)) * 100."
      last_updated:
        type: string
        format: iso_8601
        description: "Timestamp of last stats update."
      cost_avoided_usd:
        type: number
        precision: 4
        description: >
          Estimated cost avoided via cache hits. Computed by summing
          the estimated cost of each cache-hit engine call.
    initial_state:
      total_hits: 0
      total_misses: 0
      hits:
        diagrams: 0
        images: 0
      misses:
        diagrams: 0
        images: 0
      hit_rate_pct: 0
      last_updated: null
      cost_avoided_usd: 0.0000

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AC: Estrutura: cache/slides-v2/diagrams/{hash}.svg, cache/slides-v2/images/{hash}.png
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  directory_structure:
    description: >
      Filesystem layout for cached assets. Each asset is stored as a file
      named by its SHA-256 cache key, with a companion .meta.json file
      containing the cache entry metadata.
    layout:
      - path: "cache/slides-v2/"
        description: "Cache root directory"
        contents:
          - path: "cache-stats.json"
            description: "Hit/miss counters and performance metrics"

          - path: "diagrams/"
            description: "L1 cache -- deterministic diagram SVGs"
            file_pattern: "{sha256_hash}.svg"
            metadata_pattern: "{sha256_hash}.svg.meta.json"
            example: "a1b2c3...ef.svg + a1b2c3...ef.svg.meta.json"

          - path: "images/"
            description: "L2 cache -- AI-generated image PNGs"
            file_pattern: "{sha256_hash}.png"
            metadata_pattern: "{sha256_hash}.png.meta.json"
            example: "f9e8d7...01.png + f9e8d7...01.png.meta.json"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CROSS REFERENCES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_references:
    asset_cache_entry_schema:
      file: "schemas/contracts/asset-cache-entry.schema.json"
      relationship: "Cache metadata files conform to this schema"
      story: "1.5"

    visual_engines:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
      relationship: "orchestration.cache_integration defines cache directory and levels"
      story: "1.1"
      sections_consumed:
        - "orchestration.cache_integration.cache_directory"
        - "orchestration.cache_integration.cache_levels"

    asset_resolution:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/asset-resolution.yaml"
      relationship: "generate_operational_flow.steps[2] (cache_lookup) executes this config"
      story: "1.3"
      sections_consumed:
        - "generate_operational_flow.steps[2] (cache_lookup)"
        - "asset_ref_schema.asset_ref_fields.cache_key"

    cost_tracking:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cost-tracking.yaml"
      relationship: "cache_hit=true entries logged with cost_usd=0.0000"
      story: "1.4"
      sections_consumed:
        - "cost_log.entry_schema.cache_hit"
        - "aggregation.per_deck.cache_hits"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # INTEGRATION POINTS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  integration:
    visual_scout:
      description: >
        visual-scout performs cache lookup before every render() call.
        On hit: return cached output, skip API. On miss: render, then write to cache.
      hook: "before_render"
      reads: [levels, lookup, statistics]
      writes: [write, statistics]

    cost_tracking:
      description: >
        Cache hits produce cost_log entries with cache_hit=true and cost_usd=0.0000.
        This integrates with cost-tracking.yaml aggregation (cache_hits count per deck).
      hook: "on_cache_hit"
      writes_to: "cost-log.json"

    qa_inspector:
      description: >
        qa-inspector reads cache-stats.json to validate cache performance.
        Expected: hit_rate_pct > 0 for decks with repeated visual patterns.
      hook: "quality_gate"
      reads: [statistics]
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/chart-selection-matrix.yaml

```yaml
# Target: squads/slides-creator/data/chart-selection-matrix.yaml
# Purpose: Machine-readable extraction of KB_06 decision tree.
#          Input (intent, n_series, n_points) → Output chart_type.
# Consumer: Worker `select-chart-type` (task).
# Rationale_ref points back to KB_06 prose for human-readable justification.

schema_version: "1.0"
name: chart-selection-matrix
version: "1.0.0"
owner_squad: slides-creator
source_kb: KB_06
source_ref: "squads/slides-creator/data/kbs/KB_06_data_visualization.md"

# =============================================================================
# DECISION MATRIX
# Each row: (intent, n_series_range, n_points_range, chart_type, rationale_ref)
# =============================================================================
matrix:

  # ---- COMPARISON ----
  - intent: comparison
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [2, 8]
    chart_type: bar_horizontal
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#comparison-few-categories"
    notes: "Horizontal bar for <=8 categories; label readability preserved"

  - intent: comparison
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [9, 20]
    chart_type: bar_vertical
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#comparison-many-categories"

  - intent: comparison
    n_series_range: [2, 4]
    n_points_range: [2, 8]
    chart_type: bar_grouped
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#comparison-multiple-series"

  - intent: comparison
    n_series_range: [2, 6]
    n_points_range: [2, 20]
    chart_type: bar_stacked
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#comparison-composition"
    notes: "When parts sum to a meaningful total"

  # ---- TREND ----
  - intent: trend
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [3, 50]
    chart_type: line
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#trend-single-metric"

  - intent: trend
    n_series_range: [2, 5]
    n_points_range: [3, 50]
    chart_type: line_multiple
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#trend-multi-series"
    notes: "Max 5 lines; beyond that use small multiples"

  - intent: trend
    n_series_range: [6, 999]
    n_points_range: [3, 50]
    chart_type: small_multiples
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#trend-small-multiples"

  - intent: trend
    n_series_range: [1, 3]
    n_points_range: [12, 999]
    chart_type: area
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#trend-volume-emphasis"
    notes: "When volume/magnitude is the point (vs direction)"

  # ---- DECOMPOSITION ----
  - intent: decomposition
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [2, 7]
    chart_type: waterfall
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#decomposition-sequential"
    notes: "Classic P&L / EBITDA bridge"

  - intent: decomposition
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [2, 6]
    chart_type: donut
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#decomposition-share"
    notes: "Max 6 slices; prefer bar_stacked if >6"

  - intent: decomposition
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [7, 999]
    chart_type: tree_map
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#decomposition-hierarchy"

  # ---- DISTRIBUTION ----
  - intent: distribution
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [30, 9999]
    chart_type: histogram
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#distribution-density"

  - intent: distribution
    n_series_range: [1, 3]
    n_points_range: [10, 9999]
    chart_type: box_plot
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#distribution-spread"

  - intent: distribution
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [3, 30]
    chart_type: dot_plot
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#distribution-ranked"

  # ---- CORRELATION ----
  - intent: correlation
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [10, 9999]
    chart_type: scatter
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#correlation-two-vars"

  - intent: correlation
    n_series_range: [2, 4]
    n_points_range: [10, 999]
    chart_type: bubble
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#correlation-three-vars"
    notes: "Bubble size = third variable; max 4 dimensions"

  - intent: correlation
    n_series_range: [1, 1]
    n_points_range: [2, 20]
    chart_type: heatmap
    rationale_ref: "KB_06#correlation-matrix"

# =============================================================================
# FALLBACK BEHAVIOR
# =============================================================================
fallback:
  no_match_found:
    chart_type: bar_vertical
    reason: "Safe default — works for comparison + trend on small n; always readable"
    flag_to_qa: true   # qa-inspector reviews fallback cases

  n_points_exceeds_chart_limit:
    strategy: "small_multiples + aggregation"
    max_panels: 12

# =============================================================================
# INTERFACE
# =============================================================================
lookup:
  input_schema:
    intent: "comparison | trend | decomposition | distribution | correlation"
    n_series: "integer"
    n_points: "integer"
  output_schema:
    chart_type: "string"
    rationale_ref: "KB_06 anchor"
    confidence: "high | medium | low"
    fallback_used: "boolean"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/checkpoint-schema.yaml

```yaml
# Target: squads/slides-creator/data/checkpoint-schema.yaml
# Purpose: Common schema for D01/D02/D03 + brand-override approval artifacts.
# Consumer: Workers (schema validator), Human executors (fill artifact), slide-chief (guard).
# Reuses pattern from squads/slides-creator/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml#checkpoint.policy
# (always_active, fail_fast: true).

schema_version: "1.0"
name: checkpoint-schema
version: "1.0.0"
owner_squad: slides-creator

# =============================================================================
# SCHEMA (JSON Schema-like, YAML encoded)
# =============================================================================
schema:
  type: object
  required: [gate_id, status, approver, timestamp]
  properties:
    gate_id:
      type: string
      enum: [D01, D02, D03, BRAND_OVERRIDE, QA_VERDICT]
    status:
      type: string
      enum: [pending, approved, rejected, waived]
      description: "pending = awaiting; approved = proceed; rejected = return to upstream phase; waived = advisory mode only (requires deviation)"
    approver:
      type: object
      required: [stakeholder_ref, name]
      properties:
        stakeholder_ref:   {type: string, description: "e.g. STK-07-client-strategy"}
        name:              {type: string}
        organization:      {type: string}
        email:             {type: string, format: email}
    timestamp:
      type: string
      format: date-time
      description: "ISO-8601 UTC — when the approval was recorded"
    notes:
      type: string
      description: "Required when status == rejected; optional otherwise. Captures reviewer rationale or conditions."
    approval_artifact_ref:
      type: string
      description: "Path to signed document, email thread, Notion page, etc. Optional but recommended for audit."
    prior_versions:
      type: array
      description: "History of this gate for this deck_slug if the gate was re-opened"
      items:
        type: object
        properties:
          status:    {type: string}
          timestamp: {type: string}
          notes:     {type: string}
    sla_breach:
      type: object
      description: "Populated when SLA ladder triggers"
      properties:
        at_24h:  {type: boolean}
        at_72h:  {type: boolean}
        at_168h: {type: boolean}
        auto_paused: {type: boolean}

# =============================================================================
# INSTANCE EXAMPLES (drop-in templates for humans filling approval artifacts)
# =============================================================================
examples:

  approved_d01:
    gate_id: D01
    status: approved
    approver:
      stakeholder_ref: "STK-07-client-strategy"
      name: "Joana Silva"
      organization: "Flash Inc"
      email: "joana.silva@flash.com"
    timestamp: "2026-04-20T14:32:00Z"
    notes: "Análise coerente com briefing. Pillar 3 pode ficar mais conciso, mas não bloqueia."
    approval_artifact_ref: "outputs/slides-creator/flash-2026/approvals/D01-approval-email.pdf"

  rejected_d02:
    gate_id: D02
    status: rejected
    approver:
      stakeholder_ref: "STK-07-client-strategy"
      name: "Joana Silva"
      organization: "Flash Inc"
    timestamp: "2026-04-20T16:10:00Z"
    notes: "Slides 7-9 não seguem o arco SCQA esperado. Complication precisa ficar mais forte antes da Answer."
    approval_artifact_ref: null

  pending_d03:
    gate_id: D03
    status: pending
    approver:
      stakeholder_ref: "STK-07-client-strategy"
      name: "(awaiting)"
    timestamp: "2026-04-20T11:00:00Z"
    notes: "Enviado para revisão do brand steward + strategy team — SLA 72h"

  waived_d01_advisory:
    gate_id: D01
    status: waived
    approver:
      stakeholder_ref: "STK-05-sr-consultant"
      name: "Alan Nicolas"
    timestamp: "2026-04-20T09:00:00Z"
    notes: "Modo advisory acionado (flag --gate-mode advisory). Deviation registrada em deviations.yaml#DEV-2026-002."
    approval_artifact_ref: "outputs/slides-creator/flash-2026/deviations.yaml#DEV-2026-002"

# =============================================================================
# PIPELINE GUARD BEHAVIOR (consumed by workflow transitions)
# =============================================================================
guard:
  block_transition_if:
    - "file not exists"
    - "schema validation fails"
    - "status in [pending, rejected]"
    - "status == waived AND gate_mode != advisory"
  allow_transition_if:
    - "status == approved"
    - "status == waived AND gate_mode == advisory AND deviation logged"

# =============================================================================
# SLA LADDER (applied by orchestrator clock)
# =============================================================================
sla_defaults:
  - { at: 24h, action: "nudge senior consultant (SendMessage + notification channel)" }
  - { at: 72h, action: "escalate to C-level stakeholder ref" }
  - { at: 168h, action: "auto_pause — mark workflow paused; require manual resume" }

# =============================================================================
# FILESYSTEM CONVENTION
# =============================================================================
filesystem:
  path_template: "outputs/slides-creator/{deck_slug}/checkpoints/{gate_id}.yaml"
  rationale: "Per artifact-classification.md — outputs/ (not workspace/) because these are deck-specific transitional artifacts regenerable from pipeline run."
  git_tracked: true
  retention: "keep for 1 release cycle (or CODEOWNERS policy)"
```
