## Referência: references/squad/data/modern-css-arsenal.md

# Modern CSS Arsenal — 2026 Features Checklist

> **Purpose:** CSS features that signal "real designer, not AI template" — most are 2023-2025 shipped, underused by AI generation
> **Use as:** reference during design-renderer output + qa-inspector "recommended signal" check

---

## Why this matters

AI-generated HTML defaults to safe/boring CSS (2018-era Flexbox + basic Grid). "Taste tax" features — the ones that took years to ship and years more to adopt — are what distinguish a real designer's output from a template. Using them is cheap and signals quality at multiple levels (client review, peer review, accessibility audits).

**Rule of thumb:** if a CSS feature requires Chrome ≥110 or equivalent, AI is underusing it. Apply deliberately.

---

## Typography

### `text-wrap: balance` (Chrome 114+, Safari 17.4+)

Previne widow/orphan em títulos — última linha não fica com uma palavra solta.

```css
h1, h2, h3 { text-wrap: balance; }
```

**When:** todo `<h1>` até `<h3>`. Custo zero, benefício visual alto.

### `text-wrap: pretty` (Chrome 117+, Safari 17.4+)

Variação para prosa — aplica balance ao último cluster de linhas em parágrafos longos. Cost < `balance` mas pior para títulos.

```css
p { text-wrap: pretty; }
```

**When:** corpo de texto denso (blog, long-form slide com bullet lists).

### `text-spacing-trim: space-all` + `hanging-punctuation: first` (CJK)

Tipografia chinesa/japonesa/coreana — apara pontuação wide e pendura leading quotes fora da coluna.

```css
p { 
  text-spacing-trim: space-all;
  hanging-punctuation: first;
}
```

**When:** qualquer content em CJK (relevante para expansão multi-lang). Também útil em PT/EN com aspas tipográficas `「」` ou `""`.

### Variable fonts para hero weight-animation

```css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@100..900&display=swap');

.hero-title {
  font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 300;
  transition: font-weight 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.hero-title:hover {
  font-weight: 900;
}
```

**When:** landing page hero, title slides de decks premium. Uma variable font no lugar de 4 static weights.

---

## Layout

### `grid-template-areas` (named grid)

Código de layout legível como diagrama:

```css
.page {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-areas:
    "header header header"
    "sidebar main aside"
    "footer footer footer";
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 320px;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: 24px;
}

.page > header { grid-area: header; }
.page > main   { grid-area: main;   }
.page > aside  { grid-area: aside;  }
```

**When:** page layouts, dashboards, admin panels, email templates.

### `grid-template-rows: subgrid` (Firefox 71+, Safari 16+, Chrome 117+)

Child elements alinham com parent grid — resolve cards de alturas diferentes.

```css
.card-grid { 
  display: grid; 
  grid-template-rows: auto auto auto;
  gap: 16px;
}
.card { 
  display: grid; 
  grid-template-rows: subgrid; 
  grid-row: span 3; 
}
```

**When:** card grids onde alinhamento vertical entre cards importa (titles alinhados, body alinhado, CTAs alinhados).

### `@container` queries (Chrome 105+, Safari 16+)

Responsive ao tamanho do CONTAINER, não do viewport. Mudança arquitetural.

```css
.card-container {
  container-type: inline-size;
  container-name: card;
}

@container card (min-width: 500px) {
  .card { flex-direction: row; }
}
```

**When:** componentes reutilizáveis em contextos de largura variável (sidebar vs full-width).

---

## Color & Visual

### `color-mix()` + `oklch()`

Cores matemáticas sem entrar em temas custom.

```css
:root {
  --primary: oklch(0.65 0.18 25);  /* terracotta warm */
}

.button:hover {
  background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 85%, black);
}

.button-muted {
  background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 30%, white);
}
```

**When:** hover states, muted variants, semantic color variations. **OKLCH** vs HSL: OKLCH mantém perceived lightness constante ao rodar o hue — HSL não.

### `backdrop-filter` com `color-mix` (glassmorphism restraint)

Efeito vidro moderno — mas USAR COM PARCIMÔNIA (anti-slop: se tudo é glassmórfico, nada é especial).

```css
.header-glass {
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(150%);
  background: color-mix(in oklch, white 70%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, black 8%, transparent);
}
```

**When:** **no máximo 1 elemento por página** — header, modal overlay, toast. Nunca em cards em massa.

---

## Conditional

### `:has()` selector (Chrome 105+, Safari 15.4+)

Parent selector real — antes só era possível com JS.

```css
/* Card com imagem não tem padding top */
.card:has(> img) { padding-top: 0; }

/* Form com erro tem border vermelha */
.form:has(input:invalid) { border-color: var(--danger); }

/* Title slide com subtitle tem font-size maior */
.slide:has(.subtitle) h1 { font-size: 72px; }
```

**When:** conditional styling baseado em children. Elimina classe-gymnastics tipo `.card.has-image`.

---

## Motion & Transition

### `@view-transition` (Chrome 126+, Safari 18+)

Smooth transition entre navegações sem SPA.

```css
@view-transition { 
  navigation: auto; 
}

::view-transition-old(root) { animation: fadeOut 0.3s; }
::view-transition-new(root) { animation: fadeIn 0.3s; }
```

**When:** multi-page sites que querem feel de SPA sem o custo arquitetural. Para decks multi-file, pode dar continuity visual entre slides em PDF-view.

### `scroll-timeline` + `animation-timeline` (Chrome 115+)

Animações conectadas a scroll position — antes só via IntersectionObserver + JS.

```css
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.section {
  animation: fadeInUp 1s forwards;
  animation-timeline: view();
  animation-range: entry 0% entry 100%;
}
```

**When:** long-form sites, scroll-driven narrativa em decks single-page.

---

## Details (signature polish)

### `scrollbar-width: thin` + `scrollbar-color`

Scrollbar custom sem webkit-scrollbar prefix.

```css
* { 
  scrollbar-width: thin; 
  scrollbar-color: #666 transparent; 
}
```

**When:** sempre. Não custa nada, faz diferença em reviews "pixel-perfect".

### `::marker` pseudo-element

Customizar bullets de `<ul>` / `<ol>` sem pseudo-elements custom.

```css
li::marker { 
  color: var(--primary); 
  font-size: 1.1em;
}
```

**When:** editorial lists, bullet lists em decks.

### `accent-color`

Unifica color de native form controls.

```css
:root { accent-color: oklch(0.65 0.18 25); }
```

**When:** form-heavy pages. Um token resolve checkboxes, radios, progress bars.

---

## Print (underused in decks)

### `@page` + `break-after: page`

Controle page-break em PDF export.

```css
@page { 
  size: 1920px 1080px; 
  margin: 0; 
}

.slide { 
  page-break-after: always; 
  break-after: page; 
}

.slide:last-child { 
  page-break-after: auto; 
  break-after: auto; 
}
```

**When:** qualquer deck exportado para PDF (ver `data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md` para casos edge).

---

## Anti-patterns

| Feature | Por que NÃO usar (mesmo sendo moderno) |
|---|---|
| `container-type: size` (2D container) | Invalidation performance horrível. Use só `inline-size` (1D). |
| Nested CSS (`.card { .title { ... } }`) | Polifilled, mas AI abusa → output torna-se incompreensível. Prefira flat. |
| `field-sizing: content` em `<textarea>` | Chrome 123+ só — fallback chato em Safari. Não depender. |
| `round()` em CSS | Interesting em teoria, quase sempre desnecessário em prática. |

---

## Integration com qa-inspector

Adicionar check opcional (não killer_item — aspirational signal):

```yaml
qa_checks:
  - id: "CSS-ARSENAL-001"
    description: "text-wrap: balance em headings"
    severity: "recommendation"
    
  - id: "CSS-ARSENAL-002"  
    description: "oklch() em semantic colors (ou hsl acceptable)"
    severity: "recommendation"
    
  - id: "CSS-ARSENAL-003"
    description: "scrollbar-width em body ou main scroll containers"
    severity: "recommendation"
```

Score agregado: se deck usa ≥ 4 arsenal features → "Modern CSS Discipline: STRONG signal".

---

## References

- [MDN CSS](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS) — canonical reference
- [State of CSS 2025](https://2025.stateofcss.com) — adoption statistics
- `data/scale-standards.yaml` (related: typography standards)


## Referência: references/squad/data/narrative-pacing.md

# Narrative Pacing — Slow-Fast-Boom-Stop Structure

> **Purpose:** estrutura de 5 stages para animated slides, motion graphics, launch videos. Derivada de análise das animações oficiais Anthropic (Claude Design / Claude Code Desktop / Claude for Word).
> **Use as:** reference quando delivery_format inclui D (MP4/GIF) ou quando slide tem motion-heavy transitions

---

## Thesis

Animações geradas por AI têm "cheap feel" porque movimento é uniforme. Animações "Anthropic-grade" têm **estrutura narrativa** — tempo alocado de forma não-uniforme, com peak de intensidade em S4 e **abrupt stop** em S5 (não fade-out).

Essa estrutura é consistente em 3 animações Anthropic analisadas (Claude Design, Claude Code Desktop, Claude for Word) e diverge diametralmente do default AI (uniform pacing, fade ending).

---

## The 5 Stages

| Stage | % of total | Pace | Function | Forbidden |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **S1 — Trigger** | ~15% | Slow | Human reaction time; estabelecer contexto; "aterrissagem" | Jump-cut direto ao conteúdo |
| **S2 — Generate** | ~15% | Medium | Visual wow moment; revelação inicial | Nenhum "wow" (animação fica flat) |
| **S3 — Process** | ~40% | Fast | Show control, density, feature detail; rapid sequence | Uniform pace (audience fatigue) |
| **S4 — Explosion** | ~20% | Boom | Camera pull-out / 3D pop / multi-panel swarm / peak moment | Sustain current pace (no peak = no memory) |
| **S5 — Closing** | ~10% | Still | Brand logo + **abrupt stop** | Fade-to-transparent ending |

### Time mapping (exemplos)

**15s animation:**
- S1: 2.25s (sometimes 2s)
- S2: 2.25s
- S3: 6s
- S4: 3s
- S5: 1.5s

**30s animation:**
- S1: 4.5s
- S2: 4.5s
- S3: 12s
- S4: 6s
- S5: 3s

**60s launch video:**
- S1: 9s (full context-setting, often with voiceover intro)
- S2: 9s
- S3: 24s (feature showcase density)
- S4: 12s
- S5: 6s

---

## Why it works

**Signal theory:** brain registra mudança de densidade de informação. Uniform density → nenhuma mudança → nenhum peak memorizado.

- S1 slow = brain "arms itself" to pay attention
- S2-S3 crescendo = density ramp builds anticipation
- S4 boom = peak creates memory anchor (audience will remember THIS moment)
- S5 abrupt stop = brain completes the narrative loop (fade-out = ambiguity = weak closure)

**Audience retention research** (documented na indústria de cinema/advertising): peaks + abrupt endings retain 3-4x better than gradual fadeouts.

---

## The audience reaction ladder (self-check)

Depois de render, antes de ship, avaliar reação subjetiva:

| Reação | Grade | Diagnosis |
|---|---|---|
| "Looks smooth" | good (PowerPoint level) | Tecnicamente correto, sem impact |
| "Really fluid" | good+ | Tech certo, mas no wow |
| "Like something floating off the desk" | **great** | Physical weight triggered — S4 landed |
| "Doesn't look AI-made" | **great+** | Anthropic threshold reached |
| "Want to screenshot + share" | **great++** | Viral trigger — S4 + S5 + craft all worked |

**Target:** "great" mínimo. Se audience reação é "good+", falta peak em S4 ou stop em S5 está em fade.

---

## Forbidden patterns

### Uniform pacing

❌ Todo segment tem mesma densidade de informação
→ Audience fatigue, no memorable moment

### Sustained peak

❌ Animation inteira no pace de S4 (all "explosion")
→ Peak becomes baseline → no peak at all

### Fade-to-transparent ending

❌ `opacity: 1 → 0` no final
→ Ambiguous closure, brain doesn't "commit" to what happened
✅ Abrupt cut OR hold last frame for 300-500ms then cut

### Skipping S1

❌ Animation starts immediately with content (no slow lead-in)
→ No reaction time, audience misses first 1-2 seconds
→ If animation is for social feed, this costs you the hook

---

## Integration points

### Feature flag

Adicionar em `config.yaml`:
```yaml
feature_flags:
  ENABLE_MOTION_NARRATIVE:
    default: false
    description: "Apply Slow-Fast-Boom-Stop pacing to animated slides"
```

### Workflow integration

Quando `delivery_format.primary == "D"` (MP4/GIF):
1. `design-renderer` consulta este file
2. Estrutura timeline de render em 5 stages (S1-S5 proportions)
3. Enforce S5 como abrupt stop (no fade-out keyframe)

### qa-inspector check

Adicionar signal:
```yaml
qa_signals_motion:
  - id: "MOTION-PACING-001"
    description: "Timeline has 5 distinct density stages (not uniform)"
    severity: "warning"  # aspirational
    
  - id: "MOTION-PACING-002"
    description: "Ending is abrupt cut or hold, not fade-to-transparent"
    severity: "warning"
```

---

## Related

- `data/motion-export-discipline.md` (when created) — recording sync pattern
- `data/editable-vs-image-pptx-decision.md` — motion incompatible with editable PPTX export


## Referência: references/squad/data/palette-registry.yaml

```yaml
# Target: squads/slides-creator/data/palette-registry.yaml
# Purpose: Canonical palette + client brand overrides (with audit trail).
# Consumers: Workers `detect-brand-override`, `resolve-active-palette`. Human `register-palette-override`.
# Invariant: Override NEVER edits canonical. Audit trail mandatory.

schema_version: "1.0"
name: palette-registry
version: "1.0.0"
owner_squad: slides-creator

# =============================================================================
# CANONICAL — McKinsey-aligned default (never modified after first commit)
# =============================================================================
canonical:
  id: PALETTE-CANONICAL-MCKINSEY
  name: "McKinsey canonical palette"
  immutable: true
  hex:
    primary_navy:     "#003B5C"
    neutral_gray:     "#6E6E6E"
    success_green:    "#00A86B"
    alert_red:        "#C8102E"
  typography:
    family: "Helvetica Neue"
    title_pt: [28, 32]
    body_pt:  [14, 16]
    caption_pt: [10, 12]
  grid:
    columns: 12
    rows: 8
    aspect_ratio: "16:9"
    whitespace_min_pct: 30
  wcag_verified:
    primary_on_white:  {ratio: 12.3, level: "AAA"}
    gray_on_white:     {ratio: 5.7,  level: "AA"}
    green_on_white:    {ratio: 4.8,  level: "AA"}
    red_on_white:      {ratio: 5.1,  level: "AA"}

# =============================================================================
# OVERRIDES — per-project deviations from canonical.
# Each entry = one client brand. Never edited; only replaced via new entry (version bump).
# =============================================================================
overrides:
  - slug: "flash-2026"
    name: "Flash 2026 (cliente seed — audit proof)"
    version: "1.0.0"
    created_date: "2026-04-01"
    deck_refs: ["HTMLs Flash.md"]
    approver:
      stakeholder_ref: "STK-10-flash-brand-steward"
      name: "Flash brand team"
      approval_artifact_ref: "outputs/slides-creator/flash-2026/checkpoints/brand-override.yaml"
    hex:
      primary_navy:     "#1E1E2E"   # Midnight Navy
      accent_pink:      "#FF006B"
      neutral_white:    "#FFFFFF"
      accent_gold:      "#D4AF37"
    typography:
      family: "Roboto"
      title_pt: [38, 44]
      body_pt:  [16, 18]
    grid:
      columns: 12
      rows: 8
      aspect_ratio: "16:9"
      whitespace_min_pct: 25        # slight relaxation — client chose denser layout
    wcag_ratios_verified:
      white_on_midnight:   {ratio: 14.2, level: "AAA"}
      pink_on_midnight:    {ratio: 4.6,  level: "AA"}
      gold_on_midnight:    {ratio: 7.1,  level: "AAA"}
    trade_off: >-
      Cliente escolheu Midnight Navy + Pink para reforçar identidade Flash 2026 (lançamento
      de produto). Paleta canônica McKinsey rejeitada pelo brand steward — não alinha com
      posicionamento disruptivo do produto. Trade-off: perde consistência cross-deck
      McKinsey, ganha alinhamento de marca do cliente. WCAG preservado (ratios ≥ 4.5:1).
    font_rationale: >-
      Roboto em vez de Helvetica Neue — alinhamento com stack Tailwind + Google Fonts já
      utilizado nos outros materiais Flash 2026. Sem impacto em legibilidade.

# =============================================================================
# LOOKUP INTERFACE (consumed by resolve-active-palette Worker)
# =============================================================================
lookup:
  input_schema:
    project_slug: "string"
    force_canonical: "boolean (optional — forces canonical even if override exists)"
  output_schema:
    palette_id: "PALETTE-CANONICAL-MCKINSEY | PALETTE-OVERRIDE-{slug}"
    hex: "map<string, string>"
    typography: "object"
    grid: "object"
    wcag_status: "PASS | FAIL"
    rationale: "string (inherited from canonical or override)"

# =============================================================================
# REGISTRATION WORKFLOW (human task `register-palette-override`)
# =============================================================================
registration_protocol:
  required_inputs:
    - hex map (≥1 color differs from canonical)
    - rationale (≥50 words, explains why canonical insufficient)
    - trade_off (≥30 words, acknowledges what is lost)
    - wcag_ratios_verified (computed beforehand via resolve-active-palette)
    - approver stakeholder_ref
    - approval_artifact_ref (path to signed approval artifact)
  validation:
    - "rationale must not be empty or 'client requested'"
    - "all hex pairs relevant to deck must have WCAG ratio ≥ 4.5:1"
    - "override slug must be unique (case-insensitive)"
    - "canonical entry must not be modified — only new overrides appended"
  side_effect:
    - "Append to overrides[]"
    - "Git commit with message: 'palette-registry: add override {slug}'"
    - "CODEOWNERS: slides-creator maintainers must approve PR"

# =============================================================================
# FAIL-FAST
# =============================================================================
fail_fast:
  - "Override lookup by slug not found → fail explicit (no silent fallback to canonical unless force_canonical)"
  - "WCAG ratio below threshold during resolve → fail with remediation hint"
  - "Canonical entry attempt to modify → reject PR (immutable)"
```

```yaml
# Pipeline Execution Log Schema — slides-creator
# GAP-002 closure — per-run observability for SINKRA-native telemetry
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-04-20 | Upgrade Phase 4-7 Wave 1

schema_version: "1.0"
name: slides-creator-pipeline-execution-log
owner_squad: slides-creator
sinkra_framework: v3.2
storage_pattern: "append-only; one file per run in outputs/slides-creator/{run_id}/"

record_schema:
  required_fields:
    - correlation_id
    - run_id
    - started_at
    - completed_at
    - status
    - input
    - orchestrator
    - organism
    - phases
    - gates
    - dimension_router
    - final_outputs
    - cost_ledger
    - compliance
    - sinkra_framework_version
    - squad_version
  field_types:
    correlation_id: "uuid v4"
    run_id: "{timestamp}-{input_hash}"
    started_at: "ISO-8601"
    completed_at: "ISO-8601 or null"
    status: "enum: pending|in_progress|completed|halted|failed"
    input:
      type: "enum: briefing|youtube"
      hash: "sha256"
      source_path: "optional string"
    orchestrator: "slide-chief"
    organism: "ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION"
    phases: "array of {id, started_at, completed_at, session, atoms_executed, artifacts_emitted, errors}"
    gates: "array of {id, verdict, approver, timestamp, sla_ladder_breached}"
    dimension_router:
      triggered: "boolean"
      failure_dim: "enum: narrative|spec|vertical|null"
      return_phase: "enum: P01|P02|P03|null"
      retry_count: "integer 0..2"
    final_outputs: "object {deck_manifest, deck_spec, qa_report, render_request, deliverables}"
    cost_ledger: "object {model_calls, total_cost_usd, total_duration_ms}"
    compliance: "object {invariants_enforced, quality_gates_passed, ppteval_composite}"

example_record:
  correlation_id: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  run_id: "20260420-085500-hash8f3a"
  started_at: "2026-04-20T08:55:00Z"
  completed_at: "2026-04-20T09:42:17Z"
  status: completed
  input:
    type: briefing
    hash: "sha256:abc123"
    source_path: "workspace/businesses/aiox/L4-operational/briefings/sample.md"
  orchestrator: slide-chief
  organism: ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION
  phases:
    - id: P00
      started_at: "2026-04-20T08:55:00Z"
      completed_at: "2026-04-20T08:55:42Z"
      session: null
      atoms_executed:
        - [normalize-briefing, 32000, 0.08]
        - [load-kb-bundle, 8500, 0.00]
      artifacts_emitted:
        - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/briefing.normalized.json"
    - id: P01
      started_at: "2026-04-20T08:55:42Z"
      completed_at: "2026-04-20T09:08:19Z"
      session: SESSION-NARR
      atoms_executed:
        - [catalog-sources-apa, 120000, 0.42]
        - [distill-governing-thought, 45000, 0.15]
        - [build-pyramid, 180000, 0.68]
        - [apply-scqa, 75000, 0.22]
      artifacts_emitted:
        - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/sources-apa.yaml"
        - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/governing-thought.yaml"
        - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/pyramid-tree.yaml"
        - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/scqa-map.yaml"
  gates:
    - id: D01
      verdict: APPROVED
      approver: "human.operator@aiox"
      timestamp: "2026-04-20T09:12:00Z"
    - id: D02
      verdict: APPROVED
      approver: "human.operator@aiox"
      timestamp: "2026-04-20T09:22:00Z"
    - id: D03
      verdict: APPROVED
      approver: "human.operator@aiox + stk10.brand@aiox"
      timestamp: "2026-04-20T09:32:00Z"
    - id: qa_verdict
      verdict: PASS
      approver: "computed"
      timestamp: "2026-04-20T09:41:55Z"
  dimension_router:
    triggered: false
    retry_count: 0
  final_outputs:
    deck_manifest: "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deck-manifest.json"
    deck_spec: "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deck-spec.yaml"
    qa_report: "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/qa-report.json"
    render_request: "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/render-request.yaml"
    deliverables:
      - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deliverables/Slide_Specifications.md"
      - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deliverables/Design_System.md"
      - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deliverables/References_Bibliography.md"
      - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deliverables/AI_Image_Prompts.md"
      - "outputs/slides-creator/run-20260420/deliverables/Version_History.md"
  cost_ledger:
    model_calls:
      - [claude-sonnet-4-5, 450000, 85000, 6.75]
      - [claude-opus-4-6, 80000, 25000, 2.40]
    total_cost_usd: 9.15
    total_duration_ms: 2837000
  compliance:
    invariants_enforced:
      P1_fidelidade: PASS
      P2_especificacao: PASS
      P3_pyramid_mece: PASS
      P4_action_titles: PASS
      P5_enumeracao: PASS
      P6_citacao_apa: PASS
      P7_prompts_completos: PASS
    quality_gates_passed:
      brand-token-compliance: PASS
      visual-regression: PASS
      accessibility: PASS
      ppteval-composite: PASS
      human-visual-approval: PASS
    ppteval_composite:
      Design: 8.2
      Content: 8.5
      Coherence: 8.0
      GAD: 7.8
  sinkra_framework_version: "v3.2"
  squad_version: "9.0.0"

emission_protocol:
  emit_task: "emit-execution-log (TO-BE created in Wave 2)"
  emit_frequency: "on phase transition + on gate verdict + on completion"
  storage_location: "outputs/slides-creator/{run_id}/pipeline-execution-log.yaml"
  retention_days: 30

consumers:
  - name: finops-chief
    purpose: "Cost aggregation per run, per business, per model"
    query_pattern: "cost_ledger.total_cost_usd GROUP BY squad, date"
  - name: kaizen-chief
    purpose: "Quality trend analysis, invariant-failure patterns"
    query_pattern: "compliance.invariants_enforced OVER time"
  - name: replay-tooling
    purpose: "Deterministic replay for debugging"
    query_pattern: "input.hash + correlation_id reconstructs phase sequence"

meta:
  gap_closed: GAP-002
  compatible_with: sinkra-v3.2
  observability_ready: true
```

```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "planning-reflection-entry",

  "required": ["timestamp", "phase", "agent", "entry_type", "decision"],

    "timestamp": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time",

    },
    "phase": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "narrative_planning",

        "draft",

      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "True when this is the last allowed iteration (2 of 2). Next critique escalates to Human."
    }
  }
}
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/principios-invioláveis.md

# Princípios Invioláveis — Slides Creator v9.0.0

Fonte canônica: `outputs/sinkra-squad/criacao-slides-ia/architecture.yaml#invariants`
Absorvido em: 2026-04-19 (ADR-021 / EPIC-SC-NARR)

Estes 7 princípios são invariantes da geração de decks McKinsey-grade. Cada um é enforçado em layer específica (code | schema | validator) e falha bloqueia a release.

---

## P1 — Fidelidade aos dados
- **enforcement_level:** `code`
- **enforcement layer:** tasks narrativas + QA sampling
- **failure_mode:** Qualquer número/citação não rastreável à fonte = QA FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/validate-fontes-apa.md` (orphan check) + `tasks/p1-fidelity-sampling.md` (10% humano opcional).
- **NUNCA:**
  - Modificar números, datas, nomes ou fatos recebidos
  - Inferir dados que não foram fornecidos
  - Arredondar valores sem permissão explícita
  - Reescrever citações ou interpretações de terceiros
  - Preencher gaps de dados com estimativas não solicitadas
  - Alterar ordem cronológica ou causal de eventos
- **SEMPRE:**
  - Usar dados EXATAMENTE como recebidos
  - Explicitar cálculos derivados ("Análise da equipe baseada em [fonte]")
  - Documentar gaps como "Dados não disponíveis" em vez de inventar
  - Preservar contexto original de citações com aspas
  - Citar fonte primária quando usar dados secundários
  - Sinalizar ambiguidades com marker `[VALIDAR COM CLIENTE: ...]`
- **teste_de_validação:** Um analista júnior deve conseguir rastrear cada número, fato ou citação de volta ao material fonte original sem ambiguidade.
- **edge_cases:** ver `data/edge-case-decisions.yaml` (EC-01 ambíguo, EC-02 insuficiente, EC-05 negativo)

## P2 — Especificação obsessiva
- **enforcement_level:** `schema`
- **enforcement layer:** `data/slide-spec-schema.yaml` (10 componentes obrigatórios) + `deck-spec.schema.json` sobre o output de `emit-deck-spec`.
- **failure_mode:** SlideSpec sem hex/grid_coord/pt_size OR sem qualquer dos 10 componentes = schema validation FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/emit-deck-spec.md` (schema gate — consome slide-spec-schema).
- **absorbed_detail:** Wave A (2026-04-20) — 10 componentes mandatórios: metadata, action_title, layout_grid, visual_elements (1-4), support_elements, footer_sources, ai_prompts, speaker_notes, transition_flow, quality_checklist.
- **anti-pattern:** "Adicione um gráfico de barras mostrando crescimento" (vago).
- **target-pattern:** "Gráfico de barras verticais agrupadas, posicionado em grid colunas 2-9 linhas 3-6, dimensões 14cm × 8cm, barras 0.8cm cada, cores [#003B5C, #00A86B], eixo Y 0-100 incrementos 20, data labels 12pt Bold #000000..."

## P3 — Pyramid Principle + MECE
- **enforcement_level:** `validator`
- **enforcement layer:** validators narrativos rodados em `SESSION-QA` fresh.
- **failure_mode:** Vertical test falha OU MECE violado = QA FAIL.
- **validators:** `tasks/validate-pyramid.md` + `tasks/validate-vertical-flow.md` + `tasks/run-vertical-test.md` (cross-instance).
- **regras_de_ouro (Barbara Minto):**
  1. Ideias em qualquer nível sempre resumem as ideias agrupadas abaixo
  2. Ideias em cada agrupamento são mutuamente exclusivas (MECE)
  3. Ideias em cada agrupamento seguem ordem lógica (dedutiva, cronológica, estrutural ou comparativa)
- **aplicação_slide (vertical flow):** Título = conclusão/insight principal · Visual = argumentos de suporte (max 3-4) · Fonte = evidências
- **aplicação_deck (horizontal flow):** Executive Summary = topo da pirâmide · Body = argumentos detalhados · Appendix = dados brutos
- **rule_of_three:** max 3 mensagens por nível hierárquico
- **teste_de_validação:** Cada slide-título sintetiza os visuals abaixo? Cada seção-título sintetiza os slides abaixo?

## P4 — Action titles obrigatórios
- **enforcement_level:** `validator`
- **enforcement layer:** regex + componentes semânticos por slide.
- **failure_mode:** Título descritivo (ex: "Análise de market share") = QA FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/validate-action-title.md`.
- **absorbed formula (Wave A):** `[O QUE ACONTECEU] + [MAGNITUDE/POR QUE IMPORTA] + [AÇÃO IMPLÍCITA]`
- **anti-patterns:** "Análise de mercado" · "Resultados financeiros" · "Conclusões"
- **target-patterns:**
    - "Mercado brasileiro crescerá 45% ao ano até 2027, 1.7× mais rápido que média global"
    - "EBITDA expandiu 23% YoY impulsionado por mix premium (+340bps margem)"
    - "Revenue cresceu 34% em Q4 via enterprise segment, superando guidance de 28% e validando upmarket strategy"
- **vertical-test:** Ler só os títulos de um deck deve contar a história completa sem abrir nenhum slide.

## P5 — Enumeração universal
- **enforcement_level:** `validator`
- **enforcement layer:** schema check de DeckSpec + varredura cross-slide.
- **failure_mode:** Qualquer visual sem ID (Gráfico N, Tabela N.M) = QA FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/validate-enumeration-universal.md`.
- **nomenclatura_obrigatória:**
  - `Gráfico {N}` — charts (bar, line, waterfall, scatter, pie)
  - `Tabela {N}.{M}` — tables (N = seção, M = índice dentro da seção)
  - `Figura {N}` — ilustrações, imagens, ícones decorativos
  - `Diagrama {N}` — fluxos, 2x2, value chains
- **formato_referência_cruzada:** "Conforme Gráfico 3.2, ..." em speaker notes e appendix
- **teste_de_validação:** Grep cross-deck: cada visual_id aparece ≥2x (definição + ≥1 referência)?

## P6 — Citação completa APA
- **enforcement_level:** `schema`
- **enforcement layer:** schema de fonte em DeckSpec.
- **failure_mode:** Citação sem `{org, title, date, url, access_date}` = schema FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/validate-fontes-apa.md`.
- **5_componentes_obrigatórios:**
  - `org` — organização emissora (ex: "McKinsey & Company")
  - `title` — título do documento (ex: "Global AI Survey 2024")
  - `date` — data de publicação (formato depende do idioma, ver `data/context-adaptations.yaml`)
  - `url` — URL completa (ou DOI)
  - `access_date` — data de acesso (obrigatória para web sources)
- **formato_footer_default:** `Fonte: {org} {title}, {date}, p. {página}. Acesso em: {access_date}` em Helvetica Neue italic 9pt #6E6E6E
- **teste_de_validação:** Schema AJV: todas 5 chaves presentes + url parseável + dates válidas
- **edge_case:** Fontes em outro idioma seguem APA variant — ver `data/context-adaptations.yaml#language`

## P7 — Prompts de IA completos (10 componentes)
- **enforcement_level:** `schema`
- **enforcement layer:** schema do `image_prompt` embutido em SlideSpec.
- **failure_mode:** Prompt IA com <10 componentes = schema FAIL.
- **validator:** `tasks/validate-action-title.md` (P7 sub-check) + `emit-deck-spec.md` (schema gate).
- **10_componentes_obrigatórios:**
  1. `subject_specification` — o quê exatamente
  2. `style_references` — corporate photography, Annual Report 2024 style, painter reference
  3. `composition` — framing, POV, focal point, rule of thirds
  4. `lighting` — direção, intensidade, mood, time of day
  5. `color_palette` — MUST match slide palette (reference `active-palette.yaml`)
  6. `environment` — setting, context, background
  7. `technical_params` — resolution, aspect ratio, film/digital, lens
  8. `mood_and_emotion` — target feeling in viewer
  9. `negative_prompts` — what to avoid (no watermarks, no text, no fingers, etc.)
  10. `reference_images` — if any (URLs ou descrições)
- **teste_de_validação:** Schema AJV: todas 10 chaves com valor não-vazio; `color_palette` conforma com brand resolution
- **KB_de_referência:** `data/kbs/KB_08_ai_generation.md` — protocolos ultra-detalhados

---

## Gate D01/D02/D03 — Human-in-the-loop

Os princípios são observados em três checkpoints humanos durante o workflow `generate-presentation` v2:

- **D01** (post-narrative analysis) — valida P1/P3/P6.
- **D02** (post-structure) — valida P3/P4 + vertical test precondition.
- **D03** (post-design) — valida P2/P5/P7 + STK-10 co-sign quando há brand override.

Ver: `data/checkpoint-schema.yaml`.


## Referência: references/squad/data/qa-routing-table.yaml

```yaml
# QA Routing Table — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (T-002)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Maps qa-rubric.yaml dimension failures -> agent + task for automatic re-dispatch.
# Consumed by @qa-inspector after qa-report.json verdict in P05 (Quality Assurance).
# When a sub-dimension fails, qa-inspector consults this table to decide route.

meta:
  version: "1.0.0"
  status: active
  source: "MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN GAP-007 closure"
  consumer: "@qa-inspector (P05 QA phase + Critique Loop in P04.5)"
  rubric_ref: "data/qa-rubric.yaml v3.0.0"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ROUTING ENTRIES (15 total)
# 7 narrativa + 5 design + 3 acuracia/brand/tecnica
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
routes:

  # ─── Narrativa dimension fails (7) ───
  - dimension_failed: pyramid_mece
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/build-pyramid.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Pyramid violates MECE OR is non-3-level. Rebuild pyramid_tree from governing_thought."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: vertical_flow
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/run-vertical-test.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Action titles alone do not convey full narrative in 2min read. Rewrite titles AND/OR reorder slides."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: action_title_rhetoric
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/write-action-titles.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Action titles classified as descriptive_violation OR >20% executive_weak. Apply P4+ rhetorical strengthening (claim+magnitude+implication)."
    severity_when_failed: high
    invariant_enforced: P4

  - dimension_failed: governing_thought_strength
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/distill-governing-thought.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Governing thought misses claim OR magnitude OR implication. Rewrite as ONE executive sentence."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: scqa_depth
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/apply-scqa.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "SCQA blocks weak narratively. Strengthen tension (C), sharpen scope (Q), or deepen answer (A)."
    severity_when_failed: medium

  - dimension_failed: story_arc
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/validate-story-arc.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Story arc missing tension/proof/mechanism/demo/CTA. Map slide-by-slide to arc beats."
    severity_when_failed: high
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/"

  - dimension_failed: slide_function_map
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Slides without declared function OR functions='explicar topico'. Re-compress outline to audience moments with explicit function per slide."
    severity_when_failed: critical
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/ draft v1"

  # ─── Design dimension fails (5) ───
  - dimension_failed: density
    route_to:
      agent: "@design-renderer"
      task: tasks/compose-grid-layout.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
      followup: tasks/apply-design-revision.md
    feedback_hint: "Slide excede max 1 governing + 3 supporting claims. Split slide OR remove supporting claims."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: hierarchy
    route_to:
      agent: "@design-renderer"
      task: tasks/compose-grid-layout.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
      followup: tasks/apply-design-revision.md
    feedback_hint: "Typography scale or visual weight ordering violates hierarchy. Re-compose grid with explicit weight."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: contrast
    route_to:
      agent: "@visual-scout"
      task: tasks/resolve-active-palette.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
      followup: tasks/register-palette-override.md
    feedback_hint: "Text/bg pair below WCAG AA. Adjust palette OR substitute foreground/background for affected slide."
    severity_when_failed: critical
    invariant_enforced: "WCAG AA"

  - dimension_failed: readability
    route_to:
      agent: "@design-renderer"
      task: tasks/compose-grid-layout.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
      followup: tasks/apply-design-revision.md
    feedback_hint: "Line length too long, font size too small, or viewing distance assumption violated. Reflow text and/or upscale typography."
    severity_when_failed: high

  - dimension_failed: visual_coherence
    route_to:
      agent: "@design-renderer"
      task: tasks/define-design-direction.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
      followup: tasks/apply-design-revision.md
    feedback_hint: "Cross-slide inconsistency in paddings/alignment/motif. Reaffirm design_direction.yaml and apply across deck."
    severity_when_failed: medium

  # ─── Acuracia dimension fails (1 collapsed) ───
  - dimension_failed: fontes_apa
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/catalog-sources-apa.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Claims missing APA-complete source. Add {org, title, date, url, access_date} or mark [VALIDAR COM CLIENTE]."
    severity_when_failed: critical
    invariant_enforced: P6

  - dimension_failed: p1_fidelity
    route_to:
      agent: "@content-architect"
      task: tasks/p1-fidelity-sampling.md
      session: SESSION-NARR
    feedback_hint: "Sampled claim has no traceable source OR data invented. Replace with sourced version OR mark gap."
    severity_when_failed: critical
    invariant_enforced: P1

  - dimension_failed: enumeration_universal
    route_to:
      agent: "@design-renderer"
      task: tasks/validate-enumeration-universal.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
    feedback_hint: "Visual without ID (Grafico N, Tabela N.M). Add enumeration to all visuals."
    severity_when_failed: high
    invariant_enforced: P5

  # ─── Brand / Tecnica fails (3) ───
  - dimension_failed: brand_token_compliance
    route_to:
      agent: "@visual-scout"
      task: tasks/resolve-active-palette.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
    feedback_hint: "Token usage below 95% OR custom violations present. Re-resolve palette and apply tokens."
    severity_when_failed: medium

  - dimension_failed: palette_adherence
    route_to:
      agent: "@visual-scout"
      task: tasks/register-palette-override.md
      session: SESSION-SPEC
    feedback_hint: "Active palette override not registered. Either register override OR revert to canonical palette."
    severity_when_failed: medium

  - dimension_failed: ppteval_composite
    route_to:
      agent: "@qa-inspector"
      task: tasks/review-presentation.md
      session: SESSION-QA
    feedback_hint: "Legacy PPTEval composite below 7 in Design/Content/Coherence/GAD. Investigate specific PPTEval dimension and re-route to corresponding new validator."
    severity_when_failed: medium

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ESCALATION RULES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
escalation:
  - condition: "Same dimension fails 2 consecutive critique iterations"
    action: "Escalate to Human (Mission Lead). Stop critique loop. Surface qa-report.json + critique-report.yaml."

  - condition: "Multiple critical failures in same deck (>=3)"
    action: "HALT. Return to upstream phase. Likely briefing issue or scope drift."

  - condition: "Killer item KI-01..KI-10 detected"
    action: "BLOCK release. Auto-route per dimension_failed mapping above."

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation:
  total_routes: 18
  dimensions_covered:
    narrativa: 7
    design: 5
    acuracia: 3
    brand_tecnica: 3
  agents_referenced:
    - "@content-architect"
    - "@design-renderer"
    - "@visual-scout"
    - "@qa-inspector"
  tasks_referenced_existing:
    - tasks/build-pyramid.md
    - tasks/run-vertical-test.md
    - tasks/write-action-titles.md
    - tasks/distill-governing-thought.md
    - tasks/apply-scqa.md
    - tasks/compose-grid-layout.md
    - tasks/resolve-active-palette.md
    - tasks/register-palette-override.md
    - tasks/catalog-sources-apa.md
    - tasks/p1-fidelity-sampling.md
    - tasks/validate-enumeration-universal.md
    - tasks/review-presentation.md
  tasks_referenced_pending_creation:
    - tasks/validate-story-arc.md  # T-013A
    - tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md  # T-015A
    - tasks/define-design-direction.md  # T-015B
    - tasks/apply-design-revision.md  # T-017
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/qa-rubric.yaml

```yaml
# QA Rubric — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (T-001)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 3.0.0
#
# SOT for all qa-inspector evaluations. Replaces the prior contracts/qa-rubric.md
# from docs/bench/slides-creator-open-source-absorption/ which was research-tier (15/100
# design weight). v3 reflects post-Mission rebalance + case-study learnings from
# Primeiro Servico de IA webinar.
#
# Approved by Mission Lead (Human:alan-nicolas) in mission-pitch.yaml.

meta:
  version: "3.0.0"
  status: active
  applies_to: "decks generated by /slide-creator post-GA-2026-05-19"
  grandfathering: "decks generated pre-GA use legacy PPTEval composite gates from config.yaml#quality_gates"
  schema_ref: "data/checkpoint-schema.yaml"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6 DIMENSIONS (sum = 100)
# Rebalanced per Mission Lead approval:
#   Narrativa  25  (unchanged)
#   Design     25  (was 15 — promoted to peer of Narrativa)
#   Acuracia   20  (unchanged — sources, citations, factual fidelity)
#   Editabilidade 10  (was 20 — out-of-scope desta Mission)
#   Brand      10  (unchanged)
#   Tecnica    10  (was 10 — PPTEval composite kept here as legacy fallback)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dimensions:

  narrativa:
    weight: 25
    description: "Pyramid + SCQA + Action Titles + Vertical Test + Story Arc + Slide Function"
    invariants_enforced: [P3, P4]
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: pyramid_mece
        weight_within: 4
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-pyramid.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; PASS >= 7"
      - id: vertical_flow
        weight_within: 4
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-vertical-flow.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; PASS >= 7"
      - id: action_title_rhetoric
        weight_within: 4
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-action-title-rhetoric.md
        scoring: "classification: executive_strong | executive_weak | descriptive_violation"
        gate: "0 descriptive_violation; <=20% executive_weak"
      - id: governing_thought_strength
        weight_within: 4
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-governing-thought-strength.md
        scoring: "score 0-10 com decomposicao claim/magnitude/implicacao"
      - id: scqa_depth
        weight_within: 3
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-scqa-depth.md
        scoring: "score 0-10 por bloco S/C/Q/A; composite avg"
      - id: story_arc
        weight_within: 3
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-story-arc.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; arco completo (tensao/prova/mecanismo/demo/CTA)"
      - id: slide_function_map
        weight_within: 3
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-slide-function-map.md
        scoring: "100% slides com funcao declarada; 0% slides funcao 'explicar topico'"

  design:
    weight: 25
    description: "Densidade, Hierarquia, Contraste, Legibilidade, Coerencia Visual"
    invariants_enforced: [P2]
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: density
        weight_within: 5
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-density.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; claims_per_slide vs grid_bound"
        gate: "max 1 governing claim + 3 supporting per slide"
      - id: hierarchy
        weight_within: 5
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-hierarchy.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; typography_scale + visual_weight ordering"
      - id: contrast
        weight_within: 5
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-contrast.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; WCAG AA per text/bg pair"
        gate: "contrast_ratio >= wcag_aa (text fg vs bg)"
      - id: readability
        weight_within: 5
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-readability.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; line_length + font_size_min + viewing_distance"
      - id: visual_coherence
        weight_within: 5
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-visual-coherence.md
        scoring: "score 0-10; cross-slide consistency (paddings/alignment/motif)"

  acuracia:
    weight: 20
    description: "Fontes APA, P1 fidelity sampling, sem invencao"
    invariants_enforced: [P1, P6]
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: fontes_apa
        weight_within: 10
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-fontes-apa.md
        scoring: "100% claims com source_ref APA-complete"
      - id: p1_fidelity
        weight_within: 7
        validator_ref: tasks/p1-fidelity-sampling.md
        scoring: "sample claims >= 10%; zero invented data"
      - id: enumeration_universal
        weight_within: 3
        validator_ref: tasks/validate-enumeration-universal.md
        scoring: "100% visuals com ID (Grafico N, Tabela N.M)"
        invariant_enforced: P5

  editabilidade:
    weight: 10
    description: "PPTX editavel - mantido com peso reduzido pois out-of-scope desta Mission"
    note: "Apenas validacao basica: PPTX abre sem repair, action titles em camada de texto"
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: opens_without_repair
        weight_within: 5
        scoring: "binary PASS/FAIL"
        gate: "PowerPoint abre sem prompt de repair"
      - id: action_title_text_layer
        weight_within: 5
        scoring: "binary PASS/FAIL per slide"
        gate: "action title nao rasterizado (texto editavel preservado)"

  brand:
    weight: 10
    description: "Brand tokens compliance, palette adherence, asset resolution"
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: brand_token_compliance
        weight_within: 5
        scoring: "token_usage percentage"
        gate: ">=95% AND 0 custom violations"
      - id: palette_adherence
        weight_within: 3
        validator_ref: tasks/resolve-active-palette.md
        scoring: "active_palette aplicada sem override nao registrado"
      - id: asset_resolution
        weight_within: 2
        scoring: "0 broken assets, 0 placeholder leftovers"

  tecnica:
    weight: 10
    description: "PPTEval composite legacy + export e diagramas tecnicos"
    note: "Mantida como fallback legacy. Dimensoes granulares novas (design) tem precedencia."
    sub_dimensions:
      - id: ppteval_composite
        weight_within: 5
        scoring: "Design, Content, Coherence, GAD scores 0-10"
        gate: "each >= 7 (legacy threshold preserved)"
      - id: export_integrity
        weight_within: 3
        scoring: "no broken links, all media embeds resolve"
      - id: diagrams_math
        weight_within: 2
        scoring: "diagrams render; math formulas legible"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# KILLER ITEMS (any blocks release regardless of score)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
killer_items:
  - id: KI-01
    description: "PPTX nao abre OR pede repair"
    detected_by: opens_without_repair
    severity: blocking

  - id: KI-02
    description: "Action title rasterizado sem camada editavel"
    detected_by: action_title_text_layer
    severity: blocking

  - id: KI-03
    description: "Claim critico sem fonte APA-complete"
    detected_by: fontes_apa
    severity: blocking
    invariant: P6

  - id: KI-04
    description: "Texto cortado em slide principal"
    detected_by: hierarchy
    severity: blocking

  - id: KI-05
    description: "Contraste ilegivel (texto principal abaixo do AA)"
    detected_by: contrast
    severity: blocking

  - id: KI-06
    description: "Deck viola briefing aprovado (escopo divergente)"
    detected_by: human_visual_approval
    severity: blocking

  - id: KI-07
    description: "Action title classificado como descriptive_violation"
    detected_by: action_title_rhetoric
    severity: blocking
    invariant: P4

  - id: KI-08
    description: "Slide sem funcao narrativa declarada OR funcao = 'explicar topico'"
    detected_by: slide_function_map
    severity: blocking
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/ — draft v1 falha"

  - id: KI-09
    description: "Numero de slides excede 2x do slide-function-map planejado"
    detected_by: slide_function_map
    severity: blocking
    rationale: "Outline-to-deck literalism (lesson Primeiro Servico de IA)"

  - id: KI-10
    description: "Design direction artifact ausente OR identidade aplicada como skin (sem deck-stage real)"
    detected_by: visual_coherence + design_direction_yaml_present
    severity: blocking
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# RELEASE CRITERIA (gate aggregation)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
release_criteria:
  passed:
    overall_score_min: 85
    killer_items_max: 0
    narrativa_min: 7
    design_min: 7
    acuracia_min: 7

  concerns:
    overall_score_range: [75, 84]
    killer_items_max: 0
    requires_human_ack: true

  failed:
    overall_score_max: 74
    OR_killer_items_min: 1
    auto_route_per: data/qa-routing-table.yaml

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SCORING FORMULA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scoring_formula:
  overall: "weighted_sum(dimension_score * dimension_weight) where dimension_score is mean(sub_dimensions)"
  scale: "0-100"
  precision: 1  # decimal places

  example_pass:
    narrativa: 9.2  # weighted_contribution = 23.0
    design: 8.8    # weighted_contribution = 22.0
    acuracia: 9.0  # weighted_contribution = 18.0
    editabilidade: 7.0  # weighted_contribution = 7.0
    brand: 9.0     # weighted_contribution = 9.0
    tecnica: 8.5   # weighted_contribution = 8.5
    overall_score: 87.5
    killer_items: 0
    verdict: PASS

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VERSIONING & TRACEABILITY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
versioning:
  current: "3.0.0"
  previous: null  # squad never had a formal qa-rubric.yaml; v3 is canonical
  research_baseline: "docs/bench/slides-creator-open-source-absorption/contracts/qa-rubric.md (deprecated)"
  approved_by: "Human:alan-nicolas (Mission Lead, MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN)"
  approved_date: "2026-05-17"
  bump_policy: "major bump requires Mission Lead approval + roundtable"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/render-modes.yaml

```yaml
# Render Modes — design-renderer output configuration
#
# Three render modes, selected automatically from briefing.normalized.json:
#   - tsx-ds: legacy TSX output for apps/ds runtime (historical default)
#   - html-standalone-multi-file: independent HTML per slide + composer (default for standalone)
#   - html-standalone-single-file: web component deck (≤10 slides, pitch decks)
#
# Feature flag: ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER in config.yaml must be true
# for html-standalone-* modes to be available.

version: "1.0.0"

modes:

  tsx-ds:
    status: "legacy"
    description: |
      Original output mode — emite componentes TSX para o runtime apps/ds.
      Depende de apps/ds estar presente no monorepo. Atualmente o runtime
      está ausente; squad opera em handoff_only quando este modo é escolhido.
    output_structure:
      - "slides/*.tsx"
      - "thumbnails/*.png"
      - "render-summary.md"
    prerequisite: "apps/ds runtime disponivel"
    deliverable_formats:
      - "tsx_via_ds_presenter"
    when_to_use:
      - "apps/ds existe e está conectado"
      - "Deck precisa integrar em website existente baseado em ds"
    when_not_to_use:
      - "Client não usa apps/ds"
      - "Delivery é standalone (PDF/PPTX/HTML zip)"

  html-standalone-multi-file:
    status: "target"
    description: |
      Default para rendering standalone. Cada slide é um HTML independente,
      navegação via composer (index.html). CSS scope isolation nativa.
    output_structure:
      base: "outputs/slides-creator/{business}/{deck-slug}/"
      layout:
        - "index.html"              # composer com iframe-based nav
        - "shared/tokens.css"       # design tokens comuns
        - "shared/fonts.html"       # font imports incluidos per slide
        - "slides/01-cover.html"    # cada slide é HTML completo 1920x1080
        - "slides/02-agenda.html"
        - "slides/NN-{slug}.html"
        - "assets/"                 # imagens, media
    prerequisite: "ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER=true"
    deliverable_formats:
      - "html_browser"             # abrir index.html direto no browser
      - "pdf_vector"               # export via Playwright + pdf-lib
      - "pptx_editable"            # se 4 constraints seguidas, via pptxgenjs
      - "pptx_image"               # screenshot de cada slide -> PNG embedded
      - "mp4_gif"                  # se motion engine ativo, via Playwright record
    when_to_use:
      - "Deck ≥ 10 paginas"
      - "Multi-agent parallel development"
      - "PDF export essencial"
      - "Debug facil (abrir UM slide sem load do deck inteiro)"
    when_not_to_use:
      - "Deck precisa de cross-page JS state compartilhado"
      - "Pitch deck ≤ 10 paginas com narrativa muito coesa"

  html-standalone-single-file:
    status: "target"
    description: |
      Single-file web component deck — todos os slides em UM HTML.
      Cross-slide state trivial, arquivo único de distribuição.
      Requer cuidado com Shadow DOM se delivery inclui PDF.
    output_structure:
      base: "outputs/slides-creator/{business}/{deck-slug}/"
      layout:
        - "deck.html"              # web component <deck-stage> com sections
        - "assets/"                # imagens, media
    prerequisite:
      - "ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER=true"
      - "deck size ≤ 10 slides"
    deliverable_formats:
      - "html_browser"
      - "pdf_vector"               # requer Shadow DOM troubleshooting playbook
      - "mp4_gif"                  # se motion engine ativo
    caveats:
      - "PDF export complicado — ver data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md"
      - "CSS scope é global — cuidado com specificity em section styles"
      - "PPTX editable NAO suportado bem (web component complexity)"
    when_to_use:
      - "Pitch deck ≤ 10 slides"
      - "Cross-page tweaks compartilhado (color theme live switch)"
      - "Entrega em um arquivo unico (email attachment, drive upload)"
    when_not_to_use:
      - "Deck > 10 slides"
      - "Multi-agent paralelismo obrigatório"
      - "PDF export é critical path"
      - "PPTX editable é requisito"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Mode selection logic (consumed by design-renderer)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

selection_rules:

  - rule_id: "SEL-001"
    description: "apps/ds runtime present -> tsx-ds se nao override explicito"
    condition:
      - "fs.exists('apps/ds')"
      - "briefing.normalized.render_mode_override is None"
    result: "tsx-ds"

  - rule_id: "SEL-002"
    description: "Standalone render enabled + ≤10 slides + cross-page state needed"
    condition:
      - "ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER == true"
      - "deck.slide_count <= 10"
      - "briefing.cross_slide_state == true"
    result: "html-standalone-single-file"

  - rule_id: "SEL-003"
    description: "Standalone render enabled + default case"
    condition:
      - "ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER == true"
    result: "html-standalone-multi-file"

  - rule_id: "SEL-004"
    description: "Fallback: handoff_only se nada aplicável"
    condition: "default"
    result: "handoff_only"
    warning: "No render mode available. Squad returns manifest only."

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Export capability matrix
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export_capability:
  tsx-ds:
    html_browser: "via apps/ds presenter"
    pdf_vector: "via apps/ds export flow"
    pptx_editable: "not_supported"
    pptx_image: "via apps/ds screenshot flow"
    mp4_gif: "not_supported"
  html-standalone-multi-file:
    html_browser: "native (open index.html)"
    pdf_vector: "scripts/export-deck-pdf.mjs (Playwright + pdf-lib)"
    pptx_editable: "scripts/export-pptx-editable.mjs (requer 4 constraints)"
    pptx_image: "scripts/export-pptx-image.mjs (screenshot + pptxgenjs)"
    mp4_gif: "scripts/render-video.mjs (se ENABLE_MOTION_NARRATIVE=true)"
  html-standalone-single-file:
    html_browser: "native (open deck.html)"
    pdf_vector: "scripts/export-deck-stage-pdf.mjs (Shadow DOM workaround)"
    pptx_editable: "not_recommended"
    pptx_image: "scripts/export-pptx-image.mjs"
    mp4_gif: "scripts/render-video.mjs"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Output path discipline
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

output_path_rules:
  standalone_modes_base: "outputs/slides-creator/{business_slug}/{deck_slug}/"
  rationale: |
    Standalone HTML artifacts são outputs de squad execution,
    não workspace canonical data.

  forbidden_paths:
    - "workspace/businesses/*/" # NUNCA — violates artifact-classification rule
    - "apps/"                    # reserved para applications
    - "packages/"                # reserved para shared packages

  gitignore_considerations:
    - "outputs/slides-creator/**/*.pptx"  # artifacts nao versionados
    - "outputs/slides-creator/**/*.mp4"   # artifacts nao versionados
    - "outputs/slides-creator/**/*.pdf"   # artifacts nao versionados
    - "outputs/slides-creator/**/*.html"  # artifacts NAO-ignore (source-equivalent)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Dependencies (scripts to be created)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

required_scripts:
  - path: "scripts/export-deck-pdf.mjs"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright", "pdf-lib"]
    story: "STORY-SC-STANDALONE-PDF"

  - path: "scripts/export-deck-stage-pdf.mjs"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright"]
    story: "STORY-SC-STANDALONE-SINGLE-PDF"
    reference: "data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md"

  - path: "scripts/export-pptx-editable.mjs"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright", "pptxgenjs", "sharp"]
    story: "STORY-SC-PPTX-EDITABLE"
    reference: "tasks/export-editable-pptx.md"

  - path: "scripts/export-pptx-image.mjs"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright", "pptxgenjs"]
    story: "STORY-SC-PPTX-IMAGE"

  - path: "scripts/render-video.mjs"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright", "ffmpeg"]
    story: "STORY-SC-VIDEO-EXPORT"
    feature_flag: "ENABLE_MOTION_NARRATIVE"

  - path: "scripts/verify-slides.py"
    status: "not_yet_implemented"
    depends_on: ["playwright-python"]
    story: "STORY-SC-VERIFY-SCRIPT"
    purpose: "multi-viewport technical smoke test (complement to qa-inspector)"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Related
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

related:
  - "tasks/confirm-delivery-format.md"
  - "tasks/decide-slide-architecture.md"
  - "tasks/export-editable-pptx.md"
  - "data/editable-vs-image-pptx-decision.md"
  - "data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md"
  - "data/narrative-pacing.md"
  - "agents/design-renderer.md"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/scale-standards.yaml

```yaml
# Scale Standards — Typography & Hit Targets per Output Type
#
# Canonical reference for font sizes, hit targets, contrast ratios.
# Enforced by qa-inspector as killer items when body font < minimum threshold.

version: "1.0.0"
last_updated: "2026-04-21"
enforcement_level: "killer_item"  # qa-inspector blocks release if body text < min

output_types:

  slide_1920x1080:
    canvas: { width: 1920, height: 1080, unit: "px" }
    body:
      min_px: 24
      ideal_px: [28, 36]
      note: "Slides são lidos a 10m de distância (projetor). Abaixo de 24px = ilegível."
    title:
      range_px: [60, 120]
      note: "Usar alta da range para section dividers; baixa para page titles"
    hero:
      range_px: [180, 240]
      note: "Reservar para title slides ou quote slides de alto impacto"
    line_height_ratio: [1.3, 1.5]
    killer_item: "body < 24px em slide 1920×1080 = RELEASE BLOCKED"

  slide_1080x1920:  # vertical / mobile story format
    canvas: { width: 1080, height: 1920, unit: "px" }
    body:
      min_px: 28
      ideal_px: [32, 40]
      note: "Vertical é visualizado mais próximo (celular), mas tela menor compensa"
    title: { range_px: [80, 140] }
    hero: { range_px: [200, 260] }
    line_height_ratio: [1.35, 1.55]

  print_pdf:
    unit: "pt"
    body:
      min_pt: 10
      ideal_pt: [11, 12]
      px_equiv_at_72dpi: 13.3
    title: { range_pt: [18, 36] }
    caption: { range_pt: [8, 9] }
    line_height_ratio: [1.4, 1.6]
    note: "Print é lido a 30cm. Minimos vêm de legibility research, não de design preference."

  web_desktop:
    unit: "px"
    body:
      min_px: 14
      ideal_px: 16
      aging_friendly_px: 18
    cta_button:
      height_px: 44  # min hit target
    line_height_ratio: [1.5, 1.7]

  web_mobile:
    unit: "px"
    body:
      min_px: 16  # prevents iOS auto-zoom on input focus
      note: "iOS Safari auto-zooms em input com font-size < 16px. Accessibility break."
    cta_button:
      size_px: 44  # Apple HIG + Material spec
    line_height_ratio: [1.5, 1.7]
    tap_target_spacing_min_px: 8

  chinese_japanese_korean:  # CJK languages
    line_height_ratio: [1.7, 1.8]
    note: "CJK glyphs são mais densos verticalmente — precisam mais espaço entre linhas"
    additional_css:
      - "text-spacing-trim: space-all"  # Chrome 116+ — trim wide Asian punctuation
      - "hanging-punctuation: first"    # hang leading punctuation outside text column

contrast:
  body_to_background:
    wcag_aa_min_ratio: 4.5
    wcag_aaa_min_ratio: 7.0
    tool_verify: "Chrome DevTools → Accessibility → Contrast"
  large_text_to_background:
    wcag_aa_min_ratio: 3.0
    large_text_definition: "≥18pt regular OR ≥14pt bold"
  ui_components_to_background:
    wcag_aa_min_ratio: 3.0
    applies_to: ["buttons", "borders", "form inputs", "focus indicators"]

hit_targets:
  minimum_size_px: 44  # universal mobile + desktop accessibility
  spacing_between_targets_min_px: 8
  exceptions:
    - pattern: "inline text link"
      relaxation: "can be smaller if surrounded by whitespace ≥ 8px"
    - pattern: "keyboard-primary interface"
      relaxation: "smaller OK if keyboard nav is the expected interaction mode"

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# qa-inspector integration
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

qa_checks:
  - id: "SCALE-001"
    description: "Body font size meets minimum for output type"
    enforcement: "killer_item"
    validator: "computed_style on p, li, span + compare with output_type min"

  - id: "SCALE-002"
    description: "Title/body size ratio >= 2.5x for visual hierarchy"
    enforcement: "warning"
    rationale: "Sub-2.5x ratio = weak hierarchy, user cannot quickly identify key info"

  - id: "SCALE-003"
    description: "Contrast ratio body:bg meets WCAG AA"
    enforcement: "killer_item"
    validator: "axe-core + pa11y"

  - id: "SCALE-004"
    description: "Hit targets >= 44×44px em interactive elements"
    enforcement: "killer_item"
    applies_only_if: "output_type in [web_desktop, web_mobile, interactive_prototype]"

# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# References
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

references:
  - "WCAG 2.1 AA Success Criteria 1.4.3 (Contrast)"
  - "Apple HIG — Human Interface Guidelines (44pt minimum tap target)"
  - "Material Design 3 — Touch target spec"
  - "squads/slides-creator/agents/qa-inspector.md (killer_item enforcement)"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/semantic-classification.yaml

```yaml
# Semantic Classification Rules for Content-Architect
# SSOT for slide content classification -> visual_type -> engine routing.
# Consumed by: content-architect (classification), visual-scout (engine routing).
# Created by: Story 2.1 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 2)
# Dependencies: visual-engines.yaml (Story 1.1), deck-manifest.json v1.1.0 (Story 1.5)

semantic_classification:
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  story: "2.1"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CONTENT TYPES (12)
  # Semantic categories for slide content. Determined by LLM during
  # batch classification. Each type has signal keywords that help the LLM
  # identify the correct classification.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  content_types:
    - id: process
      label: "Process / Workflow"
      description: "Sequential steps, workflows, pipelines, procedures, how-to flows."
      signal_keywords: ["step", "flow", "pipeline", "procedure", "sequence", "workflow", "phase", "stage", "input", "output"]
      default_visual_type: flowchart
      default_engine: d2

    - id: hierarchy
      label: "Hierarchy / Structure"
      description: "Organizational charts, taxonomies, nested structures, parent-child relationships."
      signal_keywords: ["org chart", "structure", "levels", "parent", "child", "tree", "taxonomy", "department", "report to", "nested"]
      default_visual_type: tree
      default_engine: d2

    - id: comparison
      label: "Comparison / Versus"
      description: "Side-by-side comparisons, pros/cons, feature matrices, before/after."
      signal_keywords: ["vs", "versus", "compare", "difference", "pros", "cons", "before", "after", "advantage", "disadvantage", "alternative"]
      default_visual_type: table
      default_engine: mermaid

    - id: cycle
      label: "Cycle / Loop"
      description: "Recurring processes, feedback loops, iterative cycles, circular flows."
      signal_keywords: ["cycle", "loop", "iterate", "repeat", "continuous", "feedback", "circular", "recurring", "sprint", "rotation"]
      default_visual_type: cycle_chart
      default_engine: d2

    - id: data
      label: "Data / Metrics"
      description: "Quantitative data, statistics, charts, KPIs, percentages, measurements."
      signal_keywords: ["data", "metric", "percentage", "growth", "revenue", "chart", "graph", "KPI", "statistic", "number", "trend", "increase", "decrease"]
      default_visual_type: bar_chart
      default_engine: plotly

    - id: concept
      label: "Concept / Abstract Idea"
      description: "Abstract concepts, mental models, metaphors, big ideas that benefit from illustration."
      signal_keywords: ["concept", "idea", "model", "framework", "paradigm", "principle", "theory", "approach", "strategy", "vision", "imagine"]
      default_visual_type: metaphor
      default_engine: gpt_image

    - id: cause_effect
      label: "Cause & Effect"
      description: "Causal relationships, impact chains, root cause analysis, consequence maps."
      signal_keywords: ["cause", "effect", "impact", "result", "consequence", "because", "leads to", "root cause", "trigger", "outcome"]
      default_visual_type: flowchart
      default_engine: d2

    - id: timeline
      label: "Timeline / Chronology"
      description: "Historical sequences, roadmaps, milestones, project timelines, evolution."
      signal_keywords: ["timeline", "milestone", "roadmap", "date", "year", "quarter", "history", "evolution", "schedule", "deadline", "phase"]
      default_visual_type: timeline
      default_engine: mermaid

    - id: system
      label: "System / Architecture"
      description: "System architectures, component diagrams, infrastructure, integrations, tech stacks."
      signal_keywords: ["system", "architecture", "component", "integration", "API", "service", "infrastructure", "stack", "module", "layer", "database"]
      default_visual_type: architecture
      default_engine: d2

    - id: definition
      label: "Definition / Explanation"
      description: "Definitions, glossary terms, explanatory text. Usually text-only, no visual needed."
      signal_keywords: ["definition", "means", "refers to", "is defined as", "glossary", "term", "explain", "clarify", "what is"]
      default_visual_type: icon_card
      default_engine: none

    - id: quote
      label: "Quote / Testimonial"
      description: "Quotes, testimonials, citations, attributions. Visual is optional."
      signal_keywords: ["quote", "said", "according to", "testimonial", "feedback", "review", "endorsement", "citation"]
      default_visual_type: none
      default_engine: none

    - id: demo
      label: "Demo / Screenshot"
      description: "Product demos, screenshots, UI walkthroughs, live examples. Visual comes from product, not generated."
      signal_keywords: ["demo", "screenshot", "walkthrough", "example", "preview", "prototype", "mockup", "interface", "UI", "screen"]
      default_visual_type: none
      default_engine: none

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VISUAL TYPES (12)
  # Concrete visual output types mapped from content_type.
  # Each visual_type describes WHAT to render; the engine describes HOW.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  visual_types:
    - id: flowchart
      label: "Flowchart"
      description: "Directed graph showing sequential or branching steps."
      supported_engines: [d2, mermaid]
      output_format: svg

    - id: tree
      label: "Tree Diagram"
      description: "Hierarchical tree with parent-child nodes."
      supported_engines: [d2, mermaid]
      output_format: svg

    - id: table
      label: "Comparison Table"
      description: "Structured table or matrix for side-by-side comparison."
      supported_engines: [mermaid, d2]
      output_format: svg

    - id: venn
      label: "Venn Diagram"
      description: "Overlapping circles showing set relationships."
      supported_engines: [gpt_image, ideogram]
      output_format: png

    - id: cycle_chart
      label: "Cycle Chart"
      description: "Circular diagram showing iterative or recurring process."
      supported_engines: [d2, mermaid]
      output_format: svg

    - id: bar_chart
      label: "Bar / Line / Pie Chart"
      description: "Data visualization chart using Plotly."
      supported_engines: [plotly]
      output_format: svg

    - id: metaphor
      label: "Metaphor Illustration"
      description: "AI-generated illustration representing an abstract concept visually."
      supported_engines: [gpt_image, ideogram, recraft]
      output_format: png

    - id: timeline
      label: "Timeline"
      description: "Horizontal or vertical timeline with milestones."
      supported_engines: [mermaid, d2]
      output_format: svg

    - id: architecture
      label: "Architecture Diagram"
      description: "System architecture with components, connections, and layers."
      supported_engines: [d2, mermaid]
      output_format: svg

    - id: icon_card
      label: "Icon Card"
      description: "Simple icon with label. Minimal visual for definitions."
      supported_engines: [recraft]
      output_format: svg

    - id: infographic
      label: "Infographic"
      description: "Rich visual combining icons, text, and data in a single composition."
      supported_engines: [gpt_image, ideogram, recraft]
      output_format: png

    - id: none
      label: "No Visual"
      description: "No visual generation needed. Slide is text-only or uses existing assets."
      supported_engines: []
      output_format: null

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ENGINE AUTO-SELECTION RULES
  # Maps content_type -> visual_type -> engine.
  # Used by content-architect during classification to populate visual_strategy.
  # Aligns with routing_table in visual-engines.yaml.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  engine_rules:
    # Diagram engines (free, deterministic)
    - content_types: [process, hierarchy, cycle, cause_effect, system]
      engine: d2
      rationale: "D2 excels at structured diagrams with deterministic layout. Free via Kroki."

    - content_types: [comparison, timeline]
      engine: mermaid
      rationale: "Mermaid has native support for Gantt/timeline and simpler syntax for comparisons."

    # AI image engines (paid, non-deterministic)
    - content_types: [concept]
      engine: gpt_image
      rationale: "GPT Image has best instruction-following for abstract concept illustrations."

    # Data visualization (free, deterministic)
    - content_types: [data]
      engine: plotly
      rationale: "Plotly gives data-accurate, deterministic charts. Free local library."

    # No visual (text-only slides)
    - content_types: [definition, quote, demo]
      engine: none
      rationale: "These content types are text-heavy or use existing assets. Don't force visual generation."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VISUAL TYPE SELECTION RULES
  # Maps content_type -> visual_type for the visual_strategy field.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  visual_type_rules:
    process: flowchart
    hierarchy: tree
    comparison: table
    cycle: cycle_chart
    data: bar_chart
    concept: metaphor
    cause_effect: flowchart
    timeline: timeline
    system: architecture
    definition: icon_card
    quote: none
    demo: none

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # COMPLEXITY ESTIMATION
  # Heuristics for estimating visual complexity per slide.
  # Used to populate visual_strategy.complexity and visual_strategy.estimated_elements.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  complexity_heuristics:
    low:
      max_bullets: 3
      max_data_points: 4
      max_build_steps: 3
      description: "Simple visual with few elements. Quick to render."
    medium:
      max_bullets: 6
      max_data_points: 8
      max_build_steps: 6
      description: "Moderate visual with several elements. Standard render time."
    high:
      max_bullets: 999
      max_data_points: 999
      max_build_steps: 999
      description: "Complex visual with many elements. May need simplification."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # BATCH CLASSIFICATION PROMPT TEMPLATE
  # Single LLM call classifies ALL slides in a deck.
  # Input: array of slide summaries. Output: JSON array of classifications.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  batch_classification_prompt:
    system_message: |
      You are a visual classification expert for presentation slides.
      Your job is to analyze slide content and determine:
      1. The semantic content_type (what kind of information is being presented)
      2. The visual_type (what kind of visual would best represent it)
      3. The rendering engine (which tool should generate the visual)
      4. The complexity (how complex the visual will be)
      5. The estimated number of visual elements

      RULES:
      - Do NOT force visuals on every slide. Some slides are better as text-only.
      - Quotes, definitions, and demos should typically get engine: "none".
      - TITLE and CLOSING slides should get engine: "none" unless they have specific visual content.
      - Prefer free engines (d2, mermaid, plotly) over paid engines (gpt_image, ideogram, recraft) when both are viable.
      - If a slide has data_points or metrics, prefer "data" content_type with plotly engine.
      - If a slide describes a process with steps, prefer "process" content_type with d2 engine.

    user_message_template: |
      Classify each slide below. Return a JSON array with one object per slide.

      VALID content_types: process, hierarchy, comparison, cycle, data, concept, cause_effect, timeline, system, definition, quote, demo
      VALID visual_types: flowchart, tree, table, venn, cycle_chart, bar_chart, metaphor, timeline, architecture, icon_card, infographic, none
      VALID engines: d2, mermaid, gpt_image, recraft, plotly, ideogram, none
      VALID complexity: low, medium, high

      ENGINE SELECTION RULES:
      - process/hierarchy/cycle/cause_effect/system -> d2
      - comparison/timeline -> mermaid
      - concept -> gpt_image
      - data -> plotly
      - definition/quote/demo -> none

      SLIDES:
      {{slides_json}}

      Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element:
      {
        "slide_id": "slide-XX",
        "content_type": "...",
        "visual_type": "...",
        "engine": "...",
        "complexity": "low|medium|high",
        "estimated_elements": <number>,
        "rationale": "One sentence explaining why this classification"
      }

    input_format: |
      Each slide in {{slides_json}} is provided as:
      {
        "slide_id": "slide-XX",
        "slide_type": "CONTENT",
        "intent": "Brief description of the slide purpose",
        "payload_summary": "Key content: headline, bullets count, metrics count, data_points count"
      }

    output_validation:
      - "Response must be valid JSON array"
      - "Each element must have all 6 fields"
      - "content_type must be one of the 12 valid types"
      - "visual_type must be one of the 12 valid types"
      - "engine must be one of the 7 valid values (6 engines + none)"
      - "complexity must be low, medium, or high"
      - "estimated_elements must be a positive integer or 0"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NONE-ENGINE RULES
  # When and why engine = "none" is appropriate.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  none_engine_rules:
    always_none:
      - "Slides with content_type: definition (text-only by nature)"
      - "Slides with content_type: quote (text-only by nature)"
      - "Slides with content_type: demo (uses existing screenshots/assets)"
      - "TITLE slides (unless they have specific illustrative content)"
      - "CLOSING slides (call-to-action, no diagram needed)"

    consider_none:
      - "Slides with fewer than 2 bullets and no metrics/data_points"
      - "Slides that are content_variant=quote"
```
