```yaml
      - "Slides where the intent is purely textual (greeting, transition, thank you)"

    never_none:
      - "Slides with 3+ build_steps (process or cycle)"
      - "Slides with data_points array (data visualization)"
      - "Slides with comparison payload (comparison table)"
      - "Slides with explicit image_requests (already requesting visual)"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/shadow-dom-pdf-troubleshooting.md

# Shadow DOM PDF Export — Troubleshooting Playbook

> **Purpose:** knowledge rara documentada para quando exportar deck em single-file web-component architecture para PDF. 3 bugs reais + fix.
> **Trigger:** usar quando `render-html-standalone` em modo single-file + delivery format é PDF

---

## Quando ler este doc

Se você está em UM dos cenários abaixo, leia completo. Senão, skip.

- Arquitetura single-file deck com web component `<deck-stage>` ou similar
- Exportar para PDF multi-página via Playwright `page.pdf()`
- Primeiro export deu PDF com **apenas 1 página** (vs N esperadas)
- Ou PDF com número de páginas errado (N+1 páginas com última página vazia)

---

## Background: por que Shadow DOM PDF é hard

Single-file decks usam web component `<deck-stage>` que encapsula sections via Shadow DOM:

```html
<deck-stage>
  <section class="active">Slide 1</section>
  <section>Slide 2</section>
  <section>Slide 3</section>
</deck-stage>
```

Shadow DOM CSS interno típico:
```css
::slotted(section) { display: none; }
::slotted(section.active) { display: block; }
```

Isso funciona **perfeitamente para navegação interativa**. Quebra para PDF export por 3 razões distintas.

---

## Bug 1 — Shadow DOM vs `!important`

### Sintoma

Você roda:

```javascript
await page.pdf({ format: 'letter', printBackground: true });
```

Resultado: PDF com **1 página** (apenas a `<section class="active">` renderizada).

### Causa

Adicionou print media query em light DOM:

```css
@media print {
  deck-stage > section { display: block !important; }
}
```

Mas shadow DOM tem:
```css
::slotted(section) { display: none; }
```

Contraintuitivo: **shadow DOM internal rules têm prioridade sobre light DOM `!important`** porque são estilos de **shadow tree**, não de document root. `!important` no light DOM não alcança.

### Fix ❌ (não funciona)

Tentar `@media print` em vários scopes, pseudo-elements, higher specificity — todos falham mesmo que you think "specificity is higher".

### Fix ✅

Extrair sections de shadow DOM para light DOM antes de `page.pdf()`:

```javascript
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const stage = document.querySelector('deck-stage');
  const sections = Array.from(stage.querySelectorAll(':scope > section'));
  
  // Hide the original deck-stage
  const hideStyle = document.createElement('style');
  hideStyle.textContent = `
    @page { size: 1920px 1080px; margin: 0; }
    html, body { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
    deck-stage { display: none !important; }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(hideStyle);
  
  // Move sections to a regular div
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  sections.forEach(s => {
    s.style.cssText = [
      'width: 1920px !important',
      'height: 1080px !important',
      'display: block !important',
      'position: relative !important',    // critical — see Bug 3
      'overflow: hidden !important',
      'page-break-after: always !important',
      'break-after: page !important',
      'background: #FFFFFF',
      'margin: 0 !important',
      'padding: 0 !important',
    ].join('; ');
    container.appendChild(s);
  });
  
  // Last section: disable page-break to avoid blank trailing page
  const last = sections[sections.length - 1];
  last.style.pageBreakAfter = 'auto';
  last.style.breakAfter = 'auto';
  
  document.body.appendChild(container);
});

await page.pdf({ 
  width: '1920px', 
  height: '1080px', 
  printBackground: true,
  preferCSSPageSize: true,
});
```

---

## Bug 2 — Loop `page.pdf({pageRanges:'1'})` falhar

### Sintoma

Intuitivamente você pensou: "OK, navego para `#slide-0`, `page.pdf({pageRanges: '1'})`, salvo. Repeat para cada slide. Merge PDFs."

Código:
```javascript
for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
  await page.goto(`file://deck.html#slide-${i}`);
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
  await page.pdf({ path: `page-${i}.pdf`, pageRanges: '1' });
}
```

Resultado: **N PDFs, todos com a mesma página (a cover)**. Como se navegação por hash não funcionasse.

### Causa

Quando a print media query ativa em shadow DOM tem rule `deck-stage > section { display: block }` (override do `none`), o Chromium em print mode renderiza **todas as sections empilhadas**. `pageRanges: '1'` pega a primeira do stack — que é sempre a mesma section por ordem DOM (normalmente a cover), **não a active via hash**.

Hash navigation muda state JS interno do web component mas não muda ordem DOM. Print media ignora JS state, reorder pela ordem visual.

### Fix

Use **Bug 1 fix** (extract sections) — uma vez extraídas, ordem DOM = ordem visual desejada. Fazer um único `page.pdf()` sem loop.

---

## Bug 3 — Absolute children overflow para next page

### Sintoma

Você aplicou Bug 1 fix e agora vê N páginas. Mas o PDF tem `N+1 páginas`, com a última **contendo apenas o footer** (arrancado do último slide).

### Causa

Section no HTML original tinha `position: static`. Dentro dela, `cover-footer` ou `slide-footer` era `position: absolute`. Com `position: static`, absolute children positionam relativo ao **initial containing block** (viewport), não ao section parent.

Quando print força section height = 1080px mas containing block continua viewport-based, absolute footer posiciona onde o viewport terminaria — que para slides depois do primeiro está **fora da section**, na próxima página.

### Fix

Incluído no Bug 1 fix: inline style `position: relative !important` em cada section extraída. Isso cria novo containing block, absolute children se alinham dentro da section.

```javascript
s.style.cssText = '...; position: relative !important; ...';
```

Plus: `last-child: page-break-after: auto` evita página vazia final (a `page-break-after: always` em todas faria o renderer adicionar pagebreak após a última section, resultando em blank page).

---

## Validação final

### Contagem de páginas correta

```bash
# pdftoppm (poppler) é source of truth
pdfinfo deck.pdf | grep Pages

# OU
pdftoppm -f 1 -l 999 deck.pdf page  # gera page-1.png, page-2.png, ...
ls page-*.png | wc -l
```

### NÃO use `mdls` (macOS)

```bash
mdls -name kMDItemNumberOfPages deck.pdf  # Spotlight cache — NÃO confiável
```

Spotlight metadata tem cache. PDF reescrito pode mostrar contagem antiga. Sempre force:
```bash
mdimport deck.pdf
```

Ou simplesmente use `pdfinfo` que não tem cache.

---

## Fallback: multi-file architecture evita Shadow DOM complexity

Se o problema é recorrente + você controla architecture: **multi-file architecture não tem este problema** (cada slide é HTML independente, no shadow DOM).

Ver `tasks/decide-slide-architecture.md` para decisão e `tasks/render-html-standalone.md` (quando implementado) para modo multi-file.

---

## Reference

- [MDN Shadow DOM styling](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components/Using_shadow_DOM#styling)
- [Playwright page.pdf() docs](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-page#page-pdf)
- Related: `data/render-modes.yaml` (when created — describe single-file vs multi-file output modes)


## Referência: references/squad/data/slide-component-vocabulary.yaml

```yaml
# Slide Component Vocabulary — slides-creator (100% BRAND-AGNOSTIC & REPO-AGNOSTIC)
# Squad is portable: may live in any repo, consumed by any app. Zero hard refs.

schema_version: "3.0"
name: slide-component-vocabulary
owner_squad: slides-creator
stack_target: "React 18+ TSX / Tailwind v4 / shadcn/ui new-york baseline / Lucide OR Tabler icons / Framer Motion OR equivalent motion lib"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CANONICAL DIMENSIONS (geometric, universal)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
canonical_dimensions:
  slide:
    width_px: 1920
    height_px: 1080
    aspect_ratio: "16:9"
  scaling_contract:
    pattern: "transform: scale(containerWidth / 1920) via ResizeObserver"
    purpose: "responsive embed in any container without re-flowing internal 1920-based layout"
    implementation_freedom: "consumer app implements its own SlideFrame wrapper per house style"
  canvas:
    padding_desktop_default: "96px 120px"
    padding_alt: "corner ticks + content-centered"
  grid:
    columns: 12
    rows: 8
    gap: "Tailwind gap utilities OR explicit px/rem per house scale"
  typography_scale_pt: [8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 32, 34, 42, 48, 52, 72, 80, 120, 140, 220]
  weights: [300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900]
  whitespace_pct_target: [30, 40]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TECHNOLOGY DISCIPLINE (contract — enforced at emit-deck-spec gate)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tech_discipline:
  forbidden:
    - "hardcoded hex/oklch/rgba in slide TSX (always use CSS variable)"
    - "inline fontFamily string literals (always use var(--font-*) CSS var)"
    - "3+ accent colors on one slide (one accent max per frame)"
    - "raw HTML templates (output is TSX React functional components)"
    - "Tailwind CDN (consumer must use local Tailwind v4 build)"
    - "brand-name as text display element (use inline SVG asset instead)"
    - "local ticker/marquee implementations (declare as contract slot, consumer provides)"
    - "section without motion wrapper (unless motion_level == none AND justified)"
    - "bypass prefers-reduced-motion (every animated element respects)"
  mandatory:
    - "CSS variables for ALL colors, fonts, spacing — consumer app defines {prefix}-tokens in its globals"
    - 'shadcn/ui baseline config: {style: new-york, baseColor: neutral, cssVariables: true}'
    - "TypeScript strict mode, zero `any`"
    - "class merge utility (equivalent of `cn()` from @/lib/utils)"
    - "prefers-reduced-motion respect on every animated element"
    - 'alias imports (consumer defines @/components, @/lib/utils, @/components/ui, @/hooks per their tsconfig paths)'

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CHROME ATOM CONTRACT (interface — name + implementation up to consumer)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
chrome_atom_contract:
  purpose: "Unified slide chrome — corners + watermark + section tag + footer + page number + decorative layers"
  required_props:
    children:
      type: ReactNode
      required: true
    className:
      type: string
      required: false
    aspectRatio:
      type: string
      default: "16/9"
    fixed:
      type: "{ width: number; height: number } | null"
      purpose: "Override aspectRatio with explicit px dimensions"
    corners:
      type: boolean
      default: true
    cornersOpacity:
      type: number
      default: 0.25
    watermark:
      type: "'logo' | string | null"
      purpose: "Background mark — logo SVG or text/number placeholder"
    eyebrow:
      type: string
      purpose: "Top-left metadata mark (eg: '◤ NN / TITLE')"
    sectionTag:
      type: string
      purpose: "Top-right code tag"
    footerLabel:
      type: string
      purpose: "Bottom-center UPPERCASE mono label"
    pageNumber:
      type: string
    pageTotal:
      type: string
      purpose: "If set, renders 'NN / TOTAL'"
    hazard:
      type: boolean
      default: false
      purpose: "6px stripe at bottom edge"
    background:
      type: string
      default: "var(--{prefix}-bg)"
      purpose: "Resolved via brand-parametric slot"
  behavior:
    reduces_motion: "MUST wrap children with motion-aware primitive that short-circuits on useReducedMotion()"
    ref_forwarding: "recommended"
  implementation_name: "consumer chooses (DeckChrome, StageFrame, SlideShell, etc.)"
  source_of_truth: "This contract. Consumer ships its own implementation."

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMPONENTS — grouped by purpose layer (TSX-native, slot-based)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

structural_components:
  slide_frame:
    purpose: "Responsive wrapper with 1920→container scaling via ResizeObserver"
    contract: "Consumer implements; squad emits deck-spec referencing slot by role."
  slide_chrome:
    contract_ref: chrome_atom_contract
  motion_section:
    purpose: "Animated section wrapper — MUST wrap slide body when motion_level ≠ none"
    reduces_motion: required

title_components:
  display_title:
    purpose: "Slide mega title (hero, cover, section-break)"
    sizing: "clamp(80px, 11.5vw, 220px), weight 900, tight negative tracking"
    color_slot: "var(--{prefix}-fg)"
    variants: [display_xl, display_l_120_140, display_m_48_56]
  action_title:
    purpose: "Primary insight per P4 Action Titles — [fact]+[magnitude]+[implication]"
    sizing: "26-34pt, weight 700, line-height 1.15, -0.5px tracking, max 2 lines"
    appears_in_types: [cover, exec-summary, data, framework, financial, roadmap, conclusion]
    required: true
  subtitle:
    purpose: "Context line — audience, date, classification"
    sizing: "18-24pt, weight 400, alpha-muted color"
  eyebrow:
    purpose: "Top-left metadata label surfaced via chrome_atom_contract"
    format: "mono family, 18-22pt, 0.14em tracking, uppercase"

kpi_components:
  big_number_block:
    purpose: "KPI callout — value (42-80pt), label (12-14pt), description (body)"
    shadcn_pattern: "Card + CardTitle + CardContent + CardDescription composition"
    appears_in_types: [data, exec-summary, financial, conclusion]
  metrics_row:
    purpose: "3-column horizontal KPI strip"
    rule_of_three: enforced
    appears_in_types: [data, exec-summary, conclusion]
  bar_chart:
    purpose: "Horizontal/vertical bar comparison"
    motion_contract: "grow animation with stagger"
  donut_chart:
    purpose: "Part-to-whole 3-4 segments"
  funnel:
    purpose: "Conversion funnel"

insight_components:
  analysis_panel:
    purpose: "Framed insight box interpreting adjacent data"
    shadcn_pattern: "Alert OR Card with left-border accent"
  alert_box:
    purpose: "Warning/risk flag"
    shadcn_pattern: "Alert variant in {destructive, warning, info}"
  rag_status_band:
    purpose: "Traffic-light status container"
    semantic_mapping:
      green: "on-track / positive / recommended"
      orange: "at-risk / neutral / caveat"
      red: "off-track / alert / blocker"
    shadcn_pattern: "Badge OR Card with semantic color var"

navigation_components:
  agenda_list:
    purpose: "TOC with sequential numbering"
    appears_in_types: [agenda, toc, table-of-contents]
  section_break:
    purpose: "Inter-act transition slide"
    motion_level: cinematic
  appendix_banner:
    purpose: "Section divider for appendix slides"
  arrow_indicator:
    purpose: "Flow/direction connector (SVG path)"
    motion_contract: "path-draw animation"

metadata_components:
  footer_sources:
    purpose: "APA citations inline"
    typography: "italic mono 9-11pt, low-contrast color via var(--{prefix}-dim)"
    required_fields_per_citation: [org, title, date, url, access_date]
  page_number:
    purpose: "Position indicator via chrome_atom_contract pageNumber + pageTotal"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MOTION CONTRACT (tier semantics — preset names are consumer-implementation)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
motion:
  levels:
    cinematic:
      description: "Multi-layer 4-6s choreography"
      use_for: [hero, title, section-break]
    basic:
      description: "Per-element fade/slide/scale, 1-2s total"
      use_for: "default for all content slides"
    none:
      description: "No motion"
      use_for: "static reference slides only (MUST be justified)"
  preset_categories:
    entry: "fadeIn, fadeUp, slideIn equivalents — light entry"
    emphatic: "scaleIn, numberReveal equivalents — count-up / pop"
    reveal_mask: "clipReveal, growHeight equivalents — mask unveil"
    directional: "slideLeft/slideRight — list direction lock"
    stagger_helper: "staggered-list helper per index/base"
    cinematic_tier:
      - letter_poof
      - diagonal_entrance
      - parallax_layer
      - path_draw
      - brand_flash
      - scroll_reveal
      - scanline_sweep
      - diagonal_sweep
      - cut_to_black
  accessibility_contract: "Every slide MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion"
  implementation_freedom: "Consumer picks Framer Motion, Motion One, CSS animations, etc. Squad specifies tier semantics, not library."

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BRAND-PARAMETRIC SLOTS (resolved via active-palette.yaml + consumer globals)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
brand_parametric_slots:
  css_var_contract:
    prefix_placeholder: "{prefix}"
    resolution: "Consumer declares {prefix} in its globals.css (eg: bb, rp, acme) and defines the tokens below"
    required_tokens:
      - "var(--{prefix}-bg) — primary background"
      - "var(--{prefix}-fg) — primary foreground"
      - "var(--{prefix}-accent) — single accent per frame"
      - "var(--{prefix}-dim) — muted foreground"
      - "var(--{prefix}-surface) — cards/panels"
      - "var(--{prefix}-border) — separators"
      - "var(--{prefix}-positive) — RAG green semantic"
      - "var(--{prefix}-neutral) — RAG orange semantic"
      - "var(--{prefix}-alert) — RAG red semantic"
  font_var_contract:
    required_tokens:
      - "var(--font-{prefix}-display) — hero titles"
      - "var(--font-{prefix}-sans) — body"
      - "var(--font-{prefix}-mono) — metadata/footer"
  shadcn_baseline:
    style: new-york
    rsc: true
    tsx: true
    baseColor: neutral
    cssVariables: true
    iconLibrary: "lucide (preferred) or equivalent"
    aliases_contract:
      components: "@/components"
      utils: "@/lib/utils"
      ui: "@/components/ui"
      lib: "@/lib"
      hooks: "@/hooks"
    note: "Consumer configures actual tsconfig paths; these aliases are the default contract"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE REGISTRY SCHEMA (emit-deck-spec produces entries conforming to this)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
registry_schema:
  entry_fields:
    id: "kebab-case unique within deck"
    label: "human-readable title"
    category: "enum — see 8-ato narrative"
    component_ref: "resolved consumer-side — path to TSX functional component"
    version: "1 | 2 | 3 (V3 = full chrome_atom + full motion)"
    motionLevel: "none | basic | cinematic"
    heroSlide: "boolean (showcase/hero flag)"
    bundleRef: "string | null (optional bundle card reference)"
  8_ato_narrative_structure:
    description: "8-act narrative progression for consulting-grade decks (brand-agnostic)"
    atos:
      - { ato: 1, name: ABERTURA, purpose: "cover, profile, welcome, logo, TOC, section-break" }
      - { ato: 2, name: PROBLEMA, purpose: "statement of the problem, tensions, status quo" }
      - { ato: 3, name: VISÃO,     purpose: "mission, vision, target state" }
      - { ato: 4, name: MÉTODO,    purpose: "approach, framework, steps, methodology" }
      - { ato: 5, name: PROVA,     purpose: "metrics, charts, case studies, evidence" }
      - { ato: 6, name: CONFIANÇA, purpose: "team, experts, quotes, social proof" }
      - { ato: 7, name: VISUAL,    purpose: "imagery, portfolio, product demos" }
      - { ato: 8, name: FECHAMENTO, purpose: "CTA, pricing, contact, close" }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONSUMER INTEGRATION CONTRACT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
consumers:
  - task: classify-slide-type
    usage: "Map content → category (8-ato) + pattern_id + component_ref"
  - task: compose-grid-layout
    usage: "Instantiate pattern anatomy using {prefix}-CSS vars + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui primitives"
  - task: emit-deck-spec
    usage: "deck-spec.yaml entries include motionLevel, category, pattern_id, consumer_component_ref"
  - task: handoff-render-request
    usage: "render-request.yaml targets any consumer app conforming to tech_discipline contract"
  - template: templates/slide-component.tsx.hbs
    usage: "Parametric TSX skeleton — consumer resolves brand.prefix + consumer.imports at materialization"

meta:
  version: "3.0"
  brand_agnostic: true
  repo_agnostic: true
  portable: true
  no_hard_refs_to: [any concrete app path, any brand name, any specific CSS var prefix, any specific font name, any concrete component import path]
  only_contracts: "This file specifies contracts and schemas. Consumer apps implement + resolve."
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/slide-function-map.schema.yaml

```yaml
# Slide Function Map Schema — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (T-003B)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Schema for slide-function-map.yaml — emitted by tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md
# Consumed by tasks/validate-slide-function-map.md, design-renderer, emit-deck-spec.
# Forces declaration of WHAT EACH SLIDE DOES TO THE AUDIENCE (not WHAT IT EXPLAINS).

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  producer: "tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md (T-015A)"
  consumers:
    - "tasks/validate-slide-function-map.md (T-013B)"
    - "tasks/classify-slide-type.md"
    - "tasks/compose-grid-layout.md"
    - "tasks/emit-deck-spec.md"
  rubric_dim_ref: "data/qa-rubric.yaml#dimensions.narrativa.sub_dimensions.slide_function_map"
  killer_items_enforced: [KI-08, KI-09]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SCHEMA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
slide_function_map:
  required: [deck_id, story_arc_ref, entries]
  fields:

    deck_id:
      type: string
      description: "Deck slug"

    story_arc_ref:
      type: string
      description: "Path to story-arc.yaml"
      example: "outputs/slides-creator/{deck-slug}/story-arc.yaml"

    entries:
      type: list
      min_items: 4
      max_items: 30
      description: "Ordered list of slide functions. len(entries) == final slide count."
      item_schema:
        required: [slide_id, beat_ref, function, audience_movement]
        fields:

          slide_id:
            type: string
            pattern: "^s[0-9]{2}$"
            example: "s03"

          beat_ref:
            type: string
            pattern: "^B-[0-9]{2}$"
            description: "Reference to story_arc.beats[].beat_id"

          function:
            type: enum
            values:
              - reframe                # vira chave conceitual
              - proof                  # apresenta evidência/dado
              - contrast               # antes/depois, nós/eles, com/sem
              - mechanism_step         # passo de um mecanismo
              - demo_setup             # prepara contexto para demo
              - demo_payoff            # entrega resultado do demo
              - artifact_reveal        # entrega tangível (template, prompt, fórmula)
              - objection_neutralize   # neutraliza objeção específica
              - synthesis              # consolida insight do bloco
              - tension_amplify        # aumenta a pressão narrativa
              - emotional_anchor       # ancora emocionalmente
              - quiet_pause            # respiro visual, transição
              - cta_concrete           # ação específica que quero
              - cover                  # capa
              - section_divider        # divisor de seção (visual breath)
              - close                  # fechamento
            description: "FUNÇÃO narrativa do slide. NÃO é tipo de layout."

          audience_movement:
            type: string
            max_length: 140
            description: >-
              Em 1 frase: que MOVIMENTO emocional/cognitivo o slide produz na audiência?
              Frase obrigatória. NÃO PODE ser 'explicar X' ou 'apresentar X' (killer item KI-08).
            anti_examples:
              - "Explicar o que é IA"  # explanatório, killer
              - "Apresentar os cases"  # apresentacional, killer
              - "Falar sobre o produto"  # killer
            good_examples:
              - "Audiência percebe que IA é mais barata que cafezinho mensal"
              - "Audiência sente urgência ao ver concorrência já operando"
              - "Audiência fica com template pronto na mão (presente tangível)"

          slide_type:
            type: enum
            description: "Tipo de slide (consumido por classify-slide-type.md)"
            values:
              - title
              - executive_summary
              - framework
              - data
              - timeline_roadmap
              - financial
              - quote
              - process
              - kpi
              - chart
              - demo_screenshot
              - artifact_card
              - cta
              - appendix

          density_target:
            type: enum
            values: [minimal, low, medium, high]
            description: "Limite de claims por slide (validate-density consulta)"
            mapping:
              minimal: "1 claim, sem decorações"
              low: "1 governing + 1 supporting"
              medium: "1 governing + 2-3 supporting (default)"
              high: "1 governing + 4-5 supporting (cap absoluto)"

          merged_from_topics:
            type: list
            description: "Tópicos do outline original que viraram este slide (compression trace)"
            item_type: string

          could_be_cut_if:
            type: ["string", "null"]
            description: >-
              Critério para corte se appetite estourar. NULL = essencial.
              Forçar o autor a pensar 'sem este slide o deck ainda funciona?'

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION RULES (enforced by validate-slide-function-map.md)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation_rules:
  - rule: "Toda entry deve ter function não-vazia E enum válido"
    severity: blocking
    killer_item: KI-08
  - rule: "audience_movement não pode começar com 'explicar', 'apresentar', 'falar', 'mostrar X'"
    severity: blocking
    killer_item: KI-08
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/draft-slides-aiox.html"
  - rule: "len(entries) <= 1.2 * (sum of beats[].slides_estimated)"
    severity: blocking
    killer_item: KI-09
    rationale: "Outline-to-deck literalism — slides não podem inflar 2x o plano narrativo"
  - rule: "Toda entry.beat_ref deve existir em story-arc.beats[].beat_id"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "Pelo menos 1 entry deve ter function in {demo_payoff, artifact_reveal}"
    severity: high
    rationale: "Deck sem payoff = deck sem retorno emocional"
  - rule: "Pelo menos 1 entry deve ter function = cta_concrete"
    severity: high
    rationale: "Deck sem CTA concreto = monólogo"
  - rule: "Cards consecutivos com mesma function devem ser justificados (could_be_cut_if preenchido)"
    severity: medium
    rationale: "Repetição funcional vira wireframe (lição Primeiro Servico de IA)"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE (compressed from Primeiro Servico de IA outline)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
example:
  deck_id: "primeiro-servico-ia-v3"
  story_arc_ref: "outputs/slides-creator/primeiro-servico-ia-v3/story-arc.yaml"
  entries:
    - slide_id: s01
      beat_ref: B-01
      function: cover
      audience_movement: "Audiência reconhece tema e identifica-se com o paradoxo IA-está-em-todo-lugar-menos-aqui"
      slide_type: title
      density_target: minimal
      merged_from_topics: ["Abertura"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s02
      beat_ref: B-02
      function: tension_amplify
      audience_movement: "Audiência percebe que 78% NUNCA tentaram — gera FOMO"
      slide_type: data
      density_target: low
      merged_from_topics: ["Estatísticas de adoção", "Pesquisa de mercado"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s03
      beat_ref: B-02
      function: contrast
      audience_movement: "Audiência vê barreiras percebidas (caro/complexo) vs custo real (R$ 100)"
      slide_type: chart
      density_target: medium
      merged_from_topics: ["Barreiras", "Custo real de ferramentas IA"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s04
      beat_ref: B-03
      function: reframe
      audience_movement: "Audiência aceita: IA não é grande software, é ferramenta de R$ 100"
      slide_type: quote
      density_target: minimal
      merged_from_topics: ["Reframe central"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s05
      beat_ref: B-04
      function: mechanism_step
      audience_movement: "Audiência mapeia próprio nicho na matriz 4×3"
      slide_type: framework
      density_target: high
      merged_from_topics: ["Matriz de nichos × serviços"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s06
      beat_ref: B-04
      function: mechanism_step
      audience_movement: "Audiência identifica seu primeiro serviço viável"
      slide_type: framework
      density_target: medium
      merged_from_topics: ["Matriz de nichos × serviços (detalhe)"]
      could_be_cut_if: "Audiência já mapeou no slide anterior — pode virar handout"

    - slide_id: s07
      beat_ref: B-05
      function: demo_setup
      audience_movement: "Audiência se prepara visualmente para ver demo"
      slide_type: demo_screenshot
      density_target: minimal
      merged_from_topics: ["Demo ao vivo"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s08
      beat_ref: B-05
      function: demo_payoff
      audience_movement: "Audiência vê resultado funcionando — sensação 'é possível'"
      slide_type: demo_screenshot
      density_target: low
      merged_from_topics: ["Demo ao vivo"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s09
      beat_ref: B-06
      function: artifact_reveal
      audience_movement: "Audiência sai com template/prompt-mestre na mão"
      slide_type: artifact_card
      density_target: low
      merged_from_topics: ["Entrega do template"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s10
      beat_ref: B-07
      function: objection_neutralize
      audience_movement: "Audiência neutraliza objeção 'não sei programar'"
      slide_type: quote
      density_target: low
      merged_from_topics: ["FAQ", "Objeção técnica"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

    - slide_id: s11
      beat_ref: B-07
      function: objection_neutralize
      audience_movement: "Audiência neutraliza objeção 'não tenho tempo/dinheiro'"
      slide_type: quote
      density_target: low
      merged_from_topics: ["FAQ", "Objeção tempo/custo"]
      could_be_cut_if: "Se demo for forte o suficiente"

    - slide_id: s12
      beat_ref: B-08
      function: cta_concrete
      audience_movement: "Audiência sabe exatamente próximo passo (link/QR)"
      slide_type: cta
      density_target: minimal
      merged_from_topics: ["CTA final", "Próximos passos"]
      could_be_cut_if: null

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ANTI-PATTERNS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anti_patterns:
  - name: "Topic-translation"
    description: "Cada tópico do outline vira 1 slide sem compressão"
    detection: "len(entries) == len(outline_topics)"
    case_study_ref: "Primeiro Servico de IA v1 (27 tópicos → 27 slides)"

  - name: "Explanatory function"
    description: "audience_movement começa com explicar/apresentar/falar/mostrar"
    detection: "regex match"
    killer_item: KI-08

  - name: "Function chain monotonia"
    description: "5+ slides consecutivos com mesma function"
    detection: "rolling window"

  - name: "Missing CTA"
    description: "Nenhum slide com function=cta_concrete"
    severity: blocking
```

```yaml
# Slide Layout Patterns — slides-creator (META)
# Cross-archetype layout primitives extracted from empirical specimen (28-slide Board deck)
# Pattern IDs (LP-*) are brand-agnostic composition blueprints

schema_version: "1.0"
name: slide-layout-patterns
owner_squad: slides-creator
purpose: "Canonical layout pattern library — composable, content-free"
grid_baseline: "12 cols × 8 rows, 1280×720, gap 0.5cm"

patterns:

  - id: LP-001
    name: hero_cover
    applies_to_slide_types: [cover, title, section_divider]
    semantic: "Deck/section entry — single strong message + identity"
    anatomy:
      rows_3_5_cols_1_9: action_title (display 42-52pt)
      rows_5_6_cols_1_9: subtitle (lead 20-24pt, alpha-muted)
      rows_7_8_cols_1_3: badge_confidential + logo_area
      decorative:
        full: pattern_overlay (opacity 0.08)
        corner: glow_accent (blur 80px, opacity 0.4)
    whitespace_pct: 55
    examples_count_in_specimen: 2

  - id: LP-002
    name: action_title_plus_3_kpis
    applies_to_slide_types: [data, executive_summary, conclusion]
    semantic: "Insight statement supported by 3 quantified proof points"
    anatomy:
      row_1_cols_1_12: action_title (heading 26-28pt, full width)
      rows_3_5_cols_1_4: big_number_block (value + label + desc)
      rows_3_5_cols_5_8: big_number_block
      rows_3_5_cols_9_12: big_number_block
      rows_6_7_cols_1_12: analysis_panel (single-paragraph synthesis)
      row_8_cols_1_12: footer_sources (APA italic 9pt)
    whitespace_pct: 32
    examples_count_in_specimen: 5

  - id: LP-003
    name: action_title_plus_horizontal_bars
    applies_to_slide_types: [data, financial]
    semantic: "Ranking/comparison across categories"
    anatomy:
      row_1_cols_1_12: action_title
      rows_3_7_cols_1_9: bar_container sequence (label + bar-fill with width_pct)
      rows_3_7_cols_10_12: analysis_panel (insight callout)
      row_8: footer_sources
    whitespace_pct: 30
    examples_count_in_specimen: 4

  - id: LP-004
    name: framework_2x2_matrix
    applies_to_slide_types: [framework, perceptual_map]
    semantic: "Two-axis positioning (quadrants)"
    anatomy:
      row_1: action_title
      row_2_cols_1_12: axis_label_x (center)
      rows_3_7_col_1: axis_label_y (rotated 90)
      rows_3_5_cols_4_7: quadrant_Q2 (upper-left)
      rows_3_5_cols_8_11: quadrant_Q1 (upper-right)
      rows_6_7_cols_4_7: quadrant_Q3 (lower-left)
      rows_6_7_cols_8_11: quadrant_Q4 (lower-right)
      row_8: axis_min_max markers (x-min, x-max, y-min, y-max)
    whitespace_pct: 28
    examples_count_in_specimen: 2

  - id: LP-005
    name: framework_3_pillars
    applies_to_slide_types: [framework, strategy]
    semantic: "Three-prong decomposition (vision → pillars)"
    anatomy:
      row_1: action_title
      rows_3_6_cols_1_4: pillar_1 (header + body + icon)
      rows_3_6_cols_5_8: pillar_2
      rows_3_6_cols_9_12: pillar_3
      rows_7_8: arrow_indicator connecting pillars (optional)
    whitespace_pct: 30
    examples_count_in_specimen: 1
    rule_of_three: enforced

  - id: LP-006
    name: timeline_horizontal_roadmap
    applies_to_slide_types: [timeline_roadmap, roadmap]
    semantic: "Temporal progression with milestones"
    anatomy:
      row_1: action_title
      rows_3_7_cols_1_12: horizontal_axis (time periods Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 or years)
      rows_4_6: bar_containers spanning time periods (span_q1, span_q2, span_q1_q2, etc.)
      rows_3_7: milestone_markers with labels
      row_8: footer_sources + legend
    whitespace_pct: 25
    examples_count_in_specimen: 3

  - id: LP-007
    name: rag_status_matrix
    applies_to_slide_types: [framework, risk_assessment]
    semantic: "Traffic-light status across dimensions"
    anatomy:
      row_1: action_title
      rows_3_7_cols_1_12: grid of band-green + band-orange + band-red blocks
      each_band_slot:
        band_header: RAG-colored title
        band_desc: explanation
        band_time: timeframe if temporal
      row_8: footer_sources + RAG legend
    whitespace_pct: 28
    examples_count_in_specimen: 2
    required_semantic:
      green: on-track OR positive OR recommended
      orange: at-risk OR neutral OR caveat
      red: off-track OR alert OR blocker

  - id: LP-008
    name: single_mega_number
    applies_to_slide_types: [data, executive_summary, conclusion]
    semantic: "One number that carries the entire slide"
    anatomy:
      row_1: action_title (heading 22-26pt)
      rows_3_5_cols_1_12: hero_number (display 72-80pt, centered OR left-aligned)
      rows_6_7_cols_1_12: description_block (body 14-16pt)
      row_8: footer_sources
    whitespace_pct: 50
    examples_count_in_specimen: 1
    use_when: "Single metric drives the narrative (eg: 'R$ 150 bi')"

  - id: LP-009
    name: agenda_list
    applies_to_slide_types: [agenda, toc]
    semantic: "Sequential navigation"
    anatomy:
      row_1: 'title ("Agenda" / "Conteúdo")'
      rows_3_7_cols_1_6: agenda_blocks 1-N (with agenda-number + title + optional description)
      rows_3_7_cols_7_12: decorative_image OR current_section_highlight
      row_8: page_number
    whitespace_pct: 40
    examples_count_in_specimen: 1

  - id: LP-010
    name: appendix_table_dense
    applies_to_slide_types: [appendix, backup]
    semantic: "Reference material — higher density acceptable"
    anatomy:
      row_1: "appendix_banner (Appendix X: Title)"
      rows_2_7_cols_1_12: table OR bibliography-grid (typography body 10-12pt)
      row_8: footer_sources + page_number
    whitespace_pct: 15
    examples_count_in_specimen: 6
    density_exception: "Whitespace target relaxed for reference content"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PATTERN SELECTION HEURISTICS (for classify-slide-type + compose-grid-layout)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
selection_heuristics:
  content_shape_to_pattern:
    "single_insight + 3_proof_points": LP-002
    "ranking_comparison_categorical": LP-003
    "two_axis_positioning": LP-004
    "three_way_decomposition": LP-005
    "temporal_progression": LP-006
    "multi_dimensional_status": LP-007
    "single_hero_metric": LP-008
    "reference_dense": LP-010
    "section_transition": LP-001
    "navigation_menu": LP-009

  rule_of_three_alignment:
    description: "Pyramid principle favors 3 branches — LP-002, LP-005 naturally accommodate"
    enforce_on: [LP-005, LP-006, LP-007]

  density_by_slide_type:
    cover: [LP-001]
    data: [LP-002, LP-003, LP-008]
    framework: [LP-004, LP-005, LP-007]
    timeline: [LP-006]
    financial: [LP-002, LP-003]
    appendix: [LP-010]
    agenda: [LP-009]
    conclusion: [LP-002, LP-008]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONSUMER INTEGRATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
consumers:
  - task: classify-slide-type
    usage: "Map briefing content shape → pattern_id via selection_heuristics"
  - task: compose-grid-layout
    usage: "Instantiate pattern anatomy into grid_coords for each slide"
  - task: emit-deck-spec
    usage: "Reference pattern_id in deck-spec.yaml per slide"
  - task: validate-pyramid
    usage: "Check rule_of_three_alignment for framework slides"

meta:
  absorbed_from: "HTMLs Flash.md (empirical specimen, 28 slides)"
  absorbed_date: "2026-04-21"
  total_patterns: 10
  brand_agnostic: true
  all_patterns_instantiated_in_specimen: true
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/slide-spec-schema.yaml

```yaml
# Slide Specification Schema — slides-creator
# Wave A absorption from docs/squad/slides/enterprise_slides/output/mckinsey_ppt_architect_instructions.md
# Encodes the 10 mandatory components per slide spec (consulting-grade)
# P2 Especificação obsessiva + P4 Action titles become schema-enforceable

schema_version: "1.0"
name: slide-spec-schema
owner_squad: slides-creator
source_absorption: "ATHENA v2.0 McKinsey PPT Architect Elite"
enforcement: "SCHEMA (validate-pyramid + validate-action-title consume this)"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 10 MANDATORY COMPONENTS per slide spec
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mandatory_components:

  - id: 1_metadata
    name: Metadata
    required_fields:
      - section_number_and_name
      - position_in_deck  # ex: "7 of 45"
      - slide_type        # enum: slide_types below
      - presentation_time_minutes
      - primary_audience  # enum: [C-level, board, strategy_team, operators, investors]
      - objective         # 1-sentence goal for this slide

  - id: 2_action_title
    name: Action Title
    required_fields:
      - text              # "[O que aconteceu] + [Magnitude/Por que importa] + [Ação implícita]"
      - font_family       # default: Helvetica Neue
      - font_weight       # default: Bold
      - font_size_pt      # default: 28 (range 24-32)
      - color_hex         # default: #003B5C (navy)
      - alignment         # enum: [left, center, right]
      - grid_position     # {row: 1, cols: "1-12"}
      - margin_cm         # default: 1.5 from left border
      - leading           # default: 1.2
      - max_width_cm      # default: 24
      - max_wrap_lines    # default: 2
    formula_anti_pattern:
      - "Descriptive: 'Análise de mercado'"
      - "Descriptive: 'Resultados financeiros'"
    formula_target:
      - "'Mercado brasileiro crescerá 45% ao ano até 2027, 1.7× mais rápido que média global'"
      - "'EBITDA expandiu 23% YoY impulsionado por mix de produtos premium (+340bps margem)'"

  - id: 3_layout_grid
    name: Layout & Grid System
    required_fields:
      - grid_columns      # default: 12
      - grid_rows         # default: 8
      - slide_aspect      # enum: ["16:9", "9:16", "1:1"]
      - gutters_cm        # default: 0.5
      - useful_area_cm    # ex: "24cm × 16cm"
      - whitespace_pct    # min: 30, target: 30-40
      - primary_zone      # {rows, cols} where action title lives
      - content_zone      # {rows, cols} where visual/table lives
      - footer_zone       # {rows, cols} where citations live

  - id: 4_visual_elements
    name: Visual Elements (Elements 1-4)
    min: 1
    max: 4
    per_element_required_fields:
      - element_id        # ex: "Gráfico 3.2", "Tabela 7.1", "Imagem 2"
      - element_type      # enum: [bar_chart, line_chart, waterfall, scatter, pie, table, insight_box, icon, image]
      - title             # ex: "Crescimento por Segmento"
      - grid_position     # {cols, rows}
      - dimensions_cm     # {width, height}
      - color_palette_hex # array of exact HEX codes
      - axis_scale        # for charts: range + increments
      - typography        # {family, weight, size, color} per text element
      - data_labels       # always show values on charts
      - gridlines_opacity # default: 20% (#E5E5E5)
      - source_footer     # APA citation below element
      - alt_text          # accessibility

  - id: 5_support_elements
    name: Support Elements (callouts, insight panels)
    optional: true
    fields:
      - callout_boxes     # key_takeaway boxes with insight
      - insight_panel     # right-side insight column
      - decorative_icons  # mood/theme icons

  - id: 6_footer_sources
    name: Footer & APA Sources
    required_fields:
      - citations[]       # array of APA entries
      - per_citation:
          - org           # ex: "McKinsey & Company"
          - title         # ex: "Global AI Survey 2024"
          - date          # ex: "December 2024"
          - url           # full URL
          - access_date   # ex: "Acesso em: 15 dez 2024"
      - footer_font       # {family: Helvetica Neue, style: italic, size_pt: 9, color: "#6E6E6E"}

  - id: 7_ai_prompts
    name: AI Generation Prompts (when images needed)
    conditional: "slide has image_request"
    min_components: 10
    required_components:
      - subject_specification
      - style_references      # ex: "corporate photography, Annual Report 2024"
      - composition           # framing, POV, focal point
      - lighting              # direction, intensity, mood
      - color_palette         # must match slide palette
      - environment           # setting, context
      - technical_params      # resolution, aspect ratio, film/digital
      - mood_and_emotion
      - negative_prompts      # what to avoid
      - reference_images      # if any

  - id: 8_speaker_notes
    name: Speaker Notes
    required_fields:
      - opening_hook          # how to introduce the slide
      - key_talking_points    # bulleted (max 3-5)
      - supporting_data       # numbers to cite verbally
      - anticipated_questions # Q&A prep
      - transition_line       # how to move to next slide
      - timing_seconds

  - id: 9_transition_flow
    name: Transition & Flow
    required_fields:
      - previous_slide_id
      - next_slide_id
      - transition_rationale  # why this slide follows the previous
      - narrative_arc_position # where in SCQA this slide sits

  - id: 10_quality_checklist
    name: Quality Checklist (per-slide)
    required_checks:
      - action_title_follows_formula
      - all_numbers_traceable_to_sources
      - grid_alignment_precise
      - typography_consistent
      - whitespace_30pct_min
      - every_visual_has_enumeration_id
      - apa_citations_complete
      - data_labels_on_all_charts
      - color_palette_brand_compliant
      - wcag_contrast_aa_min
      - vertical_flow_test_pass       # title alone tells the story
      - speaker_notes_complete

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SLIDE TYPE ENUM (11 canonical types)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide_types:
  - id: title
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/title.md
    description: "Cover slide — deck title, subtitle, date, author, confidentiality"
  - id: executive_summary
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/executive-summary.md
    description: "Top-of-pyramid — entire deck condensed to 1 slide with 3-5 key takeaways"
  - id: framework
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/framework.md
    description: "2x2 matrix, pyramid, value chain, ecosystem map — conceptual structure"
  - id: data
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/data.md
    description: "Bar/line/waterfall/scatter charts — quantitative insight"
  - id: timeline_roadmap
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/timeline-roadmap.md
    description: "Gantt, milestones, horizon scanning — temporal progression"
  - id: financial
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/financial.md
    description: "P&L, bridge chart, EBITDA waterfall — financial analysis"
  - id: appendix
    archetype: templates/slide-archetypes/appendix.md
    description: "Source data, methodology, backup — supporting material"
  - id: section_divider
    description: "Section transition — title + Roman numeral + thematic image"
  - id: text_with_visual
    description: "Mixed text+visual — insight supported by chart/image"
  - id: comparison
    description: "Side-by-side — options, scenarios, before/after"
  - id: quote
    description: "Stakeholder voice, CEO message, expert citation"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ENFORCEMENT CONSUMERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
enforcement_consumers:
  - task: validate-action-title
    checks: component_2_action_title.formula + components 1/3
  - task: validate-enumeration-universal
    checks: component_4_visual_elements.element_id
  - task: validate-fontes-apa
    checks: component_6_footer_sources.citations[]
  - task: validate-pyramid
    checks: component_9_transition_flow.narrative_arc_position + component_10.vertical_flow_test_pass
  - task: p1-fidelity-sampling
    checks: component_4.source_footer + component_6.citations[]
  - task: emit-deck-spec
    produces: "deck-spec.yaml conforming to this schema for every slide"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DESIGN SYSTEM BASELINE (from McKinsey Architect)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
design_system_baseline:
  grid:
    columns: 12
    rows: 8
    aspect_ratio: "16:9"
    useful_area: "24cm × 16cm"
    gutters_cm: 0.5
  palette_default:  # brand-override resolves via resolve-active-palette
    primary: "#003B5C"  # navy
    secondary: "#6E6E6E"  # gray
    positive: "#00A86B"  # emerald green (up/good)
    negative: "#C8102E"  # red (down/bad)
    neutral_background: "#FFFFFF"
    gridlines: "#E5E5E5"
  typography_default:
    family: "Helvetica Neue"
    title_weight: Bold
    title_size_pt: [28, 32]
    body_weight: Regular
    body_size_pt: [14, 16]
    caption_size_pt: [10, 12]
    data_label_weight: Bold
    data_label_size_pt: 12
    footer_style: italic
    footer_size_pt: 9
  whitespace_pct_target: [30, 40]
  chart_selection_rules:
    comparison_categorical: bar_chart
    trend_over_time: line_chart
    decomposition_additive: waterfall_chart
    correlation_two_vars: scatter_plot
    part_to_whole_3_or_less: pie_chart
    part_to_whole_4_or_more: stacked_bar_chart

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# META
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
meta:
  absorbed_from: "docs/squad/slides/enterprise_slides/output/mckinsey_ppt_architect_instructions.md"
  absorbed_date: "2026-04-20"
  absorbed_wave: "A (master spec schema extraction)"
  gold_standard_example: "squads/slides-creator/examples/gold-standard-slide-spec.md"
  mental_model_reference: "squads/slides-creator/docs/mckinsey-architect-mental-model.md"
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/story-arc.schema.yaml

```yaml
# Story Arc Schema — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (T-003B)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Schema for story-arc.yaml — emitted by tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md
# Consumed by tasks/validate-story-arc.md, define-design-direction.md, emit-deck-spec.md.
# Codifies the rhetorical arc independent of slide count.

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  producer: "tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md (T-015A)"
  consumers:
    - "tasks/validate-story-arc.md (T-013A)"
    - "tasks/define-design-direction.md (T-015B)"
    - "tasks/emit-deck-spec.md"
  rubric_dim_ref: "data/qa-rubric.yaml#dimensions.narrativa.sub_dimensions.story_arc"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SCHEMA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
story_arc:
  required: [arc_type, beats, deck_id]
  fields:

    deck_id:
      type: string
      description: "Deck slug"

    arc_type:
      type: enum
      values:
        - educational_workshop     # tensão pedagógica, mecanismo, demo, transformação
        - executive_pitch          # problema, prova, mecanismo, oferta, CTA
        - sales_narrative          # dor, escalação, solução, prova, fechamento
        - thought_leadership       # status quo, ruptura, novo modelo, implicação
        - product_demo             # problema-solução, jobs-to-be-done, demo, próximo passo
        - board_update             # contexto, conquistas, riscos, decisão pedida
        - case_study               # situação, intervenção, resultado, lição
      description: "Tipo de arco narrativo. Define quais beats são canônicos."

    beats:
      type: list
      min_items: 4
      max_items: 8
      description: "Sequência ordenada de momentos narrativos. Cada beat agrupa 1-3 slides."
      item_schema:
        required: [beat_id, beat_type, narrative_function, slides_estimated]
        fields:
          beat_id:
            type: string
            pattern: "^B-[0-9]{2}$"
            example: "B-01"

          beat_type:
            type: enum
            values:
              - hook                  # captura atenção, estabelece relevância
              - tension               # mostra a dor / paradoxo / gap
              - reframe               # muda o ângulo, introduz tese
              - proof                 # evidência, dados, estudos
              - mechanism             # como funciona / arquitetura
              - demo                  # exemplo concreto / artefato
              - artifact_reveal       # entrega tangível (template, fórmula, código)
              - objection_handling    # antecipa e neutraliza dúvidas
              - contrast              # antes vs depois / nós vs eles
              - synthesis             # consolida insight
              - cta                   # call-to-action específico
              - close                 # encerramento / convite

          narrative_function:
            type: string
            max_length: 140
            description: "Em 1 frase: o que este beat faz com a audiência?"
            example: "Quebrar a crença de que IA é só para grandes empresas mostrando 3 cases de microempreendedores."

          slides_estimated:
            type: integer
            min: 1
            max: 3
            description: "Quantos slides este beat ocupará. Soma total deve ser slide-function-map count."

          source_outline_topics:
            type: list
            description: "Quais tópicos do outline original alimentam este beat (rastreabilidade)."
            item_type: string

          required_evidence:
            type: list
            description: "Que evidências/dados este beat precisa (consultado por catalog-sources-apa)."
            item_type: string

          design_direction_hints:
            type: list
            description: "Hints visuais por beat (alta densidade visual / contraste forte / motion / quiet slide)."
            item_type: string

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION RULES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation_rules:
  - rule: "arc_type deve ser um dos valores enumerados"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "beats[].beat_type deve ser um dos valores enumerados"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "Toda story_arc deve conter pelo menos 1 beat de tipo {hook, tension, OR reframe}"
    severity: blocking
    rationale: "Sem abertura narrativa, deck vira apostila"
  - rule: "Toda story_arc deve conter pelo menos 1 beat de tipo {proof OR demo OR artifact_reveal}"
    severity: blocking
    rationale: "Sem prova/demo, deck vira opinião"
  - rule: "Toda story_arc deve conter pelo menos 1 beat de tipo {cta OR close}"
    severity: blocking
    rationale: "Sem fechamento, deck vira monólogo"
  - rule: "sum(beats[].slides_estimated) deve igualar slide-function-map.entries count"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "Total beats <= 8 (mais que isso vira apostila, não arco)"
    severity: high

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE (derived from Primeiro Servico de IA v3)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
example:
  deck_id: "primeiro-servico-ia-v3"
  arc_type: educational_workshop
  beats:
    - beat_id: "B-01"
      beat_type: hook
      narrative_function: "Mostrar paradoxo: IA está em todo lugar mas microempreendedores acham que não é para eles."
      slides_estimated: 1
      source_outline_topics: ["Abertura", "Por que IA agora"]

    - beat_id: "B-02"
      beat_type: tension
      narrative_function: "Quantificar gap: 78% nunca tentaram, 90% acham caro/complexo."
      slides_estimated: 2
      source_outline_topics: ["Pesquisa de mercado", "Barreiras de adoção"]
      required_evidence: ["Pesquisa IBGE 2025 ou equivalente", "Dados de adoção IA SMB"]

    - beat_id: "B-03"
      beat_type: reframe
      narrative_function: "Quebrar a crença: 'IA é para grandes' → 'IA é uma ferramenta de R$ 100'."
      slides_estimated: 1

    - beat_id: "B-04"
      beat_type: mechanism
      narrative_function: "Apresentar matriz: 4 nichos × 3 serviços possíveis com IA hoje."
      slides_estimated: 2
      source_outline_topics: ["Matriz de nichos × serviços"]
      design_direction_hints: ["Visual de matriz 4×3 com ícones por célula", "Alta densidade controlada"]

    - beat_id: "B-05"
      beat_type: demo
      narrative_function: "Mostrar ao vivo: agente de WhatsApp respondendo cliente fictício."
      slides_estimated: 2
      source_outline_topics: ["Demo ao vivo"]
      design_direction_hints: ["Screenshot real do agente em ação", "Bordas suaves estilo terminal/chat"]

    - beat_id: "B-06"
      beat_type: artifact_reveal
      narrative_function: "Entregar template: o prompt-mestre que faz o demo funcionar."
      slides_estimated: 1
      design_direction_hints: ["Card grande com QR + URL", "Sensação de presente"]

    - beat_id: "B-07"
      beat_type: objection_handling
      narrative_function: "Neutralizar as 3 objeções principais: 'não sei programar', 'custa caro', 'não tem tempo'."
      slides_estimated: 2

    - beat_id: "B-08"
      beat_type: cta
      narrative_function: "Convidar para próxima jornada: workshop pago + comunidade."
      slides_estimated: 1

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ANTI-PATTERNS (detected by validate-story-arc.md)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anti_patterns:
  - name: "Topic-list arc"
    description: "beats são apenas seções do outline original sem função narrativa explícita"
    detection: "beats[].narrative_function vazio OR 'apresentar X', 'falar sobre X', 'explicar X'"
    case_study_ref: "outputs/webinars/primeiro-servico-ia/draft-slides-aiox.html"

  - name: "Missing payoff"
    description: "deck tem hook+tension mas sem demo/artifact_reveal"
    detection: "0 beats de tipo {demo, artifact_reveal}"

  - name: "Monolog deck"
    description: "deck sem CTA OR close"
    detection: "0 beats de tipo {cta, close}"

  - name: "Apostila"
    description: "mais que 8 beats — não é arco, é manual"
    detection: "len(beats) > 8"
```

```yaml
registry:

    - "Mirrored entries use version registry-tsx-v1 until an explicit promotion flow lands."
    - "Manifest slide_type values may arrive in content-contract aliases and must be normalized before category lookup."
  governance_notes:

      subject: "QUOTE is content_variant, not canonical slide_type"
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/token-registry.yaml

```yaml
# SINKRA Token Registry — slides-creator
# GAP-001 closure — 9 canonical SINKRA families
# Version: 1.0.0
# Generated: 2026-04-20 | Upgrade Phase 4-7 Wave 1

schema_version: "1.0"
name: slides-creator-token-registry
owner_squad: slides-creator
sinkra_framework: v3.2

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 1: Process Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
process:
  - id: SLIDES_CREATOR
    producer: squad meta
    consumers: [all atoms]
    description: "Root process identity"
  - id: GENERATE_PRESENTATION
    producer: workflow v2.0.0
    consumers: [slide-chief, create-presentation]
    description: "Main workflow Organism"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 2: Task Tokens (28 atoms)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task:
  # Narrative
  - { id: catalog-sources-apa,          phase: P01, session: SESSION-NARR, producer: content-architect, consumer: [validate-fontes-apa, p1-fidelity-sampling] }
  - { id: distill-governing-thought,    phase: P01, session: SESSION-NARR, producer: content-architect, consumer: [build-pyramid] }
  - { id: build-pyramid,                phase: P01, session: SESSION-NARR, producer: content-architect, consumer: [apply-scqa, write-action-titles, validate-pyramid, emit-deck-spec] }
  - { id: apply-scqa,                   phase: P01, session: SESSION-NARR, producer: content-architect, consumer: [write-action-titles, validate-vertical-flow] }
  - { id: write-action-titles,          phase: P02, session: SESSION-NARR, producer: content-architect, consumer: [run-vertical-test, validate-action-title, emit-deck-spec] }
  - { id: run-vertical-test,            phase: P02, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [D02_gate] }
  # Spec
  - { id: classify-slide-type,          phase: P03, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: template-curator, consumer: [select-chart-type, compose-grid-layout] }
  - { id: select-chart-type,            phase: P03, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: template-curator, consumer: [compose-grid-layout] }
  - { id: compose-grid-layout,          phase: P03, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: design-renderer,  consumer: [emit-deck-spec] }
  - { id: emit-deck-spec,               phase: P04, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: design-renderer,  consumer: [P05_validators, handoff-render-request] }
  # Brand
  - { id: detect-brand-override,        phase: P03, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: visual-scout,     consumer: [register-palette-override, resolve-active-palette] }
  - { id: register-palette-override,    phase: P03, session: null,         producer: Human (STK-10),   consumer: [resolve-active-palette] }
  - { id: resolve-active-palette,       phase: P03, session: SESSION-SPEC, producer: visual-scout,     consumer: [compose-grid-layout, emit-deck-spec, handoff-render-request] }
  # QA
  - { id: validate-pyramid,             phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  - { id: validate-vertical-flow,       phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  - { id: validate-enumeration-universal, phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA, producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  - { id: validate-fontes-apa,          phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  - { id: validate-action-title,        phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: qa-inspector,     consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  - { id: p1-fidelity-sampling,         phase: P05, session: SESSION-QA,   producer: Human (reviewer), consumer: [qa_verdict] }
  # Intake
  - { id: load-kb-bundle,               phase: P00, session: null, producer: Worker, consumer: [content-architect, template-curator] }
  - { id: normalize-briefing,           phase: P00, session: null, producer: slide-chief, consumer: [catalog-sources-apa, distill-governing-thought] }
  - { id: youtube-to-briefing,          phase: P00, session: null, producer: Worker, consumer: [normalize-briefing], conditional: "input_type == youtube" }
  # Handoff
  - { id: handoff-render-request,       phase: P06, session: null, producer: design-renderer, consumer: [apps/ds runtime BLOCKED] }
  - { id: prepare-ds-presenter,         phase: P06, session: null, producer: Worker, consumer: [apps/ds runtime BLOCKED] }
  # CRUD
  - { id: create-presentation,          phase: P06, session: null, producer: Human (operator), consumer: [Human reviewer] }
  - { id: review-presentation,          phase: null, session: null, producer: Human (reviewer), consumer: [] }
  - { id: update-slides-creator,        phase: null, session: null, producer: Human (@architect), consumer: [] }
  - { id: delete-slides-creator,        phase: null, session: null, producer: Human (@devops), consumer: [] }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 3: Executor Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
executor:
  - { id: HUMAN,  count: 6,  threshold_coherence: 0.7,  description: "judgment/creativity/brand alignment" }
  - { id: AGENT,  count: 10, threshold_coherence: 0.9,  description: "analysis/generation/pattern recognition" }
  - { id: WORKER, count: 12, threshold_coherence: 0.95, description: "deterministic/API/file ops" }
  - { id: CLONE,  count: 0,  threshold_coherence: 0.9,  description: "(not used — no methodology-rigidity > 0.8)" }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 4: Artifact Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
artifact:
  - { id: NORMALIZED_BRIEFING, template: templates/briefing.normalized.json, producer: normalize-briefing, consumer: [P01_atoms], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: PYRAMID_TREE,        template: templates/pyramid-tree.yaml, producer: build-pyramid, consumer: [write-action-titles, classify-slide-type, validate-pyramid], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: SCQA_MAP,            template: templates/scqa-map.yaml, producer: apply-scqa, consumer: [write-action-titles, validate-vertical-flow], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: SOURCES_APA,         template: "inline sources-apa.yaml", producer: catalog-sources-apa, consumer: [validate-fontes-apa, p1-fidelity-sampling], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: DECK_SPEC,           template: templates/deck-spec.yaml, producer: emit-deck-spec, consumer: [P05_validators, handoff-render-request, create-presentation], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: DECK_MANIFEST,       template: templates/deck-manifest.json, producer: create-presentation, consumer: [Human reviewer], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: QA_REPORT,           template: templates/qa-report.json, producer: qa-inspector, consumer: [qa_verdict, Human reviewer], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: RENDER_REQUEST,      template: templates/render-request.yaml, producer: handoff-render-request, consumer: [apps/ds (BLOCKED)], lifecycle: [draft, validated, approved] }
  - { id: ACTIVE_PALETTE,      template: "inline active-palette.yaml", producer: resolve-active-palette, consumer: [compose-grid-layout, emit-deck-spec], lifecycle: [draft, approved] }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 5: Checkpoint Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
checkpoint:
  - id: D01
    phase: P01
    type: Human
    verdict_enum: [APPROVED, REJECTED, WAIVED]
    artifact_template: templates/checkpoint-schema.yaml
    sla_ladder_hours: [24, 72, 168]
  - id: D02
    phase: P02
    type: Human
    verdict_enum: [APPROVED, REJECTED, WAIVED]
    non_overridable_preconditions: ["vertical-test == PASS"]
  - id: D03
    phase: P03
    type: Human
    verdict_enum: [APPROVED, REJECTED, WAIVED]
    co_sign_required_on: "brand override present"
    co_signer: STK-10
  - id: qa_verdict
    phase: P05
    type: Computed
    verdict_enum: [PASS, FAIL]
    pass_criteria: "narrative_dim >= 7 AND ppteval_composite >= 7"
    fail_router: { narrative: P01, spec: P03, vertical: P02 }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 6: Pattern Tokens (pattern_library SC-* namespace)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pattern:
  - { id: SC-TP-001, category: TaskPattern,       scope: "Standard task anatomy (8 SINKRA fields)" }
  - { id: SC-EP-001, category: ExecutorPattern,   scope: "Human executor shape" }
  - { id: SC-EP-002, category: ExecutorPattern,   scope: "Agent executor shape" }
  - { id: SC-EP-003, category: ExecutorPattern,   scope: "Hybrid (Agent+Human) shape" }
  - { id: SC-EP-004, category: ExecutorPattern,   scope: "Worker executor shape" }
  - { id: SC-PP-001, category: ProcessPattern,    scope: "Narrative discipline pipeline (Pyramid+SCQA+APA)" }
  - { id: SC-IP-001, category: IntegrationPattern, scope: "Brand config integration from workspace/L2-tactical/brand/" }
  - { id: SC-AP-001, category: AutomationPattern, scope: "Deterministic validator via Worker" }
  - { id: SC-DP-001, category: DocumentationPattern, scope: "SOP structure (brand-agnostic)" }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 7: Decision Tokens (agent heuristics)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
decision:
  - { namespace: BN_, range: "BN_001..BN_006", source: agents/slide-chief.md, scope: "Briefing normalization heuristics" }
  - { namespace: IM_, range: "IM_001..IM_002", source: agents/slide-chief.md, scope: "Induction method heuristics" }
  - { namespace: MS_, range: "MS_001..MS_003", source: agents/slide-chief.md, scope: "Max-slides heuristics" }
  - { namespace: RH_, range: "RH_001..RH_010", source: agents/slide-chief.md, scope: "Routing heuristics" }
  - { namespace: K,   range: "K1..K9",         source: agents/qa-inspector.md, scope: "QA killer items" }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 8: QualityGate Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
quality_gate:
  - { id: BRAND_TOKEN_COMPLIANCE, executor: Worker, threshold: "token_usage >= 95% AND 0 custom violations", schema_ref: data/checkpoint-schema.yaml }
  - { id: VISUAL_REGRESSION,      executor: Worker, threshold: "< 2% pixel diff from reference" }
  - { id: ACCESSIBILITY,          executor: Worker, threshold: "0 WCAG AA violations" }
  - { id: PPTEVAL_COMPOSITE,      executor: Agent,  threshold: "Design >= 7 AND Content >= 7 AND Coherence >= 7 AND GAD >= 7", aggregation: AND }
  - { id: HUMAN_VISUAL_APPROVAL,  executor: Human,  threshold: "explicit approval", required_for: "external-facing artifacts only" }

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FAMILY 9: Handoff Tokens
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
handoff:
  - id: BC-08_RENDER_REQUEST
    scope: "slides-creator → apps/ds runtime"
    producer: handoff-render-request
    consumer: apps/ds runtime OR LLM-direct fallback
    schema: templates/render-request.yaml
    status: handoff_only  # apps/ds runtime absent
    fallback_semantics: "emit anyway, await runtime reconnection"
  - id: BC-D01_NARRATIVE_APPROVAL
    scope: "Phase P01 → P02"
    producer: content-architect
    consumer: slide-chief (gate)
  - id: BC-D02_STRUCTURE_APPROVAL
    scope: "Phase P02 → P03"
    producer: content-architect
    consumer: slide-chief (gate)
  - id: BC-D03_DESIGN_APPROVAL
    scope: "Phase P03 → P04"
    producer: design-renderer + template-curator
    consumer: slide-chief (gate)
    co_sign: "STK-10 if brand override"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TOKEN LINEAGE (Token → Atom → Molecule → Organism)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
token_lineage:
  - token: PYRAMID_TREE (Artifact)
    atom_producer: build-pyramid
    molecule: MOL-NARR-PYRAMID
    organism: ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION
  - token: DECK_SPEC (Artifact)
    atom_producer: emit-deck-spec
    molecule: MOL-SPEC-EMISSION
    organism: ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION
  - token: D01/D02/D03 (Checkpoint)
    atom_producer: [content-architect, design-renderer+template-curator]
    molecule: (phase-level gate, not a molecule)
    organism: ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION
  - token: BRAND_TOKEN_COMPLIANCE (QualityGate)
    consumed_at: P05
    molecule: MOL-QA-NARRATIVE
    organism: ORG-GENERATE-PRESENTATION

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METADATA
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
meta:
  total_token_families: 9
  total_token_values: 120+  # 2 process + 28 tasks + 4 executors + 9 artifacts + 4 checkpoints + 9 patterns + 30+ decisions + 5 quality_gates + 4 handoffs
  lifecycle_supported: [draft, validated, approved, superseded, archived]
  gap_closed: GAP-001
  compatible_with: sinkra-v3.2
```

```yaml
# Token Transformer — Design Tokens to Engine Themes
# SSOT for transforming W3C DTCG design tokens into engine-specific theme formats.
# Consumed by: visual-scout (pre-render token injection), design-renderer (brand verification),
#               qa-inspector (brand compliance validation).
# Created by: Story 1.2 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 1)
# Dependencies: visual-engines.yaml (Story 1.1), prototype-d2-tokens.sh (Story 0.5)

token_transformer:
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  story: "1.2"
  backward_compatible: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TOKEN SOURCE: W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) Format
  # Tokens are loaded from workspace/businesses/{brand}/ directory.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  token_source:
    description: >
      Design tokens follow the W3C DTCG specification (https://tr.designtokens.org/format/).
      Each business in workspace/businesses/{brand}/ may provide tokens via:
        1. design-system/config.yaml — points to token CSS files and palette definitions
        2. brand/branding-repository.yaml — contains hex palette under brand.colors
      The Token Transformer reads from these sources and normalizes into an internal
      DesignTokens object before converting to engine-specific formats.
    base_path: "workspace/businesses/{brand}/"
    lookup_order:
      - path: "design-system/config.yaml"
        extract: "themes.{theme}.tokens"
        format: css_custom_properties
        description: "Primary source: CSS custom properties from design system config"
      - path: "brand/branding-repository.yaml"
        extract: "brand.colors"
        format: yaml_palette
        description: "Fallback: YAML palette from brand repository"
      - path: "L2-tactical/brand/brandbook.yaml"
        extract: "visual_identity.colors"
        format: yaml_palette
        description: "Legacy fallback: color definitions derived from the canonical brandbook"
    no_tokens_behavior: >
      When no design tokens are found for a brand, the Token Transformer returns
      an empty DesignTokens object. Engines degrade gracefully: diagram engines
      use their default themes, AI image engines omit color constraints from prompts.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # INTERNAL TOKEN SCHEMA (normalized intermediate format)
  # All sources are normalized to this schema before engine conversion.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  normalized_schema:
    description: >
      Internal representation used between token loading and engine conversion.
      This is NOT persisted — it exists in memory during the transform pipeline.
    fields:
      palette:
        type: array
        items: "string (hex, e.g. #4A90D9)"
        min_items: 0
        max_items: 12
        description: >
          Ordered brand palette. Index 0 = primary, 1 = secondary,
          2 = accent, 3 = neutral, 4 = background. Additional slots for
          extended palettes. Derived from DTCG color.brand.* tokens.
        semantic_mapping:
          0: primary
          1: secondary
          2: accent
          3: neutral
          4: background
      typography:
        type: object
        properties:
          heading_font:
            type: string
            description: "Font family for headings (e.g. 'Space Grotesk')"
          body_font:
            type: string
            description: "Font family for body text (e.g. 'Manrope')"
          mono_font:
            type: string
            description: "Monospace font (e.g. 'IBM Plex Mono')"
      spacing:
        type: object
        properties:
          base_unit:
            type: number
            unit: px
            description: "Base spacing unit in pixels"
      background:
        type: string
        description: "Background color hex. Defaults to palette[4] or #FFFFFF."
      style_preference:
        type: string
        enum: [flat, isometric, line_art, corporate, hand_drawn, minimal]
        default: flat
        description: "Visual style preference for AI-generated images."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ENGINE CONVERTERS
  # Each converter transforms normalized DesignTokens into engine-specific format.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  converters:

    # =========================================================================
    # D2 Converter — Design Tokens -> D2 theme-overrides CLI flag
    # =========================================================================
    d2:
      engine_id: d2
      description: >
        Converts design tokens to D2 CLI --theme-overrides flag format.
        D2 uses N (neutral) and B (accent) variables for theming.
        For Kroki API: tokens are injected as inline D2 vars block prepended
        to diagram code (Kroki does NOT support --theme-overrides flag).
      output_format: cli_flag
      cli_template: "--theme-overrides='N1:${background};N2:${primary};N3:${neutral};B1:${primary};B2:${secondary};B3:${accent};B4:${neutral}'"

      token_to_d2_mapping:
        # D2 N-variables (Neutral): node fill, stroke, font
        N1:
          source: "palette[4]"
          fallback: "#FFFFFF"
          semantic: "background / node fill"
        N2:
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"
          semantic: "primary / node stroke"
        N3:
          source: "palette[3]"
          fallback: "#34495E"
          semantic: "neutral / node font color"
        N7:
          source: "14"
          semantic: "font size (fixed)"

        # D2 B-variables (Accent): color progression B1-B6
        B1:
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"
          semantic: "primary accent (same as N2)"
        B2:
          source: "palette[1]"
          fallback: "#2ECC71"
          semantic: "secondary accent"
        B3:
          source: "palette[2]"
          fallback: "#E74C3C"
          semantic: "tertiary accent"
        B4:
          source: "palette[3]"
          fallback: "#34495E"
          semantic: "neutral accent"
        B5:
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"
          semantic: "extended (cycles primary)"
        B6:
          source: "palette[1]"
          fallback: "#2ECC71"
          semantic: "extended (cycles secondary)"

      kroki_inline_template: |
        vars: {
          d2-config: {
            theme-overrides: {
              N1: '${background}'
              N2: '${primary}'
              N3: '${neutral}'
              B1: '${primary}'
              B2: '${secondary}'
              B3: '${accent}'
              B4: '${neutral}'
            }
          }
        }

      example:
        input:
          palette: ["#4A90D9", "#2ECC71", "#E74C3C", "#34495E", "#ECF0F1"]
        output_cli: "--theme-overrides='N1:#ECF0F1;N2:#4A90D9;N3:#34495E;B1:#4A90D9;B2:#2ECC71;B3:#E74C3C;B4:#34495E'"
        output_kroki: |
          vars: {
            d2-config: {
              theme-overrides: {
                N1: '#ECF0F1'
                N2: '#4A90D9'
                N3: '#34495E'
                B1: '#4A90D9'
                B2: '#2ECC71'
                B3: '#E74C3C'
                B4: '#34495E'
              }
            }
          }

    # =========================================================================
    # Mermaid Converter — Design Tokens -> Mermaid %%{init}%% directive
    # =========================================================================
    mermaid:
      engine_id: mermaid
      description: >
        Converts design tokens to Mermaid %%{init}%% theme directive.
        The directive is prepended to the diagram code before sending to Kroki.
        Mermaid supports themeVariables for granular control.
      output_format: init_directive
```
