```yaml
      directive_template: "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'primaryColor': '${primary}', 'primaryTextColor': '${neutral}', 'primaryBorderColor': '${primary}', 'secondaryColor': '${secondary}', 'tertiaryColor': '${accent}', 'lineColor': '${neutral}', 'fontFamily': '${body_font}', 'fontSize': '14px'}}}%%"

      token_to_mermaid_mapping:
        primaryColor:
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"
          semantic: "Primary node background"
        primaryTextColor:
          source: "palette[3]"
          fallback: "#34495E"
          semantic: "Text color on primary nodes"
        primaryBorderColor:
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"
          semantic: "Border color of primary nodes"
        secondaryColor:
          source: "palette[1]"
          fallback: "#2ECC71"
          semantic: "Secondary node background"
        tertiaryColor:
          source: "palette[2]"
          fallback: "#E74C3C"
          semantic: "Tertiary node background"
        lineColor:
          source: "palette[3]"
          fallback: "#34495E"
          semantic: "Connection line color"
        fontFamily:
          source: "typography.body_font"
          fallback: "sans-serif"
          semantic: "Diagram font family"

      injection_method: prepend_to_diagram_code
      notes: >
        The %%{init}%% directive MUST be the first line of the Mermaid diagram code.
        theme: 'base' ensures all themeVariables are applied without preset interference.

      example:
        input:
          palette: ["#4A90D9", "#2ECC71", "#E74C3C", "#34495E", "#ECF0F1"]
          typography:
            body_font: "Manrope"
        output: "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'primaryColor': '#4A90D9', 'primaryTextColor': '#34495E', 'primaryBorderColor': '#4A90D9', 'secondaryColor': '#2ECC71', 'tertiaryColor': '#E74C3C', 'lineColor': '#34495E', 'fontFamily': 'Manrope', 'fontSize': '14px'}}}%%"

    # =========================================================================
    # AI Image Converter — Design Tokens -> Prompt color constraints
    # =========================================================================
    ai_image:
      engine_ids: [gpt_image, recraft, ideogram]
      description: >
        Converts design tokens to a prompt suffix that constrains AI image
        generation to use brand colors. Applied to GPTImageEngine, RecraftEngine,
        and IdeogramEngine via their brand_injection.template mechanism.
      output_format: prompt_suffix
      prompt_template: >
        IMPORTANT: Use ONLY these brand colors: ${palette_csv}.
        Background: ${background}. Style: ${style_preference}.
        Do NOT include text in the image unless explicitly instructed.
        Do NOT use colors outside the provided palette.

      token_to_prompt_mapping:
        palette_csv:
          source: "palette[0..n]"
          format: "comma-separated hex values"
          description: "All palette colors joined with commas"
          example: "#4A90D9, #2ECC71, #E74C3C, #34495E, #ECF0F1"
        background:
          source: "palette[4]"
          fallback: "white"
          description: "Background color or keyword"
        style_preference:
          source: "style_preference"
          fallback: "flat, clean, professional"
          description: "Visual style descriptor"

      injection_method: append_to_prompt
      notes: >
        AI image engines cannot guarantee exact color compliance. The prompt
        suffix is best-effort. Post-generation validation via Brand Validator
        catches deviations. Colors in AI-generated PNGs are verified by extracting
        dominant colors and comparing against the palette using delta-E.

      example:
        input:
          palette: ["#4A90D9", "#2ECC71", "#E74C3C", "#34495E", "#ECF0F1"]
          style_preference: "flat"
        output: >
          IMPORTANT: Use ONLY these brand colors: #4A90D9, #2ECC71, #E74C3C, #34495E, #ECF0F1.
          Background: #ECF0F1. Style: flat.
          Do NOT include text in the image unless explicitly instructed.
          Do NOT use colors outside the provided palette.

    # =========================================================================
    # Plotly Converter — Design Tokens -> Plotly layout template
    # =========================================================================
    plotly:
      engine_id: plotly
      description: >
        Converts design tokens to Plotly figure layout properties.
        Applied directly to fig.update_layout() in PlotlyEngine.
      output_format: plotly_layout
      layout_template:
        colorway: "${palette_array}"
        paper_bgcolor: "${background}"
        plot_bgcolor: "${background}"
        font:
          family: "${body_font}"
          color: "${neutral}"
        title:
          font:
            family: "${heading_font}"
            color: "${primary}"

      token_to_plotly_mapping:
        "layout.colorway":
          source: "palette[0..n]"
          description: "Chart color sequence"
        "layout.paper_bgcolor":
          source: "palette[4]"
          fallback: "#FFFFFF"
          description: "Chart paper background"
        "layout.plot_bgcolor":
          source: "palette[4]"
          fallback: "#FFFFFF"
          description: "Chart plot area background"
        "layout.font.family":
          source: "typography.body_font"
          fallback: "sans-serif"
        "layout.font.color":
          source: "palette[3]"
          fallback: "#34495E"
        "layout.title.font.family":
          source: "typography.heading_font"
          fallback: "sans-serif"
        "layout.title.font.color":
          source: "palette[0]"
          fallback: "#4A90D9"

      example:
        input:
          palette: ["#4A90D9", "#2ECC71", "#E74C3C", "#34495E", "#ECF0F1"]
          typography:
            heading_font: "Space Grotesk"
            body_font: "Manrope"
        output:
          colorway: ["#4A90D9", "#2ECC71", "#E74C3C", "#34495E", "#ECF0F1"]
          paper_bgcolor: "#ECF0F1"
          plot_bgcolor: "#ECF0F1"
          font:
            family: "Manrope"
            color: "#34495E"
          title:
            font:
              family: "Space Grotesk"
              color: "#4A90D9"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # BRAND VALIDATOR
  # Post-generation validation: compares rendered output colors against palette.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  brand_validator:
    description: >
      Validates that generated visuals respect the brand palette. Works differently
      for SVG (exact hex comparison) and PNG (dominant color extraction + delta-E).
      Called by VisualEngine.validateBrandCompliance() internally.
    version: "1.0.0"

    # --- SVG Validation ---
    svg_validation:
      method: hex_extraction
      description: >
        Parse SVG markup and extract all hex colors from fill, stroke, color,
        stop-color, and style attributes. Compare each against the allowed palette.
      extraction_targets:
        - attribute: fill
        - attribute: stroke
        - attribute: color
        - attribute: stop-color
        - css_property: "fill"
        - css_property: "stroke"
        - css_property: "color"
        - css_property: "background-color"
      ignored_colors:
        - "#000000"   # Black (default SVG)
        - "#FFFFFF"   # White (default SVG)
        - "none"
        - "transparent"
      comparison: exact_hex_match_or_delta_e

    # --- PNG Validation ---
    png_validation:
      method: dominant_color_extraction
      description: >
        Extract dominant colors from PNG using color quantization (k-means or
        median cut). Compare each dominant color against the allowed palette
        using CIE delta-E 2000 formula.
      extraction:
        algorithm: k_means
        num_colors: 8
        min_pixel_percentage: 2.0
        description: "Extract top 8 colors, ignore colors < 2% of pixels"
      ignored_regions:
        - "background (if solid, auto-detected)"

    # --- Delta-E Color Distance ---
    delta_e:
      formula: "CIE2000"
      description: >
        CIE delta-E 2000 is the industry standard for perceptual color difference.
        A delta-E of 0 = identical, 1 = barely perceptible, 5 = noticeable,
        10 = clearly different, 50 = opposite colors.
      thresholds:
        match:
          max_delta_e: 5.0
          verdict: compliant
          description: "Color is close enough to a palette color. Acceptable."
        warning:
          min_delta_e: 5.0
          max_delta_e: 10.0
          verdict: warning
          description: >
            Color deviates noticeably from palette. Visual warning generated
            but not blocking. Logged in VisualOutput.metadata.brand_compliance.violations.
          severity: warning
        violation:
          min_delta_e: 10.0
          verdict: violation
          description: >
            Color is clearly off-brand. Triggers color substitution
            (nearest palette match) for diagram engines. For AI image engines,
            logged as brand_violation and may trigger re-generation.
          severity: critical

    # --- WCAG AA Contrast Check ---
    wcag_contrast:
      description: >
        Verifies that text-background color combinations meet WCAG 2.1 AA
        minimum contrast ratios. Applied to diagram engines where text colors
        are deterministic.
      standard: "WCAG 2.1 AA"
      minimum_ratios:
        normal_text: 4.5
        large_text: 3.0
        ui_components: 3.0
      large_text_definition: ">= 18pt or >= 14pt bold"
      check_pairs:
        - text_source: "N3 (font color)"
          background_source: "N1 (fill color)"
          context: "D2 node text on node background"
        - text_source: "primaryTextColor"
          background_source: "primaryColor"
          context: "Mermaid primary node text"
        - text_source: "palette[3]"
          background_source: "palette[4]"
          context: "General text on background"
      on_failure:
        action: adjust_contrast
        method: >
          Darken or lighten the text color to meet minimum ratio.
          Preserve hue, adjust lightness in HSL space.
          Log adjustment in VisualOutput.metadata.brand_compliance.violations
          with severity=warning.

    # --- Color Substitution Rules ---
    color_substitution:
      description: >
        When a color in the rendered output is not in the allowed palette,
        substitute it with the nearest palette color (by delta-E distance).
        Only applies to diagram engines (D2, Mermaid, Plotly) where colors
        are deterministically set. AI image engines cannot be post-corrected
        this way (use re-generation instead).
      applicable_engines: [d2, mermaid, plotly]
      algorithm: nearest_palette_match
      steps:
        - "1. Convert out-of-palette color to CIELAB"
        - "2. Convert each palette color to CIELAB"
        - "3. Compute delta-E 2000 between out-of-palette and each palette color"
        - "4. Select palette color with minimum delta-E"
        - "5. Replace out-of-palette color with nearest match"
        - "6. Log substitution in brand_compliance.violations (severity=warning)"
      forbidden_colors_handling: >
        Colors listed in brand_constraints.forbidden_colors are NEVER substituted
        in. If the nearest match is a forbidden color, use the second nearest.
      notes: >
        Color substitution happens BEFORE the final SVG/PNG is emitted.
        The VisualOutput.metadata.colors_used array reflects post-substitution colors.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TRANSFORM PIPELINE
  # End-to-end flow: load tokens -> normalize -> convert -> inject -> validate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  transform_pipeline:
    description: >
      The complete flow from brand directory to themed visual output.
      Executed by visual-scout before calling engine.render().
    steps:
      - step: 1
        name: load_tokens
        description: "Read design tokens from workspace/businesses/{brand}/ using lookup_order"
        input: "brand_id (string)"
        output: "raw_tokens (format-specific)"
        on_not_found: "Return empty DesignTokens (engines use defaults)"

      - step: 2
        name: normalize
        description: "Convert raw tokens to normalized_schema format"
        input: "raw_tokens"
        output: "DesignTokens (normalized)"
        css_extraction: >
          For CSS custom properties: parse token files, extract --bb-* vars,
          map to palette array based on semantic naming.

      - step: 3
        name: convert
        description: "Transform normalized tokens to engine-specific format using the appropriate converter"
        input: "DesignTokens + engine_id"
        output: "engine_theme (string: CLI flag, directive, prompt suffix, or layout dict)"
        converter_selection: "converters[engine_id] or converters.ai_image for AI engines"

      - step: 4
        name: inject
        description: "Apply the converted theme to the VisualSpec before render()"
        input: "VisualSpec + engine_theme"
        output: "VisualSpec (with theme applied)"
        injection_methods:
          d2_cli: "Append CLI flag to d2 command args"
          d2_kroki: "Prepend vars block to diagram_code"
          mermaid: "Prepend %%{init}%% directive to diagram_code"
          ai_image: "Append prompt suffix to spec.prompt"
          plotly: "Merge layout dict into fig.update_layout()"

      - step: 5
        name: validate
        description: "Post-render brand compliance check via Brand Validator"
        input: "VisualOutput + DesignTokens"
        output: "ValidationResult (compliant: bool, violations: array)"
        on_violation:
          diagram_engines: "Apply color substitution, re-render if needed"
          ai_engines: "Log violation, suggest re-generation with stricter prompt"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CONSTRAINTS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  constraints:
    backward_compatibility:
      rule: >
        Token Transformer is OPTIONAL. When design_tokens is empty or absent
        in VisualSpec, engines render with their default themes. No error is thrown.
      source: "epic constraint #1 — all new fields optional"

    brand_agnostic_squad:
      rule: >
        This file (token-transformer.yaml) is brand-agnostic. It defines HOW
        to transform tokens, not WHICH tokens to use. Brand-specific data lives
        exclusively in workspace/businesses/{brand}/.
      source: "AIOX squad agnosticism rule (NON-NEGOTIABLE)"

    performance:
      rule: >
        Token loading and conversion MUST complete in < 100ms. Token files are
        small (< 50KB). No network calls. Cache normalized tokens per brand
        for the duration of a deck generation run.
      cache_key: "brand_id + token_file_mtime"
      cache_ttl: "duration of single deck generation (ephemeral)"

    delta_e_precision:
      rule: >
        Delta-E calculations MUST use CIE2000 formula, not CIE76 or CIE94.
        CIE2000 is the most perceptually uniform and is the industry standard.
      source: "roundtable decision — brand compliance rate >= 95%"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/visual-engines.yaml

```yaml
# VisualEngine Interface Contract + Operational Implementation
# SSOT for the strategy pattern that abstracts visual rendering engines.
# Consumed by: visual-scout (routing), design-renderer (output handling),
#               qa-inspector (cost/quality validation), content-architect (spec emission).
# Created by: Story 0.1 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 0)
# Implemented by: Story 1.1 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 1) -- operational config per engine

visual_engine_contract:
  version: "1.1.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-19"
  updated_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  stories: ["0.1", "1.1"]
  backward_compatible: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # INTERFACE: VisualEngine
  # The strategy pattern interface. Each engine implements these 4 methods.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  interfaces:
    VisualEngine:
      description: >
        Abstract interface for visual rendering engines. Each concrete engine
        (D2, Mermaid, GPT Image, Recraft, Plotly, Ideogram) implements this
        contract. The visual-scout selects and invokes engines through this
        uniform API.
      methods:
        render:
          signature: "render(spec: VisualSpec) -> VisualOutput | VisualError"
          description: >
            Generate a visual from the given spec. MUST call
            validateBrandCompliance internally before emitting VisualOutput.
            On failure, returns VisualError with fallback_suggestion.
          preconditions:
            - "spec.engine matches this engine's id"
            - "spec.design_tokens is present (may be empty object for no-brand contexts)"
          postconditions:
            - "VisualOutput.metadata.colors_used is populated"
            - "VisualOutput.metadata.dimensions is populated"
            - "Brand compliance was validated before output emission"

        supports:
          signature: "supports(engine: EngineType) -> boolean"
          description: >
            Returns true if this engine implementation handles the given
            engine type identifier. Used by visual-scout for routing.

        estimateCost:
          signature: "estimateCost(spec: VisualSpec) -> CostEstimate"
          description: >
            Returns the estimated cost in USD for rendering the given spec.
            Used by visual-scout to enforce the per-deck budget cap.
          return_type:
            amount_usd:
              type: number
              precision: 4
              description: "Cost in USD with 4 decimal places (e.g. 0.0400)"
            currency: "USD"
            confidence:
              type: string
              enum: [exact, estimated]
              description: "exact for fixed-price APIs, estimated for token-based"

        validateBrandCompliance:
          signature: "validateBrandCompliance(output: VisualOutput, tokens: DesignTokens) -> ValidationResult"
          description: >
            Post-generation validation. Checks that the rendered output
            respects the brand constraints encoded in design tokens.
            Called internally by render() before emitting output.
            Can also be called externally by visual-scout for re-validation.
          return_type:
            compliant:
              type: boolean
            violations:
              type: array
              items:
                field: string
                expected: string
                actual: string
                severity: "string (enum: critical, warning)"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TYPE: VisualSpec (input to render)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    VisualSpec:
      description: >
        Input specification for visual generation. Emitted by content-architect
        as part of the enriched deck-manifest (slides[].visual_strategy).
        All fields that do not exist in the v1 briefing are OPTIONAL.
      fields:
        engine:
          type: string
          enum: [d2, mermaid, gpt_image, recraft, plotly, ideogram]
          required: true
          description: "Target engine identifier. Must match an engine in engines_registry."

        content_type:
          type: string
          enum: [process, hierarchy, comparison, concept, data, timeline, architecture, icon]
          required: true
          description: >
            Semantic classification of the content to be visualized.
            Determined by content-architect during visual strategy phase.

        visual_type:
          type: string
          enum: [flowchart, sequence, mindmap, er, gantt, infographic, illustration, chart, svg_icon, diagram]
          required: true
          description: >
            Concrete visual output type. Maps content_type to a renderable
            format supported by the selected engine.

        design_tokens:
          type: object
          required: false
          default: {}
          description: >
            W3C DTCG design tokens from aiox-design squad. Contains palette,
            typography, spacing. Optional -- engines degrade gracefully
            without tokens (use engine defaults).
          properties:
            palette:
              type: array
              items: "string (hex color, e.g. #4A90D9)"
              description: "Ordered brand palette. First color = primary."
            typography:
              type: object
              properties:
                heading_font: string
                body_font: string
            spacing:
              type: object
              properties:
                base_unit: "number (px)"

        brand_constraints:
          type: object
          required: false
          default: {}
          description: >
            Additional brand rules beyond design tokens. Optional.
            When present, validateBrandCompliance uses these for validation.
          properties:
            forbidden_colors:
              type: array
              items: "string (hex)"
              description: "Colors that must NOT appear in the output."
            style_preference:
              type: string
              enum: [flat, isometric, line_art, corporate, hand_drawn, minimal]
              description: "Visual style preference for AI-generated images."
            background:
              type: string
              enum: [white, transparent, brand_primary, dark]
              default: white
            max_text_in_image:
              type: boolean
              default: false
              description: "If false, text should be added via PPTX layer, not baked into the image."

        prompt:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: >
            LLM-generated prompt for AI image engines (gpt_image, recraft,
            ideogram). Not used by diagram engines (d2, mermaid, plotly).

        diagram_code:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: >
            Source code for diagram engines (D2 syntax, Mermaid syntax, Plotly
            JSON). Not used by AI image engines.

        aspect_ratio:
          type: string
          enum: ["16:9", "4:3", "1:1", "9:16"]
          required: false
          default: "16:9"
          description: "Target aspect ratio for the generated visual."

        multi_slide:
          type: boolean
          required: false
          default: false
          description: >
            If true, the visual spans multiple slides (panoramic). Deferred
            to v2.1 -- currently always false.

        multi_slide_group:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: >
            Group identifier for panoramic visuals. All slides in the same
            group share the same base visual with different viewBox segments.
            Deferred to v2.1.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TYPE: VisualOutput (output from render)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    VisualOutput:
      description: >
        Output from a successful render() call. Consumed by design-renderer
        for slide composition and by qa-inspector for quality validation.
      fields:
        format:
          type: string
          enum: [svg, png]
          required: true
          description: "Output format. SVG for diagram engines, PNG for AI image engines."

        data:
          type: string
          required: true
          description: >
            The visual content. For SVG: raw SVG markup string.
            For PNG: base64-encoded image data or filesystem path.

        metadata:
          type: object
          required: true
          properties:
            colors_used:
              type: array
              items: "string (hex)"
              description: >
                Colors present in the output. Extracted post-render for
                brand compliance validation.
            dimensions:
              type: object
              required: true
              properties:
                width:
                  type: number
                  description: "Width in pixels"
                height:
                  type: number
                  description: "Height in pixels"
            engine_id:
              type: string
              description: "Which engine produced this output."
            generation_time_ms:
              type: number
              description: "Wall-clock time for generation in milliseconds."
            cost_usd:
              type: number
              precision: 4
              description: "Actual cost incurred for this generation."
            cache_hit:
              type: boolean
              description: "True if served from cache (L1/L2/L3)."
            brand_compliance:
              type: object
              properties:
                compliant: boolean
                violations_count: number
                violations: array

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # TYPE: VisualError (error from render)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    VisualError:
      description: >
        Error returned when render() fails. Contains enough context for
        visual-scout to attempt fallback to another engine.
      fields:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [engine_failure, brand_violation, timeout]
          required: true
          description: >
            engine_failure: API/CLI returned error or invalid output.
            brand_violation: Output failed validateBrandCompliance.
            timeout: Engine did not respond within configured timeout.

        message:
          type: string
          required: true
          description: "Human-readable error description."

        engine_id:
          type: string
          required: true
          description: "Which engine failed."

        fallback_suggestion:
          type: string
          required: false
          enum: [d2, mermaid, gpt_image, recraft, plotly, ideogram, null]
          description: >
            Suggested fallback engine ID from engines_registry, or null if
            no fallback is viable. visual-scout uses this to attempt the
            next engine in the fallback chain.

        original_spec:
          type: object
          required: false
          description: "The VisualSpec that caused the failure, for retry/debug."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ENGINES REGISTRY
  # Story 0.1: interface contract. Story 1.1: operational implementation.
  # Each engine entry has: identity, capabilities, render_config, supports,
  # estimateCost, timeout, fallback_chain -- per the VisualEngine interface.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  engines_registry:

    # =========================================================================
    # D2Engine — Deterministic diagram via D2 CLI or Kroki API
    # =========================================================================
    - id: d2
      name: "D2Engine"
      description: "D2 diagram language via CLI or Kroki API. Deterministic layout."
      category: diagram
      capabilities:
        content_types: [process, hierarchy, architecture, comparison]
        visual_types: [flowchart, sequence, er, diagram]
        output_formats: [svg, png]
        supports_theming: true
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: true
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        model: free_oss
      api_endpoint: "http://localhost:8000/d2/svg"
      api_type: kroki_self_hosted
      timeout_ms: 10000
      fallback_engines: [mermaid]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: kroki_api
        fallback_method: d2_cli
        kroki_api:
          url: "${KROKI_URL:-http://localhost:8000}/d2/svg"
          method: POST
          content_type: "text/plain"
          body: "${spec.diagram_code}"
          response_format: svg
          health_check: "${KROKI_URL:-http://localhost:8000}/health"
        d2_cli:
          command: "d2"
          args: ["--theme-overrides", "${theme_overrides}", "${input_file}", "${output_file}"]
          input_format: ".d2 file"
          output_format: ".svg file"
          layout_engines: [dagre, elk, tala]
          default_layout: dagre
        theme_injection:
          method: d2_theme_overrides
          mapping:
            "design_tokens.palette[0]": "N2,B1"   # primary -> node stroke + accent 1
            "design_tokens.palette[1]": "B2"       # secondary -> accent 2
            "design_tokens.palette[2]": "B3"       # accent -> accent 3
            "design_tokens.palette[3]": "N3,B4"    # neutral -> font color + accent 4
            "design_tokens.background": "N1"        # background -> node fill
          cli_format: "N1:${bg};N2:${primary};N3:${neutral};B1:${primary};B2:${secondary};B3:${accent};B4:${neutral}"
          kroki_format: "inline D2 vars block (Kroki does NOT support --theme-overrides)"
        png_conversion:
          tool: cairosvg
          dpi: 300
          command: "python3 -c \"import cairosvg; cairosvg.svg2png(url='${svg_path}', write_to='${png_path}', dpi=300)\""
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [d2]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'd2'"
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Free OSS. No API cost. Local CLI or self-hosted Kroki."
      error_handling:
        on_kroki_down: "fallback to d2_cli standalone"
        on_syntax_error: "re-generate D2 code via LLM (1 retry)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=mermaid)"
        retry_count: 1
        retry_delay_ms: 0
      notes: >
        Self-hosted via Kroki Docker. Layout engines: dagre, elk, tala.
        Theme overrides support brand palette injection.
        Known issue: Kroki API does NOT support --theme-overrides flag;
        use inline D2 style vars for Kroki theming (see Story 1.2 Token Transformer).

    # =========================================================================
    # MermaidEngine — Mermaid.js diagrams via Kroki API
    # =========================================================================
    - id: mermaid
      name: "MermaidEngine"
      description: "Mermaid.js diagrams via Kroki API. Markdown-like syntax."
      category: diagram
      capabilities:
        content_types: [process, hierarchy, timeline, comparison]
        visual_types: [flowchart, sequence, mindmap, gantt, er, diagram]
        output_formats: [svg, png]
        supports_theming: true
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: false
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        model: free_oss
      api_endpoint: "http://localhost:8000/mermaid/svg"
      api_type: kroki_self_hosted
      timeout_ms: 10000
      fallback_engines: [d2]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: kroki_api
        fallback_method: null  # no CLI fallback for Mermaid; fall through to D2
        kroki_api:
          url: "${KROKI_URL:-http://localhost:8000}/mermaid/svg"
          method: POST
          content_type: "text/plain"
          body: "${spec.diagram_code}"
          response_format: svg
          health_check: "${KROKI_URL:-http://localhost:8000}/health"
        theme_injection:
          method: mermaid_init_directive
          format: "%%{init: {'themeVariables': {'primaryColor': '${primary}', 'secondaryColor': '${secondary}', 'tertiaryColor': '${accent}', 'primaryTextColor': '${neutral}', 'primaryBorderColor': '${primary}'}}}%%"
          prepend_to: diagram_code
        png_conversion:
          tool: cairosvg
          dpi: 300
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [mermaid]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'mermaid'"
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Free OSS via self-hosted Kroki. Mermaid sidecar container included."
      error_handling:
        on_kroki_down: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=d2)"
        on_syntax_error: "re-generate Mermaid code via LLM (1 retry)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=d2)"
        retry_count: 1
        retry_delay_ms: 0
      notes: >
        Self-hosted via Kroki Docker (kroki-mermaid sidecar on port 8002).
        Supports more diagram types than D2 but layout is less deterministic.
        LLMs generate Mermaid syntax well. Theme injection via %%{init}%% directive.

    # =========================================================================
    # GPTImageEngine — OpenAI GPT Image API for infographics/illustrations
    # =========================================================================
    - id: gpt_image
      name: "GPTImageEngine"
      description: "OpenAI GPT Image 1.5 API. Best text-in-image accuracy."
      category: ai_image
      capabilities:
        content_types: [concept, comparison, data]
        visual_types: [infographic, illustration]
        output_formats: [png]
        supports_theming: false
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: false
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0400
        model: gpt-image-1.5
      api_endpoint: "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations"
      api_type: rest
      timeout_ms: 30000
      fallback_engines: [ideogram, recraft]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: openai_api
        openai_api:
          url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations"
          method: POST
          auth: "Bearer ${OPENAI_API_KEY}"
          headers:
            Content-Type: "application/json"
          request_body:
            model: "gpt-image-1"
            prompt: "${spec.prompt}"
            n: 1
            size: "1536x1024"   # 16:9 closest supported
            quality: "medium"
            output_format: "png"
          response_path: "data[0].b64_json"
          response_format: png_base64
        brand_injection:
          method: prompt_suffix
          template: >
            IMPORTANT: Use ONLY these brand colors: ${palette_csv}.
            Background: ${background}. Style: ${style_preference}.
            Do NOT include text in the image unless explicitly instructed.
        size_mapping:
          "16:9": "1536x1024"
          "4:3": "1024x1024"
          "1:1": "1024x1024"
          "9:16": "1024x1536"
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [gpt_image]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'gpt_image'"
        requires_env: "OPENAI_API_KEY"
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0400
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Fixed price per generation. gpt-image-1 medium quality."
        budget_warning: "At $0.04/image, 50 images = $2.00 (deck budget cap)."
      error_handling:
        on_rate_limit: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=ideogram)"
        on_content_filter: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=ideogram)"
        on_api_error: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=ideogram)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=ideogram)"
        retry_count: 0  # fallback directly, do not retry paid APIs
        retry_delay_ms: 0
      notes: >
        Best for infographics with text. ~95% text accuracy.
        Prompt engineering critical for consistent style.
        Budget cap applies: $2.00/deck max.
        No retry on failure -- fall through to ideogram or recraft.

    # =========================================================================
    # RecraftEngine — Native SVG vector generation
    # =========================================================================
    - id: recraft
      name: "RecraftEngine"
      description: "Recraft V4 API. Only engine that generates native SVG vectors."
      category: ai_vector
      capabilities:
        content_types: [icon, concept, comparison]
        visual_types: [svg_icon, illustration, diagram]
        output_formats: [svg, png]
        supports_theming: false
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: false
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0800
        model: recraft-v4
      api_endpoint: "https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/generations"
      api_type: rest
      timeout_ms: 20000
      fallback_engines: [gpt_image, ideogram]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: recraft_api
        recraft_api:
          url: "https://external.api.recraft.ai/v1/images/generations"
          method: POST
          auth: "Bearer ${RECRAFT_API_KEY}"
          headers:
            Content-Type: "application/json"
          request_body:
            prompt: "${spec.prompt}"
            style: "digital_illustration"
            model: "recraftv3"
            response_format: "svg"
            size: "1536x1024"
          response_path: "data[0].url"
          response_format: svg_url  # download SVG from returned URL
        brand_injection:
          method: prompt_suffix
          template: >
            Use ONLY these colors: ${palette_csv}.
            Style: ${style_preference}. Flat design, clean vectors.
        size_mapping:
          "16:9": "1536x1024"
          "4:3": "1024x1024"
          "1:1": "1024x1024"
          "9:16": "1024x1536"
        key_absent_fallback:
          condition: "RECRAFT_API_KEY is not set"
          action: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
          message: "Recraft API key not configured. Falling back to GPTImageEngine."
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [recraft]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'recraft'"
        requires_env: "RECRAFT_API_KEY"
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0800
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Fixed price per generation. Recraft v3 SVG output."
        budget_warning: "At $0.08/image, 25 images = $2.00 (deck budget cap)."
      error_handling:
        on_api_error: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        on_key_absent: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        retry_count: 1
        retry_delay_ms: 2000  # Recraft rate limit: backoff
        concurrency_limit: 2   # Recraft API limited to 2 concurrent
      notes: >
        Unique SVG-native capability. Ideal for icons, logos, and
        editable diagram overlays. Higher cost justified by vector output.
        Falls back to GPTImageEngine if RECRAFT_API_KEY absent.
        Concurrency limited to 2 simultaneous calls.

    # =========================================================================
    # PlotlyEngine — Local data visualization (no API cost)
    # =========================================================================
    - id: plotly
      name: "PlotlyEngine"
      description: "Plotly charting library for data visualizations."
      category: data_viz
      capabilities:
        content_types: [data, comparison, timeline]
        visual_types: [chart, infographic]
        output_formats: [svg, png]
        supports_theming: true
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: true
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        model: free_oss
      api_endpoint: local_library
      api_type: python_library
      timeout_ms: 5000
      fallback_engines: [gpt_image]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: python_local
        python_local:
          library: plotly
          renderer: kaleido
          execution: |
            import plotly.graph_objects as go
            import plotly.io as pio
            fig = go.Figure(data=spec.data_points, layout=spec.layout)
            fig.update_layout(template="plotly_white")
            pio.write_image(fig, output_path, format="${format}", width=1920, height=1080, scale=2)
          output_formats:
            svg: "plotly.io.write_image(fig, path, format='svg')"
            png: "plotly.io.write_image(fig, path, format='png', scale=2)"
          chart_types:
            bar: "go.Bar"
            line: "go.Scatter(mode='lines')"
            pie: "go.Pie"
            scatter: "go.Scatter(mode='markers')"
            treemap: "go.Treemap"
            funnel: "go.Funnel"
            heatmap: "go.Heatmap"
        theme_injection:
          method: plotly_template
          mapping:
            "design_tokens.palette[0]": "layout.colorway[0]"
            "design_tokens.palette[1]": "layout.colorway[1]"
            "design_tokens.palette[2]": "layout.colorway[2]"
            "design_tokens.typography.heading_font": "layout.title.font.family"
            "design_tokens.typography.body_font": "layout.font.family"
            "design_tokens.background": "layout.paper_bgcolor"
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [plotly]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'plotly'"
        requires_packages: ["plotly", "kaleido"]
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0000
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Local Python library. Zero API cost."
      error_handling:
        on_missing_data: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image, message='No data_points in spec')"
        on_render_error: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        retry_count: 0
        retry_delay_ms: 0
      notes: >
        Local Python library. No API cost. Best for structured data
        visualization (bar, line, pie, scatter, treemap). Exports to
        SVG/PNG via plotly.io.write_image(). Requires kaleido for PNG export.

    # =========================================================================
    # IdeogramEngine — Typography-focused AI image generation
    # =========================================================================
    - id: ideogram
      name: "IdeogramEngine"
      description: "Ideogram v3 API. Excellent typography and style consistency."
      category: ai_image
      capabilities:
        content_types: [concept, comparison]
        visual_types: [infographic, illustration]
        output_formats: [png]
        supports_theming: false
        supports_brand_colors: true
        deterministic_layout: false
      cost_per_call:
        amount_usd: 0.0400
        model: ideogram-v3
      api_endpoint: "https://api.ideogram.ai/generate"
      api_type: rest
      timeout_ms: 25000
      fallback_engines: [gpt_image, recraft]

      # --- Story 1.1: Operational Implementation ---
      render_config:
        primary_method: ideogram_api
        ideogram_api:
          url: "https://api.ideogram.ai/generate"
          method: POST
          auth: "Api-Key ${IDEOGRAM_API_KEY}"
          headers:
            Content-Type: "application/json"
          request_body:
            image_request:
              prompt: "${spec.prompt}"
              model: "V_2"
              magic_prompt_option: "AUTO"
              aspect_ratio: "ASPECT_16_9"
              style_type: "DESIGN"
          response_path: "data[0].url"
          response_format: png_url  # download PNG from returned URL
        brand_injection:
          method: prompt_suffix
          template: >
            Color palette: ${palette_csv}. Background: ${background}.
            Visual style: ${style_preference}. Clean, professional.
        aspect_ratio_mapping:
          "16:9": "ASPECT_16_9"
          "4:3": "ASPECT_4_3"
          "1:1": "ASPECT_1_1"
          "9:16": "ASPECT_9_16"
        style_code:
          description: >
            Ideogram supports style_code for visual consistency across
            multiple generations. Pass style_code from first generation
            to subsequent ones for cross-slide visual coherence.
          usage: "response.data[0].style_code -> next request.style_code"
      supports_check:
        returns_true_for: [ideogram]
        validation: "spec.engine == 'ideogram'"
        requires_env: "IDEOGRAM_API_KEY"
      estimate_cost:
        amount_usd: 0.0400
        confidence: exact
        rationale: "Fixed price per generation. Ideogram v2 model."
      error_handling:
        on_api_error: "emit VisualError(type=engine_failure, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        on_timeout: "emit VisualError(type=timeout, fallback_suggestion=gpt_image)"
        retry_count: 0
        retry_delay_ms: 0
      notes: >
        Style code feature enables cross-slide visual consistency.
        Strong typography handling. Good fallback for text-heavy visuals
        when GPT Image is unavailable.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CONSTRAINTS (from epic non-negotiables + roundtable decisions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  constraints:
    backward_compatibility:
      rule: >
        All fields in VisualSpec that do not exist in the v1 briefing
        MUST be optional with sensible defaults. Pipeline v1 must continue
        to function without any visual_strategy fields present.
      constraint_id: 1
      source: "epic constraint #1 + architectural decision #9"

    cost_precision:
      rule: >
        estimateCost(spec) MUST return amount_usd with precision of 4
        decimal places (e.g. 0.0400, not 0.04).
      constraint_id: 2
      source: "roundtable section 2.1"

    brand_validation_order:
      rule: >
        validateBrandCompliance MUST be called internally by render()
        BEFORE emitting VisualOutput. If brand validation fails, render()
        returns VisualError with type=brand_violation.
      constraint_id: 3
      source: "roundtable section 2.1 -- observacao critica"

    fallback_suggestion_scope:
      rule: >
        VisualError.fallback_suggestion MUST be one of the engine IDs
        registered in engines_registry, or null if no fallback is viable.
        Never suggest an engine not in the registry.
      constraint_id: 4
      source: "story 0.1 implementation roadmap, passo 3"

    budget_cap:
      rule: >
        Total cost of visual generation per deck MUST NOT exceed $2.00 USD.
        visual-scout enforces this using estimateCost() before each render().
        When cap is reached, only free engines (d2, mermaid, plotly) are allowed.
      constraint_id: 5
      source: "epic architectural decision #10"

    kroki_self_hosted:
      rule: >
        D2 and Mermaid engines MUST use self-hosted Kroki instance.
        Public kroki.io is FORBIDDEN due to data security concerns
        (diagrams may contain business-sensitive information).
      constraint_id: 6
      source: "epic constraint #7 + architectural decision #8"

    feature_flag:
      rule: >
        Visual generation is gated behind ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION feature
        flag. When disabled, visual-scout skips the ai_generation tier
        entirely and falls through to degraded_placeholder.
      constraint_id: 7
      source: "epic constraint #6"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROUTING TABLE
  # Maps content_type to recommended engine, with fallback chain.
  # Used by visual-scout for engine selection.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  routing_table:
    - content_type: process
      primary_engine: mermaid
      fallback_chain: [d2]
      visual_type: flowchart
      rationale: "Mermaid has simpler syntax for flowcharts; D2 for complex layouts"

    - content_type: hierarchy
      primary_engine: d2
      fallback_chain: [mermaid]
      visual_type: diagram
      rationale: "D2 supports nested containers natively"

    - content_type: comparison
      primary_engine: recraft
      fallback_chain: [gpt_image, ideogram]
      visual_type: infographic
      rationale: "SVG editable output preferred for comparison visuals"

    - content_type: concept
      primary_engine: gpt_image
      fallback_chain: [ideogram, recraft]
      visual_type: illustration
      rationale: "Best instruction-following for abstract concepts"

    - content_type: data
      primary_engine: plotly
      fallback_chain: [gpt_image]
      visual_type: chart
      rationale: "Plotly gives deterministic data-accurate charts; AI fallback for styled infographics"

    - content_type: timeline
      primary_engine: mermaid
      fallback_chain: [d2, plotly]
      visual_type: gantt
      rationale: "Native Gantt chart support in Mermaid"

    - content_type: architecture
      primary_engine: d2
      fallback_chain: [mermaid]
      visual_type: diagram
      rationale: "D2 TALA/ELK layout is superior for architecture diagrams"

    - content_type: icon
      primary_engine: recraft
      fallback_chain: [ideogram]
      visual_type: svg_icon
      rationale: "Only engine that generates native SVG vectors"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ORCHESTRATION CONFIG (Story 1.1)
  # Global operational parameters for visual-scout engine orchestration.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  orchestration:
    feature_flag: ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION
    default_timeout_ms: 30000
    budget_cap_per_deck_usd: 2.0000
    budget_cap_per_video_usd: 5.0000
    budget_cap_monthly_usd: 100.0000
    concurrency_limit: 3          # max simultaneous API calls (Promise.allSettled)
    concurrency_overrides:
      recraft: 2                  # Recraft API rate-limited to 2 concurrent

    fallback_strategy:
      description: >
        When an engine fails, visual-scout follows the engine's fallback_engines
        list in order. If all engine fallbacks are exhausted, fall through to
        the asset-resolution.yaml chain (contextual_search -> degraded_placeholder).
      max_fallback_depth: 2       # max engines to try before giving up
      on_all_engines_exhausted: "fall_through_to_asset_resolution_chain"

    engine_selection_algorithm:
      description: >
        visual-scout selects engine using routing_table[content_type].primary_engine.
        Before invoking, it checks: (1) budget remaining via estimateCost(),
        (2) engine availability via supports(), (3) API key presence.
        If primary fails pre-checks, iterate fallback_chain in order.
      steps:
        - "1. Lookup routing_table by spec.content_type"
        - "2. Get primary_engine from route"
        - "3. Check estimateCost() <= remaining_budget"
        - "4. Check supports() returns true"
        - "5. Check required API key is present in env"
        - "6. If all pass: invoke render(spec)"
        - "7. If render fails: try next in fallback_chain"
        - "8. If fallback_chain exhausted: fall through to contextual_search"
      budget_exceeded_behavior: >
        When deck budget cap is reached, ONLY free engines are allowed
        (d2, mermaid, plotly). Paid engines (gpt_image, recraft, ideogram)
        are skipped with VisualError(type=engine_failure, message="budget exceeded").

    cache_integration:
      description: >
        Before invoking any engine, visual-scout checks cache (Story 1.6).
        Cache key = SHA256(engine_id + diagram_code|prompt + design_tokens_hash).
        If cache hit: return cached VisualOutput with cache_hit=true.
      cache_directory: "${SLIDES_CACHE_DIR:-cache/slides-v2}"
      cache_levels:
        L1: "diagrams/ — exact diagram code match (TTL: indefinite)"
        L2: "images/ — exact prompt+engine match (TTL: 30 days)"
        L3: "templates/ — reusable visual patterns (TTL: indefinite)"
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/visual-generation-report.yaml

```yaml
# Visual Generation Report Schema
# SSOT for the output report emitted by visual-scout after orchestrating visual generation.
# Consumed by: slide-chief (pipeline reporting), qa-inspector (quality gate),
#               design-renderer (asset routing), cost-tracking (budget reconciliation).
# Created by: Story 2.2 (EPIC-SC-V2-001, Sprint 2)
# Dependencies:
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml (Story 1.1 -- engine registry)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/semantic-classification.yaml (Story 2.1 -- content_types)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/asset-resolution.yaml (Story 1.3 -- asset_ref schema)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml (Story 1.6 -- cache stats)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/cost-tracking.yaml (Story 1.4 -- cost log)
#   - squads/slides-creator/data/token-transformer.yaml (Story 1.2 -- brand validation)

visual_generation_report:
  version: "1.0.0"
  created_at: "2026-03-20"
  epic: EPIC-SC-V2-001
  story: "2.2"
  output_file: "visual-generation-report.json"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # REPORT SCHEMA
  # Emitted by visual-scout after visual generation orchestration completes.
  # One report per deck generation run.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  schema:
    deck_id:
      type: string
      required: true
      description: "Deck identifier from deck-manifest.json."

    generation_run_id:
      type: string
      format: uuid_v4
      required: true
      description: "Unique identifier for this generation run."

    timestamp:
      type: string
      format: iso_8601
      required: true
      description: "When the generation run completed."

    feature_flag:
      type: string
      value: "ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION"
      required: true
      description: "Feature flag that was active during this run."

    # --- Per-Slide Results ---
    slides:
      type: array
      required: true
      description: "One entry per slide in the deck."
      items:
        slide_id:
          type: string
          required: true
          description: "Slide identifier (e.g., slide-01)."

        status:
          type: string
          enum: [generated, fallback_to_search, skipped]
          required: true
          description: >
            generated: visual was successfully created by an engine.
            fallback_to_search: all engines failed or were skipped, fell through
            to contextual_search in asset-resolution chain.
            skipped: slide has engine=none or visual_strategy absent (text-only).

        engine_used:
          type: string
          enum: [d2, mermaid, gpt_image, recraft, plotly, ideogram, null]
          required: true
          description: "Engine that produced the final visual, or null if skipped/fallback."

        engine_category:
          type: string
          enum: [diagram, ai_image, ai_vector, data_viz, null]
          required: false
          description: "Category of the engine used (from engines_registry)."

        content_type:
          type: string
          enum: [process, hierarchy, comparison, cycle, data, concept, cause_effect, timeline, system, definition, quote, demo, null]
          required: true
          description: "Content type from visual_strategy (Story 2.1 classification)."

        visual_type:
          type: string
          enum: [flowchart, tree, table, venn, cycle_chart, bar_chart, metaphor, timeline, architecture, icon_card, infographic, none, null]
          required: true
          description: "Visual type from visual_strategy."

        cost_usd:
          type: number
          precision: 4
          required: true
          description: "Cost incurred for this slide's visual generation. 0.0000 for free engines or cache hits."

        cache_hit:
          type: boolean
          required: true
          description: "True if the visual was served from cache (no API call)."

        cache_key:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: "SHA-256 cache key if generated or cache hit. Null if skipped."

        generation_time_ms:
          type: number
          required: true
          description: "Wall-clock time for this slide's visual generation in milliseconds. 0 if skipped."

        output_format:
          type: string
          enum: [svg, png, null]
          required: true
          description: "Format of the generated visual output."

        output_path:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: "Filesystem path to the generated asset. Null if skipped."

        brand_compliance:
          type: object
          required: false
          description: "Brand validation result from Brand Validator (token-transformer.yaml)."
          properties:
            compliant:
              type: boolean
              description: "True if all colors pass delta-E thresholds."
            violations_count:
              type: number
              description: "Number of brand violations detected."
            wcag_aa_pass:
              type: boolean
              description: "True if text-background contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA."
            colors_substituted:
              type: number
              description: "Number of out-of-palette colors substituted (diagram engines only)."
            max_delta_e:
              type: number
              description: "Maximum delta-E value found between output colors and palette."

        alt_text:
          type: string
          required: false
          description: >
            LLM-generated alt text for accessibility. Describes the visual content
            for screen readers. Null if skipped.

        svg_to_png_converted:
          type: boolean
          required: false
          description: "True if SVG was converted to PNG via cairosvg (DPI 300)."

        fallback_chain:
          type: array
          required: false
          description: "Engines attempted before success or fallback_to_search."
          items:
            engine_id:
              type: string
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [success, failed, skipped_budget, skipped_unavailable]
            error_type:
              type: string
              required: false
              enum: [engine_failure, brand_violation, timeout, budget_exceeded, null]
            error_message:
              type: string
              required: false

        retry_count:
          type: number
          required: true
          description: "Total retry attempts across all engines for this slide."

    # --- Summary Metrics ---
    summary:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Aggregated metrics for the entire generation run."
      properties:
        total_slides:
          type: number
          description: "Total number of slides in the deck."

        generated:
          type: number
          description: "Number of slides with status=generated."

        fallback_to_search:
          type: number
          description: "Number of slides with status=fallback_to_search."

        skipped:
          type: number
          description: "Number of slides with status=skipped (engine=none)."

        generation_rate_pct:
          type: number
          description: "Percentage of non-skipped slides that were generated: (generated / (total - skipped)) * 100."

        total_cost_usd:
          type: number
          precision: 4
          description: "Total cost across all slides."

        budget_remaining_usd:
          type: number
          precision: 4
          description: "Remaining deck budget after this run."

        cache_hits:
          type: number
          description: "Total slides served from cache."

        cache_hit_rate_pct:
          type: number
          description: "Cache hit rate: (cache_hits / generated) * 100."

        total_generation_time_ms:
          type: number
          description: "Total wall-clock time for all generations."

        avg_generation_time_ms:
          type: number
          description: "Average generation time per generated slide."

        engines_used:
          type: object
          description: "Count of slides per engine."
          properties:
            d2: { type: number }
            mermaid: { type: number }
            gpt_image: { type: number }
            recraft: { type: number }
            plotly: { type: number }
            ideogram: { type: number }

        brand_compliance_rate_pct:
          type: number
          description: "Percentage of generated slides that passed brand validation."

        alt_text_coverage_pct:
          type: number
          description: "Percentage of generated slides with alt text."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # STATUS DEFINITIONS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  status_definitions:
    generated:
      meaning: >
        Visual was successfully created by a VisualEngine. Asset is ready for
        design-renderer consumption. Includes brand validation result.
      valid_engines: [d2, mermaid, gpt_image, recraft, plotly, ideogram]

    fallback_to_search:
      meaning: >
        All engines in the fallback chain failed or were skipped (budget, unavailable).
        Visual-scout falls through to contextual_search in the asset-resolution chain.
        This is NOT a failure -- it means the search-based pipeline handles this slide.
      causes:
        - "All engines failed with VisualError"
        - "Budget cap reached and only paid engines are viable"
        - "API keys missing for required engines"
        - "Circuit breaker tripped on all fallback engines"

    skipped:
      meaning: >
        Slide does not require visual generation. Either engine=none in visual_strategy,
        or visual_strategy is absent (v1 manifest without classification).
      causes:
        - "content_type: definition, quote, demo"
        - "TITLE or CLOSING slide"
        - "visual_strategy not present (v1 backward compat)"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GENERATION ORCHESTRATION FLOW (consumed by visual-scout)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  orchestration_flow:
    description: >
      Step-by-step flow that visual-scout follows to orchestrate visual generation
      for all slides in a deck. This is the core implementation logic for Story 2.2.

    pre_conditions:
      - "deck-manifest.json loaded with visual_strategy per slide (Story 2.1)"
      - "ENABLE_VISUAL_GENERATION feature flag is true"
      - "Design tokens loaded for the brand (Token Transformer, Story 1.2)"
      - "Cost tracker initialized with deck budget (Story 1.4)"
      - "Cache config loaded (Story 1.6)"

    steps:
      - step: 1
        name: classify_slides
        description: >
          Read visual_strategy from each slide in deck-manifest.json.
          Partition slides into three groups:
          - generate_group: slides with engine != none (need visual generation)
          - skip_group: slides with engine == none (text-only, skip generation)
          - unclassified_group: slides without visual_strategy (v1 backward compat, skip)
        output: "Three arrays: generate_group, skip_group, unclassified_group"

      - step: 2
        name: batch_generation
        description: >
          Process generate_group slides in parallel batches.
          Concurrency limit: 3 simultaneous engine calls (Promise.allSettled).
          Recraft calls throttled to 2 concurrent within any batch.
          Each slide follows the per-slide generation flow (step 3).
        concurrency:
          global_limit: 3
          recraft_limit: 2
          batch_method: "Promise.allSettled()"
          error_handling: >
            Promise.allSettled ensures all slides are attempted even if some fail.
            Failed slides get status=fallback_to_search, not an error that stops the batch.

      - step: 3
        name: per_slide_generation
        description: >
          For each slide in generate_group, execute the generate branch from
          asset-resolution.yaml -> generate_operational_flow:
        sub_steps:
          - "3a: Cache lookup (cache-config.yaml). On hit: return cached output, skip render."
          - "3b: Budget pre-check (cost-tracking.yaml). If estimate > remaining: skip paid engines."
          - "3c: Engine selection (visual-engines.yaml routing_table). Get primary engine."
          - "3d: Token transform (token-transformer.yaml). Convert design tokens to engine format."
          - "3e: Content generation (see step 4 below). Generate diagram code OR image prompt."
          - "3f: Render (engine.render(spec)). Invoke the selected engine."
          - "3g: Brand validation (token-transformer.yaml brand_validator). Check compliance."
          - "3h: SVG-to-PNG conversion if needed (cairosvg, DPI 300)."
          - "3i: Alt text generation (LLM call). Generate accessibility description."
          - "3j: Cache write (cache-config.yaml). Store output for future reuse."
          - "3k: Cost logging (cost-tracking.yaml). Record actual cost."
          - "3l: Emit slide result to report."

      - step: 4
        name: content_generation_by_engine_type
        description: >
          How the LLM generates content depends on the engine type:

        diagram_engines:
          engines: [d2, mermaid]
          flow: >
            1. LLM receives slide content (headline, bullets, narrative_purpose) +
               content_type + visual_type.
            2. LLM generates diagram source code in the engine's syntax
               (D2 syntax for d2, Mermaid syntax for mermaid).
            3. Token Transformer injects brand theme into the code
               (D2: theme-overrides vars block, Mermaid: %%{init}%% directive).
            4. Code is sent to engine.render() (Kroki API or CLI).
            5. On syntax error: LLM re-generates code (1 retry).
          llm_prompt_template: |
            Generate a {visual_type} diagram in {engine} syntax based on this slide content:

            Headline: {headline}
            Bullets: {bullets}
            Content Type: {content_type}
            Purpose: {narrative_purpose}

            RULES:
            - Use clear, concise labels (max 4 words per node)
            - Limit to {max_elements} elements for readability
            - Include directional flow where applicable
            - Do NOT include styling/theming (it will be injected separately)
            - Output ONLY the diagram code, no explanation

        ai_image_engines:
          engines: [gpt_image, recraft, ideogram]
          flow: >
            1. LLM receives slide content + content_type + visual_type +
               brand_constraints (palette, style_preference, background).
            2. LLM generates an image generation prompt optimized for the target engine.
            3. Token Transformer appends brand constraint suffix to the prompt.
            4. Prompt is sent to engine.render() (API call).
            5. On content filter or failure: try fallback engine.
          llm_prompt_template: |
            Generate an image generation prompt for {engine} based on this slide content:

            Headline: {headline}
            Content Type: {content_type}
            Visual Type: {visual_type}
            Purpose: {narrative_purpose}
            Style: {style_preference}
            Aspect Ratio: {aspect_ratio}

            RULES:
            - Describe the visual concept, not the text content
            - Focus on metaphor, composition, and visual storytelling
            - Do NOT include specific text to render in the image
            - Keep prompt under 200 words
            - Specify: flat illustration, clean lines, professional
            - Output ONLY the image prompt, no explanation

        data_chart_engine:
          engines: [plotly]
          flow: >
            1. Read data_points from slide content payload.
            2. Determine chart_type from visual_type mapping:
               bar_chart -> go.Bar, line -> go.Scatter, pie -> go.Pie.
            3. Token Transformer provides Plotly layout template with brand colors.
            4. Construct Plotly figure specification (data + layout).
            5. Engine.render() executes locally (no API call, zero cost).
          data_extraction: >
            data_points are extracted from slide content. Expected format:
            [{label: string, value: number, ...}]. If data_points are absent
            but content has metrics/numbers, LLM extracts structured data first.

      - step: 5
        name: alt_text_generation
        description: >
          After visual generation, LLM generates alt text for accessibility.
          Single batched LLM call for all generated slides (cost-efficient).
        llm_prompt_template: |
          Generate concise alt text for each visual below. Alt text should:
          - Describe WHAT the visual shows (not how it looks)
          - Be 1-2 sentences, under 125 characters
          - Include key data points for charts
          - Describe flow direction for diagrams
          - Not start with "Image of" or "Picture of"

          Visuals:
          {{visuals_json}}

          Return JSON array: [{"slide_id": "...", "alt_text": "..."}]

      - step: 6
        name: svg_to_png_conversion
        description: >
          For slides that need PNG output but received SVG from diagram engines,
          convert using cairosvg at DPI 300.
        trigger: "output_format == svg AND downstream requires png"
        command: >
          python3 -c "import cairosvg; cairosvg.svg2png(
            url='${svg_path}', write_to='${png_path}', dpi=300
          )"
        quality_rules:
          - "DPI must be 300 (presentation-quality)"
          - "Width must be >= 1920px for full-bleed slides"
          - "No anti-aliasing artifacts on text"

      - step: 7
        name: emit_report
        description: >
          Compile all slide results into visual-generation-report.json.
          Calculate summary metrics. Write to output directory.
        output: "visual-generation-report.json"

    post_conditions:
      - "visual-generation-report.json exists with all slides accounted for"
      - "Every generated slide has brand_compliance populated"
      - "Every generated slide has alt_text populated"
      - "Cost log updated with all API calls (cost-tracking.yaml)"
      - "Cache updated with all new generations (cache-config.yaml)"
      - "Cache stats updated with hits/misses"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FALLBACK BEHAVIOR
  # When generation fails for a slide, what happens
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fallback_behavior:
    description: >
      When a slide's primary engine fails, visual-scout follows the engine's
      fallback_engines list (from visual-engines.yaml). If all engine fallbacks
      are exhausted, the slide falls through to contextual_search in the
      asset-resolution chain.

    fallback_chain_per_engine:
      d2: [mermaid]
      mermaid: [d2]
      gpt_image: [ideogram, recraft]
      recraft: [gpt_image, ideogram]
      plotly: [gpt_image]
      ideogram: [gpt_image, recraft]

    max_fallback_depth: 2
    after_exhaustion: >
      Set slide status to fallback_to_search. The slide enters the
      contextual_search step of asset-resolution.yaml. If search also fails,
      the slide gets a degraded_placeholder.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CROSS REFERENCES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_references:
    semantic_classification:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/semantic-classification.yaml"
      provides: "content_type and visual_type per slide (input to orchestration)"
      story: "2.1"

    visual_engines:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/visual-engines.yaml"
      provides: "engines_registry, routing_table, orchestration config"
      story: "1.1"

    asset_resolution:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/asset-resolution.yaml"
      provides: "generate_operational_flow, fallback chain"
      story: "1.3"

    cache_config:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cache-config.yaml"
      provides: "cache lookup/write algorithms, L1/L2 levels"
      story: "1.6"

    token_transformer:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/token-transformer.yaml"
      provides: "converters (D2, Mermaid, AI, Plotly), brand_validator"
      story: "1.2"

    cost_tracking:
      file: "squads/slides-creator/data/cost-tracking.yaml"
      provides: "budget_caps, pre_call_check, cost_log, circuit_breaker"
      story: "1.4"
```


## Referência: references/squad/docs/mckinsey-architect-mental-model.md

# GPT McKinsey PPT Architect Elite

## 🎯 MISSÃO

Este é o agente de planejamento de apresentações executivas mais sofisticado do mundo. Cada entrega representa o padrão de excelência de $2 milhões de dólares em projetos de consultoria estratégica global.

**Padrão de Qualidade:** Indistinguível de McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte Monitor.

---

## 📋 O QUE ESTE AGENTE FAZ

### Input
- Documentos (PDF, Word, Excel, pesquisas, dados brutos)
- Contexto (audiência, objetivo, restrições)
- Idioma desejado (padrão: Português BR)

### Output
Especificação ULTRA DETALHADA de apresentação executiva:
- **Cada slide** com 2000+ palavras de especificação
- **Posicionamento pixel-perfect** (grid 12×8)
- **Cores exatas** (HEX codes)
- **Tipografia completa** (família, tamanho, peso, cor)
- **Fontes rastreáveis** (URLs, datas de acesso)
- **Prompts completos de IA** para imagens
- **Enumeração universal** (todos gráficos, tabelas, imagens)

**Para apresentação de 50 slides:** ~100.000 palavras de documentação

---

## 🏗️ ESTRUTURA DO AGENTE

### Arquivos Principais

```
gpt-mckinsey-ppt-architect/
├── instructions.md (15.000 palavras)
│   ├── 6 Fases de Workflow
│   ├── 7 Princípios Invioláveis
│   └── Troubleshooting completo
│
├── knowledge_bases/
│   ├── KB_01_storytelling_frameworks.md (6000 palavras)
│   │   └── Pyramid Principle, SCQA, MECE, Action Titles
│   ├── KB_02_frameworks_mckinsey.md
│   │   └── 7S, 3 Horizons, Growth-Share Matrix
│   ├── KB_06_data_visualization_complete.md
│   │   └── Chart selection matrix, 15+ tipos de gráficos
│   ├── KB_07_design_fundamentals.md
│   │   └── Color theory, Typography, Grid systems
│   ├── KB_08_ai_generation_master.md (7500 palavras)
│   │   └── Prompt engineering elite para imagens
│   └── KB_09-15_industries_consolidated.md
│       └── 7 indústrias (Finance, Tech, Healthcare, etc.)
│
└── examples/
    └── example_complete_slide_specification.md
        └── Demonstração de especificação completa
```

---

## ⚡ PRINCÍPIOS FUNDAMENTAIS

### 1. FIDELIDADE ABSOLUTA AOS DADOS
- ❌ NUNCA modificar números
- ❌ NUNCA inferir dados não fornecidos
- ✅ SEMPRE usar dados exatamente como recebidos

### 2. ESPECIFICAÇÃO OBSESSIVA
- Cada elemento com posição (cm ou grid)
- Cores com HEX exato (#003B5C)
- Fontes completas (família, tamanho, peso)

### 3. PYRAMID PRINCIPLE É LEI
- Conclusão primeiro (títulos são insights)
- Argumentos agrupados (MECE)
- Evidências na base

### 4. ACTION TITLES OBRIGATÓRIOS
- ❌ "Análise de mercado"
- ✅ "Mercado crescerá 45% ao ano, superando média global"

### 5. ENUMERAÇÃO UNIVERSAL
- TODO gráfico: "Gráfico X"
- TODA tabela: "Tabela Y"
- TODA imagem: "Imagem Z"

### 6. CITAÇÃO COMPLETA
- Organização + Título + Data + URL + Data de acesso
- Análises próprias explicitamente rotuladas

### 7. PROMPTS COMPLETOS DE IA
- 10 componentes obrigatórios
- HEX codes nas cores
- Parâmetros técnicos completos

---

## 📚 KNOWLEDGE BASES - QUANDO USAR

### Narrativa (SEMPRE)
**KB_01 - Storytelling Frameworks**
- Pyramid Principle
- SCQA Framework
- Action Titles
- MECE

### Frameworks Estratégicos
**KB_02 - McKinsey** (7S, 3 Horizons)
**KB_03 - BCG** (Growth-Share Matrix)
**KB_04 - Bain** (Results Delivery)

### Design e Visualização
**KB_06 - Data Visualization** (qual gráfico usar)
**KB_07 - Design Fundamentals** (cores, tipografia, grid)
**KB_08 - AI Generation** (prompts de imagens)

### Indústrias
**KB_09-15 - Industries** (KPIs e frameworks por setor)

## 🔥 DIFERENCIAIS ÚNICOS

### 1. Prompts de IA Elite
Cada imagem com prompt de 500+ palavras incluindo:
- Estilo visual específico
- Composição detalhada (ângulo, framing)
- Iluminação (natural/artificial, direção)
- **Paleta exata com HEX codes**
- Mood e atmosfera
- Parâmetros técnicos (Midjourney/DALL-E/SD)
- Negative prompts robustos

**Exemplo:**
```
Isometric 3D illustration of business growth, ascending glass staircase
(5 steps, each 1m × 1m), data points floating (23%, 45%, 67%, 89%),
abstract figure climbing (1.8m tall, #003B5C navy blue), geometric
shapes surrounding (#00A86B green 40% opacity), gradient background
(#FFFFFF to #F8F8F8), drop shadows 20% opacity 15px blur, ultra-modern
corporate aesthetic, --ar 16:9 --stylize 300 --no text, faces --v 6.0
```

### 2. Enumeração Automática
Todo elemento visual recebe ID único:
- Gráfico 7
- Tabela 7.1
- Imagem 7.2

### 3. Fontes Rastreáveis
Formato APA completo:
```
Fonte: IDC Brasil. "Mercado de IA 2024-2027". Março 2024.
https://idc.com/br/reports/ai-market. Acesso em: 10 dez 2024.
```

### 4. Grid System Preciso
- 12 colunas × 8 linhas
- Posicionamento: "Colunas 2-9, Linhas 3-6"
- Dimensões: "14cm × 8cm"

## 📖 WORKFLOW DE USO

### Fase 1: Análise (20%)
1. Ler material completo
2. Identificar mensagem principal
3. Catalogar dados
4. Mapear argumentos

### Fase 2: Estruturação (15%)
1. Aplicar Pyramid Principle
2. Mapear SCQA
3. Definir sequência de slides
4. Validar MECE

### Fase 3: Design (30%)
1. Classificar tipo de cada slide
2. Definir layouts
3. Selecionar elementos visuais
4. Estabelecer hierarquia

### Fase 4: Especificação (30%)
1. Detalhar CADA slide (2000 palavras cada)
2. Incluir todos os 10 componentes
3. Prompts de IA completos
4. Fontes rastreáveis

### Fase 5: QA (4%)
1. Checklist macro (narrativa, MECE, flow)
2. Checklist micro (por slide)
3. Teste de 2 minutos (títulos contam história)

### Fase 6: Documentação (1%)
1. Arquivo principal de especificações
2. Design system
3. Bibliografia
4. AI prompts library
