```yaml
# Templates Index — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (DEV-2026-003 pilot)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Navigable catalog of all templates. Inspired by:
#   - ppt-master/templates/layouts/layouts_index.json (21 templates indexed)
#   - ppt-master/templates/charts/charts_index.json (71 charts contrastive summaries)
#   - Presenton presentation-templates/{family}/settings.json
#
# Pilot scope: 2 decks + 3 slide functions + 1 theme. Full catalog em
# MSN-2026-SLIDES-TEMPLATES-ARCHITECTURE (Mission separada, backlog).

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  total_decks: 2
  total_slide_functions: 3
  total_themes: 1
  total_visuals: 0  # pending Mission separada
  status: pilot
  pilot_mission: "MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  next_iteration_mission: "MSN-2026-SLIDES-TEMPLATES-ARCHITECTURE (proposta, nao iniciada)"

schemas:
  - id: deck-template
    path: templates/schemas/deck-template.schema.yaml
    purpose: "Contract for deck-level templates (roteiros)"
  - id: slide-template
    path: templates/schemas/slide-template.schema.yaml
    purpose: "Contract for slide-function templates"
  - id: visual-template
    path: templates/schemas/visual-template.schema.yaml
    purpose: "Contract for charts/diagrams/infographics (visual taxonomy)"

deck_templates:
  - id: webinar-sales-perfect-webinar
    path: templates/deck/webinar-sales-perfect-webinar.yaml
    family: webinar
    pick_for: "Webinar de vendas 60-90min, cold lead, oferta R$ 500-5000"
    skip_if: "Tempo <45min OR audiencia quente OR ticket >R$ 5000"
    slide_count_target: 16
    default_theme: editorial-pentagram

  - id: executive-pitch
    path: templates/deck/executive-pitch.yaml
    family: pitch
    pick_for: "Pitch executivo 15-30min, C-level/board, decisao especifica"
    skip_if: "Audiencia frio OR tempo >45min OR decisao binaria simples"
    slide_count_target: 10
    default_theme: editorial-pentagram

slide_function_templates:
  - id: hook-opening
    path: templates/slide/hook-opening.yaml
    function: cover
    alternative_functions: [reframe, tension_amplify]
    pick_for: "Slide de abertura ou charneira que ancora UMA promessa"
    skip_if: "Slide intermediario"
    density_target: minimal

  - id: proof-stack
    path: templates/slide/proof-stack.yaml
    function: proof
    alternative_functions: [mechanism_step, contrast, synthesis]
    pick_for: "2-4 evidencias quantitativas sustentando mesma tese"
    skip_if: "Evidencia qualitativa (quote) OR 5+ evidencias (split)"
    density_target: medium

  - id: cta-concrete
    path: templates/slide/cta-concrete.yaml
    function: cta_concrete
    alternative_functions: [close, artifact_reveal, synthesis]
    pick_for: "Fechamento com UMA decisao binaria + 3 razoes para agir agora"
    skip_if: "Deck informativo OR multi-opcao OR CTA assincrono"
    density_target: minimal

themes:
  - id: editorial-pentagram
    path: templates/theme/editorial-pentagram.yaml
    motif: "Bloco de cor solido cobrindo 30-50% do canvas"
    mode: light
    primary: "#3DC02E"
    compatible_with_deck_templates: [webinar-sales-perfect-webinar, executive-pitch, tactical-masterclass, educational-workshop, board-update]

visual_templates: []  # populated em Mission separada

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SELECTION GUIDANCE (for select-deck-template / select-slide-template tasks)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
selection_guidance:
  deck_template_selection:
    instruction: |
      Para escolher deck_template:
      1. Resolva briefing.audience.primary + delivery_mode + attention_budget
      2. Filtre deck_templates compativeis em audience_fit
      3. Aplique pick_for / skip_if contra contexto especifico
      4. Se 2+ candidatos, prefira o que tem qa_emphasis alinhado com narrative goal
      5. Emit selected_template_reason: {function_match, fit_rationale, alternative_considered}

  slide_template_selection:
    instruction: |
      Para cada entry em slide-function-map.yaml:
      1. Filtre slide_function_templates onde function == entry.function OR function in alternative_functions
      2. Cruze density_target: prefer template cujo density_target == entry.density_target
      3. Cruze deck_template.qa_emphasis para escolher template com qa_gates_emphasis alinhado
      4. Verifique compatible_with.deck_templates inclui o deck atual
      5. Emit selected_template_reason

  fallback:
    instruction: |
      Se nenhum slide_function_template encontrar match exato:
      1. Use slide_function_template generico (cria 'default-content.yaml' em Mission futura)
      2. Por enquanto: emitir warning e usar slot-based composition sem template binding
      3. Log em planning-reflection.jsonl como entry_type='evidence_gap', dimension='slide_function_map'

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PROVENANCE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
provenance:
  inspired_by_benches:
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/ (template-as-contract pattern + charts_index.json)"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/presenton/ (Zod schema per layout + family settings)"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/PPTAgent/ (layout_selector with reasoning JSON)"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/presentation-ai/ (ThemeProperties separation visual/structure)"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/slide-deck-ai/ (minimal structural markers)"
  analysis_doc: "docs/bench/slides-creator-templates-architecture/00-cross-bench-synthesis.md"
  mission: "MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  deviation: "DEV-2026-003 (scope expansion approved by Mission Lead via 'ok')"
```

      "type": "object",

## Referência: references/squad/templates/schemas/deck-template.schema.yaml

```yaml
# Deck Template Schema — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (DEV-2026-003, scope expansion)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Contract for deck-level templates ("roteiros"). A deck template defines
# the NARRATIVE ARC + SUGGESTED SLIDE FUNCTIONS + DEFAULT THEME + EXECUTION CONSTRAINTS
# for a class of presentations (e.g., webinar-sales, executive-pitch, board-update).
#
# Inspired by:
#   - ppt-master/skills/ppt-master/templates/layouts/{family}/design_spec.md (11-section contract)
#   - ppt-master charts_index.json (Pick for / Skip if pattern)
#   - PPTAgent roles/planner.yaml (purpose + topic + indexes)
#   - Presenton presentation-templates/{family}/settings.json (per-family settings)

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  schema_kind: "deck-template"
  consumer_tasks:
    - "tasks/compress-outline-to-slide-functions.md (uses deck-template to derive story_arc baseline)"
    - "tasks/select-deck-template.md (NEW — to be created in MSN-2026-SLIDES-TEMPLATES-ARCHITECTURE)"
    - "tasks/define-design-direction.md (consumes default_theme + composition_overrides)"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DECK TEMPLATE SCHEMA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
deck_template:
  required: [id, name, summary, audience_fit, arc, slide_functions_recommended, default_theme]
  fields:

    id:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+[a-z0-9]$"
      example: "webinar-sales-perfect-webinar"
      description: "kebab-case unique id. Must match filename (without .yaml)."

    name:
      type: string
      max_length: 60
      example: "Perfect Webinar (Russell Brunson)"

    version:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
      default: "1.0.0"

    family:
      type: enum
      values: [webinar, pitch, board_update, financial, demo, masterclass, proposal, sales_call, research, benchmark, vsl, workshop]
      description: "Broad category for navigation"

    summary:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        pick_for:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          description: "When to choose this deck template. Concrete situations."
          example: "Webinar de vendas com 60-90min, audiencia frio-morno, oferta de R$ 500-5000, objetivo: conversao direta para checkout."
        skip_if:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          description: "When NOT to choose. Alternative deck templates."
          example: "Tempo < 30min (use executive-pitch). Audiencia quente ja convertida (use sales-call-live-close). Ticket > R$ 5000 com ciclo de venda longo (use proposal-sow)."
      pattern_inspired_by: "ppt-master charts_index.json contrastive summaries"

    audience_fit:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        primary:
          type: enum
          values: [cold_lead, warm_lead, hot_lead, prospect, customer, executive, board, investor, peer, student, mass_audience]
        size_range:
          type: enum
          values: [1_to_5, 5_to_20, 20_to_200, 200_to_2000, 2000_plus]
        delivery_modes:
          type: list
          item_enum: [in_person, webinar_live, webinar_replay, async_video, async_pdf, async_email, mobile_share]
        attention_budget_min:
          type: integer
          minimum: 5
          maximum: 240

    arc:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Narrative arc baseline per data/story-arc.schema.yaml"
      fields:
        arc_type:
          type: enum
          values: [educational_workshop, executive_pitch, sales_narrative, thought_leadership, product_demo, board_update, case_study]
        beats:
          type: list
          min_items: 4
          max_items: 8
          item_schema:
            beat_type: "enum (matches story-arc.schema.yaml beat_types)"
            narrative_function: "string"
            slides_estimated: "integer 1-3"
            optional: "boolean — true if this beat can be cut to fit appetite"

    slide_functions_recommended:
      type: list
      min_items: 4
      description: "Ordered list of slide functions per beat. Maps to slide templates in slide/ dir."
      item_schema:
        sequence: "integer (s01, s02, ...)"
        beat_ref: "string (B-NN)"
        function:
          enum_ref: "data/slide-function-map.schema.yaml#slide_function_map.entries[].function"
        suggested_slide_template:
          type: string
          description: "Reference to slide/{function}.yaml. Hint, not hard binding."
        density_target:
          enum: [minimal, low, medium, high]
        optional:
          type: boolean
          default: false

    slide_count_range:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        min: integer
        max: integer
        target: integer
        rationale:
          type: string
          example: "Webinar de 60-90min comporta 12-18 slides com 4-6min por slide em media."

    default_theme:
      type: string
      description: "Reference to templates/theme/{theme}.yaml. Can be overridden in design-direction."
      example: "editorial-pentagram"

    composition_overrides:
      type: object
      required: false
      description: "Optional overrides over default theme composition_rules"
      fields:
        grid_columns: "integer"
        baseline_padding_pt: "integer"
        title_anchor: "enum"
        footer_present: "boolean"
        slide_number_visible: "boolean"

    density_limits_overrides:
      type: object
      required: false
      description: "Optional density override for this deck class (sales decks may allow higher density on financial slides, e.g.)"

    qa_emphasis:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Per qa-rubric.yaml — which dimensions matter MOST for this deck class. Used by qa-inspector to weight findings."
      fields:
        narrativa_weight_boost: "number 0-1 (additive to default 25)"
        design_weight_boost: "number 0-1"
        acuracia_weight_boost: "number 0-1"
        rationale: "string"
      example:
        narrativa_weight_boost: 0.0
        design_weight_boost: 0.0
        acuracia_weight_boost: 0.5  # sales decks need extra source rigor
        rationale: "Sales deck: claim accuracy more important than usual (compliance risk)."

    visual_density_default:
      type: enum
      values: [sparse, moderate, dense]
      default: moderate

    failure_modes:
      type: list
      description: "Known anti-patterns specific to this deck class"
      item_schema:
        mode: string
        symptom: string
        prevention: string

    speaker_role:
      type: enum
      values: [solo_presenter, panelist, narrator_voiceover, async_no_speaker]
      default: solo_presenter

    compatible_outputs:
      type: list
      item_enum: [tsx_consumer_app, html_standalone, pptx_native, pdf, mp4, web_share_link]
      description: "Which output formats this deck template renders cleanly to"

    source_provenance:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        inspired_by:
          type: list
          item_type: string
          description: "Methodology, author, framework, prior deck"
          example: ["Russell Brunson - Perfect Webinar", "DotCom Secrets - The Big Domino"]
        bench_ref:
          type: list
          item_type: string
          description: "Bench repo paths if pattern absorbed"
          example: ["/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/examples/ppt169_kimsoong_loyalty_programme/"]
        author:
          type: string
          example: "slides-creator squad — MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
        date_created: "YYYY-MM-DD"

    evidence_ref:
      type: ["string", "null"]
      description: "Path to evidence.yaml with extended rationale, sources, risks. Keeps deck template itself short."

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION RULES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation_rules:
  - rule: "id matches filename (without .yaml)"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "summary.pick_for AND summary.skip_if both non-empty"
    severity: blocking
    rationale: "Contrastive summary is non-negotiable (ppt-master pattern)"
  - rule: "arc.beats >= 4 AND <= 8"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "slide_functions_recommended >= 4"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "default_theme references existing theme/{theme}.yaml"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "source_provenance.inspired_by non-empty (always declare provenance)"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "summary.skip_if mentions at least 1 alternative deck template"
    severity: high
    rationale: "Helps strategist navigate catalog"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE (minimal valid stub — see deck/webinar-sales-perfect-webinar.yaml for full)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
example_minimal:
  id: "stub-example"
  name: "Stub Example"
  family: pitch
  summary:
    pick_for: "Use when you need a minimal example for validating the schema."
    skip_if: "For real decks, use webinar-sales-perfect-webinar OR executive-pitch."
  audience_fit:
    primary: prospect
    size_range: 5_to_20
    delivery_modes: [in_person]
    attention_budget_min: 30
  arc:
    arc_type: executive_pitch
    beats:
      - beat_type: hook
        narrative_function: "Hook the audience"
        slides_estimated: 1
        optional: false
      - beat_type: proof
        narrative_function: "Demonstrate evidence"
        slides_estimated: 2
        optional: false
      - beat_type: mechanism
        narrative_function: "Explain how"
        slides_estimated: 2
        optional: false
      - beat_type: cta
        narrative_function: "Ask for next step"
        slides_estimated: 1
        optional: false
  slide_functions_recommended:
    - {sequence: 1, beat_ref: B-01, function: cover, suggested_slide_template: "hook-opening", density_target: minimal}
    - {sequence: 2, beat_ref: B-02, function: proof, suggested_slide_template: "proof-stack", density_target: medium}
    - {sequence: 3, beat_ref: B-02, function: proof, suggested_slide_template: "proof-stack", density_target: medium}
    - {sequence: 4, beat_ref: B-03, function: mechanism_step, suggested_slide_template: "mechanism-step", density_target: medium}
    - {sequence: 5, beat_ref: B-03, function: mechanism_step, suggested_slide_template: "mechanism-step", density_target: medium}
    - {sequence: 6, beat_ref: B-04, function: cta_concrete, suggested_slide_template: "cta-concrete", density_target: minimal}
  slide_count_range: {min: 5, max: 8, target: 6, rationale: "Stub example."}
  default_theme: "editorial-pentagram"
  qa_emphasis: {narrativa_weight_boost: 0, design_weight_boost: 0, acuracia_weight_boost: 0, rationale: "Default weights."}
  source_provenance:
    inspired_by: ["schema validation"]
    bench_ref: []
    author: "slides-creator squad"
    date_created: "2026-05-17"
```


## Referência: references/squad/templates/schemas/slide-template.schema.yaml

```yaml
# Slide Template Schema — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (DEV-2026-003)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Contract for slide-function templates. A slide template defines the
# CANONICAL STRUCTURE for ONE narrative function (hook, proof, demo_payoff, etc.).
# It is FUNCTION-FIRST, not LAYOUT-FIRST — same function can have multiple layouts.
#
# Inspired by:
#   - Presenton servers/nextjs/app/presentation-templates/{family}/*.tsx (Zod schema per layout)
#   - slide-deck-ai pptx_helper.py routing handlers (per slide type)
#   - PPTAgent roles/layout_selector.yaml ({reasoning, layout} output)
#   - ppt-master design_spec.md per-layout sections

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  schema_kind: "slide-template"
  consumer_tasks:
    - "tasks/compose-grid-layout.md (consumes slot definitions)"
    - "tasks/select-slide-template.md (NEW — selects best template per function)"
    - "tasks/emit-deck-spec.md (uses template constraints to render slide spec)"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SLIDE TEMPLATE SCHEMA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
slide_template:
  required: [id, name, function, summary, slots, constraints, sample_content]
  fields:

    id:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+[a-z0-9]$"
      example: "proof-stack"

    name:
      type: string
      max_length: 60
      example: "Proof Stack (3 evidências verticais com source)"

    version:
      type: string
      default: "1.0.0"

    function:
      type: string
      description: "Primary narrative function this slide template serves"
      enum_ref: "data/slide-function-map.schema.yaml#slide_function_map.entries[].function"
      example: "proof"

    alternative_functions:
      type: list
      description: "Other functions this template can serve (secondary)"
      item_type: string
      example: ["mechanism_step", "synthesis"]

    summary:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        pick_for:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          example: "Quando ha 2-4 evidencias quantitativas que sustentam mesma tese. Pesquisas, estatisticas, estudos de caso."
        skip_if:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          example: "Quando evidencia eh qualitativa (use quote). Quando ha 5+ evidencias (split em 2 slides OR use matrix-framework). Quando evidencia eh visual unica (use chart)."

    slots:
      type: list
      required: true
      min_items: 1
      max_items: 12
      description: "Structured slots that hold content. Each slot is named, typed, and constrained."
      item_schema:
        required: [name, type, role]
        fields:
          name:
            type: string
            example: "action_title"
          type:
            type: enum
            values: [text, number, currency, percentage, date, image, icon, chart, table, citation, list, group]
          role:
            type: enum
            values: [primary, supporting, decoration, metadata, footer]
            description: "Visual hierarchy role"
          required:
            type: boolean
            default: false
          max_chars:
            type: ["integer", "null"]
            description: "Hard cap for text slots"
          max_items:
            type: ["integer", "null"]
            description: "Hard cap for list/group slots"
          allowed_values:
            type: ["list", "null"]
            description: "Enum if applicable"
          token_ref:
            type: ["string", "null"]
            description: "Typography token reference (e.g., --slide-title-xl)"
          position_hint:
            type: ["string", "null"]
            description: "Grid position hint (e.g., 'top-left', 'center-full', 'bottom-right')"

    constraints:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        density_target:
          type: enum
          values: [minimal, low, medium, high]
          description: "Maps to design-direction.density_limits"
        max_visual_elements:
          type: integer
          default: 4
        max_text_chars_total:
          type: integer
          default: 280
        grid_columns_required:
          type: ["integer", "null"]
          description: "If template needs specific grid (e.g., 3-col for proof-stack)"
        viewing_distance_min:
          type: enum
          values: [near, medium, far]
          default: medium
        accessibility_min:
          type: enum
          values: [WCAG_AA, WCAG_AAA]
          default: WCAG_AA

    visual_pattern:
      type: object
      required: false
      description: "Optional reference visual pattern (without prescribing exact theme)"
      fields:
        layout_family:
          type: enum
          values: [stacked, columns, grid, hero, split, full_bleed, card_array, matrix, timeline_horizontal, timeline_vertical, big_number, quote_card, callout_with_image]
        motif_hints:
          type: list
          item_type: string
          example: ["leading number per evidence", "icon per stack item", "horizontal divider between blocks"]

    qa_gates_emphasis:
      type: list
      description: "Which qa-rubric.yaml sub-dimensions matter MOST for this template"
      item_schema:
        dimension: string
        emphasis: enum  # values: critical, high, medium, low
      example:
        - {dimension: contrast, emphasis: critical}     # proof needs to be legible
        - {dimension: enumeration_universal, emphasis: critical}  # each evidence numbered
        - {dimension: fontes_apa, emphasis: critical}   # each proof has source

    failure_modes:
      type: list
      description: "Anti-patterns specific to this slide template"
      item_schema:
        mode: string
        symptom: string
        prevention: string

    selected_template_reason_schema:
      type: object
      description: "When selector picks this template, must emit reason in this schema (PPTAgent pattern)"
      fields:
        function_match: "string — which function this satisfies"
        density_fit: "string — why density_target fits content volume"
        alternative_considered: "string — which other templates were considered + why rejected"

    sample_content:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Sample data that fills slots. Used for preview AND calibration."
      fields:
        slots_filled:
          type: object
          description: "Map slot.name → sample value (respecting type + constraints)"
        notes:
          type: string

    compatible_with:
      type: object
      required: false
      fields:
        deck_templates:
          type: list
          description: "Deck templates that frequently use this slide template"
        themes:
          type: list
          description: "Themes this template renders well in"

    source_provenance:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        inspired_by:
          type: list
          item_type: string
        bench_ref:
          type: list
          item_type: string
        author:
          type: string
        date_created: "YYYY-MM-DD"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION RULES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation_rules:
  - rule: "id matches filename"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "function present in data/slide-function-map.schema.yaml enum"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "summary.pick_for AND summary.skip_if both non-empty"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "At least 1 slot with role=primary"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "sample_content.slots_filled covers all required slots"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "constraints.max_text_chars_total respects density_target hierarchy (minimal<=120, low<=180, medium<=280, high<=400)"
    severity: high
```


## Referência: references/squad/templates/schemas/visual-template.schema.yaml

```yaml
# Visual Template Schema — Slides Creator Squad
# Mission: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN (DEV-2026-003)
# Created: 2026-05-17
# Version: 1.0.0
#
# Contract for visual templates (charts, diagrams, infographics). Inspired
# directly by ppt-master charts_index.json which catalogs 71 chart types
# with contrastive "Pick for / Skip if" summaries.
#
# A visual template is selected by select-chart-type or similar at runtime
# based on data shape + narrative intent.

meta:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"
  schema_kind: "visual-template"
  consumer_tasks:
    - "tasks/select-chart-type.md (selects best chart per data shape)"
    - "tasks/compose-grid-layout.md (places visual within grid)"
  inspired_by_bench: "/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/skills/ppt-master/templates/charts/charts_index.json"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VISUAL TEMPLATE SCHEMA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
visual_template:
  required: [id, name, kind, summary, data_shape_required, slots, render_modes]
  fields:

    id:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+[a-z0-9]$"
      example: "bar-chart"

    name:
      type: string
      max_length: 60
      example: "Bar Chart (single-series, vertical)"

    version:
      type: string
      default: "1.0.0"

    kind:
      type: enum
      values:
        - chart          # quantitative comparison
        - diagram        # structural/conceptual (flow, hierarchy, relationship)
        - infographic    # mixed visual+text storytelling unit
        - timeline       # temporal
        - matrix         # 2-axis classification
        - icon_array     # quantity via icons
        - quote_card     # rhetorical
        - kpi_block      # single big number + context

    summary:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        pick_for:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          description: "Concrete data shape + scale + narrative intent"
          example: "Single-series category value comparison, 3-8 categories. Audience needs to compare absolute values quickly."
        skip_if:
          type: string
          max_length: 240
          description: "When to use alternative visual_template"
          example: ">12 long-label items (use horizontal-bar-chart). Multi-series (use grouped-bar-chart). Time series (use line-chart). Composition (use stacked-bar OR pie)."
      pattern_inspired_by: "ppt-master charts_index.json"

    data_shape_required:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Shape of data this visual needs"
      fields:
        dimensions:
          type: list
          description: "Required data dimensions"
          item_schema:
            name: string
            type: "enum (categorical, ordinal, numerical, temporal, geographical)"
            cardinality_range: "object {min, max} OR null"
        series_count:
          type: object
          fields:
            min: integer
            max: integer
        examples_of_fit:
          type: list
          item_type: string
          example: ["Receita por trimestre", "Vendas por regiao", "NPS por segmento"]

    narrative_use:
      type: list
      description: "Narrative functions this visual commonly supports"
      item_enum_ref: "data/slide-function-map.schema.yaml#entries[].function"
      example: [proof, contrast, mechanism_step]

    slots:
      type: list
      required: true
      description: "Slots specific to this visual"
      item_schema:
        name: string
        type: enum  # data | label | annotation | source | legend | axis
        required: boolean
        max_items: "integer OR null"

    render_modes:
      type: list
      required: true
      min_items: 1
      description: "Which output renderers can produce this visual"
      item_schema:
        renderer:
          enum: [tsx_consumer_app, html_standalone, pptx_native, svg, png_static]
        notes: string
        complexity:
          enum: [simple, moderate, complex]

    constraints:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        max_data_points:
          type: integer
          description: "Above this, visual breaks readability"
        max_chars_per_label:
          type: integer
          default: 24
        contrast_requirement:
          type: enum
          values: [WCAG_AA, WCAG_AAA]
        color_palette_requirement:
          type: enum
          values: [single_hue, dual_hue, sequential, diverging, categorical_distinct]

    failure_modes:
      type: list
      item_schema:
        mode: string
        symptom: string
        prevention: string
      example:
        - mode: "Too many categories"
          symptom: "Bars become unreadable strips"
          prevention: "Cap at 8 categories. Above, use horizontal-bar OR aggregate small categories into 'Outros'."

    sample_data:
      type: object
      required: true
      description: "Inline sample data filling slots"

    accessibility:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        screen_reader_label_required: boolean
        color_alone_not_sufficient: boolean
        provides_data_table_alternative: boolean

    source_provenance:
      type: object
      required: true
      fields:
        inspired_by:
          type: list
          item_type: string
        bench_ref:
          type: list
          item_type: string
        author: string
        date_created: "YYYY-MM-DD"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VALIDATION RULES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
validation_rules:
  - rule: "id matches filename"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "summary.pick_for AND summary.skip_if both non-empty"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "data_shape_required.dimensions non-empty"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "render_modes >= 1"
    severity: blocking
  - rule: "constraints.max_data_points respects readability heuristic per kind"
    severity: high
```


## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/appendix.md

# Template: Appendix/Supporting Slide

## Purpose
Fornecer informações detalhadas, dados adicionais, metodologias, supporting analysis sem sobrecarregar slides principais. Servir como reference material.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - APPENDIX SLIDE

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** "A-[número]" (ex: "A-1", "A-2", "A-15")
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

**IMPORTANTE:** Appendix slides NÃO contam na numeração principal (slides 1-50 main deck, depois A-1 to A-X appendix)

---

### HEADER
**Posição:** Topo
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 0.8-1

**Formato:**
"APPENDIX | [Tópico do slide]"

OU (se appendix section específica):
"APPENDIX - METHODOLOGY | [Specific topic]"

**Exemplo:**
"APPENDIX | Detailed Market Sizing Assumptions"
"APPENDIX - DATA SOURCES | Customer Survey Methodology"

**Especificações:**
- Fonte: Helvetica Neue Bold, 14-16pt
- Cor: #6E6E6E (não #003B5C - visual cue que é appendix, não main content)
- Separator: " | " entre "APPENDIX" e topic
- Alignment: Left

**Visual cue (opcional mas recommended):**
- Top border: 3pt, #B0BEC5 (gray), full width
- Background top strip: #F5F5F5, height 0.5cm

---

## APPENDIX CATEGORIES & FORMATS

### CATEGORY 1: DETAILED DATA TABLES

**Quando usar:**
- Raw data supporting charts in main deck
- Detailed breakdowns (by geography, product, time period)
- Full datasets (main deck showed summary)

**Especificações:**

**Table structure:**
- Can be denser than main deck tables (mais rows/columns OK)
- Font: 9-10pt (slightly smaller acceptable)
- Zebra striping: Mandatory (aids scanning)
- Borders: 1pt #E0E0E0 (subtle)
- Header: Background #F5F5F5, 10pt Bold

**Max dimensions:**
- Rows: 25-30 (se mais, quebrar em múltiplos slides "A-1a, A-1b")
- Columns: 10-12 (se mais, rotate ou quebrar)

**Example:**
**Title:** "APPENDIX | Revenue by Product Line, Geography, and Customer Segment (2022-2024)"

**Table:** 3-way breakdown
- Rows: 20 product-geography combinations
- Columns: 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | CAGR | % of Total
- Format: $M, 1 decimal
- Highlights: Top 5 combinations em bold

---

### CATEGORY 2: METHODOLOGY & ASSUMPTIONS

**Quando usar:**
- Explicar calculations
- Document assumptions
- Statistical methods
- Data collection approach

**Formato:**

**Section headers:**
- "1. Data Collection"
- "2. Analysis Approach"
- "3. Key Assumptions"
- "4. Limitations"

**Content:**
- Bullets: 10-11pt Regular
- Sub-bullets: Indented, 9-10pt
- Formulas: Monospace font (Courier New), 10pt, background #F5F5F5
- References: 8pt, italics

**Example:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX - METHODOLOGY | Customer LTV Calculation"

**Section 1: Formula**
```
LTV = (Monthly Revenue per Customer × Gross Margin % × Avg Lifetime in Months)
    = (ARPU × GM% × (1 / Monthly Churn Rate))
```

**Section 2: Assumptions**
• ARPU calculated as total MRR / active customers (excludes free tier)
• Gross margin: 78% (company-wide average, excludes S&M and G&A)
• Churn rate: 12-month trailing average (2.1% monthly)
• Cohort: Customers acquired Jan 2023-Dec 2023 (n=2,450)

**Section 3: Limitations**
• Does not account for expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell)
• Assumes constant churn rate (historically 1.8-2.4% range)
• Excludes customer acquisition cost (CAC) - see separate analysis slide A-5

---

### CATEGORY 3: DETAILED CHARTS & ANALYSIS

**Quando usar:**
- Deep-dive charts não essenciais para main story
- Alternative views of same data
- Segmentation analysis
- Outlier analysis

**Formato:**
- Similar to main deck data slides BUT:
  - Can have 2 charts per slide (vs 1 principal em main deck)
  - Smaller fonts acceptable (10pt vs 11-12pt)
  - Less white space (denser OK)

**Example:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX | Revenue Growth Drivers - Detailed Decomposition"

**Chart 1 (left half):** Waterfall breakdown
- Showing 12 components (vs 5 em main deck)
- Smaller bars, 9pt labels

**Chart 2 (right half):** Time series
- Monthly view (vs quarterly em main deck)
- 36 data points, 9pt axis labels

---

### CATEGORY 4: BENCHMARKING & COMPARABLES

**Quando usar:**
- Peer comparison details
- Industry benchmarks
- Market comps
- Valuation multiples

**Formato:**

**Comparison table:**
- Rows: Peers/comparables (15-25 companies)
- Columns: Key metrics (Revenue, EBITDA Margin, Growth, Valuation, etc.)
- Sorting: By most relevant metric (ex: descending market cap)
- Highlight: Subject company em bold, background #FFFDE7 (light yellow)

**Quartile markers:**
- Top quartile: Shaded #E8F5E9 (light green)
- Bottom quartile: Shaded #FFEBEE (light red)
- Median line: Dashed, across table

**Example:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX - BENCHMARKING | SaaS Peer Comparison (Public Companies >$500M Market Cap)"

| Company | Revenue | Growth | EBITDA Margin | NRR | EV/Revenue |
|---------|---------|--------|---------------|-----|------------|
| Peer A | $2,500M | 45% | 28% | 130% | 15.2× |
| Peer B | $1,800M | 38% | 22% | 118% | 12.5× |
| **[COMPANY]** | **$615M** | **32%** | **24%** | **125%** | **10.8×** |
| Peer C | $850M | 28% | 18% | 112% | 8.5× |
| ... | | | | | |
| **Median** | **$1,250M** | **32%** | **23%** | **120%** | **11.2×** |
| **Top Quartile** | - | 42% | 27% | 128% | 14.0× |

**Highlights:**
- Subject company: Yellow background
- Metrics > median: Bold green
- Metrics < median: Regular black

---

### CATEGORY 5: SURVEY/INTERVIEW RESULTS

**Quando usar:**
- Customer research findings
- Employee survey results
- Expert interview summaries

**Formato:**

**Survey snapshot:**
- Sample: "n=1,250 customers (response rate 34%)"
- Period: "Conducted Nov 15-30, 2024"
- Method: "Online survey, 15 questions, avg completion 8 min"

**Results visualization:**
- Horizontal bar charts (% respondents)
- Pie charts (segmentation)
- Quotes: Callout boxes, italic, 10pt

**Example:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX - VOICE OF CUSTOMER | Survey Results - Product Satisfaction"

**Sample details:**
n=1,250 | Response rate 34% | Nov 15-30, 2024 | Margin of error ±2.8%

**Q1: Overall satisfaction (1-5 scale)**
- Very Satisfied (5): 42% ████████████████████
- Satisfied (4): 38% ███████████████
- Neutral (3): 12% ████████
- Dissatisfied (2): 6% ███
- Very Dissatisfied (1): 2% █

**Mean: 4.1 | Top-2-Box: 80% (↑ from 72% in 2023)**

**Q2: Most valued features (select top 3)**
- Ease of use: 68%
- Integration capabilities: 54%
- Customer support: 48%
- Pricing: 42%
- Mobile app: 35%

**Verbatim quotes:**
> "The platform is intuitive, but mobile experience needs work" - Enterprise customer, Financial Services

> "Support team is responsive, typically <2h response time" - Mid-market customer, Healthcare

---

### CATEGORY 6: RISK MATRIX & MITIGATION

**Quando usar:**
- Detailed risk assessment
- Mitigation plans
- Scenario analysis

**Formato:**

**Risk matrix (2×2):**
- X-axis: Likelihood (Low → High)
- Y-axis: Impact (Low → High)
- Quadrants: Color-coded
  - High Impact, High Likelihood: #FFEBEE (red - priority)
  - High Impact, Low Likelihood: #FFF9E6 (yellow - monitor)
  - Low Impact, High Likelihood: #E3F2FD (blue - manage)
  - Low Impact, Low Likelihood: #F5F5F5 (gray - accept)

**Risk items:**
- Bubbles on matrix
- Size: Proportional to potential $ impact
- Label: Risk ID (R1, R2, etc.)

**Risk table (below matrix):**
| ID | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Owner |
|----|------|------------|--------|------------|-------|
| R1 | Vendor delay | Medium | High | Dual source, buffer time | PMO |
| R2 | Regulatory change | Low | High | Legal monitoring, flexibility | Compliance |

---

### CATEGORY 7: GLOSSARY & DEFINITIONS

**Quando usar:**
- Technical terms
- Industry jargon
- Acronyms
- Metric definitions

**Formato:**

**Alphabetical list:**
- Term: 11pt Bold
- Definition: 10pt Regular
- Example (optional): 9pt Italic, indented

**2-column layout** (para economizar espaço):
- Left column: A-M
- Right column: N-Z

**Example:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX - GLOSSARY | Key Terms & Definitions"

**ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue)**
Annualized value of recurring subscription contracts. Calculated as MRR × 12.
_Example: Customer with $10K/month subscription = $120K ARR_

**CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)**
Total sales & marketing expense divided by number of new customers acquired in period.
_Includes: salaries, ads, events, tools. Excludes: customer success, support_

**Churn Rate**
Percentage of customers who cancel in a period. Calculated as churned customers / customers at start.
_Monthly churn 2% = 1 - (1 - 0.02)^12 = 21.5% annual churn_

---

### CATEGORY 8: DETAILED PROCESS FLOWS

**Quando usar:**
- Step-by-step processes
- Detailed workflows
- System architecture
- Decision trees

**Formato:**
- Swimlane diagrams (por role/system)
- Flowcharts (decision logic)
- Sequence diagrams (system interactions)

**Visual specs:**
- Shapes: Rectangle (process), Diamond (decision), Rounded (start/end)
- Connectors: 2pt arrows
- Colors: By actor/system
- Labels: 9pt, inside shapes

**Can be denser than main deck** (mais steps, smaller boxes)

---

## LAYOUT VARIATIONS

### DENSE DATA LAYOUT
**Para maximum information:**
- Margins: Reduced to 0.8cm (vs 1.5cm main deck)
- Font: 9-10pt (vs 11-12pt)
- Line height: 1.3 (vs 1.5)
- White space: Minimal
- Grid: Can violate 12×8 grid se necessário

### REFERENCE PAGE LAYOUT
**Para quick lookup:**
- Large table: Full slide
- Small header: Just "APPENDIX | Topic"
- No page number limit (pode ter A-1 through A-50 se needed)

---

## NAVIGATION & CROSS-REFERENCE

### LINKING TO APPENDIX (from main deck)

**In main deck slide:**
- Small superscript reference: "See detailed analysis^A-5"
- Hyperlinked (if digital deck)
- Font: 8pt, #1976D2 (blue = link)

**Footer in appendix slides:**
"Related main deck slide: Slide 12 - Revenue Analysis"

### APPENDIX TABLE OF CONTENTS

**If >10 appendix slides, create TOC as slide A-0:**

**Title:** "APPENDIX - TABLE OF CONTENTS"

**Format:**
A-1: Detailed Market Sizing Assumptions
A-2: Customer Survey Methodology & Results
A-3-A-5: Revenue Analysis by Segment (3 slides)
A-6: Peer Benchmarking - Full Dataset
A-7: Risk Assessment & Mitigation Plans
A-8-A-10: Financial Model Details (3 slides)
A-11: Glossary of Terms
A-12: Data Sources & Bibliography

**Hyperlinked** (each item clicks to that slide)

---

## VISUAL DIFFERENTIATION FROM MAIN DECK

**Consistent markers que isto é appendix:**

1. **Header styling:**
   - Always includes "APPENDIX" prefix
   - Gray tone (#6E6E6E) vs navy (#003B5C)
   - Top border gray vs navy

2. **Page numbers:**
   - "A-X" format vs "X"
   - Position: Same (consistency) but format different

3. **Density:**
   - Visibly denser (mais content per slide)
   - Smaller fonts acceptable
   - Less white space

4. **Polish:**
   - Less polished OK (não apresentável orally)
   - Focus on completeness vs aesthetics
   - Charts can be "rougher" (Excel screenshots acceptable se clear)

---

## SOURCES & CITATIONS (Even More Critical in Appendix)

**Format:**
"Sources: [Detailed list with dates, access info, page numbers]"

**Example:**
"Sources:
1. Company internal financials, audited by EY (FY 2022-2024), accessed via CFO office Dec 2024
2. Gartner Magic Quadrant for CRM, published Oct 15, 2024, available at https://www.gartner.com/doc/4822615, accessed Dec 10, 2024, p.12-18
3. Customer survey conducted by [Firm] Nov 15-30, 2024, n=1,250, response rate 34%, margin of error ±2.8% at 95% confidence
4. Industry benchmarks from SaaS Capital Index, Q3 2024 report, https://www.saas-capital.com/research, Table 5
5. Expert interviews with 8 industry practitioners, conducted Nov 2024 (anonymized per confidentiality agreements)"

**Position:** Bottom margin, 7-8pt, #B0B0B0

---

## CHECKLIST - APPENDIX SLIDE

**Organization:**
- [ ] Clearly labeled "APPENDIX"?
- [ ] Page numbered "A-X" format?
- [ ] Linked from main deck (se relevant)?
- [ ] Grouped logically (all methodology together, etc)?
- [ ] TOC provided se >10 appendix slides?

**Content:**
- [ ] Adds value (não duplicativo)?
- [ ] Too detailed for main deck mas relevant?
- [ ] Sources fully documented?
- [ ] Methodology explained?
- [ ] Assumptions stated?

**Formatting:**
- [ ] Visually distinguido de main deck?
- [ ] Readable (even if dense)?
- [ ] Tables properly formatted?
- [ ] Charts labeled?
- [ ] Definitions clear?

**Reference:**
- [ ] Cross-references work (links active)?
- [ ] Related main slide noted?
- [ ] Standalone understandable?

---

## COMMON APPENDIX SLIDE TYPES - QUICK REFERENCE

**A-1: Full dataset** (main deck showed summary)
**A-2: Methodology** (how we calculated key metrics)
**A-3: Assumptions** (what we assumed, why)
**A-4-A-6: Sensitivity analysis** (scenarios, what-ifs)
**A-7: Peer benchmarking detail** (full comps table)
**A-8: Survey/interview details** (verbatims, full results)
**A-9-A-10: Detailed process flows** (step-by-step)
**A-11: Risk matrix** (all risks, not just top 5)
**A-12: Financial model** (full P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)
**A-13: Glossary** (terms, acronyms, definitions)
**A-14: Bibliography** (all sources, links, citations)

---

## EXAMPLE APPENDIX SLIDE - COMPLETE SPEC

**SLIDE A-3: METHODOLOGY - MARKET SIZING**

**Header:**
- Text: "APPENDIX - METHODOLOGY | Total Addressable Market (TAM) Sizing Approach"
- Font: Helvetica Neue Bold, 14pt, #6E6E6E
- Top border: 3pt #B0BEC5, full width

**Section 1: Approach (Linhas 1.5-3)**
We used a bottom-up approach combining three data sources:
1. Government census data (total # of target businesses)
2. Industry surveys (penetration rates, avg spend)
3. Company sales data (validation, actual customer spend)

**Section 2: Calculation (Linhas 3-5)**
```
TAM = # Target Businesses × Penetration Rate × ARPU × 12 months
    = 250,000 businesses × 35% penetration × $4,200 ARPU × 12
    = $4.4 Billion
```

**Section 3: Assumptions (Linhas 5-6.5)**
• Target businesses: US companies 50-500 employees in sectors: Professional Services, Healthcare, Financial Services (SIC codes 70XX, 80XX, 60XX)
• Penetration: 35% based on Gartner survey 2024 (avg of 3-year adoption rates)
• ARPU: $4,200/month based on our mid-market tier pricing × 1.2 (accounts for upsells)
• Geography: US only (international TAM separate analysis - see slide A-4)

**Section 4: Validation (Linhas 6.5-7.5)**
Cross-check with top-down:
• Industry analyst reports (Gartner, Forrester) estimate $4.0-4.8B TAM → Our $4.4B within range ✓
• Our current market share: $615M / $4.4B = 14% (plausible given competitive landscape)

**Sources (Bottom margin):**
"Sources: (1) US Census Bureau, Statistics of U.S. Businesses 2023, accessed Dec 2024; (2) Gartner Inc., 'Market Analysis: CRM Software Adoption,' published Sep 2024; (3) Company internal sales database (2024 FY); (4) Forrester Research, 'CRM Market Forecast 2024-2027,' Mar 2024"

**Page number:** "A-3" - bottom right

---

**VERSÃO:** 1.0
**OWNER:** GPT McKinsey PPT Architect
**ÚLTIMA ATUALIZAÇÃO:** Dezembro 2024


## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/data.md

# Template: Data/Analytics Slide

## Purpose
Apresentar dados, análises, insights quantitativos com máxima clareza. O chart deve "falar por si" - audience deve entender sem explicação verbal.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - DATA/ANALYTICS SLIDE

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** Número sequencial (ex: "15")
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

---

### ACTION TITLE
**Posição:** Topo da área útil
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1
**Grid alignment:** Full width

**Estrutura obrigatória:**
"[O QUE OS DADOS MOSTRAM] + [MAGNITUDE/COMPARAÇÃO] + [IMPLICAÇÃO]"

**Exemplos BOM:**
✅ "Revenue cresceu 34% em Q4 impulsionado por enterprise segment, superando guidance de 28% e validando upmarket strategy"

✅ "Customer acquisition cost caiu de $245 para $180 (-27%) via channel optimization, melhorando unit economics para LTV:CAC de 4.2:1"

✅ "Market share ganhou 3.2pp para 18.5% liderando categoria premium, enquanto competitors perderam terreno em value segment"

**Exemplos RUIM:**
❌ "Análise de revenue por trimestre" (descriptive, não insight)
❌ "Dados mostram crescimento" (vago, sem quantificação)
❌ "Performance financeira Q4" (título sem insight)

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold
- **Tamanho:** 16-18pt
- **Cor:** #003B5C (navy blue)
- **Alinhamento:** Left-aligned
- **Line height:** 1.3
- **Max linhas:** 2 (idealmente 1)
- **Bold numbers:** Números devem estar em bold mesmo dentro do título

---

### MAIN CHART AREA
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, Linhas 2-7
**Grid:** Central area, máximo espaço dedicado ao visual

**Chart dimensions:**
- Width: 22cm (90% do slide width)
- Height: 10-11cm (adequado para legibilidade)
- Position: Centralizado horizontalmente

---

## CHART TYPE SPECIFICATIONS

### BAR CHART (Horizontal ou Vertical)

**Quando usar:**
- Comparação entre categorias
- Rankings
- Before/after comparisons

**Especificações obrigatórias:**

**Bars:**
- Width: 60-80% do espaço disponível
- Spacing: 20-40% da bar width
- Color: Primary (#00A86B green) para highlight, #B0BEC5 (gray) para others
- Border: None (clean look)
- Border radius: 2px (slightly rounded, modern)

**Eixo Y (valores):**
- SEMPRE começar em zero (regra absoluta para bar charts)
- Gridlines: Horizontal, #E5E5E5, 1pt, 30% opacity
- Ticks: Every significant interval (ex: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200)
- Label: 11pt Regular, #6E6E6E, right-aligned

**Eixo X (categorias):**
- Label: 11pt Regular, #000000, center-aligned sob cada bar
- Rotation: 0° (horizontal) ideal, 45° se labels longos, 90° último recurso
- Max characters: 15-20 por label

**Data Labels:**
- Position: Acima da barra (vertical) ou à direita (horizontal)
- Font: 12pt Bold, #000000
- Format: Número + unidade (ex: "$125M", "34%", "2,450 units")
- Precision: 0-1 decimal places (não mais)

**Destacar outliers:**
- Highest bar: Color #00A86B (green)
- Lowest bar (se relevant): Color #D32F2F (red)
- Others: #78909C (medium gray)

**Legend (se múltiplas séries):**
- Position: Top-right da chart area
- Font: 10pt Regular, #000000
- Symbols: 16×8px rectangles
- Spacing: 8pt entre itens

**Exemplo de especificação completa:**

**BAR CHART - Revenue by Product Line**
- Orientation: Vertical
- # Bars: 5 (Product A, B, C, D, E)
- Values: $180M, $145M, $98M, $67M, $42M
- Y-axis: $0-200M, gridlines every $50M
- Product A (highest): #00A86B
- Product E (lowest): #D32F2F
- Others: #78909C
- Data labels: Above each bar, "$XXM" format, 12pt Bold
- Spacing: Bars use 70% width, 30% spacing

---

### LINE CHART (Time Series)

**Quando usar:**
- Trends ao longo do tempo
- Múltiplas séries comparadas temporalmente
- Projeções / forecasts

**Especificações:**

**Lines:**
- Width: 3pt (main trend), 2pt (secondary trends)
- Style: Solid para actuals, dashed (4px dash, 3px gap) para forecast
- Colors:
  - Primary metric: #003B5C (navy)
  - Secondary: #00A86B (green)
  - Tertiary: #FF6F00 (orange)
  - Benchmark/Target: #B0BEC5 (gray), 2pt dashed

**Data points:**
- Markers: 6px circles
- Fill: Solid color matching line
- Border: 1px white (para destacar do line)
- Show all points OU apenas start/end/inflections (depende de densidade)

**Eixo X (Time):**
- Format: "Q1 2023", "Jan 2024", "Week 12" (consistent formatting)
- Ticks: Every period se <12 periods, every 2-3 se >12
- Label: 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E, rotação 0°

**Eixo Y (Values):**
- Não precisa começar em zero (diferente de bar chart!)
- Range: Min-10% to Max+10% (para dar breathing room)
- Gridlines: Horizontal, #E5E5E5, 1pt, 30% opacity
- Label: 11pt Regular, #6E6E6E

**Annotations:**
- Callouts para inflection points críticos
- Format: Small box com arrow apontando para ponto
- Text: "Peak: $250M in Q3" - 10pt Regular, background #FFFDE7 (light yellow)

**Shaded areas (opcional):**
- Para indicar períodos especiais (ex: recessão, lançamento produto)
- Color: #F5F5F5, 40% opacity
- Label: 9pt Italic, dentro da área

**Forecast separation:**
- Vertical dashed line separando historical vs forecast
- Label: "Forecast →" - 9pt Regular, #6E6E6E

**Exemplo:**

**LINE CHART - Monthly Revenue 2022-2024 with 2025 Forecast**
- X-axis: Jan 2022 to Dec 2025 (48 months)
- Y-axis: $80M to $180M
- Line 1 (Actual 2022-2024): #003B5C, 3pt, solid, 36 data points
- Line 2 (Forecast 2025): #003B5C, 3pt, dashed (4-3px)
- Benchmark line (Target): #B0BEC5, 2pt, dashed, horizontal at $150M
- Vertical separator: Dec 2024, dashed, #E0E0E0
- Annotation: "COVID impact" em Mar-May 2020, shaded area #F5F5F5
- Peak callout: "All-time high $172M" em Aug 2024

---

### WATERFALL CHART

**Quando usar:**
- Explicar variações (revenue walkdown, cost breakdown, P&L bridges)
- Mostrar contribuição de componentes para total
- Before/after com steps intermediários

**Especificações:**

**Bars:**
- Start bar: #003B5C (navy), full height from zero
- Positive contributions: #00A86B (green), floating
- Negative contributions: #D32F2F (red), floating
- End bar: #003B5C (navy), full height from zero

**Connectors:**
- Thin lines (1pt, #6E6E6E, dashed) conectando end de um bar ao start do próximo
- Opcional mas helpful para seguir o flow

**Data labels:**
- Valores absolutos acima de cada bar: "+$25M", "-$10M"
- Percentages (opcional): "(+15%)", "(-8%)"
- Font: 11pt Bold, cor matching bar color

**Eixo Y:**
- Start em zero
- Gridlines: #E5E5E5, 1pt
- Max value: 110% do end bar (breathing room)

**Eixo X:**
- Labels descritivos: "FY2023 EBITDA", "Revenue Growth", "Cost Inflation", "FY2024 EBITDA"
- Font: 11pt Regular, #000000, rotação 0°
- Max width: 12-15 caracteres (quebrar em 2 linhas se necessário)

**Subtotals (opcional):**
- Se muitos componentes (>7), agrupar em subtotals
- Subtotal bars: #78909C (medium gray), outlined 2pt

**Exemplo:**

**WATERFALL - EBITDA Bridge 2023 → 2024**
- Start: "2023 EBITDA $180M" - navy bar, full height
- +Revenue Growth: $45M - green floating bar
- +Margin Expansion: $12M - green
- -Cost Inflation: -$18M - red
- -Investment in R&D: -$9M - red
- End: "2024 EBITDA $210M" - navy bar
- Connectors: Dashed lines linking each bar
- Labels: All values shown, "+$XXM" ou "-$XXM"

---

### PIE CHART / DONUT CHART

**Quando usar:**
- Part-to-whole (composição, market share, revenue mix)
- Max 5-6 slices (mais que isso → bar chart!)
- Quando % composition mais importante que absolute values

**Especificações:**

**Slices:**
- Ordenar por tamanho (maior → menor, clockwise de 12h)
- Exceção: "Others" sempre por último
- Colors: Use paleta consistente, avoid similar shades adjacentes
- Border: 2pt white (para separar slices claramente)

**Explosion (destacar slice):**
- Pull out a slice mais importante 15-20px
- Apenas 1 slice exploded (não mais!)

**Labels:**
- **Option A (outside):** Line connector + label + percentage
  - Line: 1pt, #6E6E6E
  - Label: "Product A 34%" - 11pt Regular, #000000

- **Option B (inside):** Direto no slice
  - Apenas se slice >10% (otherwise too cramped)
  - Label: "34%" - 12pt Bold, color com contrast >4.5:1

**Center (donut only):**
- Total value: "Total: $450M" - 18pt Bold, #003B5C
- Secondary metric: "↑15% vs 2023" - 12pt Regular, #00A86B

**Legend:**
- Position: Right side da chart
- Format: Color box (16×16px) + Label (category) + Value ($ ou #) + Percentage
- Example: [green] Enterprise | $150M | 34%

**Evitar:**
- 3D effects (distorção, unprofessional)
- Gradients dentro de slices (confuso)
- >7 slices (use bar chart)

**Exemplo:**

**DONUT CHART - Revenue Mix by Segment**
- Total center: "Total Revenue $450M" - 18pt Bold
- Slices (clockwise de 12h):
  1. Enterprise: 34% ($153M) - #003B5C, exploded 18px
  2. Mid-market: 28% ($126M) - #00A86B
  3. SMB: 22% ($99M) - #FF6F00
  4. Consumer: 12% ($54M) - #1976D2
  5. Others: 4% ($18M) - #B0BEC5
- Labels: Outside com connectors
- Borders: 2pt white between slices

---

### SCATTER PLOT

**Quando usar:**
- Correlações entre 2 variáveis
- Segmentação (ex: 2×2 matrix)
- Outlier identification

**Especificações:**

**Data points:**
- Size: 8-12px circles (se todos iguais) OU proporcional a 3ª dimensão (bubble chart)
- Colors: By category ou single color
- Border: 1px white se points dense
- Opacity: 90% (para ver overlaps)

**Axes:**
- Eixo X e Y: Both visible, 2pt, #6E6E6E
- Origin: (0,0) se faz sentido, caso contrário min values - 10%
- Gridlines: Both horizontal e vertical, #E5E5E5, 30% opacity
- Ticks: Evenly spaced

**Quadrants (se 2×2 matrix):**
- Dividing lines: 2pt dashed, #003B5C
- Quadrant labels: 12pt Bold, #6E6E6E, em cada canto
- Background shading (opcional): Subtle colors (#F0F8FF, #E8F5E9) para destacar "good" quadrants

**Trendline (opcional):**
- Linear regression: 2pt dashed, #D32F2F
- R² value: Mostrar se >0.5 (otherwise não meaningful)
- Label: "R² = 0.73" - 10pt Regular

**Labels para pontos:**
- Apenas outliers ou pontos críticos (não todos!)
- Format: Small callout com arrow
- Text: 9pt Regular, background white 80% opacity

**Legend:**
- Se múltiplas categorias (colors diferentes)
- Position: Top-right
- Format: Circle + Label

**Exemplo:**

**SCATTER PLOT - Customer LTV vs CAC por Segment**
- X-axis: CAC ($0-$500)
- Y-axis: LTV ($0-$3,000)
- Quadrants: Dividido em x=$250, y=$1,000
  - Top-right: "High LTV, High CAC" (background #FFF9E6)
  - Top-left: "High LTV, Low CAC" ⭐ (background #E8F5E9 - sweet spot)
  - Bottom-right: "Low LTV, High CAC" ⚠️ (background #FFEBEE - problem)
  - Bottom-left: "Low LTV, Low CAC" (neutral)
- Data points: 25 circles, color by segment (Enterprise=#003B5C, SMB=#00A86B, Consumer=#FF6F00)
- Bubble size: Proportional to # customers (legend shows size scale)
- Trendline: Dashed, R²=0.68 shown
- Outliers labeled: "Segment X (Enterprise)" callout

---

## SUPPORTING ELEMENTS

### INSIGHT BOX (Opcional)
**Posição:** Colunas 1-3, Linha 6.5-7.5 OU canto que não interfere com chart
**Purpose:** Highlight de 1-2 insights críticos do chart

**Formato:**
"💡 Insight: [Key takeaway em 1 frase com número]"

**Exemplo:**
"💡 Insight: Top 3 products geram 68% do revenue mas apenas 22% do volume, indicando opportunity em premiumization"

**Especificações:**
- Background: #FFFDE7 (light yellow)
- Border: 2pt left border #FBC02D (yellow)
- Padding: 12pt all sides
- Font: 11pt Regular, #000000
- Icon: 16×16px, positioned left
- Max width: 3 colunas (1/4 do slide)

---

### DATA TABLE (Complementar ao chart)
**Quando incluir:**
- Valores exatos importantes
- Chart shows trend, table shows precision
- Audience precisa de reference numbers

**Posição:** Abaixo do chart, Linha 7-7.8, OU lado direito se chart não usa full width

**Formato:**
- Header row: Background #F5F5F5, 11pt Bold, #000000
- Data rows: Alternating white/#FAFAFA (zebra striping)
- Borders: 1pt #E0E0E0, only horizontal (between rows)
- Alignment: Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned
- Padding: 6pt top/bottom, 8pt left/right

**Max rows visíveis:** 8-10 (se mais, resume apenas top/bottom)

**Exemplo:**

| Product | Q3 Revenue | Q4 Revenue | Growth |
|---------|------------|------------|--------|
| Product A | $45M | $52M | +16% |
| Product B | $38M | $41M | +8% |
| Product C | $29M | $33M | +14% |

Specs: 10pt Regular para data, #000000, right-align numbers

---

## FONTES DE DADOS

**SEMPRE incluir** (não-negociável para data slides)

**Posição:** Rodapé, abaixo linha 8, fora da área principal

**Formato:**
"Fonte: [Sistema/Database] ([período/data de extração]); [Benchmark source] ([ano/versão]); [Metodologia] se relevante; Company analysis"

**Exemplo completo:**
"Fonte: Salesforce CRM database (Q1-Q4 2024, extracted Dec 15, 2024); Gartner Magic Quadrant for CRM (2024) para peer benchmarks; NPS calculation methodology: survey de 2,450 customers (Nov 2024, 34% response rate); McKinsey analysis"

**Especificações:**
- Font: Helvetica Neue Light, 8pt, #B0B0B0
- Position: Margin bottom (0.5cm da borda)
- Max width: 90% do slide
- Line height: 1.2
- Multiple sources: Separated by semicolons

---

## CHECKLIST DE QUALIDADE - DATA SLIDE

**Action Title:**
- [ ] Contém número específico (não vago)?
- [ ] Explica o "so what" (não apenas descreve)?
- [ ] 14-20 palavras (conciso mas completo)?
- [ ] Insights leading (não trailing)?

**Chart:**
- [ ] Tipo correto para os dados (bar vs line vs waterfall)?
- [ ] Eixos começam apropriadamente (zero para bar, não para line)?
- [ ] Gridlines presentes mas sutis (não dominam)?
- [ ] Colors acessíveis (contrast >4.5:1)?
- [ ] Legend presente e claro (se múltiplas séries)?

**Data Labels:**
- [ ] Todos os valores visíveis e legíveis?
- [ ] Formato consistente ($M, %, K units)?
- [ ] Precision apropriada (0-1 decimais, não mais)?
- [ ] Positioned para não overlap?

**Fontes:**
- [ ] Database/system especificado?
- [ ] Data de extração incluída?
- [ ] Benchmarks sourced (com link se público)?
- [ ] Metodologia explicada (se não-standard)?

**Visual Quality:**
- [ ] Exportado em alta resolução (300 DPI)?
- [ ] Fontes embedded (não substituídas)?
- [ ] Colors RGB (screen) ou CMYK (print) apropriado?
- [ ] Anti-aliasing enabled (smooth lines)?

---

**VERSÃO:** 1.0
**OWNER:** GPT McKinsey PPT Architect
**ÚLTIMA ATUALIZAÇÃO:** Dezembro 2024


## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/executive-summary.md

# Template: Executive Summary Slide

## Purpose
Sintetizar toda a apresentação em 1 slide. C-levels devem conseguir entender o核心 message sem ver resto da deck. Máxima densidade de insights com máxima clareza.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** "2" (ou página apropriada - geralmente slide 2)
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

---

### ACTION TITLE
**Posição:** Topo da área útil
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1
**Grid alignment:** Full width, top margin respeitada (1.5cm)

**Estrutura recomendada:**
"[RESPOSTA PRINCIPAL] + [IMPACTO QUANTIFICADO] + [IMPLICAÇÃO/CALL-TO-ACTION]"

**Exemplo:**
"Transformação digital pode gerar $250M EBITDA adicional em 3 anos através de 5 alavancas estratégicas, exigindo decisão Go/No-Go até Q1 2025"

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold
- **Tamanho:** 18-22pt (menor que title slide, mas ainda prominent)
- **Cor:** #003B5C (navy blue)
- **Alinhamento:** Left-aligned (leitura natural)
- **Line height:** 1.3
- **Max linhas:** 2-3 (se ultrapassar, simplificar)
- **Character count:** 120-180 caracteres ideal

**Regras:**
- SEMPRE incluir número ($M, %, tempo)
- SEMPRE incluir "so what" (implicação)
- Evitar jargão técnico
- Linguagem assertiva (não tentativa)

---

### ESTRUTURA DE CONTEÚDO

O Executive Summary segue estrutura SCQA condensada:

**S (Situation):** 1 frase de contexto
**C (Complication):** 1 frase do problema/oportunidade
**Q (Question):** Implícita (não precisa escrever)
**A (Answer):** 3-5 bullets com as respostas principais

---

### SECTION 1: CONTEXT (Opcional, se necessário)
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1.8
**Text box:** Single line, background #F5F5F5 (light gray box)

**Formato:**
"Contexto: [Cliente] opera em mercado de $X bilhões com Y% de crescimento anual, enfrentando Z pressões competitivas"

**Especificações:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular
- **Tamanho:** 12pt
- **Cor texto:** #000000
- **Background:** #F5F5F5, 100% opacity
- **Padding:** 8pt top/bottom, 12pt left/right
- **Border radius:** 4px
- **Max linhas:** 1-2

**Quando incluir:**
- Audience não familiar com contexto
- Situação mudou recentemente
- Múltiplas audiências diferentes

**Quando omitir:**
- Audience já conhece bem
- Foco total nos insights (não background)

---

### SECTION 2: KEY FINDINGS / RECOMMENDATIONS
**Posição:** Colunas 1-7, Linhas 2.5-7.5
**Grid:** Left column (60% do slide width)

**Estrutura:** 3-5 bullets principais (não mais que 5!)

**Formato de cada bullet:**

**[NÚMERO/ÍCONE] [TÍTULO DO INSIGHT EM BOLD] + descrição suporte em 1-2 linhas**

**Exemplo:**

**1. Crescimento inorgânico deve ser prioridade** para capturar 40% do mercado até 2027, vs 18% atual através de modelo orgânico (insuficiente)

**2. Digital channels podem aumentar conversão em 3.2×** de 12% para 38% via personalização de jornada, gerando $80M revenue incremental anualmente

**3. Footprint operacional exige consolidação** de 12 para 7 sites até 2026, liberando $35M em synergies e melhorando time-to-market em 40%

**Especificações tipográficas:**

**Número/Ícone:**
- **Opção A (Número):** Helvetica Neue Bold, 16pt, #00A86B (green), circle background 32px diameter
- **Opção B (Ícone):** Relevante ao tema, 24×24px, #00A86B, alinhado à esquerda

**Título (Bold part):**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold
- **Tamanho:** 14pt
- **Cor:** #000000 (black para máxima legibilidade)
- **Case:** Sentence case

**Descrição (Supporting text):**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular
- **Tamanho:** 12pt
- **Cor:** #000000
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Max linhas por bullet:** 2-3 (idealmente 2)

**Spacing:**
- Entre bullets: 24pt
- Indent da descrição: 40pt (alinhado após ícone/número)

**Regras de conteúdo:**
- MECE (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive)
- Cada bullet = 1 ideia principal
- Sempre incluir métrica quantitativa
- Ordem: Por importância (não cronológica)
- Evitar sub-bullets (flatear hierarquia)

---

### SECTION 3: VISUAL ANCHOR
**Posição:** Colunas 8-12, Linhas 2.5-7.5
**Grid:** Right column (40% do slide width)

**Purpose:** 1 visual poderoso que sintetiza o caso todo

**Opções de visual:**

#### OPÇÃO A: Value Waterfall Chart
**Melhor para:** Apresentar financial impact breakdown

**Elementos:**
- Start bar: Baseline (ex: EBITDA atual $100M)
- Positive bars: Alavancas de crescimento (+$60M, +$45M, +$30M)
- Negative bars: Investimentos necessários (-$25M, -$10M)
- End bar: Target EBITDA ($200M)

**Especificações:**
- Largura total: Colunas 8-12 (4 colunas = 8cm)
- Altura: Linhas 2.5-7 (4.5 linhas = 8.75cm)
- Colors: Green para adds (#00A86B), Red para subtracts (#D32F2F), Navy para start/end (#003B5C)
- Data labels: Acima de cada barra, 12pt Bold, values em $M
- Gridlines: Horizontal, #E5E5E5, 20% opacity
- Axis labels: 11pt Regular, #6E6E6E

#### OPÇÃO B: Strategic Framework Visual
**Melhor para:** Apresentar strategic direction ou portfolio

**Exemplo: 2×2 Matrix**
- Eixo X: Attractiveness (Low → High)
- Eixo Y: Competitive Position (Weak → Strong)
- Bubbles: Business units (tamanho = revenue)
- Colors: Segment (cada BU tem cor)
- Arrows: Strategic moves (buy, hold, divest)

**Especificações:**
- Quadrants: Background #F9F9F9 alternado
- Bubble size: Proporcional a metric (legend included)
- Labels: 10pt, inside bubble se couber, outside se não
- Arrows: 3pt width, #000000, simple style

#### OPÇÃO C: Timeline/Roadmap
**Melhor para:** Apresentar phasing ou implementation plan

**Elementos:**
- Horizontal timeline: Q1 2025 → Q4 2027
- Swim lanes: Por workstream (3-5 streams)
- Milestones: Círculos com data + deliverable
- Phases: Color-coded backgrounds

**Especificações:**
- Timeline: Top, 3pt line, #003B5C
- Quarters: Marked, 10pt Regular
- Milestones: 16px circles, #00A86B, white center
- Swim lane labels: Left, 11pt Bold, rotated 0°
- Phase backgrounds: Gradients subtle (#F0F8FF → #E6F4EA)

#### OPÇÃO D: Key Metric Dashboard
**Melhor para:** Apresentar performance snapshot

**Elementos:**
- 4-6 métricas chave
- Each metric: Large number + small label + trend arrow
- Comparison: vs target ou vs prior period

**Exemplo layout:**

```
┌─────────────┬─────────────┐
│   $250M     │    +45%     │
│   Revenue   │   ↗ Growth  │
├─────────────┼─────────────┤
│    28%      │     92      │
│  Margin ↗   │   NPS ↗     │
└─────────────┴─────────────┘
```

**Especificações:**
- Grid: 2×2 ou 3×2
- Number: 28-32pt Bold, #003B5C
- Label: 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E
- Trend arrow: 20pt, Green (#00A86B) para up, Red (#D32F2F) para down
- Borders: 1pt, #E0E0E0

---

### SECTION 4: NEXT STEPS / CALL TO ACTION
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 7.7 (bottom area, acima do page number)
**Text box:** Full width, background destacado

**Formato:**
"Próximos passos: [Ação 1] até [Data] | [Ação 2] até [Data] | [Decisão crítica] requerida em [Data]"

**Exemplo:**
"Próximos passos: (1) Aprovação do business case até 15/Jan/25 | (2) Seleção de vendor technology até 28/Fev/25 | (3) Go/No-Go decision no Board meeting de Março/25"

**Especificações:**
- **Background:** #FFF9E6 (light yellow - atenção) OU #E3F2FD (light blue - info)
- **Border:** 2pt left border, #FBC02D (yellow) ou #1976D2 (blue)
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Medium (entre Regular e Bold)
- **Tamanho:** 11pt
- **Cor:** #000000
- **Padding:** 8pt all sides
- **Border radius:** 4px

**Regras:**
- SEMPRE incluir datas específicas
- SEMPRE incluir owners (se apropriado)
- Linguagem de ação ("Aprovar", "Decidir", "Iniciar")
- Max 3-4 ações (se mais, não é executive summary!)

---

## LAYOUT ALTERNATIVO: "SO WHAT" STRUCTURE

**Para situações onde visual não é central, usar estrutura:**

### Top (20% do slide)
- Action title

### Middle-Left (70%, colunas 1-7)
- 3 key findings (bullets)

### Middle-Right (30%, colunas 8-12)
- "So What" box destacado
- Implicação estratégica principal
- Risk/upside quantificado

### Bottom (10%)
- Next steps

---

## CHECKLIST DE QUALIDADE - EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Conteúdo:**
- [ ] Action title tem número quantitativo?
- [ ] Cada bullet tem métrica ($ ou %)?
- [ ] MECE (bullets não se sobrepõem)?
- [ ] Ordem por importância (não cronológica)?
- [ ] Next steps têm datas específicas?
- [ ] "So what" é cristalino para não-especialista?

**Visual:**
- [ ] Chart é self-explanatory (sem explicação verbal)?
- [ ] Data labels todos visíveis e legíveis?
- [ ] Colors seguem paleta aprovada?
- [ ] Legend presente (se necessário)?
- [ ] Eixos labeled claramente?

**Tipografia:**
- [ ] Bold usado para destacar insights chave?
- [ ] Tamanho de fonte >11pt para corpo do texto?
- [ ] Contrast ratio >4.5:1 (WCAG AA mínimo)?
- [ ] Line height 1.4-1.6 para legibilidade?
- [ ] Sem text walls (max 2-3 linhas por bullet)?

**Density:**
- [ ] Informação suficiente mas não overwhelming?
- [ ] White space adequado (não cramped)?
- [ ] Visual balance entre texto e gráfico?
- [ ] Pode ser entendido em 60 segundos?

**Strategic:**
- [ ] C-level pode tomar decisão com este slide?
- [ ] Alinha com Pyramid Principle (resposta primeiro)?
- [ ] Risks/downsides endereçados (se material)?
- [ ] Competição/alternatives considerados?

---

## EXEMPLO COMPLETO

**SLIDE 2 - EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**

**ACTION TITLE:**
**Texto:** "Estratégia de crescimento via M&A + digital pode gerar $320M EBITDA adicional até 2027 (vs $180M baseline), exigindo $150M investment e Board approval Q1/2025"
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold, 20pt, #003B5C, left-aligned

---

**KEY FINDINGS (Colunas 1-7):**

**1. M&A é critical path para atingir scale**
Target de 3 acquisitions ($50-80M cada) em sectors adjacentes pode adicionar $180M revenue até 2027, vs crescimento orgânico limitado a 8% CAGR (insuficiente)

**2. Digital transformation pode dobrar conversão**
Investing $40M em personalization engine e mobile-first experience aumenta conversão de 18% para 35%, gerando $95M incremental revenue anualmente a partir de 2026

**3. Operational excellence libera $45M EBITDA**
Consolidação de 9 para 5 manufacturing sites + automation initiatives reduz COGS em 12% ($45M annually) com payback de 18 meses

**Especificações:**
- Números: Green circles (#00A86B), 32px diameter, white "1", "2", "3" em 16pt Bold
- Títulos: 14pt Bold, #000000
- Descrições: 12pt Regular, #000000, line-height 1.5
- Spacing: 28pt entre bullets

---

**VISUAL (Colunas 8-12):**

**Value Waterfall Chart:**
- Baseline EBITDA 2024: $180M (navy bar)
- +M&A contribution: +$95M (green bar)
- +Digital revenue: +$95M (green bar)
- +OpEx reduction: +$45M (green bar)
- -Investment cost: -$150M amortized → -$50M impact (red bar)
- Target EBITDA 2027: $365M → Net increase $185M (navy bar)

**Chart specs:**
- Width: 100% de colunas 8-12
- Height: Linhas 3-7.2
- Y-axis: $0-400M, gridlines every $50M
- Data labels: Above each bar, 12pt Bold
- Colors: #003B5C (baseline/target), #00A86B (adds), #D32F2F (subtract)

---

**NEXT STEPS (Bottom):**
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 7.7
**Texto:** "Próximos passos: (1) Board approval de $150M investment - Jan 15, 2025 | (2) M&A target screening e LOI - Q1 2025 | (3) Digital vendor selection - Feb 28, 2025"
**Background:** #FFF9E6, 2pt left border #FBC02D
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Medium, 11pt, #000000

---

**PAGE NUMBER:** "2" - Coluna 11.5, Linha 7.9, 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E

---

## FONTES DE DADOS - EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**SEMPRE incluir em rodapé (small print):**

**Posição:** Colunas 1-10, below linha 8 (fora da área principal, no bottom margin)
**Formato:**
"Fonte: Company financials (2021-2024); Market analysis (Gartner, Forrester 2024); M&A comparables (Capital IQ); Management interviews (Nov-Dec 2024); McKinsey analysis"

**Especificações:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Light
- **Tamanho:** 8pt
- **Cor:** #B0B0B0 (light gray - não compete com conteúdo)
- **Line height:** 1.2
- **Max width:** 85% do slide width

---

**VERSÃO:** 1.0
**OWNER:** GPT McKinsey PPT Architect
**ÚLTIMA ATUALIZAÇÃO:** Dezembro 2024


## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/financial.md

# Template: Financial/P&L Slide

## Purpose
Apresentar performance financeira, business case, ROI analysis, P&L bridges com máxima precisão e credibilidade.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - FINANCIAL SLIDE

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** Número sequencial
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

---

### ACTION TITLE
**Posição:** Topo
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1

**Estrutura obrigatória:**
"[METRIC] + [PERFORMANCE vs BENCHMARK/PRIOR] + [DRIVERS] + [IMPLICATION]"

**Exemplos:**

✅ "EBITDA cresceu $45M (+32%) para $185M em 2024 via expansion de margin (4pp) e volume growth (18%), superando guidance de $170M"

✅ "ROI de transformation program atingiu 4.2× com payback de 14 meses, validando business case e suportando Phase 2 approval de $80M"

✅ "Free cash flow melhorou $120M para $340M através de working capital optimization (60% do ganho) e CAPEX discipline (40%)"

**Especificações:**
- Fonte: Helvetica Neue Bold, 16-18pt, #003B5C
- Numbers: Sempre em bold (mesmo dentro do título)
- Line height: 1.3
- Max linhas: 2

---

## FINANCIAL TABLE SPECIFICATIONS

### P&L TABLE (Income Statement)

**Quando usar:**
- Performance review
- Budget vs actual
- Multi-period comparison

**Estrutura:**

**Dimensions:**
- Width: Colunas 1-12 (full width)
- Position: Linhas 2-7
- Rows: 12-18 (mais que isso → summarize ou split)

**Column structure (típico):**

| Item | 2022 | 2023 | 2024E | Growth 23-24 | % of Revenue |
|------|------|------|-------|--------------|--------------|

**Header row:**
- Background: #003B5C (navy blue - McKinsey style)
- Font: 11pt Bold, #FFFFFF
- Height: 0.8cm
- Alignment: Center (numbers), Left (labels)
- Borders: 1pt white (separar colunas)

**Data rows:**
- Alternating: White / #FAFAFA (zebra striping para legibility)
- Font: 10pt Regular, #000000
- Height: 0.6cm
- Padding: 4pt top/bottom, 8pt left/right
- Alignment:
  - Item names: Left
  - Numbers: Right
  - Percentages: Right

**Row categories:**

**REVENUE (Top section):**
- Row 1: "Revenue" - 11pt Bold, #000000
- Indented sub-items (se breakdown):
  - "  Product A" - 10pt Regular, indent 12pt
  - "  Product B"
  - "  Services"
- Border bottom: 2pt #003B5C após last revenue item

**COGS:**
- "Cost of Goods Sold" - 10pt Regular
- Sub-items se relevant

**GROSS PROFIT:**
- Row: "Gross Profit" - 11pt Bold, background #E8F5E9 (light green highlight)
- Border: 1pt top e bottom, #00A86B

**OPEX:**
- "Operating Expenses" header
- Sub-items:
  - Sales & Marketing
  - R&D
  - G&A
- Border bottom: 1pt após last opex

**EBITDA:**
- "EBITDA" - 12pt Bold, background #E8F5E9 (light green)
- Border: 2pt top e bottom, #00A86B (key metric!)

**D&A:**
- "Depreciation & Amortization"

**EBIT:**
- "EBIT" - 11pt Bold, background #E8F5E9

**Interest, Tax:**
- Standard rows

**NET INCOME:**
- "Net Income" - 12pt Bold, background #C8E6C9 (darker green - bottom line)
- Border: 3pt top e bottom, #00A86B

**Number formatting:**
- Currency: "$XXM" OU "$XX,XXXK" (consistent units!)
- Decimals: 0-1 decimal places (não mais)
- Negative numbers: "($XX)" em red #D32F2F OU "-$XX"
- Percentages: "XX%" ou "XX.X%"
- Growth: "+XX%" (green #00A86B) ou "-XX%" (red #D32F2F)

**Variance columns:**
- Calculation: (2024 - 2023) / 2023 × 100%
- Conditional formatting:
  - Positive revenue/profit growth: Green #00A86B
  - Negative: Red #D32F2F
  - Cost reduction: Green (lower is better)
- Bold se variance >10% (material)

**% of Revenue column:**
- Calculation: Item / Revenue × 100%
- Format: "XX%" ou "XX.X%"
- Benchmark comparison (opcional): Small arrow ↑↓ se vs peers

**Borders:**
- Outer border: 2pt, #003B5C (frame todo table)
- Section dividers: 1pt, #E0E0E0 (between REVENUE, COGS, OPEX, etc.)
- Key metrics: 2-3pt, #00A86B (EBITDA, Net Income)

**Exemplo completo:**

**P&L TABLE - 3-Year Performance**

| P&L Item | 2022 | 2023 | 2024E | Var % | % Rev |
|----------|------|------|-------|-------|-------|
| **Revenue** | $450M | $520M | $615M | **+18%** | 100% |
| Product A | $250M | $290M | $350M | +21% | 57% |
| Product B | $150M | $170M | $195M | +15% | 32% |
| Services | $50M | $60M | $70M | +17% | 11% |
| **COGS** | ($225M) | ($255M) | ($295M) | +16% | 48% |
| **Gross Profit** | **$225M** | **$265M** | **$320M** | **+21%** | **52%** ⬆ |
| Operating Expenses | ($135M) | ($155M) | ($175M) | +13% | 28% |
| S&M | ($70M) | ($80M) | ($90M) | +13% | 15% |
| R&D | ($40M) | ($48M) | ($55M) | +15% | 9% |
| G&A | ($25M) | ($27M) | ($30M) | +11% | 5% |
| **EBITDA** | **$90M** | **$110M** | **$145M** | **+32%** | **24%** ⬆ |
| D&A | ($15M) | ($18M) | ($22M) | +22% | 4% |
| **EBIT** | **$75M** | **$92M** | **$123M** | **+34%** | **20%** |
| Interest | ($5M) | ($6M) | ($7M) | +17% | 1% |
| Tax | ($21M) | ($26M) | ($35M) | +35% | 6% |
| **Net Income** | **$49M** | **$60M** | **$81M** | **+35%** | **13%** |

**Highlights:**
- Gross Profit row: Background #E8F5E9, Bold
- EBITDA row: Background #E8F5E9, 12pt Bold, 2pt borders
- Net Income: Background #C8E6C9 (darker), 12pt Bold, 3pt borders
- Variance >20%: Bold e colored (green ou red)
- Arrows ⬆⬇ na coluna % Rev: Comparação vs industry benchmark (52% gross margin ⬆ acima de 48% peers)

---

### WATERFALL CHART (Financial Bridge)

**Quando usar:**
- Explicar variance (YoY, budget vs actual, target gaps)
- P&L walkdown
- Value creation in M&A

**Especificações (já detalhadas em template_data_slide, aqui specific to finance):**

**Financial waterfall specifics:**

**Start bar:**
- Label: "FY2023 EBITDA $110M"
- Color: #003B5C
- Full height de zero

**Positive drivers (green bars, floating):**
- Revenue growth: +$42M
- Margin expansion: +$18M
- Cost savings: +$12M
- Colors: #00A86B

**Negative drivers (red bars, floating):**
- Wage inflation: -$15M
- Investment in growth: -$22M
- Colors: #D32F2F

**End bar:**
- Label: "FY2024 EBITDA $145M"
- Color: #003B5C
- Full height

**Labels:**
- Valores: Acima de cada bar, "+$XXM" ou "-$XXM", 11pt Bold
- Sub-labels (opcional): Breakdown dentro do bar se múltiplos componentes

**Connectors:**
- Dashed lines (1pt, #6E6E6E) conectando bars

**Net change callout:**
- Box: "Net: +$35M (+32%)"
- Position: Top-right da chart
- Background: #E8F5E9, border 2pt #00A86B
- Font: 12pt Bold

---

### ROI/BUSINESS CASE TABLE

**Quando usar:**
- Investment approval
- Program business case
- Payback analysis

**Estrutura:**

**Investment section (top):**
| Item | Year 0 | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 | Total |
|------|--------|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| Technology | ($50M) | ($20M) | ($10M) | $0 | ($80M) |
| People/Training | ($10M) | ($5M) | $0 | $0 | ($15M) |
| **Total Investment** | **($60M)** | **($25M)** | **($10M)** | **$0** | **($95M)** |

**Benefits section:**
| Benefit | Year 0 | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 | Total |
|---------|--------|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| Revenue uplift | $0 | $20M | $50M | $80M | $150M |
| Cost reduction | $0 | $15M | $30M | $45M | $90M |
| **Total Benefits** | **$0** | **$35M** | **$80M** | **$125M** | **$240M** |

**Net cash flow:**
| Item | Year 0 | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 | Total |
|------|--------|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Net Cash Flow** | **($60M)** | **$10M** | **$70M** | **$125M** | **$145M** |
| **Cumulative** | ($60M) | ($50M) | $20M | $145M | - |

**Metrics (below table):**
- **Payback Period:** 1.7 years (when cumulative turns positive)
- **ROI:** 153% (Total Benefits / Total Investment - 1)
- **NPV @ 10% discount:** $98M
- **IRR:** 42%

**Formatting:**
- Investment rows: Red text #D32F2F (cash out)
- Benefit rows: Green text #00A86B (cash in)
- Net cash flow: Bold, black
- Cumulative: Italic, conditional color (negative red, positive green)
- Metrics box: Background #FFFDE7, border 2pt #FBC02D left, 11pt Bold

---

### CASH FLOW STATEMENT

**Estrutura (simplified):**
