| Cash Flow Item | 2023 | 2024E | Variance |
|----------------|------|-------|----------|
| **Operating Activities** | | | |
| Net Income | $60M | $81M | +$21M |
| D&A | $18M | $22M | +$4M |
| Change in Working Capital | ($15M) | $8M | +$23M |
| **Cash from Operations** | **$63M** | **$111M** | **+$48M** |
| **Investing Activities** | | | |
| CAPEX | ($35M) | ($42M) | ($7M) |
| Acquisitions | ($20M) | $0 | +$20M |
| **Cash from Investing** | **($55M)** | **($42M)** | **+$13M** |
| **Financing Activities** | | | |
| Debt issuance/(repayment) | $10M | ($15M) | ($25M) |
| Dividends | ($12M) | ($15M) | ($3M) |
| **Cash from Financing** | **($2M)** | **($30M)** | **($28M)** |
| **Net Change in Cash** | **$6M** | **$39M** | **+$33M** |
| Cash, beginning | $45M | $51M | - |
| **Cash, ending** | **$51M** | **$90M** | **+$39M** |

**Key highlights:**
- Cash from Operations: Background #E8F5E9 (green - most important)
- Free Cash Flow (= Operations - CAPEX): Calculated e highlighted
  - FCF 2024: $111M - $42M = $69M (callout box)
- Net Change: Bold, 12pt

---

## KEY METRICS DASHBOARD (Financial)

**Purpose:** Quick snapshot de saúde financeira

**Layout:** 2×3 ou 3×2 grid

**Metric tiles:**

**Tile structure:**
- Size: 3-4cm × 2-2.5cm
- Border: 2pt, color-coded
- Background: White ou subtle color

**Content per tile:**
- **Metric name:** Top, 9pt Regular, #6E6E6E
- **Value:** Center, 24-28pt Bold, #003B5C
- **Trend:** Bottom, 10pt Regular com arrow
  - Format: "↑ +12% vs PY" (green #00A86B)
  - OR: "↓ -8% vs target" (red #D32F2F)
- **Sparkline (opcional):** Mini line chart (last 6-12 periods), 1cm × 0.5cm

**Example tiles:**

**Tile 1: Revenue**
- Name: "Revenue (LTM)"
- Value: "$615M"
- Trend: "↑ +18% YoY" (green)
- Sparkline: Ascending trend

**Tile 2: EBITDA Margin**
- Name: "EBITDA Margin"
- Value: "24%"
- Trend: "↑ +4pp YoY" (green)
- Border: #00A86B (green - good performance)

**Tile 3: Free Cash Flow**
- Name: "Free Cash Flow"
- Value: "$69M"
- Trend: "↑ +85% YoY"

**Tile 4: Net Debt / EBITDA**
- Name: "Net Debt / EBITDA"
- Value: "2.1×"
- Trend: "↓ from 2.8×" (green - improving)

**Tile 5: ROE**
- Name: "Return on Equity"
- Value: "18%"
- Trend: "Top quartile" (benchmark)

**Tile 6: DSO**
- Name: "Days Sales Outstanding"
- Value: "45 days"
- Trend: "↓ from 58 days" (green - improving)

---

## ASSUMPTIONS & FOOTNOTES (Critical for financial slides!)

**Position:** Bottom area, Linha 7.5-7.9 OU dedicated small section

**Format:**
"Assumptions: [List key assumptions]
Notes: [Accounting standards, methodology, exclusions]"

**Example:**
"Assumptions: (1) Revenue growth 15% CAGR 2024-2027 based on pipeline analysis; (2) Gross margin expansion 2pp annually via automation; (3) Forex USD/EUR 1.10 (constant); (4) No major M&A; (5) Tax rate 30% effective
Notes: (1) EBITDA excludes one-time restructuring charges $12M in 2024; (2) GAAP basis; (3) Constant currency analysis for organic growth"

**Specs:**
- Font: 8-9pt Regular, #6E6E6E
- Line height: 1.3
- Max width: 95% do slide
- Background (opcional): #FAFAFA para destacar

---

## CHECKLIST - FINANCIAL SLIDE

**Accuracy:**
- [ ] Numbers foot (rows sum correctly)?
- [ ] Variance calculations correct?
- [ ] Units consistent ($M vs $K vs $)?
- [ ] Decimals appropriate (0-1 places)?
- [ ] Negative numbers formatted correctly?

**Assumptions:**
- [ ] Key assumptions documented?
- [ ] Methodology explained (GAAP vs non-GAAP)?
- [ ] One-time items called out?
- [ ] Foreign exchange approach stated?
- [ ] Sources cited (audited financials vs management)?

**Visual:**
- [ ] Key metrics highlighted (color/bold)?
- [ ] Positive/negative clearly distinguished (green/red)?
- [ ] Borders emphasize hierarchy?
- [ ] Zebra striping aids readability?
- [ ] Not overwhelming (max 20 rows)?

**Comparisons:**
- [ ] Benchmarks included (vs peers, vs budget)?
- [ ] Variance drivers explained?
- [ ] Trend clear (multi-period view)?
- [ ] Outliers annotated?

**Credibility:**
- [ ] Conservative assumptions (não overly optimistic)?
- [ ] Sensitivity analysis (se business case)?
- [ ] Risks/downsides acknowledged?
- [ ] Board/CFO review completed?

---

## SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS (Tornado Chart)

**Purpose:** Show impact of key variables

**Structure:**
- Horizontal bars: Cada variável (ex: Revenue growth, Margin, Discount rate)
- X-axis: Impact em NPV ou ROI (ex: $50M to $150M)
- Centerline: Base case (ex: $100M NPV)
- Bar extends left (downside scenario) e right (upside scenario)
- Colors: Downside #D32F2F (red), Upside #00A86B (green)
- Order: Largest range at top (most impactful variable)

**Example:**
- Revenue growth: Downside $75M (-25%) to Upside $130M (+30%) = $55M range
- Gross margin: $85M to $118M = $33M range
- Discount rate: $92M to $109M = $17M range

---

**VERSÃO:** 1.0
**OWNER:** GPT McKinsey PPT Architect
**ÚLTIMA ATUALIZAÇÃO:** Dezembro 2024


## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/framework.md

# Template: Framework/Conceptual Slide

## Purpose
Apresentar frameworks estratégicos, modelos conceituais, methodologias. Traduzir conceitos abstratos em visual claro e memorable.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - FRAMEWORK SLIDE

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** Número sequencial
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

---

### ACTION TITLE
**Posição:** Topo
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1

**Estrutura:**
"[FRAMEWORK NAME] + [APLICAÇÃO AO CONTEXTO] + [INSIGHT PRINCIPAL]"

**Exemplos:**

✅ "Growth-Share Matrix posiciona 3 de 5 produtos como 'Stars', validando strategy de dobrar investimento em R&D"

✅ "Pyramid Principle revela 4 pilares estratégicos com 12 initiatives alinhadas, clarificando roadmap para os próximos 18 meses"

✅ "Value Chain analysis identifica procurement como maior opportunity ($45M savings), concentrando transformation efforts"

**Especificações:**
- Fonte: Helvetica Neue Bold, 16-18pt, #003B5C
- Alignment: Left
- Line height: 1.3
- Max linhas: 2

---

## FRAMEWORK TYPES & SPECIFICATIONS

### TYPE 1: 2×2 MATRIX (BCG Matrix, Ansoff, Eisenhower, etc.)

**Quando usar:**
- Segmentação em 4 categorias
- 2 dimensões de avaliação
- Portfolio analysis

**Especificações da estrutura:**

**Dimensions:**
- Width: 18cm (colunas 1.5-11)
- Height: 12cm (linhas 2-6.5)
- Center: Intersection at 50/50 (unless asymmetric by design)

**Axes:**
- Horizontal axis: 3pt line, #003B5C
- Vertical axis: 3pt line, #003B5C
- Arrows: 12pt arrowheads em ambos os ends

**Axis labels:**
- X-axis: Bottom (left label) e Top (right label)
  - Example: "Low ← Market Attractiveness → High"
  - Font: 12pt Bold, #000000
  - Position: Centered horizontalmente, 0.5cm from axis

- Y-axis: Left (bottom label) e Right (top label)
  - Example: "Weak ↓ Competitive Position ↑ Strong"
  - Font: 12pt Bold, #000000
  - Rotation: 90° (vertical)
  - Position: Centered verticalmente, 0.5cm from axis

**Quadrant backgrounds:**
- **Option A (subtle):** Cada quadrante cor diferente, 15% opacity
  - Top-right (best): #E8F5E9 (light green)
  - Top-left: #FFF9E6 (light yellow)
  - Bottom-right: #FFEBEE (light red)
  - Bottom-left: #F5F5F5 (light gray)

- **Option B (clean):** Sem background colors, apenas borders
  - Dividing lines: 1pt, #E0E0E0

**Quadrant labels:**
- Position: Canto superior de cada quadrante
- Font: 14pt Bold, #6E6E6E
- Examples: "Stars", "Cash Cows", "Question Marks", "Dogs"

**Data points (bubbles):**
- Size: Proporcional a 3ª dimensão (ex: revenue)
- Color: By category ou by quadrant
- Border: 2pt white (para destacar)
- Opacity: 85-90%

**Labels dos pontos:**
- Inside bubble (se couber): 10pt Bold, white ou black (depends on contrast)
- Outside com connector line (se não couber): 9pt Regular, background white 80%

**Legend:**
- Position: Bottom-right, fora do matrix
- Format:
  - Bubble sizes: "○ $100M | ◉ $500M | ⬤ $1B+"
  - Colors: Square + Label (se by category)

**Exemplo completo:**

**2×2 MATRIX - BCG Growth-Share para Portfolio de 8 Produtos**

**Axes:**
- X-axis: "Low (5%) ← Market Growth Rate → High (25%)"
- Y-axis: "Low (5%) ← Relative Market Share → High (3×)"
- Intersection: 10% growth (horizontal), 1× share (vertical)

**Quadrants:**
- Top-right: "Stars" (#E8F5E9 background, 15% opacity)
- Top-left: "Question Marks" (#FFF9E6 background)
- Bottom-right: "Cash Cows" (#E3F2FD background)
- Bottom-left: "Dogs" (#FFEBEE background)

**Bubbles:**
- Product A: Top-right (Star), 15% growth, 2.1× share, bubble Ø80px (revenue $450M)
- Product B: Top-right (Star), 18% growth, 1.8× share, bubble Ø65px ($320M)
- Product C: Bottom-right (Cash Cow), 6% growth, 2.5× share, bubble Ø90px ($580M)
- Product D-H: Positioned accordingly
- Colors: All #003B5C with 85% opacity
- Labels: Product names inside bubbles, white text 10pt Bold

**Legend:**
- Bubble size guide: ○ $100M | ◉ $300M | ⬤ $500M+
- Position: Linha 7, Colunas 9-12

**Annotations:**
- Arrow: De "Question Mark X" para "Star" quadrant, 2pt #00A86B, dashed
- Label: "Strategic move: Invest to gain share" - 9pt Italic

---

### TYPE 2: PYRAMID (Hierarchy, Maslow, Pyramid Principle)

**Quando usar:**
- Hierarquias
- Frameworks building blocks
- Priorização em níveis

**Especificações:**

**Pyramid structure:**
- Levels: 3-5 (ideal: 4)
- Width progression: Cada nível 15-20% mais estreito que anterior
- Height: Níveis iguais OU base maior (emphasize foundation)

**Dimensions:**
- Total width (base): 16cm
- Total height: 10-12cm
- Center-aligned horizontalmente

**Colors:**
- Gradient top-to-bottom (subtle)
- OR solid colors diferentes por nível
- Borders: 2pt white (separar níveis)

**Level labels:**
- Inside cada nível: 12-14pt Bold, color com contrast >4.5:1
- Format: "Level name" + "Key descriptor"

**Example - Pyramid Principle:**

**Level 1 (Top):** "Main Answer/Conclusion"
- Width: 6cm, height: 2cm
- Color: #003B5C
- Text: 14pt Bold, #FFFFFF, center

**Level 2:** "3 Supporting Arguments"
- Width: 10cm, height: 2.5cm
- Color: #00A86B (lighter than top)
- Text: 12pt Bold, #FFFFFF
- Split em 3 sections com dividers

**Level 3:** "9 Supporting Facts"
- Width: 14cm, height: 2.5cm
- Color: #81C784 (lighter ainda)
- Text: 10pt Regular, #000000
- Split em 9 small sections

**Level 4 (Base):** "Data & Evidence"
- Width: 16cm, height: 3cm
- Color: #C8E6C9 (lightest)
- Text: 10pt Regular, #000000

**Side annotations:**
- Brace/bracket indicando groupings
- Labels: "Strategic", "Tactical", "Operational" (dependendo do framework)

---

### TYPE 3: PROCESS FLOW (Linear, Cyclical)

**Quando usar:**
- Processos sequenciais
- Customer journeys
- Implementation roadmaps
- Continuous improvement cycles

**Especificações LINEAR:**

**Boxes:**
- Quantity: 4-7 steps (ideal: 5)
- Size: 3cm × 2cm cada (uniform)
- Spacing: 1cm entre boxes
- Alignment: Horizontal, center-aligned verticalmente

**Arrows:**
- Width: 2pt
- Color: #003B5C
- Style: Solid line com arrowhead
- Size: Arrowhead 8-10pt

**Step boxes:**
- Border: 2pt, cor matching step status
  - Completed: #00A86B (green)
  - In progress: #FF6F00 (orange)
  - Not started: #B0BEC5 (gray)
- Background: White OR 10% opacity da border color
- Border radius: 6px (rounded corners)

**Step labels:**
- Number: Circle no topo do box, 24px Ø, background matching border color
  - Text: "1", "2", "3"... em white, 12pt Bold
- Title: 12pt Bold, #000000, inside box, top area
- Description: 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E, inside box, bottom area (2-3 linhas max)

**Timeline (opcional):**
- Below boxes: Horizontal line com time markers
- Format: "Week 1-4", "Month 2", "Q3 2025"
- Font: 9pt Regular, #6E6E6E

**Example - 5 Step Process:**

**Step 1: Diagnose**
- Box: 3×2cm, border 2pt #00A86B (completed), radius 6px
- Number: Circle "1", green background
- Title: "Diagnose" - 12pt Bold
- Description: "Assess current state via interviews + data analysis" - 10pt
- Time: "Weeks 1-2" below

**Steps 2-5:** Similar structure, progressively different status colors

**Arrows:** Connecting each box, 2pt #003B5C, 1cm length

---

**Especificações CYCLICAL (circular/continuous):**

**Circle structure:**
- Diameter: 12-14cm
- Center: Middle do slide
- Segments: 4-6 (ideally divisível por círculo)

**Segments:**
- Equal angles (ex: 4 segments = 90° cada)
- Curved borders separating: 2pt white
- Colors: Alternating shades ou sequential gradient
- Direction: Clockwise (standard)

**Arrows (circular):**
- Curved arrows indicando direction
- Width: 3pt
- Color: #003B5C
- Position: Between segments (outside circle)

**Segment labels:**
- Outside: 12pt Bold, #000000, radial alignment
- Inside: Ícone + brief descriptor, 10pt Regular

**Center label:**
- Circle: 3cm Ø
- Content: Core concept ("Continuous Improvement", "Customer-Centric")
- Font: 14pt Bold, #003B5C

**Example - PDCA Cycle:**

4 segments (Plan, Do, Check, Act), 90° each, clockwise
- Segment colors: #E3F2FD, #C5E1A5, #FFF9C4, #FFCCBC
- Center: "PDCA Cycle" em 3cm circle
- Arrows: Curved, between segments, clockwise
- Each segment: Ícone + "Plan: Define objectives" (etc)

---

### TYPE 4: PILLARS / BUILDING BLOCKS

**Quando usar:**
- Strategic pillars
- Foundation + components
- Multi-dimensional frameworks

**Especificações:**

**Base/Foundation:**
- Width: Full width (20cm)
- Height: 1.5-2cm
- Color: #003B5C (navy - strong foundation)
- Label: "Foundation: [Core principle]" - 13pt Bold, #FFFFFF

**Pillars:**
- Quantity: 3-5 (ideal: 4)
- Width: 3-4cm cada
- Height: 6-8cm
- Spacing: 1-1.5cm entre pillars
- Top-aligned no foundation

**Pillar design:**
- Shape: Rectangle com top ligeiramente mais largo (architectural pillar)
- Color: Unique per pillar (#00A86B, #1976D2, #FF6F00, #7E57C2)
- Border: None ou 2pt darker shade
- Gradient: Subtle vertical (darker bottom → lighter top)

**Pillar labels:**
- Title: Inside, top area, 14pt Bold, #FFFFFF
- Sub-bullets: 2-4 items, 10pt Regular, #FFFFFF, indented
- Icon: Top de cada pillar, 32×32px, white

**Roof/Top element (opcional):**
- Triangular top conectando pillars
- Label: "Vision: [Ultimate goal]"
- Color: Lighter shade, #78909C

**Example - 4 Pillars of Strategy:**

**Foundation:**
- "Customer-Centricity as Core Principle"
- Full width, 2cm height, #003B5C

**Pillar 1: Customer Experience**
- 3.5×7cm, #00A86B
- Icon: User (32px, white)
- Title: "Customer Experience"
- Bullets: "• NPS >70", "• <2h response time", "• Omnichannel"

**Pillars 2-4:** Similar, different colors e content

**Roof:**
- Triangle spanning all 4 pillars
- "Vision: Market Leader by 2027"
- #B0BEC5, 12pt Bold

---

### TYPE 5: FUNNEL (Conversion, Sales Pipeline)

**Quando usar:**
- Conversion processes
- Sales funnels
- Customer acquisition journeys

**Especificações:**

**Funnel shape:**
- Trapezoids stacked, progressively narrower
- Stages: 4-6 (ex: Awareness → Interest → Consideration → Purchase → Loyalty)
- Total width (top): 18cm
- Total width (bottom): 6cm
- Total height: 12cm

**Stage design:**
- Height: Equal OU proportional ao volume (wider stages taller)
- Colors: Gradient top-to-bottom (#E3F2FD → #003B5C)
- Borders: 2pt white separating stages
- Alignment: Center-aligned

**Labels (inside cada stage):**
- Stage name: 12pt Bold, color com contrast
- Volume: 14pt Bold (ex: "10,000 leads")
- Conversion rate: 11pt Regular (ex: "↓ 40% convert")

**Side metrics:**
- Right side: Percentages ou absolute numbers
- Left side: Drop-off rates
- Font: 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E

**Annotations:**
- Arrows pointing to leaks/issues
- Boxes com improvement opportunities

**Example - Sales Funnel:**

**Stage 1 (Top): Awareness**
- Width: 18cm, height: 2cm
- Color: #E3F2FD (light blue)
- Label: "Awareness | 100,000 visitors" - black text
- Side: "100%" (right)

**Stage 2: Interest**
- Width: 15cm, height: 2cm
- Color: #90CAF9 (medium blue)
- Label: "Interest | 25,000 signups"
- Side: "25%" (right), "-75,000 (-75%)" (left, red)

**Stages 3-5:** Progressive narrowing

**Final Stage: Loyalty**
- Width: 6cm, height: 2cm
- Color: #003B5C (navy)
- Label: "Loyalty | 2,500 repeat customers" - white text
- Side: "2.5%" (cumulative conversion)

**Annotation:**
- Arrow pointing to Stage 2→3 drop: "Largest leak: Onboarding friction" - 10pt, #D32F2F

---

## SUPPORTING ELEMENTS

### FRAMEWORK SOURCE / ATTRIBUTION
**Posição:** Próximo ao framework visual, não intrusivo
**Formato:** Small text box

**Template:**
"Fonte: [Framework name] desenvolvido por [Author/Firm], adaptado para [Client context]"

**Exemplo:**
"Fonte: BCG Growth-Share Matrix (1970), adaptado para análise de portfolio digital"

**Specs:**
- Font: 9pt Italic, #6E6E6E
- Background: None ou #F9F9F9 (subtle)
- Border: None

---

### KEY TAKEAWAYS BOX
**Posição:** Linha 7-7.8, Colunas 1-12 (bottom area)
**Purpose:** 2-3 key insights do framework

**Formato:**
"✓ [Insight 1]
✓ [Insight 2]
✓ [Insight 3]"

**Specs:**
- Background: #E8F5E9 (light green)
- Border: 2pt left, #00A86B
- Padding: 10pt
- Font: 11pt Regular, #000000
- Checkmarks: 12pt, #00A86B

---

## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/timeline-roadmap.md

# Template: Timeline/Roadmap Slide

## Purpose
Apresentar sequências temporais, implementation plans, project roadmaps, milestones. Criar senso de momentum e clareza na execução.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - TIMELINE/ROADMAP

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11.5-12, Linha 7.9
**Formato:** Número sequencial
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 10pt, #6E6E6E

---

### ACTION TITLE
**Posição:** Topo
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, Linha 1

**Estrutura:**
"[PROGRAMA/INITIATIVE] + [TIMELINE SPAN] + [KEY MILESTONE/OUTCOME]"

**Exemplos:**

✅ "Transformation roadmap de 18 meses (Q1/25-Q2/26) entrega $80M impact via 5 waves sequenciadas, com quick wins em primeiros 90 dias"

✅ "Product development timeline comprime go-to-market de 12 para 7 meses através de parallel workstreams, targeting launch Q3/2025"

✅ "Integration plan de 24 meses consolida operations até Q4/2026 com 3 major milestones e $45M synergy realization"

**Especificações:**
- Fonte: Helvetica Neue Bold, 16-18pt, #003B5C
- Line height: 1.3
- Max linhas: 2

---

## TIMELINE FORMATS

### FORMAT 1: HORIZONTAL GANTT-STYLE

**Quando usar:**
- Project plans com múltiplos workstreams
- Overlapping initiatives
- Resource allocation over time

**Estrutura:**

**Time axis (horizontal, top):**
- Position: Linha 2, Colunas 2-12
- Span: Quarters, months, ou weeks (depends on duration)
- Line: 2pt, #003B5C
- Markers: Vertical ticks para cada period
- Labels: Above axis, 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E
  - Format: "Q1 2025", "Jan", "Week 1"
  - Spacing: Equal intervals

**Swim lanes (vertical):**
- Quantity: 4-7 workstreams/initiatives
- Height: 1-1.2cm cada
- Position: Linhas 2.5-7, full width
- Labels: Left side (colunas 1-1.5), 11pt Bold, #000000
  - Examples: "Technology", "Process", "People", "Governance"
- Alternating backgrounds: White / #FAFAFA (zebra striping)

**Activity bars:**
- Height: 80% da swim lane height (deixa spacing)
- Color: Status-based
  - Completed: #00A86B (green), 100% opacity
  - In progress: #FF6F00 (orange), 100% opacity
  - Planned: #B0BEC5 (gray), 60% opacity
- Border radius: 4px (rounded)
- Border: None ou 1pt darker shade

**Bar labels:**
- Inside bar (se couber): 10pt Bold, white ou black (contrast dependent)
- Format: "[Activity name]" OU "[Name] • [Duration]"
- Truncate com "..." se too long

**Dependencies (arrows):**
- Connecting bars: 2pt dashed line, #6E6E6E
- Arrowhead: 8pt, indicating dependency direction
- Apenas mostrar critical path dependencies (não todas!)

**Milestones:**
- Symbol: Diamond (◆) 16pt
- Color: #D32F2F (red - draw attention)
- Position: On timeline, acima do swim lanes
- Label: Below diamond, 9pt Regular, #000000
  - Format: "Go-Live" | "UAT Complete" | "Board Approval"
- Vertical dashed line: Connecting milestone to relevant bars

**Today marker:**
- Vertical line: 3pt, #FF6F00 (orange)
- Label: "Today" at top, 10pt Bold
- Full height through all swim lanes

**Exemplo completo:**

**HORIZONTAL GANTT - Digital Transformation (18 months: Q1/25-Q2/26)**

**Time axis:**
- Q1/25 | Q2/25 | Q3/25 | Q4/25 | Q1/26 | Q2/26
- Positioned at Linha 2, even spacing

**Swim lane 1: Technology Platform**
- Bar 1: "CRM Implementation" - Q1-Q2/25 (green, completed)
- Bar 2: "Data Warehouse Migration" - Q2-Q4/25 (orange, in progress)
- Bar 3: "AI/ML Layer" - Q4/25-Q2/26 (gray, planned)

**Swim lanes 2-5:** Similar structure para Process, People, Governance, Change Management

**Milestones:**
- ◆ "Phase 1 Go-Live" - End of Q2/25
- ◆ "Full Integration" - End of Q1/26
- ◆ "Value Realization" - End of Q2/26

**Today line:** Vertical orange at mid-Q4/24

**Dependencies:**
- Arrow de "CRM Implementation" → "Data Warehouse" (dashed)
- Arrow de "Data Warehouse" → "AI/ML Layer"

---

### FORMAT 2: VERTICAL TIMELINE (Historical ou Sequential)

**Quando usar:**
- Historical evolution
- Sequential phases (não parallel)
- Storytelling linear

**Estrutura:**

**Vertical axis (left):**
- Line: 3pt, #003B5C, vertical
- Length: Linhas 2-7.5
- Position: Coluna 2

**Time markers:**
- Circles on line: 20px Ø, #003B5C fill
- Inner circle: 8px Ø, white (donut style)
- Spacing: Even intervals (ex: 1.5cm apart para 4-6 events)

**Time labels:**
- Left of line (Coluna 1-1.5): Date/period
- Font: 12pt Bold, #003B5C
- Format: "Q1 2023", "Jan 2024", "Phase 1"
- Alignment: Right-aligned to line

**Event boxes:**
- Position: Right of timeline (Colunas 2.5-12)
- Size: Variable width (based on content), 1.5-2cm height
- Background: Alternating slight offset (stagger para avoid monotony)
- Border: 2pt left, color-coded by phase/status
  - Past: #00A86B (green)
  - Present: #FF6F00 (orange)
  - Future: #1976D2 (blue)

**Event content:**
- Title: 12pt Bold, #000000
- Description: 10pt Regular, #6E6E6E, 1-2 linhas
- Icon (opcional): 24×24px, left side

**Connector lines:**
- From circle to event box: 2pt, #E0E0E0
- Horizontal, 0.5-1cm length

**Exemplo:**

**VERTICAL TIMELINE - Company Evolution 2020-2025**

**2020 - Founded**
- Circle on vertical line
- Box (right): "Company founded with $5M seed funding, 12 employees"
- Border: 2pt green (past)

**2021 - Product Launch**
- Circle
- Box: "V1.0 launched, acquired first 50 customers, $2M ARR"
- Border: 2pt green

**2022 - Series A**
- Circle
- Box: "Raised $25M Series A, expanded to 80 employees, entered EU market"
- Border: 2pt green

**2023 - Scaling**
- Circle
- Box: "Reached $15M ARR, launched enterprise tier, 200 customers"
- Border: 2pt green

**2024 - Present**
- Circle (larger, 24px, highlighted)
- Box: "Current: $40M ARR, 500+ customers, preparing Series B"
- Border: 2pt orange (present)

**2025 - Target**
- Circle (dashed border, indicating future)
- Box: "Target: $100M ARR, market leader, potential IPO evaluation"
- Border: 2pt blue (future)

---

### FORMAT 3: PHASED ROADMAP (Waves/Sprints)

**Quando usar:**
- Agile delivery
- Wave-based transformation
- Incremental rollout

**Estrutura:**

**Phases (horizontal bands):**
- Width: Full width (Colunas 1-12)
- Heights: Proporcionais ou iguais
- Position: Stacked verticalmente, Linhas 2-7.5
- Colors: Gradient progression (#E3F2FD → #1976D2 - light to dark)
- Borders: 2pt white between phases

**Phase labels:**
- Left side: Large number + phase name
  - Number: 48pt Bold, 20% opacity, background
  - Name: 14pt Bold, #FFFFFF ou #000000 (contrast)
- Example: "1 | FOUNDATION" | "2 | BUILD" | "3 | SCALE"

**Timeline markers (top):**
- Months/quarters across phases
- Format: Small labels, 9pt Regular, #6E6E6E

**Content inside phases:**
- Bullets: 2-5 key initiatives per phase
- Font: 10pt Regular, color with good contrast
- Icons: 20×20px, matching phase theme
- Deliverables: Bold
- Metrics: In brackets, ex: "CRM rollout [500 users]"

**Phase outcomes (right side):**
- Box summarizing phase value
- Background: #FFFDE7 (light yellow)
- Border: 2pt #FBC02D (yellow) left border
- Content: "Value: $X M | Time: Y weeks"
- Font: 10pt Bold

**Transition points:**
- Gates between phases: Vertical dashed line
- Label: "Gate 1: Steering Committee Approval" - 9pt Italic
- Icon: Checkpoint symbol

**Exemplo:**

**PHASED ROADMAP - 3-Wave Transformation (12 months)**

**WAVE 1: FOUNDATION (Months 1-3)**
- Background: #E3F2FD (light blue)
- Number: "1" em 48pt, 20% opacity
- Content:
  • Current state assessment [6 weeks]
  • Technology selection [4 weeks]
  • Pilot team formation [2 weeks]
  • Quick wins identification
- Outcome box: "Value: $5M quick wins | Time: 12 weeks"
- Gate: "✓ Business Case Approved"

**WAVE 2: BUILD (Months 4-8)**
- Background: #90CAF9 (medium blue)
- Number: "2"
- Content:
  • Core platform deployment [500 users]
  • Process redesign [15 processes]
  • Training program [200 people]
  • Change management
- Outcome: "Value: $35M run-rate | Time: 20 weeks"
- Gate: "✓ UAT Passed"

**WAVE 3: SCALE (Months 9-12)**
- Background: #1976D2 (dark blue)
- Number: "3"
- Content:
  • Enterprise rollout [2,000 users]
  • Advanced features [AI/ML]
  • Optimization & tuning
  • Full value capture
- Outcome: "Value: $80M total | Time: 16 weeks"
- Gate: "✓ Go-Live Complete"

---

### FORMAT 4: CALENDAR/SPRINT VIEW

**Quando usar:**
- Short-term planning (weeks/months)
- Sprint planning
- Detailed scheduling

**Estrutura:**

**Calendar grid:**
- Columns: Days ou weeks
- Rows: Workstreams ou teams
- Cell size: 1.5-2cm × 1.5-2cm
- Gridlines: 1pt, #E0E0E0

**Header row:**
- Dates/periods: 10pt Bold, #000000
- Background: #F5F5F5
- Example: "Week 1 (Jan 2-8)" | "Week 2 (Jan 9-15)"

**Activity cells:**
- Fill color: By status ou type
  - Design: #E3F2FD (blue)
  - Development: #C8E6C9 (green)
  - Testing: #FFF9C4 (yellow)
  - Deployment: #FFCCBC (coral)
- Text: Activity name, 9pt Regular
- Icon: 16×16px indicating type

**Spanning activities:**
- Multi-cell merge para activities >1 period
- Clear borders: 2pt

**Legend:**
- Bottom-right
- Color squares + labels
- Format: ▢ Design | ▢ Development | ▢ Testing | ▢ Deployment

---

## SUPPORTING ELEMENTS

### RISK/ISSUE FLAGS
**Purpose:** Highlight blockers ou risks

**Position:** Inline com timeline, adjacent to affected items

**Format:**
- Icon: ⚠️ 16pt, #D32F2F (red)
- Callout box: Small pop-up
  - Background: #FFEBEE (light red)
  - Border: 2pt #D32F2F left
  - Text: "Risk: [Description]" - 9pt Regular
  - Mitigation: "Mitigation: [Action]" - 9pt Italic

**Example:**
⚠️ "Risk: Vendor delay (2 weeks) | Mitigation: Parallel workstream initiated"

---

### CUMULATIVE VALUE CURVE (Overlay)
**Purpose:** Show value realization over time

**Position:** Overlay on timeline, top area

**Format:**
- Line chart: Cumulative $ value
- X-axis: Aligned com timeline periods
- Y-axis: $0 - Target value
- Line: 3pt, #00A86B (green)
- Shaded area: Below line, #00A86B 20% opacity
- Milestones: Circles on line para major gates
- Target line: Horizontal dashed, #B0BEC5

**Example:**
Overlay showing cumulative value de $0 (Q1) → $80M (Q4), com milestones marcados

---

### RESOURCE ALLOCATION BAR (Optional)
**Purpose:** Show team/budget allocation

**Position:** Bottom of timeline, Linha 7.8

**Format:**
- Stacked horizontal bar
- Segments: By team ou budget category
- Colors: Distinct per segment
- Labels: Inside segments, "Team A: 40%"
- Total: "100 FTEs" ou "$5M budget"

---

## CHECKLIST - TIMELINE SLIDE

**Content:**
- [ ] Início e fim claramente marcados?
- [ ] Milestones críticos identificados?
- [ ] Dependencies mapeadas?
- [ ] Quick wins destacados (se aplicável)?
- [ ] Risks/blockers endereçados?

**Visual:**
- [ ] Timeline type apropriado (Gantt vs vertical vs phased)?
- [ ] Today marker visível (se relevant)?
- [ ] Colors indicam status/tipo consistentemente?
- [ ] Spacing adequado (não cramped)?
- [ ] Text legível em todos os elementos?

**Accuracy:**
- [ ] Dates realistas e validados?
- [ ] Dependencies factually corretas?
- [ ] Resource allocation plausível?
- [ ] Buffer time incluído (não optimistic bias)?

**Actionability:**
- [ ] Next steps claros?
- [ ] Owners identificados (se apropriado)?
- [ ] Decision points marcados?
- [ ] Success criteria definidos?

---

## AI IMAGE GENERATION - TIMELINE VISUALS

```
3D isometric project timeline visualization, horizontal gantt chart style,

60% opacity), milestone diamonds (◆ 15cm, #D32F2F red) elevated 10cm above
timeline, thin connector arrows (2cm width, #6E6E6E gray, flowing between
```

## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-archetypes/title.md

# Template: Title Slide (Capa)

## Purpose
Estabelecer credibilidade, contexto e expectativa para a apresentação. Primeira impressão crítica.

---

## SLIDE SPECIFICATION - TITLE SLIDE

### PAGE NUMBER
**Posição:** Rodapé direito
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 11-12, Linha 8 (bottom-right corner)
**Formato:** Sem número (capa não é numerada)
**Fonte:** N/A

---

### ACTION TITLE / HEADLINE
**Posição:** Centro-superior da área útil
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 2-11, Linhas 3-4
**Grid alignment:** Centralizado horizontalmente, terço superior vertical

**Texto sugerido (customizar):**
"Estratégia de Transformação Digital para [Nome do Cliente]"

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold
- **Tamanho:** 36-42pt
- **Cor:** #003B5C (navy blue - McKinsey standard)
- **Alinhamento:** Centro
- **Line height:** 1.2 (tight para impacto)
- **Kerning:** -20 (slightly tighter)
- **Caso:** Title Case
- **Max linhas:** 2 (se necessário quebrar)

**Regras de conteúdo:**
- Descrever O QUE é a apresentação
- Incluir nome do cliente (se apropriado)
- Tema/objetivo principal
- Evitar jargão desnecessário
- 5-10 palavras ideal

---

### SUBTITLE (Opcional)
**Posição:** Logo abaixo do título principal
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 3-10, Linha 4.5
**Grid alignment:** Centralizado, spacing de 20pt abaixo do título

**Texto sugerido:**
"Apresentação para [Stakeholder / Board / Comitê]"
"Versão [Data] - [Status: Draft / Final / Confidential]"

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular
- **Tamanho:** 18-22pt
- **Cor:** #6E6E6E (medium gray)
- **Alinhamento:** Centro
- **Line height:** 1.4
- **Case:** Sentence case

---

### CLIENT LOGO (Se aplicável)
**Posição:** Centro da página
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 5-8, Linhas 5-6
**Tamanho:** Máximo 4cm largura × 2cm altura
**Formato:** PNG com transparência ou SVG (vetorial preferido)
**Resolução:** 300 DPI mínimo

**Especificações:**
- Centralizado perfeitamente
- Spacing: 60pt acima e abaixo
- Não distorcer proporções (manter aspect ratio)
- Se fundo escuro do logo: adicionar subtle drop shadow (2px blur, 10% opacity)

**Regras:**
- Usar logo oficial fornecido pelo cliente
- Verificar approval de uso
- Não modificar cores ou proporções
- Se múltiplos logos (parceiros): max 3, alinhados horizontalmente

---

### CONSULTING FIRM LOGO
**Posição:** Rodapé esquerdo
**Coordenadas:** Coluna 1-2, Linha 8
**Tamanho:** Máximo 3cm largura × 1.5cm altura
**Formato:** PNG alta resolução ou vetorial

**Especificações:**
- Alinhado à esquerda da área útil
- Spacing: 40pt da borda inferior
- Cor: Versão monocromática ou cores brand oficiais
- Não competir visualmente com título

**Marcas principais:**
- McKinsey: Navy blue logo
- BCG: Green square logo
- Bain: Red & black logo
- Deloitte: Green dot logo

---

### DATE & VERSION
**Posição:** Rodapé centro
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 5-8, Linha 8
**Grid alignment:** Centralizado no bottom

**Formato sugerido:**
"[Mês] [Ano]"
Exemplo: "Dezembro 2024"

OU (se versioning importante):
"Versão 2.3 | 15 de Dezembro de 2024 | CONFIDENCIAL"

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular
- **Tamanho:** 10-12pt
- **Cor:** #6E6E6E (medium gray)
- **Alinhamento:** Centro
- **Case:** Sentence case
- **Letter spacing:** 0 (normal)

**Regras:**
- Data sempre presente (rastreabilidade)
- Se Draft: incluir "DRAFT - NÃO CIRCULAR"
- Se Confidencial: "CONFIDENCIAL - USO RESTRITO"
- Versioning se múltiplas iterações

---

### CONFIDENTIALITY / DISCLAIMER
**Posição:** Rodapé inferior (última linha)
**Coordenadas:** Colunas 1-12, abaixo da linha 8 (margem bottom)
**Grid alignment:** Full width, bottom margin

**Texto padrão (customizar conforme necessidade):**
"Este documento contém informações confidenciais e proprietárias de [Cliente]. Não deve ser reproduzido ou distribuído sem autorização prévia por escrito."

**Especificações tipográficas:**
- **Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Light
- **Tamanho:** 8-9pt
- **Cor:** #B0B0B0 (light gray)
- **Alinhamento:** Centro ou justificado
- **Line height:** 1.3
- **Max width:** 90% da largura do slide

**Variações:**
- **Interno:** "Internal use only - Do not distribute"
- **Cliente:** "Property of [Client Name] - Confidential"
- **Público:** (omitir ou versão leve)

---

### BACKGROUND & DESIGN ELEMENTS

**Background color:**
- **Opção 1 (Classic):** #FFFFFF (pure white) - McKinsey/Bain style
- **Opção 2 (Modern):** #F8F8F8 (off-white) - mais warm
- **Opção 3 (Bold):** Navy blue (#003B5C) com texto branco - high impact

**Decorative elements (opcional, use com moderação):**

**Subtle geometric accent:**
- Tipo: Thin line ou small shape
- Posição: Canto superior direito ou borda esquerda
- Cor: Brand color 20% opacity
- Espessura: 2-4pt
- Comprimento: 15-25% da largura do slide

**Gradient (se usar):**
- Tipo: Linear, top to bottom
- Colors: #FFFFFF → #F5F5F5 (very subtle)
- Opacity: 100%
- Evitar gradientes fortes (unprofessional)

**Photography/Image (alternativa):**
- Se usar: Imagem high-quality, relevant ao tema
- Posição: Background full-bleed com overlay
- Overlay: 60-80% opacity white ou navy
- Texto sobre overlay deve ter contrast ratio >7:1 (WCAG AAA)

---

## VARIAÇÕES POR CONTEXTO

### Executive Presentation (C-Level)
- Título: Mais outcomes-focused
- Design: Ultra-clean, minimal decoration
- Logos: Prominent mas tasteful
- Confidentiality: Sempre incluir

**Exemplo:**
**Título:** "Transformação Digital: Plano Estratégico 2025-2027"
**Subtitle:** "Board of Directors | Dezembro 2024"

---

### Internal Working Session
- Título: Mais descritivo/funcional
- Design: Simples, foco em clareza
- Version/Date: Mais prominent
- Status: "DRAFT - WORKING VERSION"

**Exemplo:**
**Título:** "Digital Transformation Workstream 3: Technology Architecture"
**Subtitle:** "Weekly Steering Committee | Week of Dec 18, 2024 | v4.2"

---

### Client Proposal / RFP Response
- Título: Problem-focused
- Client logo: Prominent
- Firm logo: Supporting
- Customization: Máxima para client brand

**Exemplo:**
**Título:** "Proposta de Transformação Operacional para [Cliente]"
**Subtitle:** "Resposta ao RFP #2024-456 | Confidencial"

---

### Academic / Public Presentation
- Título: Topic-focused
- No confidentiality
- Affiliations claras
- Data prominent

**Exemplo:**
**Título:** "The Future of Digital Banking: Trends and Implications"
**Subtitle:** "Financial Services Conference 2024 | São Paulo"

---

## CHECKLIST DE QUALIDADE - TITLE SLIDE

**Conteúdo:**
- [ ] Título é claro, conciso, outcomes-oriented?
- [ ] Nome do cliente correto (se aplicável)?
- [ ] Audience identificado no subtitle?
- [ ] Data presente e correta?
- [ ] Versioning apropriado?

**Visual:**
- [ ] Logos em alta resolução (não pixelados)?
- [ ] Proporções dos logos respeitadas?
- [ ] Hierarquia visual clara (título > subtitle > logos)?
- [ ] Espaçamento consistente (grid 12×8 respeitado)?
- [ ] Cores seguem brand guidelines?

**Tipografia:**
- [ ] Fonte consistente com resto da deck?
- [ ] Tamanhos apropriados (título 36-42pt)?
- [ ] Contrast ratio >7:1 para texto principal?
- [ ] Kerning/spacing otimizado?
- [ ] Sem orphans ou widows?

**Compliance:**
- [ ] Confidentiality statement apropriado?
- [ ] Copyright/trademark notices corretos?
- [ ] Client approval obtido (se logo usado)?
- [ ] Versão final vs draft claramente marcada?

**Technical:**
- [ ] Arquivo fonte editável fornecido?
- [ ] Imagens embedded ou linked corretamente?
- [ ] Fontes embedded no PDF?
- [ ] Exportação em alta resolução (300 DPI)?

---

## COMMON MISTAKES - EVITAR

**Design:**
- ❌ Título muito longo (>15 palavras) → dificulta leitura
- ❌ Múltiplos logos competing por atenção
- ❌ Background image que dificulta legibilidade
- ❌ Elementos decorativos excessivos
- ❌ Gradientes fortes ou cores conflitantes

**Conteúdo:**
- ❌ Título vago ("Apresentação", "Projeto XYZ")
- ❌ Data faltando ou errada
- ❌ Versioning inconsistente
- ❌ Confidentiality statement inadequado
- ❌ Typos (imperdesoável na capa!)

**Technical:**
- ❌ Logos em baixa resolução (pixelados)
- ❌ Cores RGB em print deck (usar CMYK)
- ❌ Elementos fora da safe zone (podem cortar)
- ❌ Fontes não embedded

---

## EXEMPLO COMPLETO - ESPECIFICAÇÃO FINAL

**SLIDE 1 - CAPA**

**Fundo:** #FFFFFF (pure white)

**TÍTULO (centro-superior):**
**Posição:** Colunas 2-11, Linhas 3-3.8
**Texto:** "Estratégia de Crescimento para Mercado B2B"
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Bold, 40pt, #003B5C, center-aligned, line-height 1.2

**SUBTITLE:**
**Posição:** Colunas 3-10, Linha 4.2
**Texto:** "Apresentação ao Comitê Executivo"
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 20pt, #6E6E6E, center-aligned

**CLIENT LOGO:**
**Posição:** Colunas 5.5-7.5, Linhas 5.2-6
**Arquivo:** client_logo_full_color.png (300 DPI)
**Tamanho:** 3.5cm × 1.8cm (mantém aspect ratio)

**FIRMA LOGO:**
**Posição:** Coluna 1.5, Linha 7.8
**Arquivo:** mckinsey_logo_navy.svg
**Tamanho:** 2.8cm × 1.2cm

**DATA:**
**Posição:** Colunas 5-8, Linha 7.8
**Texto:** "Dezembro 2024"
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Regular, 11pt, #6E6E6E, center

**CONFIDENCIALIDADE:**
**Posição:** Colunas 1-12, margin bottom (2cm da borda)
**Texto:** "CONFIDENCIAL - Propriedade de [Cliente S.A.] - Distribuição restrita"
**Fonte:** Helvetica Neue Light, 8pt, #B0B0B0, center, line-height 1.3

**ELEMENTO DECORATIVO:**
Thin line accent - Coluna 11.5-12, Linhas 1-2.5, 3pt width, #00A86B 30% opacity

---

## AI IMAGE PROMPT (Se usar hero image no fundo)

**APENAS SE OPTAR POR DESIGN COM IMAGEM DE BACKGROUND:**

```
Professional business strategy concept, abstract geometric composition,
isometric view, clean modern corporate aesthetic, interconnected 3D blocks
representing business growth (ascending staircase formation, 5 levels, each
2m × 2m × 0.5m), subtle data visualization elements floating (line charts,
bar graphs 20% opacity), color palette: navy blue #003B5C (60%), forest
green #00A86B (30%), white #FFFFFF (10%), ultra-minimalist, bokeh effect
background (soft blur, depth of field), high-key lighting (bright, airy,
professional), gradient white overlay 70% opacity for text readability,
8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus on foreground elements, --ar 16:9
--stylize 500 --no people, faces, text, logos --v 6.0

OVERLAY: 70% white (#FFFFFF) opacity gradient (top to bottom: 80% → 60%)
ENSURES: Text contrast ratio >7:1 for WCAG AAA compliance
```

**IMPORTANTE:** Imagem deve ser SUPPORTING, não distracting. Texto sempre legível.

---

## FONTES E REFERÊNCIAS

**Inspiração visual:**
- McKinsey Quarterly covers (ultra-clean, minimal)
- BCG Publications (bold use of brand colors)
- Harvard Business Review (professional photography + overlay)

**Guidelines consultadas:**
- McKinsey Brand Guidelines (internal)
- PowerPoint Design Best Practices (Microsoft)
- Presentation Zen (Garr Reynolds)
- WCAG 2.1 Accessibility Guidelines

## Referência: references/squad/templates/slide-component.tsx.hbs

```text
{{!--
  Parametric TSX Slide Component Skeleton — slides-creator (100% BRAND-AGNOSTIC)

  Stack contract:
    - React 18+ TSX
    - Tailwind v4 (@import "tailwindcss" in consumer globals.css)
    - shadcn/ui new-york baseline + cssVariables: true
    - Icon library: Lucide preferred, consumer may substitute
    - Motion library: Framer Motion preferred, consumer may substitute as long as
      useReducedMotion equivalent exists
    - CSS variables only (zero hardcoded hex/rgba/oklch)

  Placeholders resolved at materialization:
    {{consumer.imports.chrome}}        — path to consumer's Chrome atom implementation
    {{consumer.imports.motion}}        — path to consumer's motion preset module
    {{consumer.imports.cn}}            — path to consumer's class-merge utility
    {{brand.css_var_prefix}}           — eg: "bb", "rp", "acme" (consumer-chosen)
    {{brand.background_token}}         — token suffix (eg: "bg", "dark")
    {{brand.accent_token}}             — token suffix (eg: "accent", "lime", "red")
    {{brand.fg_token}}                 — token suffix (eg: "fg", "cream", "ink")
    {{brand.dim_token}}                — token suffix (eg: "dim", "muted", "fg-3")
    {{brand.display_font}}             — token suffix (eg: "display", "hero")

  Variables from emit-deck-spec + resolve-active-palette:
    slide           { id, label, category, ato, version, motionLevel, heroSlide, bundleRef, pattern_id }
    chrome          { eyebrow, sectionTag, footerLabel, pageNumber, pageTotal, corners, watermark, hazard }
    brand           { css_var_prefix, background_token, accent_token, fg_token, dim_token, display_font }
    content         { action_title, subtitle?, content_blocks[] }
    consumer        { imports: { chrome, motion, cn, ChromeComponent } }
--}}
"use client"

import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "{{consumer.imports.motion_lib}}"
import { cn } from "{{consumer.imports.cn}}"
import { {{consumer.imports.ChromeComponent}} } from "{{consumer.imports.chrome}}"
import {
  fadeIn,
  fadeUp,
  scaleIn,
  staggerV2,
} from "{{consumer.imports.motion_presets}}"

/**
 * {{slide.label}}
 *
 * Slide ID:  {{slide.id}}
 * Category:  {{slide.category}}  (ato {{slide.ato}})
 * Pattern:   {{slide.pattern_id}}  (see data/slide-layout-patterns.yaml)
 * Version:   {{slide.version}}
 * Motion:    {{slide.motionLevel}}
 *
 * Generated from templates/slide-component.tsx.hbs by emit-deck-spec.
 * Conforms to data/slide-component-vocabulary.yaml v3.0 (brand-agnostic).
 */

export interface {{pascalCase slide.id}}Props {
  /** Brand parametric CSS vars injected as style. Resolved by consumer at build. */
  brandVars?: Record<string, string>
  /** Override chrome defaults */
  chromeOverrides?: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof {{consumer.imports.ChromeComponent}}>>
  className?: string
}

export function {{pascalCase slide.id}}({
  brandVars,
  chromeOverrides,
  className,
}: {{pascalCase slide.id}}Props = {}) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion()

  return (
    <{{consumer.imports.ChromeComponent}}
      eyebrow="{{chrome.eyebrow}}"
      sectionTag="{{chrome.sectionTag}}"
      footerLabel="{{chrome.footerLabel}}"
      pageNumber="{{chrome.pageNumber}}"
      pageTotal="{{chrome.pageTotal}}"
      corners={ {{chrome.corners}} }
      watermark={ {{chrome.watermark}} }
      hazard={ {{chrome.hazard}} }
      background="var(--{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{brand.background_token}})"
      className={cn("text-[color:var(--{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{brand.fg_token}})]", className)}
      {...chromeOverrides}
      style={brandVars as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      {{!-- Action Title — always present per P4 Action Titles invariant --}}
      {{#if content.action_title}}
      <motion.h1
        {...(reduce ? {} : fadeUp(0.1))}
        className={cn(
          "font-[family-name:var(--font-{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{brand.display_font}})]",
          "text-[clamp(26px,3vw,34px)] font-bold leading-[1.15] tracking-[-0.5px]",
          "max-w-[850px]",
        )}
      >
        {{content.action_title}}
      </motion.h1>
      {{/if}}

      {{#if content.subtitle}}
      <motion.p
        {...(reduce ? {} : fadeIn(0.3))}
        className="mt-6 text-[22px] font-normal text-[color:var(--{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{brand.dim_token}})]"
      >
        {{content.subtitle}}
      </motion.p>
      {{/if}}

      {{!-- Pattern body scaffolded by pattern_id (LP-*) --}}
      {{#ifEquals slide.pattern_id "LP-002"}}
        {{!-- action_title_plus_3_kpis --}}
        <div className="mt-12 grid grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {{#each content.kpis}}
          <motion.div
            {...(reduce ? {} : staggerV2({{@index}}, 0.5))}
            className="flex flex-col gap-2"
          >
            <div className="text-[clamp(48px,6vw,72px)] font-extrabold leading-none tabular-nums text-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{../brand.accent_token}})]">
              {{this.value}}
            </div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{../brand.dim_token}})]">
              {{this.label}}
            </div>
            <div className="text-sm opacity-80">
              {{this.description}}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
          {{/each}}
        </div>
      {{/ifEquals}}

      {{#ifEquals slide.pattern_id "LP-004"}}
        {{!-- framework_2x2_matrix --}}
        <div className="relative mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 grid-rows-2 gap-4 h-[520px]">
          <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-0 bottom-0 w-px bg-[color:var(--{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-border)]" />
          <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-0 right-0 h-px bg-[color:var(--{{brand.css_var_prefix}}-border)]" />
          {{#each content.quadrants}}
          <motion.div
            {...(reduce ? {} : scaleIn(0.4 + {{@index}} * 0.15))}
            className="rounded-lg border p-6 flex flex-col justify-center border-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-border)] bg-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-surface)]"
          >
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-{{../brand.accent_token}})]">
              {{this.label}}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold">{{this.title}}</div>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm opacity-80">{{this.description}}</p>
          </motion.div>
          {{/each}}
        </div>
      {{/ifEquals}}

      {{#ifEquals slide.pattern_id "LP-007"}}
        {{!-- rag_status_matrix --}}
        <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {{#each content.rag_bands}}
          <motion.div
            {...(reduce ? {} : fadeUp(0.3 + {{@index}} * 0.12))}
            data-rag-level="{{this.level}}"
            className={cn(
              "rounded-sm border-l-4 p-4",
              "{{this.level}}" === "green"  && "border-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-positive)] bg-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-positive)]/10",
              "{{this.level}}" === "orange" && "border-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-neutral)] bg-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-neutral)]/10",
              "{{this.level}}" === "red"    && "border-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-alert)] bg-[color:var(--{{../brand.css_var_prefix}}-alert)]/10",
            )}
          >
            <div className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">{{this.header}}</div>
            <p className="text-sm">{{this.description}}</p>
            {{#if this.time}}
            <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-2">{{this.time}}</div>
            {{/if}}
          </motion.div>
          {{/each}}
        </div>
      {{/ifEquals}}

      {{!-- Additional pattern_id scaffolds (LP-001, LP-003, LP-005, LP-006, LP-008, LP-009, LP-010)
           follow the same shape — reference data/slide-layout-patterns.yaml anatomy section
           and instantiate using consumer's chrome_atom + CSS vars + Tailwind v4 utilities. --}}

    </{{consumer.imports.ChromeComponent}}>
  )
}

export default {{pascalCase slide.id}}
```

```yaml
# Slide Template — CTA Concrete
# Schema ref: templates/schemas/slide-template.schema.yaml
# Pilot status: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN DEV-2026-003 (3 de 3 pilots)

id: "cta-concrete"
name: "CTA Concrete (decisao binaria com 3 razoes para agir agora)"
version: "1.0.0"

function: cta_concrete
alternative_functions: [close, artifact_reveal, synthesis]

summary:
  pick_for: >-
    Slide de fechamento que pede UMA decisao binaria (SIM/NAO sobre acao especifica). Funciona
    quando audiencia ja recebeu valor e precisa de proximo passo claro. Inclui scarcity OR bonus
    OR 3 razoes para agir agora.
  skip_if: >-
    Quando deck eh apenas informativo (use synthesis ou quiet-pause). Quando decisao eh
    multi-opcao (use decision-matrix em Mission futura). Quando CTA eh assincrono via email
    (use email-cta template em Mission futura). Quando deck eh educacional puro (terminar com
    synthesis, nao CTA).

slots:
  - name: action_title
    type: text
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_chars: 60
    token_ref: "--slide-title-xl"
    position_hint: top-center-or-left
  - name: cta_concrete_action
    type: text
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_chars: 50
    token_ref: "--slide-title-md"
    position_hint: center-prominent
  - name: cta_link_or_qr
    type: group
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_items: 2
    position_hint: center-secondary
  - name: reasons_to_act_now
    type: list
    role: supporting
    required: false
    max_items: 3
    position_hint: bottom-stacked
  - name: scarcity_or_bonus
    type: text
    role: supporting
    required: false
    max_chars: 80
    position_hint: badge-corner

constraints:
  density_target: minimal
  max_visual_elements: 3
  max_text_chars_total: 240
  grid_columns_required: 12
  viewing_distance_min: medium
  accessibility_min: WCAG_AAA  # CTA precisa ser ultra-legivel

visual_pattern:
  layout_family: hero
  motif_hints:
    - "CTA action em destaque visual maximo (cor de marca ou inverso)"
    - "QR code OU link grande visivel a 5m de distancia"
    - "Reasons to act em badges/chips menores no rodape"
    - "Scarcity/bonus opcional em badge corner com cor de alerta"

qa_gates_emphasis:
  - {dimension: contrast, emphasis: critical}              # CTA ilegivel = vendas perdidas
  - {dimension: hierarchy, emphasis: critical}              # action > razoes > scarcity
  - {dimension: action_title_rhetoric, emphasis: critical}  # title nao pode ser passivo
  - {dimension: density, emphasis: high}                    # minimal density: CTA respira
  - {dimension: readability, emphasis: critical}            # text legivel a distance

failure_modes:
  - mode: "CTA generico"
    symptom: "cta_concrete_action = 'comece agora' OR 'saiba mais'"
    prevention: "Acao deve ser concreta: 'Reserve sua vaga em 24h via link X' OR 'Aprove proposta ate sexta'"
  - mode: "QR/link ausente OR escondido"
    symptom: "Slide tem texto pedindo acao mas nao tem onde clicar/escanear"
    prevention: "cta_link_or_qr obrigatorio. Deve ocupar area minima de 200x200px (mobile-readable)"
  - mode: "Densidade alta"
    symptom: ">3 elementos competindo com CTA"
    prevention: "max_visual_elements: 3. CTA respira ou perde forca."
  - mode: "Sem urgencia"
    symptom: "CTA sem scarcity/deadline/bonus"
    prevention: "scarcity_or_bonus recomendado para CTA frio. Para CTA quente, reasons_to_act_now (3 razoes)"
  - mode: "Multi-CTA"
    symptom: "2+ CTAs competindo"
    prevention: "UM CTA por slide. Multi-CTA dilui conversao. Se necessario, use synthesis antes."

selected_template_reason_schema:
  function_match: "cta_concrete (canonical) OR close/artifact_reveal/synthesis"
  density_fit: "minimal — CTA precisa respirar"
  alternative_considered: "ex: synthesis-recap rejected porque deck precisa de acao, nao recap"

sample_content:
  slots_filled:
    action_title: "Sua primeira IA em 14 dias"
    cta_concrete_action: "Reserve sua vaga: aiox.dev/primeiro-servico"
    cta_link_or_qr:
      - type: "QR Code"
        target: "https://aiox.dev/primeiro-servico"
      - type: "Short URL"
        target: "aiox.dev/primeiro"
    reasons_to_act_now:
      - "20 vagas restantes (turma fecha sexta)"
      - "Bonus: prompt-mestre validado (R$ 297) para quem entrar em 48h"
      - "Garantia: 14 dias para entregar primeiro servico ou reembolso integral"
    scarcity_or_bonus: "20 vagas | encerra sexta 23h59"
  notes: "Exemplo derivado de webinar de venda. CTA binario (entrar OU nao entrar). 3 razoes incluem scarcity, bonus e garantia."

compatible_with:
  deck_templates: [webinar-sales-perfect-webinar, executive-pitch, sales-call-live-close, proposal-sow]
  themes: [editorial-pentagram, demo-day-yc, aiox-house]

source_provenance:
  inspired_by:
    - "Russell Brunson — Stack and Close (Perfect Webinar)"
    - "Dan Kennedy — Magnetic Marketing direct response CTAs"
    - "Y Combinator demo day closing slides"
  bench_ref:
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/skills/ppt-master/templates/layouts/pitch-deck/ (closing slide patterns)"
  author: "slides-creator squad — MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  date_created: "2026-05-17"
```

```yaml
# Slide Template — Hook Opening
# Schema ref: templates/schemas/slide-template.schema.yaml
# Pilot status: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN DEV-2026-003 (1 de 3 pilots)

id: "hook-opening"
name: "Hook Opening (capa de impacto)"
version: "1.0.0"

function: cover
alternative_functions: [reframe, tension_amplify]

summary:
  pick_for: >-
    Slide de abertura (s01) OU slide-charneira que precisa ANCORAR atencao em UMA promessa.
    Funciona quando ha 1 governing thought forte que define o restante do deck.
  skip_if: >-
    Slide intermediario (use proof-stack ou mechanism-step). Quando nao ha governing thought claro
    (volte para tasks/distill-governing-thought). Quando audiencia precisa de contexto antes da promessa
    (use tension-amplify slide template).

slots:
  - name: action_title
    type: text
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_chars: 90
    token_ref: "--slide-title-xl"
    position_hint: center-left
  - name: subtitle
    type: text
    role: supporting
    required: false
    max_chars: 120
    token_ref: "--slide-title-md"
    position_hint: center-left
  - name: speaker_block
    type: group
    role: metadata
    required: false
    max_items: 3
    position_hint: bottom-left
  - name: visual_anchor
    type: image
    role: supporting
    required: false
    position_hint: right-half
  - name: motif_block
    type: decoration
    role: decoration
    required: false
    position_hint: top-or-side

constraints:
  density_target: minimal
  max_visual_elements: 3
  max_text_chars_total: 220
  grid_columns_required: 12
  viewing_distance_min: medium
  accessibility_min: WCAG_AAA  # cover slide eh memoria — contraste alto

visual_pattern:
  layout_family: hero
  motif_hints:
    - "Bloco de cor solido cobrindo 30-50% do canvas (motif Primeiro Servico v3)"
    - "Tipografia black/extrabold protagonista"
    - "Visual anchor opcional do lado oposto ao titulo"
    - "Espaco branco respiratorio no restante"

qa_gates_emphasis:
  - {dimension: governing_thought_strength, emphasis: critical}
  - {dimension: action_title_rhetoric, emphasis: critical}
  - {dimension: contrast, emphasis: critical}
  - {dimension: hierarchy, emphasis: critical}
  - {dimension: density, emphasis: high}

failure_modes:
  - mode: "Title que descreve em vez de prometer"
    symptom: "Action title eh nominal ('Apresentacao sobre X')"
    prevention: "Title DEVE ser executive_strong: claim + magnitude + implicacao"
  - mode: "Cover poluido"
    symptom: ">3 elementos visuais OR texto secundario competindo com title"
    prevention: "max 3 visual elements + 1 title + 1 subtitle"
  - mode: "Motif ausente"
    symptom: "Cover sem bloco de cor / decoracao ancoradora — vira slide vazio"
    prevention: "motif_block presente OR visual_anchor presente OR ambos. Minimum 1."

selected_template_reason_schema:
  function_match: "cover OR reframe OR tension_amplify (specify which)"
  density_fit: "minimal density justifica este template OR escolheu outro"
  alternative_considered: "ex: hero-quote vs hero-data — escolhi hook-opening porque governing thought eh declarativo, nao quote"
```

```yaml
# Slide Template — Proof Stack
# Schema ref: templates/schemas/slide-template.schema.yaml
# Pilot status: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN DEV-2026-003 (2 de 3 pilots)

id: "proof-stack"
name: "Proof Stack (2-4 evidencias verticais com source)"
version: "1.0.0"

function: proof
alternative_functions: [mechanism_step, contrast, synthesis]

summary:
  pick_for: >-
    Quando ha 2-4 evidencias quantitativas/estudos que sustentam mesma tese. Pesquisas, estatisticas,
    estudos de caso, dados de adocao, benchmarks. Cada evidencia carrega numero + fonte + interpretacao.
  skip_if: >-
    Quando evidencia eh QUALITATIVA (use quote-card slide template). Quando ha 5+ evidencias
    (split em 2 slides OR use matrix-framework). Quando evidencia eh visual unica como chart
    grande (use chart-hero). Quando comparacao binaria (use contrast-2col).

slots:
  - name: action_title
    type: text
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_chars: 90
    token_ref: "--slide-title-md"
    position_hint: top-left
  - name: proof_items
    type: list
    role: primary
    required: true
    max_items: 4
    position_hint: center-stacked-vertical
  - name: synthesis_line
    type: text
    role: supporting
    required: false
    max_chars: 90
    token_ref: "--slide-body"
    position_hint: bottom-center
  - name: source_footer
    type: citation
    role: footer
    required: true
    position_hint: bottom-left

constraints:
  density_target: medium
  max_visual_elements: 4
  max_text_chars_total: 320
  grid_columns_required: 12
  viewing_distance_min: medium
  accessibility_min: WCAG_AA

visual_pattern:
  layout_family: stacked
  motif_hints:
    - "Numero ou icone grande a esquerda de cada proof item"
    - "Divisor horizontal sutil entre proofs (ou padding generoso)"
    - "Source citation em rodape com tipografia menor"
    - "Optional: synthesis line em italico abaixo dos proofs"

qa_gates_emphasis:
  - {dimension: fontes_apa, emphasis: critical}            # cada proof tem source
  - {dimension: enumeration_universal, emphasis: critical} # cada proof numerado
  - {dimension: hierarchy, emphasis: critical}              # numero/icone > titulo proof > corpo
  - {dimension: density, emphasis: high}                    # max 4 proofs
  - {dimension: action_title_rhetoric, emphasis: high}      # title carrega tese sintetica

failure_modes:
  - mode: "Proofs sem source"
    symptom: "Number/percentage sem citation"
    prevention: "source_footer obrigatorio + KI-03 (claim sem fonte)"
  - mode: "Hierarquia plana"
    symptom: "Number e body proof items com mesmo peso visual"
    prevention: "Number sempre maior (--slide-title-lg) que body (--slide-body)"
  - mode: "Proof overflow"
    symptom: ">4 proofs amontoados, perdendo legibilidade"
    prevention: "max_items: 4 enforced. Split em 2 slides se necessario."
  - mode: "Title descritivo"
    symptom: "Title = 'Tres evidencias sobre X'"
    prevention: "Title carrega TESE sintetica: 'Adoção dobra quando UX precede tecnologia (3 evidencias)'"

selected_template_reason_schema:
  function_match: "proof (canonical) OR mechanism_step/contrast/synthesis"
  density_fit: "medium density (3-4 itens) — se 1 item, use kpi-block; se 5+, split"
  alternative_considered: "ex: matrix-framework rejected porque proofs nao tem 2 eixos"

sample_content:
  slots_filled:
    action_title: "Adoção de IA dobra quando empresas começam por UX e nao por tecnologia"
    proof_items:
      - number: "2.3x"
        body: "Adopcao IA em 12 meses quando piloto comeca por journey mapping antes de stack"
        source_inline: "(McKinsey, 2025)"
      - number: "67%"
        body: "Reducao em rework de implementacao em projetos UX-first vs tech-first"
        source_inline: "(Forrester State of AI Adoption, 2025)"
      - number: "R$ 200K"
        body: "Economia media por projeto evitando re-arquitetura pos-MVP"
        source_inline: "(Gartner, 2025)"
    synthesis_line: "Quando UX precede stack, time aceita IA como ferramenta, nao como ameaca."
    source_footer: "Fontes: McKinsey State of AI 2025; Forrester The Total Economic Impact of AI Adoption 2025; Gartner CIO Agenda 2025. Acesso 2026-05-17."
  notes: "Exemplo synthetic. 3 proofs (cabe em max 4) com sources APA-complete. Synthesis line opcional."

compatible_with:
  deck_templates: [executive-pitch, webinar-sales-perfect-webinar, board-update, tactical-masterclass, benchmark-research]
  themes: [editorial-pentagram, consulting-mckinsey, financial-bloomberg, demo-day-yc]

source_provenance:
  inspired_by:
    - "McKinsey 3-pillar evidence presentation pattern"
    - "Barbara Minto — Pyramid Principle (MECE proof groupings)"
    - "Y Combinator traction slide conventions"
  bench_ref:
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/skills/ppt-master/templates/layouts/google_style/03_content.svg"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/presenton/servers/nextjs/app/presentation-templates/neo-modern/TitleKpiSnapshotGrid.tsx (KPI grid inspiration)"
  author: "slides-creator squad — MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  date_created: "2026-05-17"
```

```yaml
# Theme Template — Editorial Pentagram
# Pilot status: MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN DEV-2026-003 (1 de 1 theme pilot)
# Note: schema for themes will be formalized em MSN-2026-SLIDES-TEMPLATES-ARCHITECTURE.
# Por enquanto, segue padrao ThemeProperties absorvido de presentation-ai + tokens estilo ppt-master spec_lock.

id: "editorial-pentagram"
name: "Editorial Pentagram (workshop vibe, bloco de cor protagonista)"
version: "1.0.0"

description: |
  Tema editorial inspirado em Pentagram + retrospectiva v3 do Primeiro Servico de IA.
  Blocos de cor solida como ancora visual. Tipografia condensada protagonista.
  Sparse decoration. Workshop vibe.

mode: light

motif:
  name: "Bloco de cor solido cobrindo 30-50% do canvas"
  rationale: "Cria ancora visual recorrente sem virar wireframe. Cada slide-chave tem cortina de cor."
  rendered_as:
    - "Block fundo lime/dark cobrindo 30-50% do canvas (alinhado top-left ou bottom-right)"
    - "Tipografia black/extrabold sobre o bloco"
    - "Espaco branco respiratorio no restante"
    - "Bordas sem radius (squared)"

colors:
  primary: "#3DC02E"          # lime/green ancora
  primary_deep: "#2E8F22"     # hover/active darker
  accent: "#FFB800"           # yellow alert/scarcity
  background: "#FFFFFF"
  background_block: "#3DC02E" # mesma primary para blocos
  text: "#0A0A0A"
  text_inverse: "#FFFFFF"     # texto sobre primary
  heading: "#0A0A0A"
  smart_layout: "#F5F5F5"
  card_background: "#FAFAFA"
  divider: "#E5E5E5"
  success: "#3DC02E"
  warning: "#FFB800"
  danger: "#E5392B"

fonts:
  heading: "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui"
  body: "Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui"
  monospace: "JetBrains Mono, monospace"
  heading_weight: 900  # black
  body_weight: 400
  heading_url: "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700;900&display=swap"

scale_tokens:
  # Sizes em pt (canvas 1920x1080)
  slide_title_xl: 96
  slide_title_lg: 64
  slide_title_md: 44
  slide_title_sm: 32
  slide_body: 22
  slide_caption: 16
  line_height_heading: 1.05
  line_height_body: 1.45

border_radius:
  card: "0px"     # squared editorial
  slide: "0px"
  button: "4px"
  badge: "999px"  # apenas badges sao pill

transitions:
  default: "150ms ease-out"

shadows:
  card: "none"    # editorial flat, no shadow
  button: "none"
  slide: "none"
  emphasis: "0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"  # raro

background:
  type: solid
  default_color: "#FFFFFF"
  alternates:
    section_break: "#0A0A0A"  # dark divider
    cta: "#3DC02E"            # primary anchored

composition_defaults:
  grid_columns: 12
  baseline_padding_pt: 48
  title_anchor: top_left
  footer_present: true
  slide_number_visible: false
  safe_area_pct: 0.92

density_defaults:
  max_claims_governing_per_slide: 1
  max_claims_supporting_per_slide: 3
  max_visual_elements_per_slide: 4
  max_text_chars_per_slide: 240

variation_rules:
  layouts_count_min: 5
  layout_repetition_max: 2
  quiet_slide_ratio_min: 0.2
  accent_color_density: sparse
  motion_policy: subtle_transitions

forbidden_patterns:
  - "5+ cards iguais em grid (wireframe-like)"
  - "Bullet list > 5 itens"
  - "Drop shadows pesadas (rompe editorial flatness)"
  - "Gradients (sempre cor solida)"

accessibility:
  contrast_required: WCAG_AAA  # text-on-block precisa ser 7:1
  text_min_pt_body: 18
  text_min_pt_caption: 14

compatible_with_deck_templates:
  - webinar-sales-perfect-webinar
  - executive-pitch
  - tactical-masterclass
  - educational-workshop
  - board-update

source_provenance:
  inspired_by:
    - "Pentagram editorial design system"
    - "Y Combinator demo day visual language"
    - "Primeiro Servico de IA v3 retrospective (case-study)"
  bench_ref:
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/presentation-ai/src/lib/presentation/themes.ts (ThemeProperties pattern)"
    - "/Users/alan/Code/bench/ppt-master/examples/ppt169_谷歌风_google_annual_report/ (block of color anchor)"
  author: "slides-creator squad — MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  date_created: "2026-05-17"

evidence_ref: "outputs/sinkra-squad/MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN/case-study-primeiro-servico-ia.md"
```
