## Referência: references/squad/workflows/generate-presentation.yaml

```yaml
name: generate-presentation
version: 3.0.0
schema: sinkra-workflow-v1
orchestrator: slide-chief
type: pipeline

metadata:
  owner_squad: slides-creator
  adr_ref: "docs/adrs/ADR-021-absorb-narrative-discipline-into-slides-creator.md"
  epic_ref: "docs/stories/epic-sc-narr/EPIC-SC-NARR.md"
  source_mapping: "outputs/sinkra-squad/criacao-slides-ia/"
  mission_ref: "MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN"
  case_study_ref: "outputs/sinkra-squad/MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN/case-study-primeiro-servico-ia.md"
  qa_rubric_ref: "data/qa-rubric.yaml v3.0.0"
  qa_routing_table_ref: "data/qa-routing-table.yaml"
  superseded:
    - { version: 1.5.0, reason: "pre-absorption, no narrative layer" }
    - { version: 2.0.0, reason: "pre-MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN. Added P02.5 (compression), P04.5 (critique loop), 10 new validators, qa-rubric v3, qa-routing-table." }

# =============================================================================
# GLOBAL — session isolation + checkpoints + feature flags
# =============================================================================
global:
  checkpoint_policy: always_active
  fail_fast: true
  max_refinement_loops: 2

  isolation:
    enforced: true
    rule: "No LLM context shared between sessions. Cross-session validation avoids self-validation blindspot."
    sessions:
      - id: SESSION-NARR
        agents: [content-architect]
        phases: [P01, P02_titles]
        kb_bundle_ref: "SESSION-NARR"  # determined by kb-loading-matrix.yaml
      - id: SESSION-SPEC
        agents: [template-curator, design-renderer, visual-scout]
        phases: [P03, P04]
        kb_bundle_ref: "SESSION-SPEC"
      - id: SESSION-QA
        agents: [qa-inspector]
        phases: [P02_vertical, P05]
        kb_bundle_ref: "SESSION-QA"

  feature_flags:
    skip_narrative: false                   # true → bypass P01/P02/P03 (legacy v1.5 behavior)
    enable_p1_sampling: false               # true → 10% sample re-verification in P05
    enable_visual_generation: true
    enable_youtube_entrypoint: true
    enable_html_standalone_render: false    # Wave C — unlock standalone HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 output
    enable_motion_narrative: false          # Wave C — Slow-Fast-Boom-Stop pacing
    enable_design_direction_advisor: false  # Wave C — 20-philosophy fallback for vague briefs

  gate_mode: hard  # hard | advisory (advisory requires deviations.yaml entry)

# =============================================================================
# PHASES
# =============================================================================
phases:

  - id: P00
    name: "Intake"
    weight_pct: 1
    session: null
    bounded_context: []
    agents: [slide-chief]
    tasks:
      - confirm-delivery-format      # Wave C — Phase 0 checkpoint (MUST run first; prevents 2-3h rework)
      - normalize-briefing           # existing
      - youtube-to-briefing          # existing, conditional on flag + input type
      - load-kb-bundle               # deterministic KB selection
      - decide-slide-architecture    # Wave C — conditional on ENABLE_HTML_STANDALONE_RENDER
    outputs:
      - briefing.normalized.json     # includes delivery_format + slide_architecture fields
      - kb-bundle-{phase}.yaml
    conditional_tasks:
      - task: decide-slide-architecture
        requires_flag: enable_html_standalone_render
      - task: youtube-to-briefing
        requires_flag: enable_youtube_entrypoint
        requires_input: briefing.source_type == "youtube"
    hard_checkpoint:
      at: after_confirm-delivery-format
      rule: "Cannot proceed to normalize-briefing without briefing.normalized.json.delivery_format set"
      fail_action: return_to_user_with_prompt

  - id: P01
    name: "Narrative Analysis"
    weight_pct: 20
    session: SESSION-NARR
    bounded_context: [BC-01, BC-04]
    agents: [content-architect]
    tasks:
      - catalog-sources-apa          # NEW — P6 enforcement
      - distill-governing-thought    # NEW — single sentence
      - build-pyramid                # NEW — Minto 3 levels, MECE
      - apply-scqa                   # NEW — % allocation
    outputs:
      - sources-apa.yaml
      - governing-thought.yaml
      - pyramid-tree.yaml
      - scqa-map.yaml
    gate: D01
    on_gate_fail: return_to_P01_with_feedback

  - id: P02
    name: "Narrative Structure"
    weight_pct: 12
    session: [SESSION-NARR, SESSION-QA]
    bounded_context: [BC-01]
    agents: [content-architect, qa-inspector]
    tasks:
      - write-action-titles
      - run-vertical-test
    outputs:
      - deck-manifest.json
      - vertical-test-result.yaml
    gate: D02
    gate_preconditions:
      - vertical-test-result.verdict == PASS
    on_gate_fail: return_to_P01_or_P02

  - id: P02_5
    name: "Narrative Compression (Story Arc + Slide Function Map)"
    weight_pct: 8
    session: SESSION-NARR
    bounded_context: [BC-01]
    agents: [content-architect]
    tasks:
      - compress-outline-to-slide-functions   # T-015A — emits story-arc.yaml + slide-function-map.yaml
    outputs:
      - story-arc.yaml
      - slide-function-map.yaml
    gate: null
    inline_validation:
      - validate-story-arc
      - validate-slide-function-map
    killer_items_enforced: [KI-08, KI-09]
    on_inline_validation_fail: return_to_P02_5
    rationale: |
      Etapa anti-outline-literal. Lição empírica do webinar Primeiro Serviço de IA:
      27 tópicos viraram 27 slides ruins. Esta phase força compressão editorial e
      declaração de função narrativa por slide ANTES de qualquer decisão de design.
      Sem este gate, KI-08 (slide sem função) e KI-09 (compression ratio violated) podem
      passar até P05 — caro demais.

  - id: P03_DIRECTION
    name: "Design Direction (pre-design)"
    weight_pct: 5
    session: SESSION-SPEC
    bounded_context: [BC-02, BC-05]
    agents: [design-renderer]
    tasks:
      - define-design-direction               # T-015B — emits design-direction.yaml
    outputs:
      - design-direction.yaml
    killer_items_enforced: [KI-10]
    gate: null
    rationale: |
      Sub-phase obrigatória antes de P03 (compose-grid-layout). Lição empírica:
      identidade aplicada como skin (sem visual_reference real, sem dominant_motif)
      produz wireframe bonito-mas-vazio. KI-10 enforce.

  - id: P03
    name: "Design"
    weight_pct: 30
    session: SESSION-SPEC
    bounded_context: [BC-02, BC-05]
    agents: [template-curator, design-renderer, slide-chief]
    tasks:
      - classify-slide-type          # NEW — template-curator
      - select-chart-type            # NEW — Worker (lookup in chart-selection-matrix)
      - compose-grid-layout          # NEW — design-renderer
      - detect-brand-override        # NEW — Worker (filesystem probe)
      - register-palette-override    # NEW — Human (slide-chief dispatches, STK-10-equivalent approves)
      - resolve-active-palette       # NEW — Worker (palette-registry lookup + WCAG)
    outputs:
      - design-overview.md
      - grid-layouts.yaml
      - active-palette.yaml
    gate: D03
    on_gate_fail: return_to_P03

  - id: P04
    name: "Detailed Specification"
    weight_pct: 22
    session: SESSION-SPEC
    bounded_context: [BC-03]
    agents: [content-architect, design-renderer, visual-scout]
    tasks:
      - create-presentation
      - emit-deck-spec
    outputs:
      - deck-manifest.json
      - deck-spec.yaml
    gate: null

  - id: P04_5
    name: "Design Critique Loop"
    weight_pct: 12
    session: SESSION-DESIGN-CRITIQUE
    bounded_context: [BC-06]
    agents: [design-planner, design-renderer]
    tasks:
      - run-design-critique          # T-016 — invokes 10 validators + emits critique-report.yaml
      - apply-design-revision        # T-017 — applies routed revisions (conditional on verdict=REVISE)
    outputs:
      - critique-reports/iteration-{N}.yaml
      - revision-{N}.yaml
      - planning-reflection.jsonl (append)
      - deck-spec.yaml (overwritten if REVISE)
    gate: D04
    gate_preconditions:
      - "critique_report.verdict in [PASS, ESCALATE]"
    iteration_cap: 2
    on_iteration_cap_reached: escalate_to_human
    killer_items_enforced: [KI-08, KI-09, KI-10]
    rationale: |
      Phase central da MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN. Bridge entre draft DeckSpec
      e QA macro. design-planner orquestra critique + revise iterativamente, com cap
      em 2 iterações. PASS → P05. ESCALATE → Human. Killer items checked first.

  - id: P05
    name: "Quality Assurance"
    weight_pct: 4
    session: SESSION-QA
    bounded_context: [BC-06]
    agents: [qa-inspector]           # fresh instance, not reused from P02
    tasks:
      - validate-pyramid             # P3
      - validate-vertical-flow       # P3/P4
      - validate-enumeration-universal  # P5
      - validate-fontes-apa          # P6
      - validate-action-title        # P4 (legacy regex check)
      - p1-fidelity-sampling         # P1 (flag-gated)
      - review-presentation          # PPTEval macro + killer items legacy
      # New Mission validators (MSN-2026-SLIDES-NARRATIVE-DESIGN)
      - validate-density             # T-005
      - validate-hierarchy           # T-006
      - validate-contrast            # T-007
      - validate-readability         # T-008
      - validate-visual-coherence    # T-009
      - validate-governing-thought-strength  # T-011
      - validate-action-title-rhetoric       # T-012
      - validate-scqa-depth          # T-013
      - validate-story-arc           # T-013A
      - validate-slide-function-map  # T-013B
    outputs:
      - qa-report.json               # v2, +narrative_dim + validator-reports/*
    gate: qa_verdict
    gate_preconditions:
      - qa-report.verdict == PASS
    on_gate_fail:
      dimension_router:
        narrative_fail: return_to_P01_or_P02
        design_fail: return_to_P03
        spec_fail: return_to_P04

  - id: P06
    name: "Release"
    weight_pct: 1
    session: null
    bounded_context: [BC-07, BC-08]
    agents: [slide-chief, design-renderer]
    tasks:
      - emit-deck-spec               # NEW (repeat for final state)
      - create-presentation          # existing — packaging steps
      - handoff-render-request       # NEW — BC-08 seam
      - prepare-ds-presenter         # existing — wired to P06 (resolves registry-orphan)
    outputs:
      - deliverables/Slide_Specifications.md
      - deliverables/Design_System.md
      - deliverables/References_Bibliography.md
      - deliverables/AI_Image_Prompts.md
      - deliverables/Version_History.md
      - deck-spec.yaml
      - render-request.yaml
    render_state:
      materialized: "apps/ds runtime available"
      handoff_only: "apps/ds runtime blocked — render-request.yaml emitted, not consumed"

# =============================================================================
# HARD GATES (D01/D02/D03 + QA)
# =============================================================================
gates:
  D01:
    name: "Cliente aprova análise?"
    type: approval_artifact
    artifact: "{output_dir}/checkpoints/D01.yaml"
    schema_ref: "squads/slides-creator/data/checkpoint-schema.yaml"
    required_fields: [status, approver, timestamp]
    pass_criteria: "status == approved"
    block_on: [missing, pending, rejected]
    sla_ladder:
      - { at: 24h, action: nudge_sr_consultant }
      - { at: 72h, action: escalate_C_level }
      - { at: 168h, action: auto_pause }

  D02:
    name: "Teste vertical passa E cliente aprova estrutura"
    type: approval_artifact_plus_precondition
    artifact: "{output_dir}/checkpoints/D02.yaml"
    preconditions:
      - vertical-test-result.verdict == PASS
    pass_criteria: "status == approved AND precondition satisfied"
    block_on: [missing, pending, rejected, precondition_fail]

  D03:
    name: "Cliente aprova Design Overview"
    type: approval_artifact
    artifact: "{output_dir}/checkpoints/D03.yaml"
    pass_criteria: "status == approved"
    block_on: [missing, pending, rejected]

  qa_verdict:
    name: "P05 QA verdict"
    type: computed_from_report
    source: "{output_dir}/qa-report.json"
    pass_criteria: "verdict == PASS AND narrative_dim >= 7 AND ppteval_composite >= 7"
    fail_router: dimension_router

# =============================================================================
# 7 PRINCÍPIOS INVIOLÁVEIS — enforcement wiring
# =============================================================================
invariants:
  P1:
    name: "Fidelidade aos dados"
    enforcement: [schema, semantic]
    enforced_by_tasks: [catalog-sources-apa, create-presentation, p1-fidelity-sampling]
    validator: validate-fontes-apa + validate-pyramid (data_points_traced)
    failure: "QA FAIL — data point without source_ref"

  P2:
    name: "Especificação obsessiva"
    enforcement: schema
    enforced_by_tasks: [create-presentation, emit-deck-spec]
    validator: deck-spec.schema.json (hex/grid_coord/pt_size required)
    failure: "schema validation FAIL"

  P3:
    name: "Pyramid Principle + MECE"
    enforcement: validator
    enforced_by_tasks: [build-pyramid, apply-scqa]
    validator: validate-pyramid + validate-vertical-flow
    failure: "QA FAIL — pyramid tree invalid OR MECE violated"

  P4:
    name: "Action titles"
    enforcement: validator
    enforced_by_tasks: [write-action-titles]
    validator: validate-action-title (regex + components)
    failure: "QA FAIL — title descriptive instead of action"

  P5:
    name: "Enumeração universal"
    enforcement: validator
    enforced_by_tasks: [create-presentation]
    validator: validate-enumeration-universal
    failure: "QA FAIL — visual without ID (Gráfico N, Tabela N.M)"

  P6:
    name: "Citação completa APA"
    enforcement: [schema, semantic]
    enforced_by_tasks: [catalog-sources-apa]
    validator: validate-fontes-apa
    failure: "schema FAIL — missing {org, title, date, url, access_date}"

  P7:
    name: "Prompts de IA (10 componentes)"
    enforcement: schema
    enforced_by_tasks: [create-presentation (image-spec substep)]
    validator: validate-action-title (P7 sub-check) + deck-spec.schema
    failure: "schema FAIL — image_prompt with <10 components"

# =============================================================================
# TASK REGISTRY (23 new + existing referenced)
# =============================================================================
tasks:
  # --- NEW (narrative)
  - { id: catalog-sources-apa,       responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-NARR, phase: P01 }
  - { id: distill-governing-thought, responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-NARR, phase: P01 }
  - { id: build-pyramid,             responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-NARR, phase: P01 }
  - { id: apply-scqa,                responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-NARR, phase: P01 }
  - { id: write-action-titles,       responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-NARR, phase: P02 }
  - { id: run-vertical-test,         responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-QA,   phase: P02 }
  # --- NEW (design + brand)
  - { id: classify-slide-type,       responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: P03 }
  - { id: select-chart-type,         responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: P03 }
  - { id: compose-grid-layout,       responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: P03 }
  - { id: detect-brand-override,     responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: P03 }
  - { id: register-palette-override, responsavel_type: Human,  session: null,          phase: P03 }
  - { id: resolve-active-palette,    responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: P03 }
  # --- NEW (QA validators)
  - { id: validate-pyramid,               responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-QA, phase: P05 }
  - { id: validate-vertical-flow,         responsavel_type: Agent,  session: SESSION-QA, phase: P05 }
  - { id: validate-enumeration-universal, responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-QA, phase: P05 }
  - { id: validate-fontes-apa,            responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-QA, phase: P05 }
  - { id: validate-action-title,          responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-QA, phase: P05 }
  - { id: p1-fidelity-sampling,           responsavel_type: Human,  session: null,       phase: P05 }
  # --- NEW (KB + packaging + handoff)
  - { id: load-kb-bundle,         responsavel_type: Worker, session: null,          phase: [P00, P01, P02, P03, P04] }
  - { id: emit-deck-spec,         responsavel_type: Worker, session: SESSION-SPEC, phase: [P04, P06] }
  - { id: handoff-render-request, responsavel_type: Worker, session: null,          phase: P06 }
  # --- EXISTING (referenced, not redefined)
  - { id: normalize-briefing,     responsavel_type: Agent,  phase: P00, existing: true }
  - { id: youtube-to-briefing,    responsavel_type: Agent,  phase: P00, existing: true, conditional: "input_type == youtube" }
  - { id: create-presentation,    responsavel_type: Agent,  phase: [P04, P06], existing: true }
  - { id: prepare-ds-presenter,   responsavel_type: Worker, phase: P06, existing: true }
  - { id: review-presentation,    responsavel_type: Agent,  phase: P05, existing: true }

# =============================================================================
# TRANSITIONS (condition-based edges)
# =============================================================================
transitions:
  - from: P00
    to: P01
    condition: "briefing.normalized.json exists AND kb-bundle-P01.yaml exists"
    on_fail: halt_and_surface

  - from: P01
    to: P02
    condition: "D01.status == approved"
    on_fail: halt_and_wait_for_approval

  - from: P02
    to: P03
    condition: "D02.status == approved AND vertical-test-result.verdict == PASS"
    on_fail: halt_and_wait

  - from: P03
    to: P04
    condition: "D03.status == approved AND active-palette.yaml exists"
    on_fail: halt_and_wait

  - from: P04
    to: P05
    condition: "deck-spec.yaml exists AND deck-manifest.json v2 valid"

  - from: P05
    to: P06
    condition: "qa-report.verdict == PASS"
    on_fail: dimension_router

  - from: P06
    to: complete
    condition: "deliverables emitted"

# =============================================================================
# DIMENSION ROUTER (QA FAIL fan-out)
# =============================================================================
dimension_router:
  narrative_fail:
    trigger: "validate-pyramid FAIL OR validate-vertical-flow FAIL OR validate-action-title FAIL"
    route_to: P01  # may re-run P02 if only action titles fail
  design_fail:
    trigger: "ppteval.design < 7 OR validate-enumeration-universal FAIL"
    route_to: P03
  spec_fail:
    trigger: "schema FAIL on deck-spec.yaml OR validate-fontes-apa FAIL"
    route_to: P04
  data_fidelity_fail:
    trigger: "p1-fidelity-sampling FAIL (10% spot-check)"
    route_to: P01  # re-extract with stricter prompt

# =============================================================================
# HANDOFF CONTRACTS (outbound)
# =============================================================================
handoffs:
  - to: downstream_renderer
    contract: render-request.yaml
    phase: P06
    bounded_context: BC-08
    consumer: slides-creator design-renderer (apps/ds runtime) OR slides-creator LLM-direct fallback
    fallback: handoff_only (render-request emitted, not consumed)

  - to: client
    contract: deliverables/
    phase: P06
    consumer: STK-01/STK-02/STK-03 audience + STK-07 client strategy team

# =============================================================================
# RELEASE CRITERIA
# =============================================================================
release:
  ready_when:
    - "All 6 phases completed"
    - "qa_verdict gate PASS"
    - "deliverables/ populated with 5 markdown files + deck-spec.yaml + render-request.yaml"
    - "Post-execution learning log written"

# =============================================================================
# BACK-COMPAT
# =============================================================================
back_compat:
  skip_narrative_mode:
    trigger: "flag --skip-narrative OR workflow.global.feature_flags.skip_narrative == true"
    bypass_phases: [P01, P02, P03_narrative_subset]
    reuses: "original v1.5 sequence (briefing → content → visual strategy → template → assets → render → qa → release)"
    version_marker: "workflow v1.5-compat"
    deprecation: "planned removal at v2.2 — 1 release after ADR-021 lands"
```
